l-m-h3-b0c42-03.title: Mmadụ ole ka a ga-ahọrọ na klaasị nke ọ bụla?
l-m-h3-b0c42-03.topic: Nlele e kewara na nha nlele
l-m-h3-b0c42-03.goal: Site n'ọtụtụ ọnọdụ nha nlele site na klaasị mgbe e kewara ụlọ akwụkwọ dịka klaasị, chọta iwu ma jiri ọnọdụ ọhụrụ nyochaa ya.
l-m-h3-b0c42-03.material: Ụlọ akwụkwọ P (400, 300, 300 ụmụ akwụkwọ n’otu klaasị) họọrọ mmadụ 100 dịka 40, 30, 30. Q (500, 300, 200) họọrọ 50 dịka 25, 15, 10. Chọta iwu ịhọrọ.
l-m-h3-b0c42-03.s.s1.prompt: Kedu otu ị ga-esi họrọ mmadụ 40 n’ụlọ akwụkwọ R (600, 300, 100)?
l-m-h3-b0c42-03.s.s1.r.b: I họọrọ ole na ole n'ọtụtụ klaasị, n'usoro megidere ọnụ ọgụgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ.
l-m-h3-b0c42-03.s.s1.r.c: I jiri oke Q 5:3:2 dịka ọ dị.
l-m-h3-b0c42-03.s.s1.r.d: I leghaara nha klaasị anya, kesaa ihe fọrọ nke nta ka hà.
l-m-h3-b0c42-03.s.s1.explain: Nha nlele nke klaasị kwekọrọ na oke klaasị ahụ n'ime ngụkọta. 600:300:100 na-enye 24:12:4.
l-m-h3-b0c42-03.s.s2.model.0: Oke klaasị R bụ 6:3:1; ikesa mmadụ 40 n’otu oke ahụ na-enye 24, 12, 4.
l-m-h3-b0c42-03.s.s2.model.1: Ụlọ akwụkwọ abụọ gara aga kekwara nlele dịka ọnụ ọgụgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ; ya mere R kwesịkwara iso oke ahụ. 60% nke 40 bụ 24.

l-m-h3-b0c42-13.title: Ihe kpatara zoro ezo n’azụ ụkpụrụ abụọ na-arị ma daa ọnụ
l-m-h3-b0c42-13.goal: Site n’ọtụtụ ọnọdụ nke common factor dị n’azụ ụkpụrụ abụọ na-agbanwe ọnụ, chọta ma kwuo iwu ahụ, ma nyochaa n’ọnọdụ ọhụrụ.
l-m-h3-b0c42-13.material: Ọnọdụ na-eto ma na-ebelata ọnụ: ① okwu ọhụrụ na ịdị elu (afọ) ② ire igwe ikuku na ire ihe ọṅụṅụ (okpomọkụ) ③ akara ọgụgụ na nha akpụkpọ ụkwụ (klaasị). Tinye iwu ahụ n’“ire nche anwụ na ọnụọgụ ndị bịara n’azụ”.
l-m-h3-b0c42-13.s.s1.prompt: Mgbe ire nche anwụ na ndị bịara n’azụ na-abawanye ọnụ, nkọwa dabara bụ nke aṅaa?
l-m-h3-b0c42-13.s.s1.o.a: A na-ere ọtụtụ nche anwụ, ya mere ụmụ akwụkwọ na-abịa n’azụ
l-m-h3-b0c42-13.s.s1.r.a: O chere na otu bụ ihe kpatara ibe ya.
l-m-h3-b0c42-13.s.s1.o.b: Ụmụ akwụkwọ na-abịa n’azụ, ya mere a na-ere ọtụtụ nche anwụ
l-m-h3-b0c42-13.s.s1.r.b: O chere na ntụziaka ihe kpatara ya na nsonaazụ ya gbanwere.
l-m-h3-b0c42-13.s.s1.o.c: Agba nche anwụ na-ekpebi ma mmadụ ga-abịa n’azụ
l-m-h3-b0c42-13.s.s1.r.c: O mepụtara mmekọrịta ọhụrụ n’enweghị ntọala.
l-m-h3-b0c42-13.s.s1.o.d: Ụbọchị mmiri ozuzo nwere ike ibuli ha abụọ
l-m-h3-b0c42-13.s.s1.explain: Dịka n’ọnọdụ ndị gara aga, n’azụ uru abụọ na-agbanwe ọnụ nwere ike ịdị 3rd factor na-emetụta ha abụọ. N’ebe a, mmiri ozuzo dabara.
l-m-h3-b0c42-13.s.s2.model.0: Na ① ruo ③, 3rd factor dịka afọ, okpomọkụ, ma ọ bụ ọkwa mere ka uru abụọ ahụ na-agbanwe ọnụ; ya mere maka nche anwụ na ndị bịara n’azụkwa, mmiri ozuzo nwere ike ịbụ ihe kpatara ha abụọ.
l-m-h3-b0c42-13.s.s2.model.1: Tupu i were ya na otu na-akpata ibe ya, chọọ ihe na-emetụta ha abụọ; ya mere ụbọchị mmiri ozuzo kacha dabara.

l-m-h3-b0c42-19.title: Gịnị na-eme uru a tụrụ anya ma iwu onyinye gbanwee?
l-m-h3-b0c42-19.goal: Lee ọtụtụ ikpe nke uru a tụrụ anya mgbe a gbanwere iwu onyinye, kwupụta iwu ahụ, jiri ikpe ọhụrụ nwalee ya.
l-m-h3-b0c42-19.material: Anyị lere uru a tụrụ anya Y, nke e nwetara site n’ịgbanwe iwu onyinye X. E(X)=3, Y=2X → 6. E(X)=5, Y=X+4 → 9. E(X)=2, Y=3X−1 → 5. Chọta iwu ahụ.
l-m-h3-b0c42-19.s.s1.prompt: Mgbe E(X)=10, gịnị bụ uru a tụrụ anya Y=0.5X+3?
l-m-h3-b0c42-19.s.s1.r.b: E mekwara ka 3 a gbakwụnyere mụbaa na 0.5.
l-m-h3-b0c42-19.s.s1.r.d: Echefuru 0.5 a ga-eji mụbaa, gbakwụnyere naanị 3.
l-m-h3-b0c42-19.s.s1.explain: Uru a tụrụ anya Y=aX+b bụ a×E(X)+b. 0.5×10+3=8.
l-m-h3-b0c42-19.s.s2.model.0: N’ihe atụ ndị ahụ, 2×3=6, 5+4=9, 3×2−1=5; ọnụọgụ e ji mụbaa na-amụba uru a tụrụ anya, nke e gbakwụnyere na-agbakwụnyekwa: 0.5×10+3=8.
l-m-h3-b0c42-19.s.s2.model.1: Uru a tụrụ anya Y bụ otu usoro etinyere na uru a tụrụ anya X; itinye 10 na-enye 0.5×10+3=8.

l-m-h3-b0c42-25.title: Kedu ụdị nkezi nkezi nlele niile na-enwe?
l-m-h3-b0c42-25.goal: Lee ọtụtụ ikpe nke nkezi nlele niile, kwupụta iwu ahụ, jiri ikpe ọhụrụ nwalee ya.
l-m-h3-b0c42-25.material: Anyị wepụtara nlele nha 2 site n’otu nnukwu ìgwè, na-etinyeghachi ihe, wee chọta nkezi nlele niile. Maka {1,3}, nkezi nkezi nlele bụ 2; maka {1,2,6}, ọ bụ 3.
l-m-h3-b0c42-25.s.s1.prompt: Maka nnukwu ìgwè {2,2,8}, gịnị bụ nkezi nlele niile?
l-m-h3-b0c42-25.s.s1.r.a: E jiri median 2 mee ihe. Ọ dabaghị n’ikpe gara aga {1,2,6}.
l-m-h3-b0c42-25.s.s1.r.c: E jiri etiti uru kacha nta na nke kacha ukwuu (2 na 8) mee ihe.
l-m-h3-b0c42-25.s.s1.explain: Nkezi nlele niile hà nhata nkezi nnukwu ìgwè. Nkezi {2,2,8} bụ 4.
l-m-h3-b0c42-25.s.s2.model.0: {1,3} na-enye 2, {1,2,6} na-enye 3, nke ha nhata nkezi nnukwu ìgwè ma dị iche na median; ya mere {2,2,8} na-enye nkezi 4.
l-m-h3-b0c42-25.s.s2.model.1: Ikpe abụọ gara aga kwadoro iwu na nkezi nlele hà nhata nkezi nnukwu ìgwè; ya mere (2+2+8)÷3=4.

l-m-h3-b0c43-03.title: Ịchọta iwu maka ịhọrọ ọnụọgụ
l-m-h3-b0c43-03.goal: Lelee ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke iwu ịhọrọ n'usoro ọnụọgụ n'oge dị nhata, kwuo iwu ị chọpụtara, ma jiri ihe atụ ọhụrụ nwalee ya.
l-m-h3-b0c43-03.material: A họpụtara ụmụ akwụkwọ n'ime ndị e nyere nọmba site na 1 ruo N, n'ime ụmụ akwụkwọ n, dịka iwu si dị. 5 n'ime 100: nọmba 7, 27, 47, 67, 87. 6 n'ime 60: nọmba 4, 14, 24, 34, 44, 54. Chọta iwu ahụ.
l-m-h3-b0c43-03.s.s1.prompt: Ọ bụrụ na a họrọ 8 n'ime 80 ma nọmba mmalite bụ 3, kedu nọmba a ga-ahọrọ?
l-m-h3-b0c43-03.s.s1.r.a: E ji nọmba mmalite 3 mee oghere dị n'etiti nhọrọ.
l-m-h3-b0c43-03.s.s1.r.b: E ji ọnụ ọgụgụ nlele 8 mee oghere dị n'etiti nhọrọ.
l-m-h3-b0c43-03.s.s1.explain: Oghere dị n'etiti bụ ngụkọta ọnụ ọgụgụ÷ọnụ ọgụgụ nlele (100÷5=20, 60÷6=10). 80÷8=10, ya mere malite na 3 ma tinye 10 oge ọ bụla.
l-m-h3-b0c43-03.s.s2.model.0: N'ihe atụ abụọ ahụ oghere bụ 100÷5=20 na 60÷6=10, ya bụ ngụkọta ọnụ ọgụgụ÷ọnụ ọgụgụ nlele; ya mere tinye 80÷8=10 oge ọ bụla, nweta nọmba 3, 13, …, 73.
l-m-h3-b0c43-03.s.s2.model.1: Ozugbo e setịpụrụ nọmba mmalite, nọmba ndị ọzọ na-aga n'ihu n'oghere nhata, ya mere malite na 3 ma tinye 10.

l-m-h3-b0c43-08.title: Ego ole dị n’ime mean ± standard deviation?
l-m-h3-b0c43-08.goal: Lelee ọtụtụ ọnọdụ nke proportion dị n’ime interval otu standard deviation site na mean, kwuo iwu ị chọtara, ma nyochaa ya n’ọnọdụ ọhụrụ.
l-m-h3-b0c43-08.material: Ndị a bụ ule ebe akara gbasara dịka bell. Na mean 50 na standard deviation 10, ihe dịka 68% dị n’isi 40 ruo 60; na mean 80 na standard deviation 5, ihe dịka 68% dị n’isi 75 ruo 85; na mean 20 na standard deviation 4, ihe dịka 68% dị n’isi 16 ruo 24.
l-m-h3-b0c43-08.s.s1.prompt: N’ule mean ya bụ 70 na standard deviation 8, kedu interval nwere ihe dịka 68%?
l-m-h3-b0c43-08.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụ mean ± 2 × standard deviation, ya mere interval nwere ihe dịka 95%.
l-m-h3-b0c43-08.s.s1.explain: Ihe dịka 68% bụ interval na-aga 1 standard deviation n’akụkụ abụọ nke mean. 70±8, ya bụ isi 62 ruo 78.
l-m-h3-b0c43-08.s.s2.model.0: N’ọnọdụ atọ ahụ niile, ihe dịka 68% dị site na mean − standard deviation ruo mean + standard deviation; ya mere site na 70−8=62 ruo 70+8=78.
l-m-h3-b0c43-08.s.s2.model.1: Na mean 50 na standard deviation 10 ọ bụ 40 ruo 60; otu a, anyị na-agbakwunye ma wepụ standard deviation 8 n’akụkụ abụọ nke 70.

l-m-h3-b0c43-12.title: Iwu zoro ezo n’etiti mmefu mgbasa ozi na ire
l-m-h3-b0c43-12.goal: Chọta ma kwuo iwu site n’ọtụtụ ọnọdụ nke ire e buru amụma maka mmefu mgbasa ozi dị iche, ma nyochaa iwu ahụ n’ọnọdụ ọhụrụ.
l-m-h3-b0c43-12.material: Maka mmefu mgbasa ozi x iri puku won, ire e buru amụma bụ y iri puku won. Mgbe x bụ 0, y bụ 50; mgbe x bụ 10, y bụ 80; mgbe x bụ 20, y bụ 110. Chọta iwu ahụ.
l-m-h3-b0c43-12.s.s1.prompt: Mgbe mmefu mgbasa ozi bụ 35 iri puku won, gịnị bụ ire e buru amụma?
l-m-h3-b0c43-12.s.s1.r.a: Ọ gbakwunyere mmefu mgbasa ozi 35 dịka ọ dị na ntọala 50.
l-m-h3-b0c43-12.s.s1.r.d: Ọ gbakwunyere 35×3 ọzọ na 110. Ma 110 bụrịrị uru mgbe mmefu mgbasa ozi bụ 20.
l-m-h3-b0c43-12.s.s1.explain: Mgbe mmefu mgbasa ozi mụbara 10, ire mụbara 30, ya bụ 3 maka 1. Ịgbakwunye 3×35 na ntọala 50 na-enye 155.
l-m-h3-b0c43-12.s.s2.model.0: Oge ọ bụla x rịrị 10, y rịrị 30, ya bụ 3 maka 1; mgbe x bụ 0, y bụ 50. Ya mere 50+3×35=155 iri puku won.
l-m-h3-b0c43-12.s.s2.model.1: N’ọnọdụ ndị a, y=50+3x dabara n’ụkpụrụ niile, ya mere itinye 35 na-enye amụma 50+105=155.

l-m-h3-b0c44-10.s.s1.r.a: Ka n na-ebuwanye ibu, mgbasa nke nkezi nlele na-ebelata mgbe niile.
l-m-h3-b0c44-10.s.s1.r.b: Mgbe n ghọrọ okpukpu 4, uru ahụ na-aghọ ọkara, ọ bụghị 1/4.

l-m-h3-b0c44-12.goal: Lelee ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke mgbasa ọkọlọtọ mgbe a gbanwere akara, kwuo iwu ị chọpụtara, ma jiri ihe atụ ọhụrụ nwalee ya.
l-m-h3-b0c44-12.material: Nkezi akara bụ 60, mgbasa ọkọlọtọ bụ 10. Ọ bụrụ na ị gbakwunye 5 na akara niile, nkezi na-aghọ 65, mgbasa ọkọlọtọ adịgide 10; ọ bụrụ na ị mụbaa akara niile na 2, nkezi na-aghọ 120, mgbasa ọkọlọtọ na-aghọ 20.
l-m-h3-b0c44-12.s.s1.prompt: Ọ bụrụ na ị mụba akara niile na 3 wepụ 4, gịnị bụ standard deviation?
l-m-h3-b0c44-12.s.s1.r.b: Ihe agbakwunyere ma ọ bụ e wepụrụ anaghị emetụta standard deviation.
l-m-h3-b0c44-12.s.s1.r.c: Iwepụ nọmba anaghị agbanwe mgbasa. Ọ na-agbanwe naanị site n’ọnụọgụ ị mụbara.
l-m-h3-b0c44-12.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụrụ na i mụbaa, standard deviation na-abawanyekwa site n’ọnụọgụ ị mụbara.

l-m-h3-b0c44-12.s.s2.model.0: Ịgbakwunye ma ọ bụ iwepụ na-akpali ụkpụrụ niile ọnụ, ya mere mgbasa na-anọ otu; naanị ịmụba ugboro 3 ka a na-etinye, nke na-enye 30.
l-m-h3-b0c44-12.s.s2.model.1: Mgbe anyị mụbara na 2, standard deviation ghọkwara okpukpu 2; ya mere maka okpukpu 3 ọ bụ 30, iwepụ 4 enweghị mmetụta.

l-m-h3-b0c44-13.title: Proportion akara 90 ma ọ bụ karịa na normal distribution
l-m-h3-b0c44-13.goal: Lelee ọtụtụ ọnọdụ nke proportion gburugburu mean na normal distribution, kwuo iwu ị hụrụ ma nyochaa ya n’ọnọdụ ọhụrụ.
l-m-h3-b0c44-13.material: Akara ule na-agbaso normal distribution nwere mean 70 na standard deviation 10. Ihe dịka 68% nke ụmụ akwụkwọ nwetara isi 60 ruo 80, ihe dịka 95% nwetara isi 50 ruo 90, ihe dịka 99.7% nwetara isi 40 ruo 100.
l-m-h3-b0c44-13.s.s1.prompt: Site n’iji iwu ahụ, ihe dịka pasentị ole nwetara isi 90 ma ọ bụ karịa?
l-m-h3-b0c44-13.s.s1.r.a: 5% bụ ngụkọta nke ndị nwere 50 ma ọ bụ obere na ndị nwere 90 ma ọ bụ karịa. Ị ga-achọta naanị otu akụkụ.
l-m-h3-b0c44-13.s.s1.r.b: 16% bụ proportion akara 80 ma ọ bụ karịa.
l-m-h3-b0c44-13.s.s1.r.d: 0.15% bụ proportion akara 100 ma ọ bụ karịa.
l-m-h3-b0c44-13.s.s1.explain: 50 ruo 90 bụ 95%, ya mere ikewa 5% dị n’èzí n’etiti akụkụ abụọ na-enye ihe dịka 2.5% maka 90 ma ọ bụ karịa.
l-m-h3-b0c44-13.s.s2.model.0: 50 ruo 90 bụ 95%, ya mere ikewa 5% dị n’èzí n’etiti akụkụ abụọ na-enye 2.5% maka 90 ma ọ bụ karịa.
l-m-h3-b0c44-13.s.s2.model.1: Normal distribution nwere symmetry n’aka ekpe na aka nri; ya mere 90 ma ọ bụ karịa na 50 ma ọ bụ obere hà nhata, ngụkọta ha bụ 5%, otu akụkụ bụ 2.5%.

l-m-h3-b0c45-11.goal: Chọta ma kwuo usoro site n’ọtụtụ ọnọdụ nke ọnụọgụ afọ ruo mgbe aha afọ sexagenary kwekọrọ ọzọ na nke mbụ, ma nyochaa ya n’ọnọdụ ọhụrụ.
l-m-h3-b0c45-11.material: Aha afọ na-ejikọta heavenly stems 10 na earthly branches 12 n’usoro. Mgbe Gapja gasịrị, Eulchuk, Byeongin, … afọ 10 mgbe afọ Gapja gachara, naanị stem ya na nke Gapja hà; afọ 12 gasịrị, naanị branch ya hà.
l-m-h3-b0c45-11.s.s1.prompt: Afọ ole gachara ka afọ mbụ nwere stem na branch kpọmkwem otu na afọ Gapja ga-abịa?
l-m-h3-b0c45-11.s.s1.r.a: Ị gbakwunyere 10 na 12. A ga-achọta afọ mgbe okirikiri abụọ ahụ kwekọrọ n’otu oge.
l-m-h3-b0c45-11.s.s1.r.b: Stem ndị ahụ hà nhata, ma branch dị iche. Ihe fọdụrụ nke 30÷12 bụ 6.
l-m-h3-b0c45-11.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụ afọ kwekọrọ, ma ọ bụghị afọ mbụ ọ na-alọghachi.
l-m-h3-b0c45-11.s.s1.explain: Kwa afọ 60, least common multiple nke 10 na 12, stem na branch na-ejikọta nke mbụ. Ọ bụ ya mere a ji kpọọ ya cycle afọ 60.
l-m-h3-b0c45-11.s.s2.model.0: Stem na-emegharị kwa afọ 10, branch kwa afọ 12; ya mere afọ mbụ ha abụọ kwekọrọ n’otu oge bụ afọ 60, least common multiple nke 10 na 12.
l-m-h3-b0c45-11.s.s2.model.1: Afọ 30 gachara, naanị stem ahụ hà, branch dịkwa nzọụkwụ 6 n’akụkụ, ya mere ọ naghị arụ ọrụ. Ọ bụ ya mere afọ 60 ji bụrụ nke mbụ.

l-m-h3-b0c45-12.goal: Chọta ma kwuo usoro site n’ọtụtụ ọnọdụ nke ọnụọgụ triangle n’ọkwa nke ọ bụla nke Sierpinski triangle, ma nyochaa ya n’ọnọdụ ọhụrụ.
l-m-h3-b0c45-12.material: Malite na triangle agba 1, n’ọkwa ọ bụla gbanwee triangle nke ọ bụla ka ọ bụrụ triangle nta 3 ma wepụ nke etiti. Ọkwa 0 nwere 1, ọkwa 1 nwere 3, ọkwa 2 nwere 9.
l-m-h3-b0c45-12.s.s1.prompt: N’iji usoro ahụ, triangle ole dị n’ọkwa 5?
l-m-h3-b0c45-12.s.s1.r.a: Ị gbakọrọ 3×5. Ọ na-aghọ okpukpu 3 n’ọkwa ọ bụla.
l-m-h3-b0c45-12.s.s1.r.b: Ị mụbara 3 naanị ugboro 4. Maka ọkwa 5, a ga-amụba ugboro 5.
l-m-h3-b0c45-12.s.s1.r.c: Ị mụbara 5 n’onwe ya ugboro 3. Nọmba a na-amụba bụ 3, ugboro a na-amụba bụkwa ọkwa ahụ.
l-m-h3-b0c45-12.s.s1.explain: Ọ na-aghọ okpukpu 3 n’ọkwa ọ bụla, ya mere ọkwa n bụ 3 e mụbara ugboro n. Ọkwa 5 bụ 3⁵=243.
l-m-h3-b0c45-12.s.s2.model.0: Ọ na-aghọ okpukpu 3 n’ọkwa ọ bụla: 1, 3, 9; ya mere ọkwa 5 bụ 3 e mụbara ugboro 5, ya bụ 243.
l-m-h3-b0c45-12.s.s2.model.1: Otu triangle na-aghọ 3, ya mere ọnụọgụ na-aghọ okpukpu 3 oge ọ bụla. Ọ na-aga n’ihu 27, 81, 243; ya mere ọkwa 5 bụ 243.

l-m-h3-b0c45-13.goal: Chọta ma kwuo usoro site n’ọtụtụ ụzọ ijikọta nọmba odd iji mepụta Pythagorean triple, ma nyochaa ya n’ọnọdụ ọhụrụ.
l-m-h3-b0c45-13.material: (3, 4, 5), (5, 12, 13), na (7, 24, 25) bụ nọmba nwere ike ịbụ akụkụ atọ nke right triangle. Nọmba kacha nta bụ odd, abụọ ndị ọzọ na-esochi ibe ha.
l-m-h3-b0c45-13.s.s1.prompt: N’ịgbaso otu usoro ahụ, mgbe nọmba kacha nta bụ 9, gịnị bụ nọmba abụọ ndị ọzọ?
l-m-h3-b0c45-13.s.s1.r.b: 9²+20²=481 na 21²=441, ya mere ọ naghị arụ ọrụ.
l-m-h3-b0c45-13.s.s1.r.c: Ọ na-eme right angle, ma nọmba abụọ ndị ọzọ anaghị esochi ibe ha.
l-m-h3-b0c45-13.s.s1.r.d: 9²+41²=1762 na 42²=1764, ya mere ọ naghị arụ ọrụ.
l-m-h3-b0c45-13.s.s1.explain: Iwu: mgbe obere nọmba bụ n, ndị ọzọ bụ (n²−1)/2 na (n²+1)/2. Maka 9, ha bụ 40 na 41, 81+1600=1681=41².
l-m-h3-b0c45-13.s.s2.model.0: 9²=81. Iwepụ 1 na nọmba a ma kewaa na 2 na-enye 40; ịgbakwunye 1 ma kewaa na 2 na-enye 41. 81+1600=1681=41², ya mere ọ na-arụ ọrụ.
l-m-h3-b0c45-13.s.s2.model.1: Dịka 3→4,5; 5→12,13; 7→24,25, n² bụ ngụkọta nọmba abụọ na-esochi ibe ha. Ya mere 81=40+41, ndị kwekọrọ na 9 bụ 40 na 41.

l-m-h3-b0c46-09.title: Ọtụtụ ntụpọ ole ka ị ga-enweta ma ị chịkọba ha n’usoro triangle?
l-m-h3-b0c46-09.goal: Chọta ma kwupụta usoro dị n’ihe atụ dị iche iche nke ọnụ ọgụgụ ntụpọ a chịkọbara ka ha dị ka triangle, ma jiri ikpe ọhụrụ nwalee usoro ahụ.
l-m-h3-b0c46-09.material: Ndị Pythagorean Gris oge ochie ji ntụpọ a chịkọbara n’ụdị triangle kee nọmba. Ahịrị 1 nwere ntụpọ 1, ahịrị 2 nwere 3, ahịrị 3 nwere 6, ahịrị 4 nwere 10, ahịrị 5 nwekwara 15.
l-m-h3-b0c46-09.s.s1.prompt: Site n’usoro ahụ, ntụpọ ole ga-adị ma ahịrị dị 10?
l-m-h3-b0c46-09.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ nchikọta ruo n’ahịrị 9. Ị ga-agbakwunye ntụpọ 10 nke ahịrị nke 10.
l-m-h3-b0c46-09.s.s1.r.c: A gbakọrọ nke a dịka 10×10. Nchikọta ahụ na-abawanye otu n’ahịrị ọ bụla.
l-m-h3-b0c46-09.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ 10×11. Ị ga-ekewa ya abụọ.
l-m-h3-b0c46-09.s.s1.explain: Maka ahịrị n, ọ bụ nchikọta site na 1 ruo n, ya bụ n(n+1)/2. Maka 10 ahịrị, 10×11/2=55.

l-m-h3-b0c46-10.goal: Chọta ma kwupụta usoro dị n’ihe atụ dị iche iche nke nọmba praịm ndị a chọrọ iji mata nọmba praịm ruo N, ma jiri ikpe ọhụrụ nwalee usoro ahụ.
l-m-h3-b0c46-10.material: Iji mata nọmba praịm site na 1 ruo N, gafee akara n’ọtụtụ nke nọmba praịm nta. Maka 30 ma ọ bụ obere, ruo 2, 3, 5 ezuola; maka 50 ma ọ bụ obere, ruo 2, 3, 5, 7; maka 100 ma ọ bụ obere, ruo 7 ezuola.
l-m-h3-b0c46-10.s.s1.prompt: Chọta usoro ahụ ma họrọ nọmba praịm kacha ukwuu achọrọ iji mata nọmba praịm ruo 200.
l-m-h3-b0c46-10.s.s1.r.a: 169=13² abụghị ọtụtụ nke 7, ya mere a naghị agafe ya akara ma ọ na-adị.
l-m-h3-b0c46-10.s.s1.r.b: 169=13×13 abụghị nke 11 na-ekewa, ya mere ọ ka dị.
l-m-h3-b0c46-10.s.s1.explain: Ị ga-agafe akara naanị ruo nọmba praịm p nke p² hà ma ọ bụ dị obere karịa N. 13²=169≤200<17², ya mere ruo 13.
l-m-h3-b0c46-10.s.s2.model.0: Nọmba mejupụtara nwere ihe nkewa praịm nke square ya hà ma ọ bụ dị obere karịa N, ya mere gafee akara ruo 13, nke bụ praịm kacha ukwuu nwere p²≤200.
l-m-h3-b0c46-10.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na ị gafee akara naanị ruo 11, 13×13=169 ga-adị; mana 17²=289>200, ya mere 13 ezuola.

l-m-h3-b0c46-11.title: Ogologo ogo ole ka ifuru a haziri n’usoro ga-atụgharị ka o dakọrịta onwe ya?
l-m-h3-b0c46-11.goal: Chọta ma kwupụta usoro dị n’ihe atụ nke obere ogo ntụgharị maka ọnụ ọgụgụ petal ọ bụla, ma jiri ikpe ọhụrụ nwalee ya.
l-m-h3-b0c46-11.material: Ị chọrọ ịtụgharị ụkpụrụ petal ya hà nhata n’etiti ha ka o wee dakọrịta ọdịdị mmalite ya. Maka petal 4, ọ dakọtara mgbe ntụgharị 90°; petal 6, 60°; petal 8, 45°; petal 10, 36°.
l-m-h3-b0c46-11.s.s1.prompt: Maka petal 12, kedu obere ogo ntụgharị mbụ ọ ga-eji dakọrịta?
l-m-h3-b0c46-11.s.s1.r.b: Nke a bụ ogo maka petal 10.
l-m-h3-b0c46-11.s.s1.r.c: Eji ọnụ ọgụgụ petal mee ogo ahụ. Ị ga-ekewa 360°.
l-m-h3-b0c46-11.s.s1.r.d: Nke a bụ ogo maka petal 6.
l-m-h3-b0c46-11.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụ 360° nke otu ntụgharị zuru ezu, nke e kewara site n’ọnụọgụ petal. 360÷12=30°.
l-m-h3-b0c46-11.s.s2.model.0: Maka petal 4, 6, 8, na 10, ogo ahụ bụ 360÷ọnụọgụ petal; ya mere maka 12, 360÷12=30°.
l-m-h3-b0c46-11.s.s2.model.1: Oghere dị n’etiti petal hà nhata, ya mere ntụgharị 30°—otu n’ime akụkụ 12 nhata nke ntụgharị zuru ezu—na-eme ka ọ dakọrịta.

l-m-h3-b0c46-12.topic: Fọdụrụ mgbe e ji 9 kee nọmba
l-m-h3-b0c46-12.goal: Chọta ma kwupụta usoro dị n’ihe atụ dị iche iche nke fọdụrụ mgbe e ji 9 kee nọmba, ma jiri ikpe ọhụrụ nwalee usoro ahụ.
l-m-h3-b0c46-12.material: Ndị na-agbakọ oge ochie na-achọta fọdụrụ nnukwu nọmba mgbe e ji 9 kee ya n’ụzọ dị mfe. Maka 123, nchikọta mkpụrụedemede ọnụọgụ ya bụ 6, fọdụrụ ya bụ 6. Maka 4567, nchikọta ya bụ 22, fọdụrụ ya bụ 4. Maka 8109, nchikọta ya bụ 18, fọdụrụ ya bụ 0.
l-m-h3-b0c46-12.s.s1.prompt: Jiri usoro ahụ chọta ihe fọdụrụ mgbe e ji 9 kee 73819.
l-m-h3-b0c46-12.s.s1.r.b: Nke a bụ nchikọta ọnụọgụ ya. Chọta ihe fọdụrụ mgbe e ji 9 kee nchikọta ahụ ọzọ.
l-m-h3-b0c46-12.s.s1.explain: Ihe fọdụrụ mgbe e ji 9 kee nchikọta 7+3+8+1+9=28 bụ 1; nke a bụkwa ihe fọdụrụ 73819. 9×8202=73818.
l-m-h3-b0c46-12.s.s2.model.0: Nchikọta ọnụọgụ 28 na-ahapụ ihe fọdụrụ 1 mgbe e ji 9 kee ya, ya mere 73819 na-ahapụkwa ihe fọdụrụ 1.
l-m-h3-b0c46-12.s.s2.model.1: Na 123, 4567, na 8109, ihe fọdụrụ nke nchikọta ahụ dabara na nke nọmba ahụ; ya mere dịka usoro ahụ si dị, 28→1, a na-enyochakwa ya n’ihi na 9×8202=73818.

l-m-h3-b0c46-13.topic: Ụkpụrụ Euler banyere ihe siri ike nwere ihu dị larịị
l-m-h3-b0c46-13.goal: Chọta ma kwupụta usoro dị n’ihe atụ dị iche iche nke ọnụ ọgụgụ isi, akụkụ, na ihu nke ihe ndị a, ma jiri ikpe ọhụrụ nwalee ya.
l-m-h3-b0c46-13.material: Igbe cube nwere isi 8, akụkụ 12, na ihu 6; pyramid ntọala square nwere 5, 8, na 5; prism triangle nwere 6, 9, na 5. Chọọ mmekọrịta dị n’etiti ọnụọgụ ndị a.
l-m-h3-b0c46-13.s.s1.prompt: Ọ bụrụ na prism ntọala pentagon nwere isi 10 na ihu 7, akụkụ ole ka o nwere?
l-m-h3-b0c46-13.s.s1.r.a: Nke a wepụrụ 4 na 17. N’ime mmekọrịta ahụ, naanị 2 ka a na-ewepụ.
l-m-h3-b0c46-13.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ nchikọta isi na ihu. Ị ga-ewepụ 2.
l-m-h3-b0c46-13.s.s1.r.d: Nke a gbakwụnyere 2 kama iwepụ ya.
l-m-h3-b0c46-13.s.s2.model.0: Maka ụdị atọ ahụ, isi−akụkụ+ihu=2; ya mere ọnụ ọgụgụ akụkụ bụ 10+7−2=15.
l-m-h3-b0c46-13.s.s2.model.1: 8−12+6, 5−8+5, na 6−9+5 niile bụ 2; site n’otu mmekọrịta ahụ, 10−akụkụ+7=2, ya mere akụkụ ya bụ 15.

l-m-h3-b0c47-10.goal: Chọta iwu site n’ọtụtụ ikpe nke otú ugboro si agbanwe dabere n’ogologo eriri, kwupụta ya, jiri ikpe ọhụrụ nwalee ya.
l-m-h3-b0c47-10.material: A pịrị eriri nwere otu esemokwu ka o si n’ogologo ntụaka 120cm dị mkpụmkpụ, ugboro ya agbanwekwara. Ogologo 120cm bụ 1×, 60cm bụ 2×, 40cm bụ 3×, 30cm bụ 4×.
l-m-h3-b0c47-10.s.s1.prompt: Mgbe ogologo ya bụ 20cm, ugboro ya bụ ugboro ole nke ntụaka?
l-m-h3-b0c47-10.s.s1.r.a: Ị na-agbakwunye 1 n’ọtụtụ ugboro n’usoro nke ọ bụla. Lelee 120÷20.
l-m-h3-b0c47-10.s.s1.r.b: Ị wepụrụ 120−20. Iwu ahụ bụ mmekọrịta ịmụba na ikewa.
l-m-h3-b0c47-10.s.s1.r.d: Ị chegharịrị ya. Mgbe eriri dị mkpụmkpụ, ugboro ya na-arị elu.
l-m-h3-b0c47-10.s.s1.explain: Ogologo × ọtụtụ ugboro na-abụ 120 mgbe niile (60×2, 40×3, 30×4). Mgbe ọ bụ 20cm, 120÷20=6 ugboro.
l-m-h3-b0c47-10.s.s2.model.0: Ịmụba ogologo ahụ na ọnụọgụ ugboro na-enye 120 mgbe niile; ya mere na 20cm, 120÷20=6 ugboro.
l-m-h3-b0c47-10.s.s2.model.1: Mgbe ogologo bụ ọkara, ọ bụ 2×; mgbe ọ bụ 1/3, ọ bụ 3×. Ha na-emegiderịta ibe ha n’otu oke, ya mere 20cm nke bụ 1/6 na-enye 6×.

l-m-h3-b0c47-11.title: Kedu usoro dị na nchikọta ahịrị triangle?
l-m-h3-b0c47-11.goal: Chọta iwu site n’ọtụtụ ikpe nke nchikọta nọmba dị n’ahịrị triangle Pascal, kwupụta ya, jiri ikpe ọhụrụ nwalee ya.
l-m-h3-b0c47-11.material: Na triangle Pascal, gbakọta nọmba niile dị n’ahịrị nke ọ bụla. Ahịrị 1 bụ 1, nchikọta ya 1; ahịrị 2 bụ 1 1, nchikọta 2; ahịrị 3 bụ 1 2 1, nchikọta 4; ahịrị 4 bụ 1 3 3 1, nchikọta 8; ahịrị 5 bụ 1 4 6 4 1, nchikọta 16.
l-m-h3-b0c47-11.s.s1.prompt: Gịnị bụ nchikọta nọmba niile dị n’ahịrị 8?
l-m-h3-b0c47-11.s.s1.r.a: Nke ahụ bụ nchikọta ahịrị 7. E tinyere nọmba ahịrị na ike n’otu ebe na-ezighi ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c47-11.s.s1.r.b: Ị gbakọrọ 2⁸. Nchikọta ahịrị n bụ 2ⁿ⁻¹.
l-m-h3-b0c47-11.s.s1.r.c: Ị gbakwụnyere 1 ruo 8. Nchikọta ahụ na-amụba okpukpu 2 n’ahịrị nke ọ bụla.
l-m-h3-b0c47-11.s.s1.explain: Nchikọta 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 na-amụba okpukpu 2 oge ọ bụla; ya mere ahịrị n bụ 2ⁿ⁻¹. Ahịrị 8 bụ 2⁷=128.
l-m-h3-b0c47-11.s.s2.model.0: Nchikọta ahụ na-amụba okpukpu 2 n’ahịrị nke ọ bụla; ya mere ahịrị 8 bụ 1 e jiri 2 mụbaa ugboro 7, nke bụ 128.
l-m-h3-b0c47-11.s.s2.model.1: Site na 16 dị n’ahịrị 5, ịmụba ya na 2 ugboro 3 ọzọ na-enye 32, 64, 128; ya mere azịza bụ 128.

l-m-h3-b0c47-12.title: Ka ọnụ ọgụgụ akụkụ na-abawanye, gịnị na-eme otu akụkụ ime nke polygon mgbe niile?
l-m-h3-b0c47-12.topic: Otu akụkụ ime nke polygon mgbe niile
l-m-h3-b0c47-12.goal: Chọta iwu site n’ọtụtụ ikpe nke ọnụ ọgụgụ akụkụ polygon mgbe niile na ogo otu akụkụ ime, kwupụta ya, jiri ikpe ọhụrụ nwalee ya.
l-m-h3-b0c47-12.material: Lee ọnụ ọgụgụ akụkụ polygon mgbe niile na ogo otu akụkụ ime. Triangle mgbe niile bụ 60°, square bụ 90°, pentagon mgbe niile bụ 108°, hexagon mgbe niile bụ 120°.
l-m-h3-b0c47-12.s.s1.prompt: Ogo ole bụ otu akụkụ ime nke octagon mgbe niile?
l-m-h3-b0c47-12.s.s1.r.a: Nke ahụ bụ nchikọta akụkụ asatọ niile, ọ bụghị otu akụkụ.
l-m-h3-b0c47-12.s.s1.r.b: Nke ahụ bụ uru hexagon mgbe niile. Ka akụkụ na-abawanye, akụkụ ahụ na-ebuwanye.
l-m-h3-b0c47-12.s.s1.r.c: Nke ahụ bụ otu akụkụ ime nke dodecagon mgbe niile. Ị gbagwojuru ọnụ ọgụgụ akụkụ ahụ anya.
l-m-h3-b0c47-12.s.s1.explain: Otu akụkụ ime bụ 180°−360°÷(ọnụọgụ akụkụ). Maka octagon mgbe niile, ọ bụ 180°−45°=135°.
l-m-h3-b0c47-12.s.s2.model.0: Otu akụkụ ime bụ 180° wepụ 360°÷n; ya mere mgbe n=8, ọ bụ 180°−45°=135°.
l-m-h3-b0c47-12.s.s2.model.1: Mgbe n bụ 3, 4, 5, 6, ụkpụrụ 60, 90, 108, 120 hà nhata 180−360/n; ya mere maka 8, ọ ga-abụ 135°.

l-m-h3-b0c47-13.title: Afọ ole ọ bụla ka aha afọ alaka-isi ahụ na-alọghachi?
l-m-h3-b0c47-13.topic: Okirikiri afọ iri isii na aha isi na alaka
l-m-h3-b0c47-13.goal: Chọta iwu site n’ọtụtụ ikpe nke ugboro aha isi na alaka afọ, kwupụta ya, jiri ikpe ọhụrụ nwalee ya.
l-m-h3-b0c47-13.material: Kalenda ochie kpọrọ afọ ọ bụla site n’ijikọta isi eluigwe 10 na alaka ụwa 12 n’usoro. 1984 bụ Gapja, 1985 bụ Eulchuk, 1986 bụ Byeongin, 1987 bụ Jeongmyo.
l-m-h3-b0c47-13.s.s1.prompt: Kedu afọ mbụ mgbe 1984 gachara nke ga-abụ afọ Gapja ọzọ?
l-m-h3-b0c47-13.s.s1.r.a: Naanị isi ahụ alọghachila na Gap (Gapsul). Alaka ahụ alọghachibeghị.
l-m-h3-b0c47-13.s.s1.r.b: Naanị alaka ahụ alọghachila na Ja (Byeongja). Isi ahụ alọghachibeghị.
l-m-h3-b0c47-13.s.s1.r.c: Isi ahụ bụ Gap, ma alaka ahụ bụ Jin (Gapjin).
l-m-h3-b0c47-13.s.s1.explain: Isi na-alọghachi kwa afọ 10, alaka kwa afọ 12. Ha na-ezukọta ọzọ mgbe afọ 60 gachara, nke bụ ọtụtụ nta jikọrọ ọnụ nke 10 na 12.
l-m-h3-b0c47-13.s.s2.model.0: Isi na-emeghachi kwa afọ 10, alaka kwa afọ 12; ya mere afọ ha ga-adakọ ọzọ bụ afọ 60 ka e mesịrị, 2044.
l-m-h3-b0c47-13.s.s2.model.1: Na 1994 naanị mkpụrụ osisi dakọtara, na 1996 naanị alaka dakọtara; ya mere afọ 60, nke bụ ọtụtụ nkewa kacha nta nke 10 na 12, ga-agafe.

l-m-h3-b0c48-10.title: Ọ bụrụ na i jikọọ isi n niile, ahịrị ole ga-adị?
l-m-h3-b0c48-10.goal: Chọta ma kwuo iwu site n'ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke ọnụ ọgụgụ ahịrị mgbe e jikọtara isi niile dị n'okirikiri, ma jiri ihe atụ ọhụrụ nwalee iwu ahụ.
l-m-h3-b0c48-10.material: Debe isi n n'okirikiri, jikọọkwa ụzọ isi abụọ ọ bụla site n'ahịrị. Maka n=2, 3, 4, 5, e nwere ahịrị 1, 3, 6, 10. Jiri iwu a tụọ ọnọdụ n=7.
l-m-h3-b0c48-10.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ihe ị ga-enweta ma i jiri iwu dabara n'ihe atụ niile tụọ n=7?
l-m-h3-b0c48-10.s.s1.r.b: Maka n=3 ọ na-enye 6, nke adabaghị na 3 dị n'ihe atụ.
l-m-h3-b0c48-10.s.s1.r.c: Maka n=4 ọ na-enye 5, nke adabaghị na 6 dị n'ihe atụ.
l-m-h3-b0c48-10.s.s1.o.d: n²/2 e mechara gbaa gburugburu, ya bụ 25
l-m-h3-b0c48-10.s.s1.r.d: Maka n=4 ọ na-enye 8, nke adabaghị na 6 dị n'ihe atụ.
l-m-h3-b0c48-10.s.s1.explain: A na-ejikọ isi ọ bụla na n−1 ndị ọzọ, mana a na-agụ ahịrị ọ bụla ugboro abụọ; ya mere ọ bụ n(n−1)/2. Maka n=7 ọ bụ 21.
l-m-h3-b0c48-10.s.s2.model.0: Itinye 4 n'ime n(n−1)/2 na-enye 6, itinye 5 na-enye 10, ya mere ọ dabara n'ihe atụ; n=7 na-enye 21.
l-m-h3-b0c48-10.s.s2.model.1: Isi ọ bụla nwere ahịrị n−1, mana a na-agụ ahịrị ọ bụla ugboro abụọ, ya mere ị ga-ekewa na 2.

l-m-h3-b0c48-11.title: Kedu iwu dị maka ngụkọta ọnụọgụ anọ sochiri ibe ha?
l-m-h3-b0c48-11.goal: Chọta ma kwuo iwu site n'ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke ngụkọta ọnụọgụ eke anọ sochiri ibe ha, ma jiri ihe atụ ọhụrụ nwalee iwu ahụ.
l-m-h3-b0c48-11.material: Ngụkọta ọnụọgụ eke anọ sochiri ibe ha bụ 1+2+3+4=10, 2+3+4+5=14, 3+4+5+6=18, na 4+5+6+7=22. Chọta iwu ngụkọta mgbe ọnụọgụ mbụ bụ n.
l-m-h3-b0c48-11.s.s1.prompt: Kedu iwu kwekọrọ n'ihe atụ anọ niile?
l-m-h3-b0c48-11.s.s1.r.a: Maka n=1 ọ na-enye 4, nke dị iche na 10 dị n'ihe atụ.
l-m-h3-b0c48-11.s.s1.r.c: Maka n=2 ọ na-enye 12, nke dị iche na 14 dị n'ihe atụ.
l-m-h3-b0c48-11.s.s1.r.d: Maka n=2 ọ na-enye 20, nke dị iche na 14 dị n'ihe atụ.
l-m-h3-b0c48-11.s.s1.explain: n+(n+1)+(n+2)+(n+3)=4n+6. Mgbe ọnụọgụ mbụ rịrị elu na 1, ngụkọta na-arịkwa elu na 4.
l-m-h3-b0c48-11.s.s2.model.0: Ngụkọta 10, 14, 18, 22 na-arị elu na 4 oge ọ bụla, na mgbe n=1 ngụkọta bụ 10, ya mere ngụkọta bụ 4n+6.
l-m-h3-b0c48-11.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na ị kpọọ ọnụọgụ anọ n, n+1, n+2, n+3 ma gbakwụnye ha, ị ga-enweta 4n+6, ya mere iwu ahụ ziri ezi.

l-m-h3-b0c48-12.goal: Chọta ma kwuo iwu site n'ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke etu uru y dị na tebụl si eto, ma jiri ihe atụ ọhụrụ nwalee iwu ahụ.
l-m-h3-b0c48-12.material: Tebụl: mgbe x=0, 1, 2, 3, 4, y=1, 2, 5, 10, 17. Chọta iwu site n'otú y si agbanwe, tụọkwa y mgbe x=6.
l-m-h3-b0c48-12.s.s1.prompt: Iwu nke dabara na tebụl, gịnịkwa bụ amụma maka x=6?

l-m-h3-b0c49-12.material: 1/(1·2)=1/2, nchikọta okwu abụọ bụ 2/3, nke atọ 3/4, nke anọ 4/5. Jiri iwu a tụọ nchikọta okwu 9.
l-m-h3-b0c49-12.s.s1.prompt: Dabere n’iwu dabara n’ihe atụ ndị a, gịnị bụ nchikọta okwu 9?

l-m-h3-b0c49-12.s.s1.r.b: Mgbe n=1, ọ na-enye 2, nke dị iche na 1/2 a hụrụ.
l-m-h3-b0c49-12.s.s1.o.c: Nchikọta ahụ na-abawanye 1/2 oge ọ bụla, ya bụ 9/2
l-m-h3-b0c49-12.s.s1.r.c: Mgbe n=2, ọ na-enye 1, nke dị iche na 2/3 a hụrụ.
l-m-h3-b0c49-12.s.s1.explain: Nchikọta bụ 1/2, 2/3, 3/4, 4/5; ya mere ọ bụ n/(n+1). Maka n=9, ọ bụ 9/10.
l-m-h3-b0c49-12.s.s2.model.0: Nchikọta bụ 1/2, 2/3, 3/4, 4/5; ya mere nchikọta okwu n bụ n/(n+1), okwu 9 na-enye 9/10.

l-m-h3-b0c50-20.s.s1.prompt: Kedu iwu ị pụrụ ịhụ ka ọnụ ọgụgụ ntụgharị na-abawanye?

l-m-h3-b0c50-20.s.s1.r.a: Ị nwere ike ịhụ ọchịchọ na mgbanwe na-ebelata ka ntụgharị na-abawanye.
l-m-h3-b0c50-20.s.s1.o.b: Ugboro ikwu na-abawanye ka ị na-atụgharị ọtụtụ

l-m-h3-b0c50-20.s.s1.o.d: Oge ọ bụla a tụgharịrị, ugboro ikwu bụ kpọmkwem 1/6
l-m-h3-b0c50-20.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ 0.3 mgbe n=10, ya mere ọ bụghị kpọmkwem 1/6.
l-m-h3-b0c50-20.s.s1.explain: Ka ntụgharị na-abawanye, uru ahụ na-abịaru ihe dị ka 0.167 nso, mgbanwe ya na-ebelata. Nke a bụ otu ihe na nkọwa ọnụ ọgụgụ nke ohere.
l-m-h3-b0c50-20.s.s2.model.0: 0.3, 0.19, 0.168, 0.1672 na-abịaru 1/6=0.1667 nso; ya mere ka ntụgharị na-abawanye, ugboro ikwu na-abịaru 1/6 nso.

l-m-h3-b0d07-07.material: Ka Sₙ bụrụ ngụkọta site na term mbụ ruo nke n. S₁=1/2, S₂=2/3, S₃=3/4, S₄=4/5. Jiri ụkpụrụ a chepụta S₁₀ na ngụkọta series niile.
l-m-h3-b0d07-07.s.s1.prompt: Nke ziri ezi maka S₁₀ na ngụkọta series bụ nke dị aṅaa?
l-m-h3-b0d07-07.s.s1.r.a: Sₙ na-eru nso 1 site n’uru dị ala karịa 1.
l-m-h3-b0d07-07.s.s1.r.b: Ngụkọta bụ limit mgbe n→∞. S₁₀ bụ naanị partial sum.
l-m-h3-b0d07-07.s.s1.r.c: Denominator bụ n+1; ya mere maka n=10 ọ bụ 11.
l-m-h3-b0d07-07.s.s1.explain: Ọ dị ka Sₙ=n/(n+1). S₁₀=10/11, ka n na-eto ọ na-eru nso 1; ya mere ngụkọta bụ 1.
l-m-h3-b0d07-07.s.s2.model.0: S₁ ruo S₄ nwere ụdị n/(n+1), ya mere S₁₀=10/11; ka n na-eto ọ na-eru nso 1, ngụkọta bụ 1.
l-m-h3-b0d07-07.s.s2.model.1: Numerator bụ n, denominator bụ n+1; ya mere S₅=5/6 dabara, limit bụ 1, ngụkọta series bụ 1.

l-m-h3-b0d07-20.goal: Chọta ma kwuo ụkpụrụ n'ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke derivative nke n nke f(x)=xeˣ, ma jiri ihe atụ ọhụrụ nwalee ya.
l-m-h3-b0d07-20.material: Iwepụta f(x)=xeˣ ugboro ugboro na-enye f'(x)=(x+1)eˣ, f''(x)=(x+2)eˣ, f'''(x)=(x+3)eˣ. Jiri ụkpụrụ a tụọ uru derivative nke 10 na x=0.
l-m-h3-b0d07-20.s.s1.prompt: Uru derivative nke 10 f⁽¹⁰⁾(0) nke f bụ ole?
l-m-h3-b0d07-20.s.s1.r.b: Derivative nke n bụ (x+n)eˣ. Maka n=10, ọ bụ +10.
l-m-h3-b0d07-20.s.s1.r.c: Itinye x=0 na (x+10)eˣ na-enye 10. Ọbụna ma xeˣ bụ 0, derivative ya dị iche.
l-m-h3-b0d07-20.s.s1.r.d: Coefficient anaghị eto dịka factorial, ọ na-abawanye na 1 oge ọ bụla.
l-m-h3-b0d07-20.s.s1.explain: Derivative nke n bụ (x+n)eˣ. Itinye x=0 na-enye f⁽¹⁰⁾(0)=10.
l-m-h3-b0d07-20.s.s2.model.0: Oge ọ bụla a na-ewepụta derivative, okwu na-adịgide adịgide na-abawanye na 1; ya mere derivative nke n bụ (x+n)eˣ, na x=0 ọ bụ 10.
l-m-h3-b0d07-20.s.s2.model.1: Okwu na-adịgide adịgide nke f', f'', f''' bụ 1, 2, 3; ya mere nke n bụ n, ya mere f⁽¹⁰⁾(0)=10.

l-m-h3-b0d07-26.title: Ịchọta usoro n’ime mkpọda tangent 2ˣ
l-m-h3-b0d07-26.goal: Chọta ma kwupụta usoro n’ọtụtụ ikpe nke mkpọda tangent na y=2ˣ, jiri ikpe ọhụrụ nyochaa ya.
l-m-h3-b0d07-26.material: Ịtụ mkpọda tangent y=2ˣ nyere 0.69 mgbe x=0, 1.39 mgbe x=1, 2.77 mgbe x=2. Jiri usoro a chepụta mkpọda mgbe x=3.
l-m-h3-b0d07-26.s.s1.prompt: Kedu mkpọda ziri ezi mgbe x=3?
l-m-h3-b0d07-26.s.s1.r.a: E gbakwụnyere 0.69 na 2.77. Uru ahụ na-amụba na 2 oge ọ bụla.
l-m-h3-b0d07-26.s.s1.r.c: E chere na ọdịiche ahụ adịghị agbanwe. N’ezie ọdịiche ahụ na-abawanye.
l-m-h3-b0d07-26.s.s1.explain: A na-amụba mkpọda na 2 oge ọ bụla. (2ˣ)'=2ˣ ln 2, ln 2≈0.69; ya mere mgbe x=3, ọ bụ ihe dị ka 5.5.
l-m-h3-b0d07-26.s.s2.model.0: 0.69, 1.39, 2.77 na-amụba na 2; ya mere mgbe x=3, ọ bụ 2×2.77, ihe dị ka 5.5.
l-m-h3-b0d07-26.s.s2.model.1: Mkpọda dabere n’oke 2ˣ; ọ na-amụba na 2 mgbe x rịrị 1, ya mere mgbe x=3, 2.77×2≈5.5.

l-m-h3-b0d07-34.goal: Chọta ma kwupụta usoro site n’ọtụtụ ikpe uru ∫₀^π sin(nx)dx, jiri ikpe ọhụrụ nyochaa ya.
l-m-h3-b0d07-34.material: Ịgbakọ definite integral ∫₀^π sin(nx)dx maka n=1, 2, 3, 4 na-enye 2, 0, 2/3, 0. Jiri usoro ahụ chepụta uru mgbe n=7.
l-m-h3-b0d07-34.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụ 0 naanị mgbe n bụ ọbụna; 7 bụ nọmba na-adịghị ọbụna.
l-m-h3-b0d07-34.s.s1.r.b: Mgbe n na-adịghị ọbụna, numerator bụ 2 (maka n=3, ọ bụ 2/3).
l-m-h3-b0d07-34.s.s1.r.d: Denominator bụ n, ọ bụghị n² (maka n=3, ọ bụ 2/3).
l-m-h3-b0d07-34.s.s1.explain: ∫₀^πsin(nx)dx=(1−cos nπ)/n. Ọ bụrụ n adịghị ọbụna, ọ bụ 2/n; ọ bụrụ n bụ ọbụna, ọ bụ 0.
l-m-h3-b0d07-34.s.s2.model.0: Maka n=1 na 3, uru bụ 2 na 2/3; ya mere mgbe n na-adịghị ọbụna, ọ bụ 2/n. Ebe 7 adịghị ọbụna, uru ya bụ 2/7.
l-m-h3-b0d07-34.s.s2.model.1: Usoro n=even na-enye 0, n=odd na-enye 2/n dabara n’ikpe niile; ya mere n=7 na-enye 2/7.

l-m-h3-b0d08-07.goal: Chọta ma kọwaa ụkpụrụ n’ọnọdụ limit a₁=√2, aₙ₊₁=√(2+aₙ), nwalee ya n’ọnọdụ ọhụrụ.
l-m-h3-b0d08-07.material: a₁=√2≈1.414; n=2: a₂≈1.848, a₃≈1.962, a₄≈1.990. Jiri ụkpụrụ chepụta limit.
l-m-h3-b0d08-07.s.s1.r.a: I were ya dịka L=2+L. E nwere square root.
l-m-h3-b0d08-07.s.s1.r.b: a₂ karịrị 1.5; ya mere limit karịrị nke ahụ.
l-m-h3-b0d08-07.s.s1.r.d: Nke ahụ bụ uru a₄. Sequence ahụ ka na-eto.
l-m-h3-b0d08-07.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ limit bụ L, L=√(2+L). Site na L²−L−2=0, L=2.
l-m-h3-b0d08-07.s.s2.model.0: Uru na-eru nso 2 ruo mgbe ebighị ebi; idozi L=√(2+L) na-enye L=2, ya mere limit bụ 2.
l-m-h3-b0d08-07.s.s2.model.1: Na 1.414, 1.848, 1.962, 1.990, mmụba na-ebelata ma na-eru nso 2; ya mere limit bụ 2.

l-m-h3-b0d08-20.material: Maka n=1, 2, 3, uru kacha ukwuu nke fₙ(x)=x·e^(−nx) na-eme na x=1, 1/2, 1/3 n'otu n'otu. Jiri ụkpụrụ ahụ tụọ x ebe uru kacha ukwuu ga-eme mgbe n=5.
l-m-h3-b0d08-20.s.s1.prompt: Mgbe n=5, x ole ka uru kacha ukwuu na-eme?
l-m-h3-b0d08-20.s.s1.r.a: Maka n=1 ọ bụ 1; ya mere denominator bụ n, ọ bụghị n−1 (n−1 agaghị arụ ọrụ maka n=1).
l-m-h3-b0d08-20.s.s1.r.d: A tụgharịrị ntụziaka x si ebelata ka n na-abawanye.
l-m-h3-b0d08-20.s.s1.explain: Site na fₙ'(x)=(1−nx)e^(−nx)=0, x=1/n, akara ya gbanwee site na + gaa − n'akụkụ abụọ; ya mere ọ bụ max.
l-m-h3-b0d08-20.s.s2.model.0: 1, 1/2, 1/3 niile bụ ụdị 1/n, ya mere maka n=5, x=1/5. Iwepụta derivative na-enye (1−5x)e^(−5x)=0, nke bụkwa x=1/5, ya mere ọ ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0d08-20.s.s2.model.1: Akara fₙ'(x)=(1−nx)e^(−nx) na-agbanwe site na + gaa − na x=1/n, ya mere mgbe n=5, x ebe ọ kacha ukwuu bụ 1/5.

l-m-h3-b0d08-26.goal: Chọta ma kwuo ụkpụrụ n'ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke derivative nke n nke f(x)=ln x, ma jiri ọnọdụ ọhụrụ nwalee ụkpụrụ ahụ.
l-m-h3-b0d08-26.material: Maka f(x)=ln x, f'(1)=1, f''(1)=−1, f'''(1)=2, f⁽⁴⁾(1)=−6. Jiri ụkpụrụ a tụọ uru derivative nke 6, f⁽⁶⁾(1).
l-m-h3-b0d08-26.s.s1.r.a: Akara na-agbanwe. Maka ogo ọbụna ọ bụ −.
l-m-h3-b0d08-26.s.s1.r.c: Nha ya bụ (n−1)!, ya mere ọ bụ 5!, ọ bụghị 6.
l-m-h3-b0d08-26.s.s1.r.d: Ma akara ma nha ezighị ezi.
l-m-h3-b0d08-26.s.s2.model.0: Uru ndị ahụ bụ 1, −1, 2, −6; akara na-agbanwe, nha bụ (n−1)!. Ya mere mgbe n=6 ọ bụ −120.
l-m-h3-b0d08-26.s.s2.model.1: Ogo ọbụna adịghị mma, nha na-etokwa dịka 0!, 1!, 2!, 3!; ya mere ogo 6 bụ −5!=−120.

l-m-h3-b0d08-33.material: Ka Iₙ=∫₀^(π/2)sinⁿx dx. I₀=π/2, I₁=1, I₂=π/4, I₃=2/3, I₄=3π/16. Jiri usoro ahụ tụọ I₅.
l-m-h3-b0d08-33.s.s1.r.a: Ị jiri oke 4/5 naanị, i mụbaa ya na I₃.
l-m-h3-b0d08-33.s.s1.r.b: I were oke ahụ dịka 3/4 n’amaghị ama. Mgbe n=5, ọ bụ 4/5.
l-m-h3-b0d08-33.s.s2.model.1: Oke na okwu dị ebe abụọ gara aga bụ (n−1)/n; ya mere I₅=I₃×4/5=8/15.

l-m-h3-b0d09-03.goal: Chọta ma kwupụta usoro n’ọtụtụ ikpe nke anya isi parabola ruo focus, jiri ikpe ọhụrụ nyochaa ya.
l-m-h3-b0d09-03.material: A tụrụ anya isi (1 , 2) ,  (4 , 4) ,  (9 , 6) dị na parabola y²=4x ruo focus (1 , 0); ha bụ 2 ,  5 ,  10.
l-m-h3-b0d09-03.s.s1.prompt: Kedu iwu dị n’etiti nhazi isi na anya focus?
l-m-h3-b0d09-03.s.s1.r.a: Na (4 , 4) ,  anya 5 dị iche na nhazi y bụ 4.
l-m-h3-b0d09-03.s.s1.r.d: Na (1 , 2) ,  anya bụ 2 ,  ma okwu a na-enye 3.
l-m-h3-b0d09-03.s.s1.explain: Maka isi atọ niile, anya bụ nhazi x+1. Nke a jikọtara na nkọwa parabola: anya focus hà nhata anya ruo directrix x=−1.
l-m-h3-b0d09-03.s.s2.model.0: (1,2) na-enye 2, (4,4) na-enye 5, (9,6) na-enye 10, ha hà x+1; ya mere iwu bụ anya=x+1.
l-m-h3-b0d09-03.s.s2.model.1: Anya ruo directrix x=−1 bụ x+1. Na parabola, anya focus hà nhata anya directrix; ya mere anya focus bụkwa x+1.

l-m-h3-b0d09-10.title: Ịchọta ụkpụrụ na mkpọda asymptote
l-m-h3-b0d09-10.goal: Chọta ma kwuo ụkpụrụ n'ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke mkpọda asymptote hyperbola, ma jiri ọnọdụ ọhụrụ nwalee ya.
l-m-h3-b0d09-10.material: Anyị chọtara asymptote hyperbola x²/a² − y²/b² = 1. Mgbe (a, b)=(2, 3), y=±3x/2; mgbe (4,1), y=±x/4; mgbe (1,5), y=±5x. (1, 1, 4, 5)
l-m-h3-b0d09-10.s.s1.prompt: Iwu dị n'etiti mkpọda asymptote na a, b bụ nke?
l-m-h3-b0d09-10.s.s1.r.a: Na (2, 3), a/b bụ 2/3 mana nke bụ eziokwu bụ 3/2.
l-m-h3-b0d09-10.s.s1.r.b: Na (2, 3), b−a=1 mana nke bụ eziokwu bụ 3/2.
l-m-h3-b0d09-10.s.s1.r.c: Na (2, 3), ab=6 mana nke bụ eziokwu bụ 3/2.
l-m-h3-b0d09-10.s.s1.explain: N'ihe atụ atọ niile mkpọda bụ ±b/a. Asymptote ahụ bụ otu na y=±(b/a)x, nke e nwetara site na x²/a²−y²/b²=0.
l-m-h3-b0d09-10.s.s2.model.0: (2,3) na-enye 3/2, (4,1) na-enye 1/4, (1,5) na-enye 5; ha niile hà nhata b/a, ya mere iwu bụ mkpọda ±b/a.
l-m-h3-b0d09-10.s.s2.model.1: Isetịpụ x²/a²−y²/b²=0 na-enye y²=(b²/a²)x², ya mere mkpọda n'ihe atụ ndị ahụ bụ b/a.

l-m-h3-b0d09-19.title: Iwu maka akụkụ e nwetara site na uru ngwaahịa ntụpọ
l-m-h3-b0d09-19.goal: Chọta ma kwuo iwu site n'ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke uru ngwaahịa ntụpọ maka akụkụ dị iche iche, ma jiri ihe atụ ọhụrụ nwalee iwu ahụ.
l-m-h3-b0d09-19.material: Maka vectors abụọ nwere |a|=2 na |b|=3, a chọpụtara ngwaahịa ntụpọ maka akụkụ θ dị iche. Ọ bụrụ θ=0°, ọ bụ 6; 60° bụ 3; 90° bụ 0; 180° bụ −6.
l-m-h3-b0d09-19.s.s1.prompt: Kedu iwu na-ekpebi ngwaahịa ntụpọ a·b?
l-m-h3-b0d09-19.s.s1.r.a: Na θ=0°, sin0°=0, ya mere ọ gaghị abụ 6.
l-m-h3-b0d09-19.s.s1.r.c: Na θ=60° ọ ga-abụ 4, nke dị iche na uru n'ezie 3.
l-m-h3-b0d09-19.s.s1.r.d: Na θ=90° ọ ga-abụ 3, nke dị iche na uru n'ezie 0.
l-m-h3-b0d09-19.s.s1.explain: cos0°=1, cos60°=1/2, cos90°=0, cos180°=−1; ya mere 6cosθ dabara na uru anọ niile.
l-m-h3-b0d09-19.s.s2.model.0: 6cos60°=3, 6cos90°=0, 6cos180°=−6 ziri ezi niile; ya mere iwu bụ 6cosθ.
l-m-h3-b0d09-19.s.s2.model.1: |a||b|=6, ka akụkụ na-eto site na 0° ruo 180°, uru na-agbanwe site na 6 ruo −6, ya mere ọdịdị ya bụ otu cosθ.

l-m-h3-b0d09-28.goal: Chọta ma kwupụta iwu n’ọtụtụ uru |a+b|²+|a−b|², jiri ikpe ọhụrụ nyochaa ya.
l-m-h3-b0d09-28.material: A chọtara |a+b|²+|a−b|². Ọ bụrụ a=(1,0), b=(0,1), ọ bụ 4; maka a=(3,0), b=(0,2), ọ bụ 26; maka a=(2,1), b=(1,3), ọ bụ 30.
l-m-h3-b0d09-28.s.s1.prompt: Kedu njikọ dị n’etiti uru a na |a| na |b|?

l-m-h3-b0d10-18.material: Maka b nke ọ bụla, achọtara m ogologo nwere akara nke ntule b n’ụzọ a=(3, 4). Maka b=(1, 0), ọ bụ 0.6; b=(0, 5), ọ bụ 4; b=(5, 5), ọ bụ 7.

l-m-h3-b0d10-18.s.s1.r.c: Maka b=(1, 0), ọ bụ 5, ma uru n’ezie bụ 0.6.
l-m-h3-b0d10-18.s.s1.explain: N’ime ikpe atọ niile, ọ bụ (a·b)/|a|. 3/5=0.6, 20/5=4, 35/5=7.

l-m-h3-b0d10-18.s.s2.model.1: Ogologo ntule bụ |b|cosθ, a·b=|a||b|cosθ; ya mere ọ bụ a·b kewara na |a|.

l-m-h3-b0d10-33.goal: Chọta ma kwuo ụkpụrụ n'ọtụtụ ọnọdụ nke radius akụkụ obe okirikiri e mere mgbe ụgbọelu gbupụrụ sphere, wee nwalee ụkpụrụ ahụ n'ọnọdụ ọhụrụ.
l-m-h3-b0d10-33.material: Ịkpụ sphere x²+y²+z²=169 na ụgbọelu z=k na-eme okirikiri. Mgbe k=0 radius bụ 13, k=5 radius bụ 12, k=12 radius bụ 5.
l-m-h3-b0d10-33.s.s1.prompt: Kedu mmekọrịta dị n'etiti radius r nke okirikiri akụkụ obe na k?
l-m-h3-b0d10-33.s.s1.r.b: Maka k=5 ọ na-enye 8, mana uru n'ezie bụ 12.
l-m-h3-b0d10-33.s.s1.r.c: Maka k=12 ọ na-enye 10.6, mana uru n'ezie bụ 5.
l-m-h3-b0d10-33.s.s1.r.d: Maka k=0 ọ na-enye 169, mana uru n'ezie bụ 13.
l-m-h3-b0d10-33.s.s1.explain: Isi dị na okirikiri akụkụ obe na-emezu x²+y²=169−k². Ya mere r=√(169−k²), nke dabara n'ọnọdụ atọ niile.
l-m-h3-b0d10-33.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ k=5, √(169−25)=12; ọ bụrụ k=12, √(169−144)=5, ya mere ọ dabara n'ọnọdụ niile. Ya mere r=√(169−k²).
l-m-h3-b0d10-33.s.s2.model.1: Isi ndị dị n'akụkụ obe na-emezu x²+y²+k²=169, ya mere x²+y²=169−k², radius bụkwa mgbọrọgwụ square ya.

l-m-h3-b0c33-13.title: Ihe dịka ego ole ka ga-eto na 7% kwa afọ n’ime afọ 10?
l-m-h3-b0c33-13.goal: Mee atụmatụ ego mgbe afọ 10 gachara na compound interest 7% kwa afọ, họrọ nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe ndabere gị.
l-m-h3-b0c33-13.material: Mee atụmatụ ihe dịka ego 1,000×10,000 won ga-aghọ ma e tinye ya afọ 10 na compound interest 7% kwa afọ. Ọnụọgụ afọ ego ji eto ruo okpukpu 2 bụ ihe dịka 72 ÷ ọnụego mmasị kwa afọ (%).
l-m-h3-b0c33-13.s.s1.prompt: Atụmatụ nke kacha nso na ego mgbe afọ 10 gachara bụ nke dị aṅaa?
l-m-h3-b0c33-13.s.s1.r.a: Ọ fọrọ obere ka ọ ghara ịbawanye. I chefuru na a na-agbakwunye ọmụrụ nwa ruo afọ 10.
l-m-h3-b0c33-13.s.s1.r.b: Ị gbakwụnyere 70% naanị, dịka ọmụrụ nwa dị mfe. N’ọmụrụ nwa jikọtara ọnụ, ọmụrụ nwa na-enweta ọmụrụ nwa.
l-m-h3-b0c33-13.s.s1.r.d: I weere ya dịka ugboro 7. 7% kwa afọ abụghị ugboro 7.
l-m-h3-b0c33-13.s.s1.explain: 72÷7 bụ ihe dịka 10; ya mere n’ime afọ 10 ego ahụ na-aghọ ihe dịka okpukpu 2, ihe dịka 2,000×10,000 won. Uru n’ezie bụ ihe dịka 1,967×10,000 won.
l-m-h3-b0c33-13.s.s2.model.0: 72÷7 bụ ihe dịka 10; ya mere n’ime afọ 10 ego ahụ na-aghọ ihe dịka okpukpu 2, ihe dịka 2,000×10,000 won.
l-m-h3-b0c33-13.s.s2.model.1: Ọbụna na ọmụrụ nwa dị mfe ọ ga-abụ 1,700×10,000 won; ọmụrụ nwa jikọtara ọnụ na-enwetakwa ọmụrụ nwa, ya mere ọ karịrị nke ahụ, ihe dịka 2,000×10,000 won.

l-m-h3-b0c33-14.goal: Tụlee ngwaahịa ọnụ ahịa otu ihe na ọnụọgụ ere, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke dabara adaba, ma kọwaa ihe ndabere gị.
l-m-h3-b0c33-14.material: Ụlọ ahịa rere igbe nri ehihie 198 kwa ụbọchị, nke ọ bụla bụ 4,980 won. Tụlee ego ire kwa ụbọchị.
l-m-h3-b0c33-14.s.s1.prompt: Kedu atụmatụ kacha nso na ire kwa ụbọchị?
l-m-h3-b0c33-14.s.s1.r.b: O nwere otu ọnụọgụ karịrị akarị. 5,000×200 bụ 100×10,000 won.
l-m-h3-b0c33-14.s.s1.r.c: Ị weere ọnụọgụ ahụ dịka ihe dịka 100. 198 dị nso na 200.
l-m-h3-b0c33-14.s.s1.explain: Ịgbanwe 4,980 ka ọ bụrụ 5,000 na 198 ka ọ bụrụ 200 na-enye 5,000×200=1,000,000 won, ya bụ ihe dịka 100×10,000 won.
l-m-h3-b0c33-14.s.s2.model.0: Ịgbanwe 4,980 ka ọ bụrụ 5,000 na 198 ka ọ bụrụ 200 na-enye 5,000×200=1,000,000, ya bụ ihe dịka 100×10,000 won.
l-m-h3-b0c33-14.s.s2.model.1: Ịgbakọta ọnụọgụ abụọ ahụ na-enye ihe dịka 5,000 won na ihe 200; ngwaahịa ha bụ ihe dịka 100×10,000 won, nhọrọ ndị ọzọ nwekwara ọnụọgụ adabaghị.

l-m-h3-b0c33-15.goal: Tụlee ọnụego mmụba ire n’ime ọnwa abụọ, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke dabara adaba ma kọwaa ihe ndabere gị.
l-m-h3-b0c33-15.material: Ire ọnwa gara aga bụ 2,030×10,000 won, nke ọnwa a bụ 2,490×10,000 won. Iwere ọnwa gara aga dịka ntọala, tụlee pasent ọnụego mmụba.
l-m-h3-b0c33-15.s.s1.prompt: Kedu atụmatụ kacha nso na ọnụego mmụba?
l-m-h3-b0c33-15.s.s1.r.c: Ị kewara mmụba 460 na ihe dịka 1,000. Ntọala ya bụ 2,030.

l-m-h3-b0c33-15.s.s1.explain: Mmụba ahụ bụ ihe dịka 460, 20% nke 2,000 bụ 400; ya mere ọnụego mmụba dị n’ime pasent 20. N’ezie, ọ bụ ihe dịka 22.7%.
l-m-h3-b0c33-15.s.s2.model.0: Mmụba ahụ bụ ihe dịka 460, 20% nke 2,000 bụ 400; ya mere ọnụego mmụba dị ihe dịka 20%.

l-m-h3-b0c33-16.title: Ihe dịka ole bụ uru atụ anya nke otu tiketi lọtrị?
l-m-h3-b0c33-16.goal: Tụlee onyinye atụ anya site n’otu tiketi lọtrị, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke dabara adaba, ma kọwaa ihe ndabere gị.
l-m-h3-b0c33-16.material: Tiketi lọtrị na-efu 1,000 won. Nrite nke 1 bụ 100×10,000 won (ohere 1/10,000), nke 2 bụ 1×10,000 won (ohere 1/500), ndị ọzọ bụ enweghị nrite. Tụlee onyinye atụ anya nke otu tiketi.
l-m-h3-b0c33-16.s.s1.prompt: Kedu atụmatụ kacha nso na onyinye atụ anya?
l-m-h3-b0c33-16.s.s1.r.a: I were ya dịka ọnụ ahịa ịzụta. Uru atụ anya pere mpe nke ukwuu.
l-m-h3-b0c33-16.s.s1.r.c: I were nrite nke 2 n’onwe ya dịka uru atụ anya.
l-m-h3-b0c33-16.s.s1.r.d: Akụkụ nrite nke 1 naanị ya bụ 100 won, ya mere nke a pere mpe.
l-m-h3-b0c33-16.s.s1.explain: Akụkụ nrite nke 1 bụ 100×10,000÷10,000=100 won, akụkụ nrite nke 2 bụ 1×10,000÷500=20 won; ngụkọta ya bụ ihe dịka 120 won.
l-m-h3-b0c33-16.s.s2.model.0: Nrite nke 1 na-enye 100×10,000÷10,000=100 won, nke 2 na-enye 1×10,000÷500=20 won; ịgbakwunye ha na-enye ihe dịka 120 won.
l-m-h3-b0c33-16.s.s2.model.1: A na-amụba nrite nke ọ bụla na ohere ya ma gbakwunye; ya mere ọ bụ ihe dịka 120 won, ngụkọta 100 won na 20 won, nke pere mpe karịa ọnụahịa tiketi 1,000 won.

l-m-h3-b0c34-14.goal: Tụọ ọnụ ahịa mgbe ọnụ ahịa na-arị elu ogologo oge; họrọ oke dabara adaba ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c34-14.material: Ọ bụrụ ọnụ ahịa na-arị 3% kwa afọ ruo afọ 24, tụọ ọnụ ahịa ihe dị ugbu a bụ 1,000 won ga-abụ okpukpu ole. Afọ ọnụ ahịa ga-eji bụrụ okpukpu 2 bụ ihe dịka 72÷ọnụọgụ mmụba kwa afọ (%).
l-m-h3-b0c34-14.s.s1.prompt: Mgbe afọ 24 gachara, ọnụ ahịa ga-abụ okpukpu ole nke taa?
l-m-h3-b0c34-14.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ otu mmụba 3% naanị. Ọ na-arị elu n'ime afọ 24 niile.
l-m-h3-b0c34-14.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ okpukpu abụọ nke mmụba okpukpu 2. Nke ahụ ga-ewe afọ 48.
l-m-h3-b0c34-14.s.s1.r.d: I gụrụ 72 dịka ọnụọgụ okpukpu. 72 bụ ọnụọgụ e ji tụọ afọ.
l-m-h3-b0c34-14.s.s1.explain: 72÷3=24, ya mere mgbe afọ 24 gachara ọnụ ahịa bụ ihe dịka okpukpu 2. N'ezie, 1.03²⁴ dị ihe dịka 2.03.
l-m-h3-b0c34-14.s.s2.model.0: 72÷3 bụ 24, ya mere mgbe afọ 24 gachara ọnụ ahịa bụ ihe dịka okpukpu 2.
l-m-h3-b0c34-14.s.s2.model.1: N'ihi mmụba na-agbakọta, nke na-ebukọta 3% kwa afọ dịka ọmụrụ nwa, ọ bụ ihe dịka okpukpu 2; nke a karịrị okpukpu 1.72 a ga-enweta site n'ịgbakwụnye naanị.

l-m-h3-b0c34-15.material: Ị zụtara ihe ọnụ ahịa ya bụ 19.99 dollar n'ụlọ ahịa ịntanetị mba ọzọ. Ọnụego mgbanwe taa bụ ihe dịka 1,380 won maka dollar 1. Tụọ ego won ya.

l-m-h3-b0c34-15.s.s1.r.b: Otu ogo ọnụọgụ buru oke ibu. 20×1,400 bụ 28,000.
l-m-h3-b0c34-15.s.s1.r.d: Nke a pere mpe ogo ọnụọgụ abụọ. Ọbụna dollar 20 dị n'ogo 2×10,000 won.
l-m-h3-b0c34-15.s.s1.explain: Were 19.99 dịka 20, 1,380 dịka ihe dịka 1,400; 20×1,400=28,000, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dịka 27,600 won.
l-m-h3-b0c34-15.s.s2.model.0: Were 19.99 dollar dịka 20 dollar; 20×1,380=27,600, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dịka 27,600 won.
l-m-h3-b0c34-15.s.s2.model.1: Ọbụna ma e bulie ọnụego mgbanwe ka ọ bụrụ 1,400 won, 20×1,400=28,000 won bụ njedebe elu nke 2×10,000; ya mere 276,000 buru oke ibu.

l-m-h3-b0c34-16.goal: Tụọ ngwaahịa ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị ahịa, ego onye ọ bụla mefuru na ọnụ ọgụgụ ụbọchị; họrọ oke dabara adaba ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c34-16.material: Ụlọ oriri na-enweta ndị ahịa 198 kwa ụbọchị na nkezi; onye ọ bụla na-emefu 9,900 won. Tụọ ahịa ụbọchị 30.
l-m-h3-b0c34-16.s.s1.prompt: Kedu atụmatụ kacha nso n'ahịa otu ọnwa?
l-m-h3-b0c34-16.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụrụ na ịmụba ihe dịka 200×10,000 won kwa ụbọchị na ụbọchị 30, ọ karịrị 600×10,000 won nke ukwuu.
l-m-h3-b0c34-16.s.s1.r.c: Ọbụna ahịa otu ụbọchị bụ ihe dịka 200×10,000 won, ya mere nke a pere mpe.
l-m-h3-b0c34-16.s.s1.r.d: Otu ogo ọnụọgụ buru oke ibu. 200×10,000 won×30 bụ 6,000×10,000 won.
l-m-h3-b0c34-16.s.s1.explain: Were 198 dịka 200 na 9,900 dịka 10,000; ọ bụ ihe dịka 200×10,000 kwa ụbọchị na 6,000×10,000 n'ime ụbọchị 30.
l-m-h3-b0c34-16.s.s2.model.0: Ahịa otu ụbọchị bụ ihe dịka mmadụ 200×10,000 won=200×10,000; n'ime ụbọchị 30 ọ bụ ihe dịka 6,000×10,000 won.
l-m-h3-b0c34-16.s.s2.model.1: Ahịa otu ụbọchị bụrị ihe dịka 200×10,000 won; n'ime ụbọchị 30 ọ karịrị 600×10,000 ma erughị 6×100 nde. Ya mere ọ bụ ihe dịka 6,000×10,000 won.

l-m-h3-b0c35-04.goal: Mee atụmatụ ụtụ isi dị n’ime ọnụahịa 33,000 won gụnyere ụtụ isi, họrọ nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe akaebe.
l-m-h3-b0c35-04.material: E nwere ihe ọnụahịa ya etinyelarị ụtụ isi 10%. Akwụkwọ nnata na-ekwu naanị na ngụkọta bụ 33,000 won.
l-m-h3-b0c35-04.s.s1.prompt: Ihe dịka ego ole bụ ụtụ isi dị n’ime ngụkọta 33,000 won?
l-m-h3-b0c35-04.s.s1.r.a: Ị tụgharịrị otu ebe uru ọnụọgụ.
l-m-h3-b0c35-04.s.s1.r.c: Ị gụrụ ọnụego ụtụ isi ka ọ bụrụ okpukpu abụọ.
l-m-h3-b0c35-04.s.s1.r.d: Ị mụbara ngụkọta, nke tinyelarị ụtụ isi, na 10%. A ga-amụba ọnụahịa tupu ụtụ isi.
l-m-h3-b0c35-04.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na ọnụahịa tupu ụtụ isi bụ x, mgbe ahụ 1.1x=33,000, ya mere x=30,000 na ụtụ isi bụ ihe dịka 3,000 won.
l-m-h3-b0c35-04.s.s2.model.0: Ịkewa 33,000 na 1.1 na-enye ihe dịka 30,000, ya mere ụtụ isi bụ ihe dịka 3,000 won.
l-m-h3-b0c35-04.s.s2.model.1: 3,300, nke bụ 10% nke 33,000, dị ntakịrị oke n’ihi na o sitereghị n’ọnụahịa tupu ụtụ isi. 3,000, nke bụ 10% nke 30,000, bụ nke ziri ezi.

l-m-h3-b0c35-19.s.s1.r.c: A gbakwụnyere nrite naanị n’enweghị ịmụba ha na ohere.

l-m-h3-b0c36-13.title: Ọnụọgụ ụkpụrụ maka foto agba 100
l-m-h3-b0c36-13.goal: Mee atụmatụ ọnụọgụ ụkpụrụ mgbe e dere foto 100 dịka matriks, họrọ nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0c36-13.material: Foto agba nwere pixel 100 n’obosara na 100 n’ịdị elu nwere ụkpụrụ 3 maka pixel ọ bụla: red, green, blue. Anyị chọrọ ime matriks site n’itinye foto 100, otu foto n’ahịrị ọ bụla.
l-m-h3-b0c36-13.s.s1.prompt: Ihe dịka ụkpụrụ ole ka matriks a nwere?
l-m-h3-b0c36-13.s.s1.r.a: Nke ahụ bụ ọnụọgụ ụkpụrụ maka otu foto. Ị mụbaghị ya na ọnụọgụ foto.
l-m-h3-b0c36-13.s.s1.r.b: I chefuru na e nwere ụkpụrụ agba 3.
l-m-h3-b0c36-13.s.s1.r.c: Ị mụbara ọnụọgụ foto, 100, na onwe ya.
l-m-h3-b0c36-13.s.s1.explain: Otu foto nwere ụkpụrụ 100×100×3=30000, ya mere foto 100 nwere 3000000, ihe dịka nde 3 (300×10,000).
l-m-h3-b0c36-13.s.s2.model.0: Otu foto nwere ụkpụrụ 100×100×3=30,000 (3×10,000), maka foto 100 a na-amụba, ya mere nha ya bụ ihe dịka 3,000,000 (300×10,000).
l-m-h3-b0c36-13.s.s2.model.1: Pixel 10,000 (1×10,000) nwere agba 3 nke ọ bụla na-enye 30,000 (3×10,000); ịmụba na foto 100 na-enye ihe dịka 3,000,000 (300×10,000).

l-m-h3-b0c36-14.title: Oke njehie maka nkwado 60%
l-m-h3-b0c36-14.goal: Mee atụmatụ oke nke ọnụego nkwado niile site n’ọnụego nkwado e mere atụmatụ na sample, họrọ nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0c36-14.material: A họọrọ ndị bi 400 ma jụọ ha, 240 (60%) kwadoro iwu. Standard error nke sample proportion bụ ihe dịka 0.025. A na-eme atụmatụ oke dịka sample proportion ± 2×standard error.
l-m-h3-b0c36-14.s.s1.prompt: Oke ole ka ị ga-eme atụmatụ maka ọnụego nkwado nke ndị bi niile?
l-m-h3-b0c36-14.s.s1.r.a: I were standard error 0.025 ka ọ pere mpe nke ukwuu, dịka 0.005.
l-m-h3-b0c36-14.s.s1.r.c: I mere oke ahụ ka ọ gbasaa nke ukwuu nke na ọ fọrọ nke nta ka ọ ghara ikwu ihe ọ bụla.
l-m-h3-b0c36-14.s.s1.r.d: I chere na sample proportion hà nhata proportion niile.
l-m-h3-b0c36-14.s.s1.explain: 2×0.025=0.05, ya mere atụmatụ ahụ bụ 60% ± 5 percentage points, ya bụ 55% ruo 65%.
l-m-h3-b0c36-14.s.s2.model.0: Oke njehie bụ 2×0.025=0.05, ya mere ịgbakwunye na iwepụ percentage points 5 na 60% na-enye 55% ruo 65%.
l-m-h3-b0c36-14.s.s2.model.1: Ebe ọ bụ sample, nsonaazụ mmadụ 400 abụghị kpọmkwem otu ihe na nke mmadụ niile, ya mere kwuo oke 60% ± 5 percentage points.

l-m-h3-b0c36-15.topic: Njehie na ime ka uru kacha mma
l-m-h3-b0c36-15.title: Ịtụ mean nke njehie ndị e squared
l-m-h3-b0c36-15.goal: Mee atụmatụ mean nke njehie amụma ndị e squared (MSE), họrọ nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0c36-15.material: Ụdị amụma na okpomọkụ ebe 3 bụ 2, 3, na 4 degrees, ma ụkpụrụ n’ezie bụ 3, 3, na 6 degrees. Njehie (n’ezie − amụma) bụ 1, 0, na 2. Mee atụmatụ nha mean nke njehie ndị e squared (MSE).
l-m-h3-b0c36-15.s.s1.prompt: Kedu uru n’ime ndị a ka MSE kacha nso?
l-m-h3-b0c36-15.s.s1.r.b: Ị mere nkezi njehie n’etinyeghị ha n’ike square.
l-m-h3-b0c36-15.s.s1.r.c: Ị gbakwụnyere njehie ndị e mere square kama ịchọta nkezi ha.
l-m-h3-b0c36-15.s.s1.r.d: Ị lere square nke njehie kacha ukwuu naanị.
l-m-h3-b0c36-15.s.s1.explain: Square nke njehie bụ 1, 0 na 4. Ikewa ngụkọta 5 na 3 na-enye 5/3, ihe dịka 1.7.
l-m-h3-b0c36-15.s.s2.model.0: Ime square nke njehie na-enye 1, 0 na 4; a na-ekewa ngụkọta 5 na ọnụọgụ ha 3, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dịka 1.7.
l-m-h3-b0c36-15.s.s2.model.1: Square kacha ukwuu bụ 4, ndị ọzọ dị ntakịrị; ya mere nkezi pere mpe nke ukwuu karịa 4, ihe dịka 1.7 dabara.

l-m-h3-b0c36-16.title: Ịtụle ole ihe nlereanya ga-aza nke ọma na data ọhụrụ
l-m-h3-b0c36-16.goal: Tụlee oke izi ezi a pụrụ ịtụ anya site n’obere nnwale, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke dabara adaba ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0c36-16.material: E tinyere ihe nlereanya nhazi n’ọnọdụ nnwale 50, o ziri 45 (90%). Njehie ọkọlọtọ nke izi ezi a bụ ihe dịka 0.04, a na-atụlekwa oke ya dịka 90%±2×0.04.
l-m-h3-b0c36-16.s.s1.prompt: N’ọnọdụ ọhụrụ 1000, oke ole ka ọ ga-aza nke ọma?
l-m-h3-b0c36-16.s.s1.r.a: Ebe ọ bụ 90%, i kwubiri na ọ ga-abụrịrị kpọmkwem 900 n’ime 1000.
l-m-h3-b0c36-16.s.s1.r.c: Ị bufere ọnụ ọgụgụ azịza ziri ezi nke data nnwale dịka ọ dị.
l-m-h3-b0c36-16.s.s1.r.d: Nnwale ahụ nwere naanị ọnọdụ 50, ma i weere njehie ahụ dịka ọ fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ efu.
l-m-h3-b0c36-16.s.s1.explain: 90%±8 pasent bụ 82% ruo 98%. N’ime ọnọdụ 1000, nke ahụ bụ ihe dịka ọnọdụ 820 ruo 980.
l-m-h3-b0c36-16.s.s2.model.0: N’ihe atụ 50, njehie bụ ihe dịka ±8 pasent; ya mere maka ọnọdụ 1000, kwe ka oke 820 ruo 980.
l-m-h3-b0c36-16.s.s2.model.1: 90% apụtaghị kpọmkwem 900; tụlee njehie 2×0.04=0.08: 82% ruo 98%, ma dịka ọnụọgụ ọnọdụ ọ bụ 820 ruo 980.

l-m-h3-b0c37-13.title: Ọnụọgụ ịmụba a chọrọ maka matrix product
l-m-h3-b0c37-13.goal: Mee atụmatụ ọnụọgụ ịmụba a chọrọ maka matrix multiplication, họrọ nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0c37-13.material: Ị chọrọ ịmụba matriks 1000×500 A na matriks 500×200 B. A na-enweta ụkpụrụ ọ bụla nsonaazụ site n’ịmụba ụzọ abụọ ụkpụrụ 500 ma chịkọta ha.
l-m-h3-b0c37-13.s.s1.prompt: Ihe dịka ịmụba ole ka a chọrọ n’ozuzu?
l-m-h3-b0c37-13.s.s1.r.a: Ị gụrụ naanị ụkpụrụ dị na nsonaazụ ma chefuo na ụkpụrụ ọ bụla chọrọ ịmụba 500.
l-m-h3-b0c37-13.s.s1.r.b: Ị mụbara naanị 500×200. I chefuru ahịrị 1000.
l-m-h3-b0c37-13.s.s1.r.c: Ị mere atụmatụ ọnụọgụ ịmụba ka ọ dị okpukpu 10 karịa.
l-m-h3-b0c37-13.s.s1.explain: Nsonaazụ nwere ụkpụrụ 1000×200=200,000 (20×10,000), ụkpụrụ nke ọ bụla chọkwara ịmụba 500; ya mere 20×10,000×500=nde 100 (1×10⁸).
l-m-h3-b0c37-13.s.s2.model.0: Ụkpụrụ nsonaazụ 200,000 (20×10,000) nke ọ bụla chọrọ ịmụba 500; ya mere 20×10,000×500 bụ ihe dịka nde 100 (1×10⁸).
l-m-h3-b0c37-13.s.s2.model.1: A na-amụba ahịrị 1000, kọlụm 200, na 500 dị n’etiti ọnụ, ya mere 1000×200×500 bụ ihe dịka nde 100 (1×10⁸).

l-m-h3-b0c37-14.title: Ịtụ ohere ịbụ onye ọrịa mgbe nsonaazụ ule bụ positive
l-m-h3-b0c37-14.goal: Mee atụmatụ probability na onye nwetara positive n’ule bụ n’ezie onye ọrịa, họrọ nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0c37-14.material: A nwale mmadụ 1000. 2% (mmadụ 20) bụ ndị ọrịa, 80% nke ndị ọrịa nwetara positive, 10% nke ndị na-abụghị ndị ọrịa nwetakwara positive. Mee atụmatụ oke ndị ọrịa n’ezie n’etiti ndị nwetara positive.
l-m-h3-b0c37-14.s.s1.prompt: Oke ahụ bụ ihe dịka ole?
l-m-h3-b0c37-14.s.s1.r.a: Ị gwakọtara oke positive n’etiti ndị ọrịa na oke ndị ọrịa n’etiti positive.
l-m-h3-b0c37-14.s.s1.r.c: Nke ahụ bụ oke positive n’etiti ndị na-abụghị ndị ọrịa. Ọ bụghị oke ndị ọrịa.
l-m-h3-b0c37-14.s.s1.r.d: Nke ahụ bụ oke ndị ọrịa tupu ule. Ọ na-agbanwe mgbe nsonaazụ positive gasịrị.
l-m-h3-b0c37-14.s.s1.explain: N’ime ndị ọrịa 20, mmadụ 16 na n’ime ndị na-abụghị ndị ọrịa 980, mmadụ 98 nwetara positive. N’ime positive 114, mmadụ 16 bụ ndị ọrịa, ya bụ ihe dịka 14%.
l-m-h3-b0c37-14.s.s2.model.0: N’etiti ndị nwetara positive, ndị ọrịa bụ 20×0.8=mmadụ 16, ndị na-abụghị ndị ọrịa bụ 980×0.1=mmadụ 98, ya mere ọ bụ 16/114, ihe dịka 14%.
l-m-h3-b0c37-14.s.s2.model.1: E nwere ọtụtụ ndị na-abụghị ndị ọrịa, ya mere false alarm 98 karịrị ndị ọrịa 16, ihe dịka 14% nke positive bụ ndị ọrịa.

l-m-h3-b0c37-15.title: Ịtụ ọnụ ọgụgụ nzọụkwụ maka gradient descent
l-m-h3-b0c37-15.goal: Mee atụmatụ ọnụ ọgụgụ nzọụkwụ gradient descent chọrọ ruo mgbe uru ga-adị obere nke ọma, họrọ nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0c37-15.material: Ọ bụrụ na i mee gradient descent na f(x)=x² na learning rate 0.1, x na-aghọ 0.8 ugboro n’ime nzọụkwụ ọ bụla. Malite na x=10, mee atụmatụ nzọụkwụ ole ga-ewe ka |x| dị obere karịa 1.
l-m-h3-b0c37-15.s.s1.prompt: Ihe dịka nzọụkwụ ole ka ọ ga-ewe?
l-m-h3-b0c37-15.s.s1.r.b: I chere na x na-abụ ọkara oge ọ bụla.
l-m-h3-b0c37-15.s.s1.r.c: I chere na ọ na-ebelata naanị 0.1 kwa nzọụkwụ.
l-m-h3-b0c37-15.s.s1.r.d: I chere na ọ na-adị obere okpukpu 10 n’otu oge.
l-m-h3-b0c37-15.s.s1.explain: 0.8¹⁰≈0.107 na 0.8¹¹≈0.086, ya mere 10×0.8¹¹≈0.86<1. Ọ na-ewe ihe dịka nzọụkwụ 11.
l-m-h3-b0c37-15.s.s2.model.0: Ọ na-aghọ okpukpu 0.8 na nzọụkwụ ọ bụla, ya mere chọọ n ebe 10×0.8ⁿ<1. Ọ bụ 1.07 na n=10 na 0.86 na n=11, ya mere ihe dịka nzọụkwụ 11.
l-m-h3-b0c37-15.s.s2.model.1: Ibelata ruo okpukpu 0.8 na nzọụkwụ ọ bụla na-ewe ihe karịrị nzọụkwụ 3 iji belata ọkara, ya mere a chọrọ ihe dịka nzọụkwụ 10 ma ọ bụ ntakịrị karịa ka 10 daa n’okpuru 1.

l-m-h3-b0c37-16.title: Ịtụ precision na recall
l-m-h3-b0c37-16.goal: Mee atụmatụ precision na recall nke ụdị ahụ, họrọ nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0c37-16.material: N’ule 2000, 80 bụ positive n’ezie. N’ime 100 ụdị ahụ kpọrọ positive, 60 bụ positive n’ezie. Mee atụmatụ nha precision na recall.
l-m-h3-b0c37-16.s.s1.prompt: Precision na recall bụ ihe dịka ole?
l-m-h3-b0c37-16.s.s1.o.a: Precision ihe dịka 0.75, recall ihe dịka 0.6
l-m-h3-b0c37-16.s.s1.o.c: Precision ihe dịka 0.6, recall ihe dịka 0.75
l-m-h3-b0c37-16.s.s1.r.d: Nke ahụ bụ accuracy. Ọ dị elu n’ihi na e nwere ọtụtụ ọnọdụ nkịtị.
l-m-h3-b0c37-16.s.s1.explain: Precision=60/100=0.6 na recall=60/80=0.75. Accuracy dị elu na 0.97 n’ihi na e nwere ọtụtụ ọnọdụ nkịtị.
l-m-h3-b0c37-16.s.s2.model.0: N’ime positive 100 e buru amụma, 60 ziri ezi, ya mere precision bụ 0.6; n’ime positive n’ezie 80, a chọtara 60, ya mere recall bụ 0.75.
l-m-h3-b0c37-16.s.s2.model.1: Denominator nke precision bụ 100, ọnụọgụ akpọrọ positive; nke recall bụ 80, ọnụọgụ positive n’ezie, ya mere ha bụ ihe dịka 0.6 na 0.75.

l-m-h3-b0c38-04.goal: Tụlee ogologo vektọ (3.9, 4.1) iji kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke dabara adaba, kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0c38-04.material: E nwere vektọ (3.9, 4.1) na-anọchite anya njirimara onyonyo. Ka anyị tụlee ogologo vektọ a n’enweghị ihe mgbako. 3.9 na 4.1 abụọ dị nso na 4.
l-m-h3-b0c38-04.s.s1.prompt: Kedu atụmatụ kacha mma maka ogologo vektọ ahụ?
l-m-h3-b0c38-04.s.s1.r.a: Nke ahụ bụ nha otu akụkụ naanị. Ị ga-atụle akụkụ abụọ ahụ.
l-m-h3-b0c38-04.s.s1.r.b: Ị gbakwụnyere akụkụ ndị ahụ naanị. Ogologo bụ mgbọrọgwụ square nke ngụkọta square ha.
l-m-h3-b0c38-04.s.s1.r.c: Ị hapụrụ mgbọrọgwụ square nke ngụkọta square.
l-m-h3-b0c38-04.s.s1.explain: Iwere ya dịka (4,4), ogologo ya bụ √(16+16)=√32≈5.7. Uru n’ezie bụkwa ihe dịka 5.66.
l-m-h3-b0c38-04.s.s2.model.0: Akụkụ abụọ ahụ bụ ihe dịka 4; ya mere ogologo bụ √(4²+4²)=√32, dị n’agbata 5 na 6, ihe dịka 5.7.
l-m-h3-b0c38-04.s.s2.model.1: Ogologo bụ mgbọrọgwụ square nke ngụkọta square; ya mere ọ bụ ihe dịka 5.7, mgbọrọgwụ square nke 16+16=32. Ọ bụghị 4 ma ọ bụ 8.

l-m-h3-b0c38-12.goal: Tụlee ohere na ngwaahịa a kpọrọ nwere ntụpọ nwere ntụpọ n’ezie iji kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke dabara adaba, kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0c38-12.material: 1% ngwaahịa nwere ntụpọ. AI nyocha na-akpọ 90% nke ndị nwere ntụpọ dịka ndị nwere ntụpọ, na-akpọkwa 9% nke ndị nkịtị dịka ndị nwere ntụpọ n’amaghị ama. Ka anyị tụlee site n’iche maka ngwaahịa 1000.
l-m-h3-b0c38-12.s.s1.prompt: Ihe dịka ole bụ ohere ngwaahịa a kpọrọ nwere ntụpọ nwere ntụpọ n’ezie?
l-m-h3-b0c38-12.s.s1.r.a: Ị gwakọtara ya na ọnụego nyocha na-achọta ntụpọ. Ntụziaka ahụ bụ nke ọzọ.
l-m-h3-b0c38-12.s.s1.r.b: N’ime ihe dịka 98 a kpọrọ nwere ntụpọ, naanị 9 nwere ntụpọ n’ezie.
l-m-h3-b0c38-12.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụrụ na a kpọrọ ya nwere ntụpọ, ohere ahụ na-arị elu karịa ọnụego mbụ ntụpọ 1%.
l-m-h3-b0c38-12.s.s1.explain: N’ime 1000, 10 nwere ntụpọ, 9 n’ime ha, tinyere ihe dịka 89 n’ime 990 ndị nkịtị, a ga-akpọ ha nwere ntụpọ. 9÷98 bụ ihe dịka 9%.
l-m-h3-b0c38-12.s.s2.model.0: A ga-akpọ ihe dịka 9+89=98 nwere ntụpọ, naanị 9 nwere ntụpọ n’ezie; ya mere ohere bụ ihe dịka 10%.
l-m-h3-b0c38-12.s.s2.model.1: E nwere ọtụtụ ngwaahịa nkịtị, ya mere mkpebi ụgha banyere ntụpọ karịrị nke ziri ezi; ohere ahụ dị ala, ihe dịka 10%.

l-m-h3-b0c38-18.title: N'ime oke ole ka ozi spam kwa ụbọchị ga-adị?
l-m-h3-b0c38-18.topic: Atụmatụ nkesa binomial site na nkesa nkịtị
l-m-h3-b0c38-18.goal: Tụọ oke ọnụọgụ ozi spam kwa ụbọchị, họrọ oke dabara adaba, kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c38-18.material: N'ime ozi email 400 kwa ụbọchị, ohere nke spam bụ 25% (nọọrọ onwe ha). Nkezi spam bụ 100, ọkọlọtọ ndapụ bụ √75≈8.7. Ka anyị jiri nkesa nkịtị tụọ ya.
l-m-h3-b0c38-18.s.s1.prompt: Kedu oke nwere ihe dịka 95% nke ọnụọgụ spam kwa ụbọchị?
l-m-h3-b0c38-18.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ nkezi±1 ọkọlọtọ ndapụ, oke ihe dịka 68%.
l-m-h3-b0c38-18.s.s1.r.b: Oke ahụ dị warara nke ukwuu. Tinye ọkọlọtọ ndapụ 8.7 n'uche.
l-m-h3-b0c38-18.s.s1.r.c: Nke a karịrị ọkọlọtọ ndapụ ugboro 8, sara mbara karịa 95% nke ukwuu.
l-m-h3-b0c38-18.s.s1.explain: Ihe dịka 95% bụ nkezi±ọkọlọtọ ndapụ 2: 100±2×8.7, ihe dịka 83 ruo 117.
l-m-h3-b0c38-18.s.s2.model.0: N'ime nkesa nkịtị, 95% bụ nkezi±ọkọlọtọ ndapụ 2; ya bụ 100±17.4, ihe dịka 83 ruo 117.
l-m-h3-b0c38-18.s.s2.model.1: 92 ruo 108 bụ ±1 ọkọlọtọ ndapụ, ya mere naanị ihe dịka 68% dị na ya; 25 ruo 175 sara mbara nke ukwuu. 83 ruo 117 dabara.

l-m-h3-b0c38-20.title: Gịnị ga-abụ w mgbe emelitere ya ugboro atọ?
l-m-h3-b0c38-20.goal: Tụọ w mgbe nzọụkwụ gradient descent 3 gachara; họrọ oke dabara adaba, kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c38-20.material: Loss bụ f(w)=w², mmalite w=10, learning rate 0.1. N'ọnọdụ mmelite ọ bụla, wepụ 0.1×2w na w. Ka anyị tụọ w mgbe mmelite atọ gachara.
l-m-h3-b0c38-20.s.s1.prompt: Kedu uru kacha dabara maka w mgbe mmelite atọ gachara?
l-m-h3-b0c38-20.s.s1.r.a: I chere na ọ ga-eru ebe kacha nta n'otu nzọụkwụ. Learning rate dị obere.
l-m-h3-b0c38-20.s.s1.r.b: Ị nọgidere na-eji mkpọda mbụ, 20. Mkpọda na-ebelata.
l-m-h3-b0c38-20.s.s1.r.d: Nke a bụ uru mgbe naanị mmelite otu gachara.
l-m-h3-b0c38-20.s.s1.explain: Mmelite ọ bụla na-eme ka w bụrụ 0.8 nke ya. 10×0.8×0.8×0.8=5.12.
l-m-h3-b0c38-20.s.s2.model.0: Mmelite ọ bụla na-eme ka w bụrụ 0.8 nke mbụ; ya mere 10×0.8³=5.12, ihe dịka 5.1.
l-m-h3-b0c38-20.s.s2.model.1: Mkpọda na-ebelata ka w na-ebelata, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dịka 5.1, karịrị 4 (iwepụ 2 oge ọ bụla) ma dị ala karịa 8 (naanị otu mmelite).

l-m-h3-b0c39-13.title: Ugboro ole ka a ga-awụ iji jupụta akpa mmiri 20 L?
l-m-h3-b0c39-13.goal: Tụlee ugboro ole karama 1.8 L ga-eji jupụta akpa 20 L, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke dabara adaba, kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0c39-13.material: Ị jupụtara karama 1.8 L na mmiri, jiri ya jupụta akpa 20 L. Tụlee ugboro ole n’enweghị ihe mgbako.
l-m-h3-b0c39-13.s.s1.prompt: A ga-awụ ugboro ole ihe dịka?
l-m-h3-b0c39-13.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ uru e nwetara site n’iwere karama dịka ihe dịka 5 L. Karama bụ 1.8 L, ya mere a chọrọ ịwụ karịa.
l-m-h3-b0c39-13.s.s1.r.c: Ị mụbara 20×1.8. A ga-ekewa iji tụlee.
l-m-h3-b0c39-13.s.s1.r.d: Ọnụọgụ ọnụọgụ buru otu ebe karịa. 20÷2 bụ ihe dịka 10.
l-m-h3-b0c39-13.s.s1.explain: Iwere 1.8 dịka 2, 20÷2=ugboro 10; ebe karama dị ntakịrị karịa nke ahụ, ọ bụ ntakịrị karịa 10, ihe dịka ugboro 11.
l-m-h3-b0c39-13.s.s2.model.0: Ịgbanwe 1.8 L ka ọ bụrụ 2 L na-enye 20÷2=ugboro 10; karama n’ezie pere mpe ntakịrị, ya mere ihe dịka ugboro 11.
l-m-h3-b0c39-13.s.s2.model.1: 20÷1.8 dị ntakịrị karịa 20÷2=10, ya mere ihe dịka ugboro 11. Ugboro 36 ma ọ bụ 4 adabaghị n’ọnụọgụ ọnụọgụ.

l-m-h3-b0c39-14.goal: Tụlee ọnụahịa bolt 412, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke dabara adaba ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0c39-14.material: Bolt otu na-efu 78 won, ịchọrọ 412. Mmefu ego bụ 30,000 won. Tupu ịmụba kpọmkwem, buru ụzọ kpebie site n’ịtụle.
l-m-h3-b0c39-14.s.s1.prompt: Site n’atụmatụ, kedu ka mmefu ego dị?
l-m-h3-b0c39-14.s.s1.r.a: Mgbe i jiri 70 won na ihe 400 mee atụmatụ, i gbadara ha abụọ; ya mere uru ahụ dị nta.
l-m-h3-b0c39-14.s.s1.r.b: 78 won karịrị 75 won, 412 karịrị 400; ya mere ọ karịrị 30,000 won.
l-m-h3-b0c39-14.s.s1.r.d: Ọnụọgụ digits dị obere otu ogo. 80×400 bụ 32,000.
l-m-h3-b0c39-14.s.s1.explain: 80 won×400 ihe=32,000 won. Ezigbo uru 78×412=32,136 won; ya mere ego 30,000 ezughị.
l-m-h3-b0c39-14.s.s2.model.0: Were 78 won dịka 80, 412 dịka 400: 80×400=32,000, karịrị 30,000; ya mere ezughị.
l-m-h3-b0c39-14.s.s2.model.1: Ọbụna 75 won×400 bụ 30,000 won; uru ndị dị adị ka ukwuu, ya mere ha gafere 30,000 ma ego ezughị.

l-m-h3-b0c39-17.s.s1.prompt: Site n'oke ibu ahụ, gịnị ka mkpebi kwesịrị ịbụ?
l-m-h3-b0c39-17.s.s1.o.a: Ọ dị nchebe (n'ihi na nkezi bụ 0.5 kg)
l-m-h3-b0c39-17.s.s1.r.a: Ọbụna ma nkezi bụ 0.5, ha niile nwere ike ịdị arọ. Tụlee nke kacha arọ.
l-m-h3-b0c39-17.s.s1.o.b: Ọ dị nchebe (n'ihi na ikpe dị mfe bụ 96 kg)
l-m-h3-b0c39-17.s.s1.r.b: I lere naanị ọnọdụ kacha dị mfe. A na-ekpebi nchekwa site n'ọnọdụ kacha arọ.
l-m-h3-b0c39-17.s.s1.o.c: Enweghị m ike ijide n'aka (104 kg ga-ekwe omume)
l-m-h3-b0c39-17.s.s1.o.d: Enweghị m ike ikpebi (amaghị ibu kpọmkwem)
l-m-h3-b0c39-17.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụrụ na ị ma oke ahụ, ị nwere ike iji nke kacha nta na nke kacha elu tụọ ya.

l-m-h3-b0c39-17.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ ihe 200 niile bụ 0.52 kg, ọ bụ 104 kg, nwere ike ịgafe 100; ya mere enweghị nkwa na ọ dị nchebe.

l-m-h3-b0c41-14.material: Ihe dịka mmadụ 48 na-eri nri n’ụlọ nri kwa ụbọchị; onye ọ bụla na-eji ihe dịka 0.11kg osikapa. Were ọnwa dịka ụbọchị 30, tụlee osikapa a ga-eji.
l-m-h3-b0c41-14.s.s1.prompt: Kedu atụmatụ kacha dabara adaba maka osikapa otu ọnwa?

l-m-h3-b0c41-14.s.s1.r.b: Nke ahụ karịrị 50kg kwa ụbọchị. Echefuru ebe decimal nke 0.11kg.
l-m-h3-b0c41-14.s.s1.r.d: Ọnụọgụ a were ọnwa dịka naanị ihe dịka ụbọchị 15.

l-m-h3-b0c41-14.s.s2.model.0: Ihe dịka mmadụ 50×0.1kg=5kg ka a na-eji kwa ụbọchị; ya mere ụbọchị 30 bụ ihe dịka 150kg, 160kg kacha nso.
l-m-h3-b0c41-14.s.s2.model.1: Ugboro 30 nke 5kg kwa ụbọchị bụ ihe dịka 150kg; ya mere 16kg na 1600kg nwere ebe ọnụọgụ na-ezighị ezi.

l-m-h3-b0c41-15.goal: Tụlee ma ọnụahịa ngụkọta ihe a ga-azụta gafere mmefu ego iji kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke dabara adaba, kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c41-15.material: Anyị zụtara ihe 4, nke ọ bụla 3,980 won; ihe 6, nke ọ bụla 1,990 won; na ihe 1, 9,900 won. Mmefu ego bụ 30,000 won. Kpebie site n’atụmatụ ma ọ gafere mmefu ego.
l-m-h3-b0c41-15.s.s1.prompt: Kedu azịza ziri ezi site n’atụmatụ?
l-m-h3-b0c41-15.s.s1.o.a: Ihe dịka 38,000 won, ya mere ọ gafere mmefu ego
l-m-h3-b0c41-15.s.s1.o.b: Ihe dịka 28,000 won, ya mere ọ dabara n’ime mmefu ego
l-m-h3-b0c41-15.s.s1.r.b: Nke a bụ ngụkọta n’enweghị ihe 9,900 won. Ị ga-agbakwunye ihe niile.
l-m-h3-b0c41-15.s.s1.o.c: Ihe dịka 16,000 won, ya mere ọ dabara n’ime mmefu ego
l-m-h3-b0c41-15.s.s1.r.c: Ị gbakwụnyere ọnụahịa otu ihe naanị, amụbaghị na ọnụọgụ.
l-m-h3-b0c41-15.s.s1.r.d: Ọbụna ma i bulie ọnụahịa elu, ọ bụrụ na ọ karịrị nke ukwuu, ị ka nwere ike ikpebi.
l-m-h3-b0c41-15.s.s1.explain: 4000×4+2000×6+10000=38000 won. Ngụkọta kpọmkwem bụ 37,760 won, ọ gaferekwa mmefu ego 30,000 won.
l-m-h3-b0c41-15.s.s2.model.0: Ịchịkọta ọnụahịa ka ọ bụrụ 4000, 2000 na 10000 won ma mụbaa na ọnụọgụ na-enye 38000 won; ya mere ọ karịrị mmefu ego 30000 won.
l-m-h3-b0c41-15.s.s2.model.1: Uru n’ezie pere mpe karịa atụmatụ ntakịrị, ma ọdịiche pere mpe; ya mere ị nwere ike ikwu na ọ karịrị 30000 won.

l-m-h3-b0c42-14.material: Site na data ụmụ akwụkwọ mụrụ awa 0 ruo 6, anyị nwetara ahịrị “akara = 8×awa + 45”. Itinye awa 10 na-enye akara 125.
l-m-h3-b0c42-14.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nkwupụta dabara maka ịkọ akara mgbe a mụrụ awa 10?
l-m-h3-b0c42-14.s.s1.o.a: Kwuo na ọ bụ akara 125 dịka ọ dị
l-m-h3-b0c42-14.s.s1.r.a: Akara kacha elu bụ 100, ya mere akara 125 enweghị isi.
l-m-h3-b0c42-14.s.s1.o.b: Ahịrị ahụ ezighị ezi, ya mere enweghị ike ịkọ amụma
l-m-h3-b0c42-14.s.s1.r.b: Ahịrị ahụ bara uru n’ime awa 0 ruo 6. Nsogbu bụ na nke a dị n’èzí oke ahụ.
l-m-h3-b0c42-14.s.s1.o.c: Enweghị data karịrị awa 6, ya mere o siri ike ịtụkwasị obi
l-m-h3-b0c42-14.s.s1.r.d: O kwupụtara akara 100 n’enweghị data ọ bụla.
l-m-h3-b0c42-14.s.s1.explain: A pụrụ ịtụkwasị ahịrị ahụ obi naanị n’ime awa 0 ruo 6 ebe data dị. N’èzí oke ahụ, amụma na-adịghị mma dịka akara 125 na-apụta.
l-m-h3-b0c42-14.s.s2.model.0: Data bụ naanị awa 0 ruo 6, ya mere awa 10 dị n’èzí oke; uru usoro akara 125 karịrị akara zuru oke, ya mere enweghị ike ịtụkwasị ya obi dịka ọ dị.

l-m-h3-b0c42-20.title: Ọ bụrụ na a tụgharịa dice ugboro 600, ihe dị ka ugboro ole ka 6 ga-apụta?
l-m-h3-b0c42-20.goal: Tụọ nso ugboro ole 6 ga-apụta n’ime ntụgharị dice 600, họrọ nso kwesịrị ekwesị ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c42-20.material: Mgbe a tụgharịrị dice ziri ezi ugboro 600, nkezi ugboro 6 pụtara bụ 100, ndapụ ọkọlọtọ dịkwa ihe dị ka 9. Tụọ nso nke ga-enwe ihe dị ka 95% nke ikpe.
l-m-h3-b0c42-20.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nso dabara adaba nwere ihe dị ka 95%?
l-m-h3-b0c42-20.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ nso na-enwe nsonaazụ mgbe niile, ya mere ọ bụghị atụmatụ.
l-m-h3-b0c42-20.s.s1.r.b: Nke a bụ nkezi ± 5 × ndapụ ọkọlọtọ, sara mbara karịa ihe dị ka 95%.
l-m-h3-b0c42-20.s.s1.r.c: Nke a dị warara karịa ndapụ ọkọlọtọ 9 nke ukwuu; ọ gaghị enwe 95%.
l-m-h3-b0c42-20.s.s1.explain: Ihe dị ka 95% bụ nkezi ± 2 × ndapụ ọkọlọtọ. 100±18, ya bụ 82 ruo 118.
l-m-h3-b0c42-20.s.s2.model.0: Ịga ihe dị ka 18, nke bụ 2 × ndapụ ọkọlọtọ, n’akụkụ abụọ nke nkezi na-enye 82 ruo 118; nke a na-ekpuchi ihe dị ka 95%, ya mere ọ dabara.
l-m-h3-b0c42-20.s.s2.model.1: 99 ruo 101 dị warara nke ukwuu, 55 ruo 145 sara mbara nke ukwuu; 82 ruo 118, nke bụ nkezi ± 2 × ndapụ ọkọlọtọ, ziri ezi.

l-m-h3-b0c42-26.topic: Ịtụ ọnụ ọgụgụ mmadụ site n’ihe atụ
l-m-h3-b0c42-26.goal: Tụọ ọnụ ọgụgụ azụ dị n’ọdọ mmiri, họrọ nha ma ọ bụ nso kwesịrị ekwesị, kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c42-26.material: E jidere azụ 100, kaa ha akara, hapụ ha. Ụbọchị ole na ole ka e mesịrị, e jidere azụ 50, 5 n’ime ha nwere akara.
l-m-h3-b0c42-26.s.s1.prompt: Kedu atụmatụ kwesịrị ekwesị maka ọnụ ọgụgụ azụ dị n’ọdọ mmiri?
l-m-h3-b0c42-26.s.s1.r.a: A gbakọtara ya dịka 100+50−5. E jighị oke ahụ mee ihe.
l-m-h3-b0c42-26.s.s1.r.c: E jiri azụ 45 enweghị akara mụbaa na 100.
l-m-h3-b0c42-26.s.s1.r.d: E jiri 100×5 mụbaa; nke ahụ adabaghị n’ihe oke pụtara.
l-m-h3-b0c42-26.s.s1.explain: Azụ akara 100 bụ ihe dị ka 10% (5÷50) nke azụ niile, ya mere ọdọ ahụ nwere ihe dị ka azụ 1000.
l-m-h3-b0c42-26.s.s2.model.0: 10% nke azụ 50 e jidere nke ugboro abụọ nwere akara; ya mere azụ akara 100 bụ 10% nke azụ niile, ihe dị ka 1000.
l-m-h3-b0c42-26.s.s2.model.1: Anyị chere na oke dị n’ihe atụ yiri oke dị n’ọdọ dum, ya mere atụmatụ bụ 100÷0.1=1000.

l-m-h3-b0c43-04.goal: Tụlee ọnụ ọgụgụ mkpụrụ osikapa dị n'otu akpa, kpebie ọnụọgụ ma ọ bụ oke dabara adaba, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c43-04.material: Ịgụ 100g osikapa nyere ihe dị ka mkpụrụ 5000. Tụọ ọnụ ọgụgụ mkpụrụ osikapa dị n'akpa 5kg dum.
l-m-h3-b0c43-04.s.s1.prompt: Nke bụ atụmatụ dabara adaba maka ọnụ ọgụgụ mkpụrụ ahụ bụ nke?

l-m-h3-b0c43-04.s.s1.r.b: Ewere 5kg dị ka ihe dị ka 500g, ya mere uru ọnụọgụ ebe ahụ pere mpe nke ukwuu.
l-m-h3-b0c43-04.s.s1.r.c: A were 5kg dịka ihe dịka 50kg, ya mere ebe uru ọnụọgụ dị oke elu.

l-m-h3-b0c43-04.s.s2.model.0: 5kg bụ okpukpu 50 nke 100g, ya mere mkpụrụ ahụ bụkwa okpukpu 50 nke 5000, ihe dịka 25 × 10,000 (250,000), nke dabara.
l-m-h3-b0c43-04.s.s2.model.1: Anyị na-eme ka ọnụọgụ mkpụrụ n’ime sample 100g bawanye ruo ibu niile, ya mere anyị na-eme atụmatụ 5000×50=250000.

l-m-h3-b0c43-13.title: Olee otu ị ga-esi mee atụmatụ correlation coefficient site na scatter plot?
l-m-h3-b0c43-13.goal: Mee atụmatụ nha correlation coefficient site na scatter plot, họrọ nha ma ọ bụ oke dabara, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c43-13.material: Na scatter plot nke ịdị elu na ibu ụmụ akwụkwọ 30, ọtụtụ isi ihe na-eme eriri dị warara na-atụ aka elu-nri, naanị ole na ole si n’ahịrị pụọ ntakịrị.
l-m-h3-b0c43-13.s.s1.prompt: Kedu atụmatụ dabara maka correlation coefficient?
l-m-h3-b0c43-13.s.s1.r.a: Isi ihe na-aga elu-nri, ya mere ọ ga-abụ positive.
l-m-h3-b0c43-13.s.s1.r.c: Eriri ahụ dị warara nke ukwuu, ya mere ọ karịrị 0.5.
l-m-h3-b0c43-13.s.s1.r.d: Nke ahụ bụ uru mgbe isi ihe gbasasịrị ihe fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ ebe niile.
l-m-h3-b0c43-13.s.s1.explain: Isi ihe na-aga elu-nri ma chịkọta nke ọma n’akụkụ ahịrị kwụ ọtọ; ya mere ihe dịka 0.9, nọmba positive dị nso 1, dabara.
l-m-h3-b0c43-13.s.s2.model.0: Isi ihe na-aga elu-nri, ya mere ọ bụ positive; ha chịkọtakwara nso n’ahịrị, ya mere ihe dịka 0.9, nso 1, dabara.
l-m-h3-b0c43-13.s.s2.model.1: Isi ihe agbasaghị nke ukwuu, ya mere 0.1 ma ọ bụ 0.5 pere mpe; ntụziaka bụ elu-nri, ya mere ọ gaghị abụ −0.9. Ya mere ihe dịka 0.9 ziri ezi.

l-m-h3-b0c43-25.title: Ọnụego nlele na-agbanwekarị ruo ole?
l-m-h3-b0c43-25.goal: Tụọ oke ebe ọnụego nlele na-adaba, họrọ ọnụọgụ ma ọ bụ oke dabara adaba, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c43-25.material: Ọnụego ndị nwere otu echiche n'ime ìgwè mmadụ niile bụ 0.3. Ọ bụrụ na anyị jiri usoro nhọrọ n'amaghị ama nyochaa mmadụ 100, mgbasa ọkọlọtọ nke ọnụego nlele bụ ihe dị ka 0.046. Tụọ oke ebe ọnụego nlele ga-adaba ihe dị ka 95% nke oge.
l-m-h3-b0c43-25.s.s1.prompt: Oke dabara adaba ebe ọnụego nlele ga-adaba ihe dị ka 95% nke oge bụ nke?
l-m-h3-b0c43-25.s.s1.r.a: Ọ dị warara karịa mgbasa ọkọlọtọ 0.046 nke ukwuu.
l-m-h3-b0c43-25.s.s1.r.c: Ọ sara mbara nke ukwuu nke na ọ fọrọ nke nta ka ọ tinye uru ahụ mgbe niile.
l-m-h3-b0c43-25.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ uru niile nwere ike ịdị, ya mere ọ bụghị atụmatụ.
l-m-h3-b0c43-25.s.s1.explain: Ihe dị ka 95% bụ nkezi ±2×mgbasa ọkọlọtọ. 0.3±2×0.046, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka 0.21 ruo 0.39.
l-m-h3-b0c43-25.s.s2.model.0: Ịgbasa ihe dị ka 0.09 (ugboro 2 nke mgbasa ọkọlọtọ) site na 0.3 gaa n'akụkụ abụọ na-enye 0.21 ruo 0.39, nke kpuchiri ihe dị ka 95%, ya mere ọ dabara adaba.
l-m-h3-b0c43-25.s.s2.model.1: 0.29 ruo 0.31 dị warara nke ukwuu, 0.10 ruo 0.50 dịkwa sara mbara nke ukwuu; ya mere 0.21 ruo 0.39, nke bụ 0.3±2×0.046, bụ eziokwu.

l-m-h3-b0c44-14.title: Ịtụ margin of error nke poll
l-m-h3-b0c44-14.goal: Mee atụmatụ margin of error nke poll iji họrọ nha ma ọ bụ oke dabara, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0c44-14.material: Anyị jụrụ mmadụ 400 a họọrọ n’amaghị ama, support rate maka otu iwu bụ 52%. Anyị chọrọ ime atụmatụ margin of error 95% nke sample proportion.
l-m-h3-b0c44-14.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ atụmatụ kacha dabara maka margin of error.
l-m-h3-b0c44-14.s.s1.r.a: Ọ sara mbara nke ukwuu. Mgbe ahụ ị gaghị ama ma ndị mmadụ kwadoro ya.
l-m-h3-b0c44-14.s.s1.r.b: ±10 percentage points bụ maka mmadụ ihe dịka 100. Maka mmadụ 400 ọ dị warara karịa.
l-m-h3-b0c44-14.s.s1.r.c: Maka mmadụ 400, ị gaghị enwe ike ịtụ ya nke ọma otú a.
l-m-h3-b0c44-14.s.s1.explain: 1÷√400=0.05, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dịka ±5 percentage points. Kpọmkwem karịa, 1.96×√(0.52×0.48÷400)≈4.9 percentage points.
l-m-h3-b0c44-14.s.s2.model.0: Standard error nke sample proportion bụ ihe dịka 0.025, margin of error dịkwa ihe dịka okpukpu abụọ nke ahụ; ya mere ±5 percentage points dabara.
l-m-h3-b0c44-14.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na sample bụ 400, 1÷√400=0.05, ya mere atụmatụ dịka ±5 percentage points dabara.

l-m-h3-b0c44-15.title: Ihe dị ka ole isi n'ịtụ mkpụrụ ego ugboro 100?
l-m-h3-b0c44-15.topic: Ịtụ atụmatụ site na normal distribution
l-m-h3-b0c44-15.goal: Mee atụmatụ oke ọnụọgụ isi a na-enwetakarị n’ịtụ mkpụrụ ego iji họrọ nha ma ọ bụ oke dabara, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0c44-15.material: Mgbe a tụbara mkpụrụ ego ziri ezi ugboro 100, a na-ewere ọnụọgụ isi ka ọ dị nso na normal distribution nwere mean 50 na standard deviation 5. Mee atụmatụ oke ọnụọgụ isi na-adaba n’ime ya ọtụtụ oge (ihe dịka 95%).
l-m-h3-b0c44-15.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ oke kacha dabara maka ọnụọgụ isi.
l-m-h3-b0c44-15.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụ mean ± standard deviation ugboro 5, nke sara mbara karịa nke ukwuu.
l-m-h3-b0c44-15.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụ mean ± otu standard deviation, ya mere naanị ihe dịka 68% dabara n’ime ya.
l-m-h3-b0c44-15.s.s1.r.d: Oke ahụ dị warara nke ukwuu, nsonaazụ na-apụkarị n’èzí ya.
l-m-h3-b0c44-15.s.s1.explain: Ihe dịka 95% bụ mean ± standard deviation ugboro 2. Ebe ọ bụ 50±10, oke ya bụ ugboro 40 ruo 60.
l-m-h3-b0c44-15.s.s2.model.0: 95% dị n’ime standard deviation 2 site na mean, 2×5=10, ya mere ugboro 40 ruo 60 dabara.
l-m-h3-b0c44-15.s.s2.model.1: 45 ruo 55 na-ejide naanị ihe dịka 68%; iji jide 95% a chọrọ 40 ruo 60, nke gbasara okpukpu abụọ.

l-m-h3-b0c44-16.title: Ịtụ confidence interval maka oge ụra
l-m-h3-b0c44-16.goal: Mee atụmatụ population mean nke oge ụra ụmụ akwụkwọ iji họrọ nha ma ọ bụ oke dabara, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0c44-16.material: Anyị nyochara oge ụra kwa ụbọchị nke ụmụ akwụkwọ 36, mean bụ awa 7.0. Anyị maara na population standard deviation bụ awa 1.2. Mee atụmatụ confidence interval 95% maka population mean.
l-m-h3-b0c44-16.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ atụmatụ kacha dabara maka confidence interval.
l-m-h3-b0c44-16.s.s1.r.a: Maka ụmụ akwụkwọ 36, ị gaghị eme atụmatụ nke ọma otú a.
l-m-h3-b0c44-16.s.s1.r.c: Nke a jiri standard deviation 1.2 dịka ọ dị, leghara sample size anya.
l-m-h3-b0c44-16.s.s1.r.d: O jiri naanị 1 ugboro standard error, ya mere ọ dị warara karịa maka 95%.
l-m-h3-b0c44-16.s.s1.explain: Standard error bụ 1.2÷6=0.2, 1.96×0.2≈0.4, ya mere ọ bụ 7.0±0.4.
l-m-h3-b0c44-16.s.s2.model.0: Standard error bụ 1.2÷√36=0.2; ịgbakwunye ma wepụ ihe dịka okpukpu 2 nke ahụ, 0.4, na-enye awa 6.6 ruo 7.4.
l-m-h3-b0c44-16.s.s2.model.1: Sample mean anaghị agbasa nke ukwuu dịka nke otu onye, ya mere interval na-adị ihe dịka ±0.4, ọ bụghị ±1.2.

l-m-h3-b0c45-14.material: Akwụkwọ Egypt oge ochie nwere nsogbu ịchọta mpaghara ala gburugburu nwere diameter 9. Were ya na okirikiri nwere diameter 9 dabara kpọmkwem n’ime square nwere akụkụ 9.
l-m-h3-b0c45-14.s.s1.prompt: Kedu atụmatụ kacha mma maka mpaghara okirikiri a?
l-m-h3-b0c45-14.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụ 89% nke square. Okirikiri na-ewe ihe dịka 79%.
l-m-h3-b0c45-14.s.s1.r.b: Ọbụna ma π bụ 3, mpaghara karịrị 60.
l-m-h3-b0c45-14.s.s1.r.d: Nke ahụ bụ mpaghara square. Okirikiri pere mpe karịa ya.
l-m-h3-b0c45-14.s.s1.explain: Okirikiri pere mpe karịa square (81), ịtụ atụmatụ na π≈3.14 na-enye ihe dịka 63.6. 64 kacha nso.
l-m-h3-b0c45-14.s.s2.model.0: Okirikiri dabara n’ime square, ya mere ọ pere mpe karịa 81; 3.14×4.5² bụ ihe dịka 64, ya mere 64 dị nso.
l-m-h3-b0c45-14.s.s2.model.1: Ọbụna ma e were π dịka 3, 3×20.25=60.75, ya mere 54 pere mpe nke ukwuu; 72 ga-achọ π karịrị 3.5, ya mere 64 dabara.

l-m-h3-b0c45-15.title: Kedu decimal approximate nke nọmba base-60 1;24,51,10?
l-m-h3-b0c45-15.goal: Mee atụmatụ nọmba 1;24,51,10 e dere na base 60 iji họrọ nha ma ọ bụ oke dabara, kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c45-15.material: Mbadamba Babylon dekọrọ √2 na base 60 dịka 1;24,51,10. Nke a pụtara 1 + 24/60 + 51/3600 + 10/216000.
l-m-h3-b0c45-15.s.s1.prompt: Kedu decimal approximate kacha mma maka nọmba a?
l-m-h3-b0c45-15.s.s1.r.a: Ị gụrụ digit ndị ahụ site n’ijikọta ha ọnụ. A ga-ekewa na 60.
l-m-h3-b0c45-15.s.s1.r.b: Ị were 24/60 dịka 0.6. N’ezie ọ bụ 0.4.
l-m-h3-b0c45-15.s.s1.r.d: Ị gụrụ 24 dịka decimal places. 24/60 bụ 0.4.
l-m-h3-b0c45-15.s.s1.explain: 24/60=0.4 na 51/3600≈0.014, ya mere 1+0.4+0.014 bụ ihe dịka 1.414, nke fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ otu na √2.
l-m-h3-b0c45-15.s.s2.model.0: 24/60 bụ 0.4, 51/3600 bụ ihe dịka 0.014, ya mere ọ dị ihe dịka 1.414. Ọ bụ otu ihe na √2≈1.414.
l-m-h3-b0c45-15.s.s2.model.1: Na base 60, ebe ọ bụla na-ebelata site n’ịkewa na 60; ya mere e kwesịghị ịgụ ya dịka 1.24, mee atụmatụ ya dịka 1+0.4+0.014.

l-m-h3-b0c45-16.title: Kedu atụmatụ dabara maka gburugburu ụwa site na ọdịiche akụkụ onyinyo?
l-m-h3-b0c45-16.goal: Mee atụmatụ girth nke Ụwa iji họrọ nha ma ọ bụ oke dabara, kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c45-16.material: N’otu obodo, ìhè anyanwụ na-adaba kpọmkwem n’etiti ehihie; akụkụ dị n’etiti radii abụọ e sere site n’etiti Ụwa gaa n’obodo a na obodo dị 800km bụ 7.2°. A chọtara akụkụ ahụ site na akụkụ onyinyo.
l-m-h3-b0c45-16.s.s1.prompt: Kedu atụmatụ kacha mma maka gburugburu Ụwa?
l-m-h3-b0c45-16.s.s1.r.a: Ị gụrụ ọnụọgụ digit ezighị ezi. 360÷7.2 bụ 50.
l-m-h3-b0c45-16.s.s1.r.b: Nke ahụ bụ 7.2×800. A ga-agbakọ oke ahụ site n’iji 360° dịka otu okirikiri zuru ezu.
l-m-h3-b0c45-16.s.s1.r.c: Ị jiri 180° dịka ntọala. Otu okirikiri gburugburu Ụwa bụ 360°.
l-m-h3-b0c45-16.s.s1.explain: 360° bụ okpukpu 50 nke 7.2°, ya mere gburugburu Ụwa bụ okpukpu 50 nke 800km, ihe dịka 40,000km.
l-m-h3-b0c45-16.s.s2.model.0: Otu okirikiri 360° bụ okpukpu 50 nke 7.2°, ya mere gburugburu ahụ bụkwa ihe dịka 40,000km, okpukpu 50 nke 800km.
l-m-h3-b0c45-16.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na 7.2° bụ 800km, mgbe ahụ 1° bụ ihe dịka 111km; ịmụba na 360 na-enye ihe dịka 40,000km, ya mere ọ dabara.
