l-m-h3-b0c46-14.material: N’usoro nhazi nha nhata nke ụda 12, ịrịgo ọkara ụda 12 na-eme ka ugboro ya mụbaa ugboro 2; ọkara ụda nke ọ bụla na-amụba ya site n’otu ihe. Ụda dị ọkara ụda 7 karịa Do (262Hz) bụ Sol.
l-m-h3-b0c46-14.s.s1.prompt: Kedu atụmatụ kacha kwesị ekwesị maka ugboro Sol?
l-m-h3-b0c46-14.s.s1.r.a: Nke a gbakwụnyere 1Hz maka ọkara ụda ọ bụla. Ugboro kwesịrị ịba ụba site n’ịmụba.
l-m-h3-b0c46-14.s.s1.r.b: Nke a bụ ugboro Do dị elu, ọkara ụda 12 n’elu (ugboro 2).
l-m-h3-b0c46-14.s.s1.r.d: Nke a bụ 262×7. Ugboro anaghị abụ ugboro 7 maka ọkara ụda nke ọ bụla.
l-m-h3-b0c46-14.s.s1.explain: Ọkara ụda 6 bụ ihe dị ka ugboro 1.41, nke 12 bụ ugboro 2; ya mere ọkara ụda 7 bụ ihe dị ka ugboro 1.5. 262×1.5≈393Hz.
l-m-h3-b0c46-14.s.s2.model.0: Ọkara ụda 12 bụ ugboro 2, ya mere ọkara ụda 7 bụ 2 n’ike 7/12, ihe dị ka ugboro 1.5; 262×1.5≈393Hz.
l-m-h3-b0c46-14.s.s2.model.1: Ọkara ụda 6 bụ √2 ugboro, nke 12 bụ ugboro 2; ya mere ọkara ụda 7 dị nso ugboro 1.5, nke mere 393Hz ji bụrụ atụmatụ kwesịrị ekwesị.

l-m-h3-b0c46-15.title: Gịnị ga-eme ma i jiri ọka okpukpu abụọ tinye n’ogige square 64 nke ọ bụla?
l-m-h3-b0c46-15.goal: Tụọ ogo 2⁶⁴ ka i kpebie nha ma ọ bụ nso kwesịrị ekwesị, kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0c46-15.material: E nwere akụkọ ebe a na-etinye ọka 1 n’ogige mbụ n’ime bọọdụ nwere square 64, na-etinyekwa okpukpu abụọ n’ogige nke ọ bụla sochirinụ. Ngụkọta ya dị ihe dị ka 2⁶⁴ ọka. 2¹⁰ dị ihe dị ka 1,000.
l-m-h3-b0c46-15.s.s1.prompt: Kedu atụmatụ kacha kwesị ekwesị maka ogo 2⁶⁴?
l-m-h3-b0c46-15.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ 64×2. Ị ga-amụba 2 n’onwe ya ugboro 64.
l-m-h3-b0c46-15.s.s1.r.b: Nke a dị ihe dị ka 2²⁰. Ị ga-amụba 2 ọtụtụ ugboro ọzọ.
l-m-h3-b0c46-15.s.s1.r.d: Nke a dị nso na 2¹²⁸. E were exponent dịka okpukpu abụọ.
l-m-h3-b0c46-15.s.s1.explain: 2⁶⁴=2⁴×(2¹⁰)⁶≈16×10¹⁸, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dịka 10¹⁹. Uru n’ezie bụ ihe dịka 1.8×10¹⁹.
l-m-h3-b0c46-15.s.s2.model.0: 2¹⁰≈10³, ya mere 2⁶⁰≈10¹⁸; ịmụba na 2⁴=16 na-enye ihe dịka 1.6×10¹⁹, nke dị gburugburu 10¹⁹.
l-m-h3-b0c46-15.s.s2.model.1: Oge ọ bụla i mụbara 2 n’onwe ya ugboro 10, ọ na-aghọ ihe dịka okpukpu 1,000; ya mere ugboro 64 bụ 10¹⁸, ya bụ 1,000 e mụbara ugboro 6, mụbaa na 16, nke na-enye ihe dịka 10¹⁹.

l-m-h3-b0c46-16.title: Lita ole ka mmiri ozuzo 20mm n’elu ala dum ga-abụ?
l-m-h3-b0c46-16.goal: Mee atụmatụ oke mmiri ozuzo rain gauge tụrụ iji họrọ nha ma ọ bụ range dabara, kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0c46-16.material: Rain gauge oge Joseon na-atụ omimi mmiri ozuzo dara. Mmiri ozuzo 20mm dara n’otu ebe. Mmiri omimi 1mm n’elu 1m² bụ 1L. Otu mmiri ahụ dara n’elu ala dum nwere mpaghara 1,000m².
l-m-h3-b0c46-16.s.s1.prompt: Kedu atụmatụ kacha dabara maka mmiri ozuzo dara n’ala ahụ?
l-m-h3-b0c46-16.s.s1.r.b: E mụbara nkeji ndị ahụ n’ụzọ na-ezighị ezi, nke mere ka ọ dị okpukpu 100 karịa.
l-m-h3-b0c46-16.s.s1.r.c: Nke a gbakọrọ naanị oke dara n’elu 1m². A ga-amụba ya na mpaghara ala ahụ.
l-m-h3-b0c46-16.s.s1.r.d: Nke a na-ewere mpaghara ala ahụ dịka 100m².
l-m-h3-b0c46-16.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụ 20L kwa 1m², ala ahụ bụkwa 1,000m², ya mere 20×1,000=20,000L (tonne 20).
l-m-h3-b0c46-16.s.s2.model.0: 1mm bụ 1L kwa 1m², ya mere 20mm bụ 20L kwa 1m²; maka 1,000m² ọ bụ 20,000L.
l-m-h3-b0c46-16.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụ 20L maka 1m² nke ọ bụla, gafee 1,000 n’ime ha, ya bụ 20,000L; ya mere 200L pere mpe nke ukwuu.

l-m-h3-b0c46-17.goal: Mee atụmatụ ibu nkume elu dolmen iji họrọ nha ma ọ bụ oke dabara, kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0c46-17.material: Ọ bụrụ na i were nkume granite dị n’elu dịka igbe akụkụ anọ, ọ bụ ogologo 5m, obosara 3m, ọkpụrụkpụ 1m. Granite dị ihe dịka okpukpu 2.7 karịa mmiri nke otu olu. Mmiri 1m³ bụ tonne 1.
l-m-h3-b0c46-17.s.s1.prompt: Kedu atụmatụ kacha dabara maka ibu nkume elu ahụ?
l-m-h3-b0c46-17.s.s1.r.a: 2.7 ugboro tonne 15 bụ ihe dịka tonne 40, ya mere tonne 400 dị arọ nke ukwuu.
l-m-h3-b0c46-17.s.s1.r.c: 2.7 ugboro tonne 15 bụ ihe dịka tonne 40, ya mere tonne 4,000 dị arọ nke ukwuu.
l-m-h3-b0c46-17.s.s1.r.d: Ọbụna ma olu 15m³ bụ mmiri, ọ ga-abụ tonne 15, ya mere tonne 4 dị mfe nke ukwuu.
l-m-h3-b0c46-17.s.s1.explain: Olu bụ 5×3×1=15m³, nke ga-abụ tonne 15 ma ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ mmiri; granite bụ okpukpu 2.7 nke ahụ, ya mere ihe dịka tonne 40.
l-m-h3-b0c46-17.s.s2.model.0: Olu bụ 15m³, dịka mmiri ọ ga-abụ tonne 15, ya mere ihe dịka tonne 40, nke e nwetara site n’ịmụba na 2.7, dabara.
l-m-h3-b0c46-17.s.s2.model.1: Ọ dị arọ karịa tonne 15, dị mfe karịa tonne 45 nke bụ okpukpu 3 nke tonne 15, ya mere ihe dịka tonne 40 dabara.

l-m-h3-b0c47-14.title: Ànyị ga-atụle gburugburu ụwa site n'akụkụ onyinyo?
l-m-h3-b0c47-14.goal: Tụọ gburugburu ụwa site n'iji anya na akụkụ dị n'etiti obodo abụọ, kpebie ọnụọgụ ma ọ bụ oke dabara adaba, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c47-14.material: Otu ọkà mmụta Gris oge ochie tụrụ gburugburu ụwa site na ọdịiche 7.2° n'akụkụ onyinyo ehihie nke obodo abụọ. Obodo abụọ ahụ dị n'otu ahịrị ugwu na ndịda, ha dịkwa ihe dị ka 800km n'ebe ibe ha nọ.
l-m-h3-b0c47-14.s.s1.prompt: Gịnị bụ ihe dị ka ogologo gburugburu ụwa na km?
l-m-h3-b0c47-14.s.s1.r.a: I mụbara 800×7.2. 7.2° bụ naanị akụkụ nke 360°.
l-m-h3-b0c47-14.s.s1.r.b: Ị hapụrụ otu ọnụọgụ. Bido site n'ịtụle 360÷7.2.
l-m-h3-b0c47-14.s.s1.r.d: I mụbara 800×360. Ị kwesịrị ịmụba na 360÷7.2.
l-m-h3-b0c47-14.s.s1.explain: 7.2° bụ 1/50 nke 360°, ya mere gburugburu ụwa bụ ihe dị ka ugboro 50 nke 800km, ya bụ 4×10⁴ km (40,000km).
l-m-h3-b0c47-14.s.s2.model.0: 7.2° bụ 1/50 nke 360°, ya mere gburugburu ụwa bụ ihe dị ka 4×10⁴ km (40,000km), nke bụ ugboro 50 nke 800km.
l-m-h3-b0c47-14.s.s2.model.1: Otu ntụgharị zuru ezu nke 360° bụ ugboro 50 nke 7.2°, ya mere 800×50=40000; enwere ike ịtụ gburugburu ya dị ka ihe dị ka 4×10⁴ km.

l-m-h3-b0c47-15.topic: Oke semitone na nha nhata ụda 12
l-m-h3-b0c47-15.goal: Tụọ oke nke otu semitone si arụpụta ugboro ụda, kpebie ọnụọgụ ma ọ bụ oke dabara adaba, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c47-15.material: Otu octave bụ semitone 12, ugboro ụda na-abawanye okpukpu 2. Ka e were ya na otu semitone na-amụba ugboro ụda site n'otu ihe r mgbe niile. Ịmụba r ugboro 12 na-enye 2.
l-m-h3-b0c47-15.s.s1.prompt: Atụmatụ kacha dabara maka uru r bụ nke?
l-m-h3-b0c47-15.s.s1.r.a: Ị tụlere 2÷12. Ịmụba 1.17 ugboro 12 na-enye ihe karịrị okpukpu 6.
l-m-h3-b0c47-15.s.s1.r.b: Ịmụba 1.5 ugboro 12 na-enye ihe dị ka okpukpu 130.
l-m-h3-b0c47-15.s.s1.r.c: Ịmụba 1.08 ugboro 12 na-enye ihe dị ka 2.5. Nke a karịrị 2.
l-m-h3-b0c47-15.s.s1.explain: Ịmụba 1.06 ugboro 12 na-enye ihe dị ka 2.01. 1.08 na-enye ihe dị ka 2.5, 1.17 na-enyekwa ihe karịrị okpukpu 6.
l-m-h3-b0c47-15.s.s2.model.0: Ịmụba 1.06 n'onwe ya ugboro 2, 4, na 8 na-enye ihe dị ka 1.12, 1.26, na 1.59; ugboro 12 na-enye ihe dị ka 2.01, ya mere ọ dabara adaba.

l-m-h3-b0c47-17.topic: Mmasị ngwakọta na oge iji rute okpukpu 2
l-m-h3-b0c47-17.goal: Tụọ mgbe isi ego n'ụlọ akụ mmasị ngwakọta ga-aghọ ihe dị ka okpukpu 2, kpebie ọnụọgụ ma ọ bụ oke dabara adaba, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c47-17.material: E nwere ego mmasị ngwakọta ebe a na-agbakwunye mmasị 8% kwa afọ na isi ego na mmasị. Ịmụba 1.08 n'onwe ya ugboro 2, 4, na 8 na-enye ihe dị ka 1.17, 1.36, na 1.85.
l-m-h3-b0c47-17.s.s1.prompt: Afọ ole ka e mesịrị ka isi ego ga-abụ ihe dị ka okpukpu 2?
l-m-h3-b0c47-17.s.s1.r.b: Ị tụlere ọkara nke 8. Mgbe afọ 4 gachara, ọ bụ naanị ihe dị ka okpukpu 1.36.
l-m-h3-b0c47-17.s.s1.r.c: Nke ahụ dị ogologo nke ukwuu. Mgbe afọ 9 gachara, ọ ghọọla ihe dị ka okpukpu 2.
l-m-h3-b0c47-17.s.s1.r.d: Ị tụlere 100÷8. I chefuru mmasị ngwakọta, ebe mmasị na-enweta mmasị ọzọ.
l-m-h3-b0c47-17.s.s1.explain: Mgbe afọ 8 gachara ọ bụ ihe dị ka okpukpu 1.85; ịmụba otu ugboro ọzọ na-enye ihe dị ka okpukpu 2.0, ya mere ọ ga-eru okpukpu 2 mgbe ihe dị ka afọ 9.
l-m-h3-b0c47-17.s.s2.model.0: Mgbe afọ 8 gachara ọ bụ ihe dị ka okpukpu 1.85, mgbe afọ 9 gachara ọ bụ ihe dị ka okpukpu 2.0; ya mere afọ 9 dabara adaba.
l-m-h3-b0c47-17.s.s2.model.1: Site na mmasị dị mfe, 100÷8 ga-abụ ihe dị ka afọ 12; mana n'ihi na mmasị na-enweta mmasị, ọ na-ewe ihe dị ka afọ 9, nke dị ngwa karịa.

l-m-h3-b0c48-14.title: Ịtụ ọnụ ọgụgụ nje bacteria
l-m-h3-b0c48-14.goal: Tụọ ọnụọgụ ma ọ bụ oke dabara adaba maka nje bacteria mgbe awa 6 gachara, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0c48-14.material: Nje bacteria 1000 na-abawanye okpukpu 2 kwa nkeji 20. Nri zuru ezu dị. Tụọ ihe dị ka ole ga-adị mgbe awa 6 gachara. (2¹⁰ bụ ihe dị ka 1000.)
l-m-h3-b0c48-14.s.s1.prompt: Atụmatụ dabara adaba maka nje bacteria mgbe awa 6 gachara bụ ole?
l-m-h3-b0c48-14.s.s1.r.a: Ịba okpukpu 2 kwa nkeji 20 bụ uto site n'ike ọnụọgụ, ọ bụghị ịmụba n'ụzọ dị mfe.
l-m-h3-b0c48-14.s.s1.r.d: Awa 6 bụ oge nkeji 20 dị 18, ya mere ọ bụ 2¹⁸, ọ bụghị 2⁶.
l-m-h3-b0c48-14.s.s1.explain: Awa 6 bụ oge nkeji 20 dị 18, ya mere ọ bụ 2¹⁸ ugboro. 2¹⁸≈1000×256, nke bụ ihe dị ka 26 × 10,000 ugboro, ya bụ ihe dị ka 2.6 × 100,000,000 (260 nde).
l-m-h3-b0c48-14.s.s2.model.0: 2¹⁸≈1000×256, nke bụ ihe dị ka 26 × 10,000 ugboro, ebe mmalite bụ nje bacteria 1000; ya mere ihe dị ka 2.6 × 100,000,000 (260 nde) nje bacteria.
l-m-h3-b0c48-14.s.s2.model.1: E nwere oge nkeji 20 dị 18, ya mere ị na-amụba 2 n'onwe ya ugboro 18. Nke a na-eme ngụkọta ahụ ka ọ bụrụ ọtụtụ narị nde, ọ bụghị iri puku.

l-m-h3-b0c48-15.title: Ịtụ oke njehie nke nsonaazụ nyocha nlele
l-m-h3-b0c48-15.goal: Tụọ oke njehie nke ọnụego nnabata, kpebie ọnụọgụ ma ọ bụ oke dabara adaba, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0c48-15.material: A họrọ ma jụọ ụmụ akwụkwọ 300, 60% kwadoro. A na-atụ njehie nke ọnụego nlele dịka ihe dị ka 1/√n (n bụ ogo nlele, √300≈17.3). Tụọ oke ọnụego nnabata nke ìgwè niile.
l-m-h3-b0c48-15.s.s1.prompt: Oke dabara adaba maka ọnụego nnabata nke ìgwè niile bụ nke?
l-m-h3-b0c48-15.s.s1.r.a: E mere ka njehie ahụ buru ibu nke ukwuu, isi pasent 20.
l-m-h3-b0c48-15.s.s1.r.c: E mere ka njehie ahụ pere mpe nke ukwuu, isi pasent 1.
l-m-h3-b0c48-15.s.s1.r.d: E chere na ọnụego nlele bụ kpọmkwem ọnụego ìgwè niile.
l-m-h3-b0c48-15.s.s1.explain: 1/√300≈0.058, ya mere njehie bụ ihe dị ka isi pasent 6. Ije isi pasent 6 n'elu na n'okpuru 60% na-enye 54% ruo 66%.
l-m-h3-b0c48-15.s.s2.model.0: Njehie bụ ihe dị ka isi pasent 6, ya mere ọnụego nnabata nke ìgwè niile kwesịrị ịdị n'ime 60%±isi pasent 6, ya bụ 54% ruo 66%.
l-m-h3-b0c48-15.s.s2.model.1: Nlele ahụ bụ naanị ụmụ akwụkwọ 300, ya mere enweghị ike ikwu na ọ bụ kpọmkwem 60%; ị ga-ekwe ka njehie dị ihe dị ka isi pasent 6.

l-m-h3-b0c48-16.title: Ọnụọgụ mkpụrụ ole ka 2¹⁰⁰ nwere?
l-m-h3-b0c48-16.material: 2¹⁰=1024 bụ ihe dị ka 10³. Jiri nke a tụọ ọnụ ọgụgụ mkpụrụ nke 2¹⁰⁰ nwere.
l-m-h3-b0c48-16.s.s1.prompt: Ọnụọgụ mkpụrụ ziri ezi maka 2¹⁰⁰ bụ ole?

l-m-h3-b0c48-16.s.s1.r.b: 10³⁰ bụ ọnụọgụ mkpụrụ 31. Ọ dị otu mkpụrụ mkpụmkpụ.
l-m-h3-b0c48-16.s.s1.r.d: Ọbụna ịmụba 2 n'onwe ya ugboro 100 erughị 10¹⁰⁰.
l-m-h3-b0c48-16.s.s1.explain: 2¹⁰⁰=(2¹⁰)¹⁰≈(10³)¹⁰=10³⁰, 10³⁰ bụkwa ọnụọgụ mkpụrụ 31. N'ezie ọ bụ ihe dị ka 1.27×10³⁰.

l-m-h3-b0c48-17.title: Isi ego ole ka mkpụrụ ego ziri ezi na-enyekarị?
l-m-h3-b0c48-17.goal: Tụọ ọnụọgụ ma ọ bụ oke dabara adaba maka isi ego mgbe a tụbara mkpụrụ ego ugboro 100, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0c48-17.material: Ọ bụrụ na ị tụba mkpụrụ ego ziri ezi ugboro 100, nkezi isi ego bụ 50, mgbasa ọkọlọtọ bụ 5. Ihe dị ka 95% nke nsonaazụ na-adịkarị n'ime mgbasa ọkọlọtọ 2 nke nkezi. Tụọ oke ọkọlọtọ iji nwalee echiche.
l-m-h3-b0c48-17.s.s1.prompt: Ọbụna na mkpụrụ ego ziri ezi, oke isi ego ole na-apụtakarị?
l-m-h3-b0c48-17.s.s1.r.a: Ịnweta kpọmkwem 50 bụ ihe na-adịghị eme ugboro ugboro. Ị chọrọ oke.
l-m-h3-b0c48-17.s.s1.r.b: Nke a bụ oke mgbasa ọkọlọtọ 1; ya mere ọbụna mkpụrụ ego ziri ezi na-apụ n'èzí ya ihe dị ka 30% nke oge.
l-m-h3-b0c48-17.s.s1.r.d: Oke ahụ sara mbara nke ukwuu nke na ọ naghị ewepụ nsonaazụ ọ bụla.
l-m-h3-b0c48-17.s.s1.explain: 50±2×5 na-enye 40 ruo 60. N'ime oke a, e nweghị nnukwu ihe kpatara ịjụ echiche na mkpụrụ ego ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c48-17.s.s2.model.0: Mgbe mgbasa ọkọlọtọ bụ 5, oke ugboro 2 bụ 50±10; ya mere 40 ruo 60 bụ nsonaazụ a na-ahụkarị.
l-m-h3-b0c48-17.s.s2.model.1: 45 ruo 55 bụ 1 mgbasa ọkọlọtọ, ya mere ọbụna mkpụrụ ego ziri ezi na-apụkarị n’èzí ya, a pụkwara ikpehie ngwa ngwa; ya mere 40 ruo 60 dabara.

l-m-h3-b0c49-15.title: Akwụkwọ ga-adị oke ole ma apịaji ya ugboro 42?
l-m-h3-b0c49-15.goal: Tụọ ọkpụrụkpụ akwụkwọ a apịaji ugboro 42, họrọ nha ma ọ bụ nso dabara, kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c49-15.material: Were akwụkwọ ọkpụrụkpụ 0.1mm, nke a pụrụ ịpịaji ọkara ugboro 42. Tụọ ọkpụrụkpụ ya site na iji 2¹⁰≈1000 na 1km=10⁶mm.
l-m-h3-b0c49-15.s.s1.prompt: Kedu atụmatụ dabara adaba maka ọkpụrụkpụ mgbe apịaji ugboro 42?
l-m-h3-b0c49-15.s.s1.r.a: Nke a jiri naanị mgbakwunye. Ọkpụrụkpụ na-abawanye okpukpu 2 n’apịaji nke ọ bụla.
l-m-h3-b0c49-15.s.s1.r.b: A gbanwere nha n’ụzọ na-ezighi ezi, ya mere atụmatụ ahụ buru oke ibu.
l-m-h3-b0c49-15.s.s1.r.c: E tụrụ 2⁴² n’ụzọ na-ezighi ezi dịka 4.4×10⁹.
l-m-h3-b0c49-15.s.s1.explain: 2⁴²=2²×(2¹⁰)⁴≈4×10¹², ya mere ọkpụrụkpụ bụ ihe dị ka 4×10¹¹mm, ya bụ ihe dị ka 44×10⁴ km.
l-m-h3-b0c49-15.s.s2.model.0: 2⁴²≈4.4×10¹² ugboro; ịmụba na 0.1mm na-enye ihe dị ka 4.4×10¹¹mm, ya bụ ihe dị ka 44×10⁴ km.
l-m-h3-b0c49-15.s.s2.model.1: Ọ na-adị okpukpu 2 n’apịaji nke ọ bụla, ya mere apịaji 42 na-eme ka ọ bụrụ 2⁴² ugboro. Nke ahụ bụ ọtụtụ puku ijeri ugboro, ya mere ọ bụ ọtụtụ narị puku km, ọ bụghị mm.

l-m-h3-b0c49-16.goal: Tụọ ohere na otu klas nwere mmadụ abụọ nwere otu ụbọchị ọmụmụ, họrọ nha ma ọ bụ nso dabara, kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c49-16.material: N’ime klas mmadụ 30, tụọ ohere na otu ụzọ mmadụ 2 ga-enwe otu ụbọchị ọmụmụ. E nwere ụzọ abụọ mmadụ 435 ahọrọ n’ime mmadụ 30, ohere otu ụzọ nwere otu ụbọchị ọmụmụ bụ ihe dị ka 1/365.
l-m-h3-b0c49-16.s.s1.prompt: Kedu atụmatụ dabara adaba maka ohere na otu ụzọ ahụ dị?
l-m-h3-b0c49-16.s.s1.r.a: E ji ọnụ ọgụgụ mmadụ tụọ ya, ọ bụghị ọnụ ọgụgụ ụzọ abụọ.
l-m-h3-b0c49-16.s.s1.r.b: Maka mmadụ 30, ohere ahụ karịrị ihe dị ka 50% nke mmadụ 23.
l-m-h3-b0c49-16.s.s1.explain: Ụzọ abụọ 435×1/365≈1.2 ụzọ; ohere na enweghị ụzọ ọbụla bụ ihe dị ka 30%. Ya mere ohere na e nwere otu bụ ihe dị ka 70%.
l-m-h3-b0c49-16.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na ụzọ abụọ 435 nke ọ bụla nwere 1/365, ọnụ ọgụgụ ụzọ a tụrụ anya bụ ihe dị ka 1.2; ohere enweghị ụzọ bụ 30%, ya mere ohere inwe ya bụ 70%.
l-m-h3-b0c49-16.s.s2.model.1: Gụọ ụzọ abụọ, ọ bụghị mmadụ; ya mere 8% sitere na 30÷365 bụ atụmatụ dị obere nke ukwuu.

l-m-h3-b0c49-18.title: Ọ bụrụ na ihe nwere ohere 1 n’ime 100,000 (1/10⁵), mmadụ ole ka nke a ga-eme?
l-m-h3-b0c49-18.goal: Tụọ ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị ga-enwe ihe omume dị ụkọ, họrọ nha ma ọ bụ nso dabara, kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c49-18.material: Mmetụta ọgwụ nwere ohere 1 n’ime 100,000 (1/10⁵). Ọ bụrụ na mmadụ 5000×10⁴ (nde 50) aṅụọ ọgwụ a, tụọ ihe dị ka mmadụ ole ga-enwe mmetụta ahụ.
l-m-h3-b0c49-18.s.s1.prompt: Kedu atụmatụ dabara adaba maka ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị ihe a metụtara?
l-m-h3-b0c49-18.s.s1.r.a: 5×10⁷÷10⁵=500. Mmadụ 5 dị ole na ole nke ukwuu n’ọnụọgụ ọnụọgụ.
l-m-h3-b0c49-18.s.s1.r.b: Ọ dị otu ọnụọgụ digit ole na ole.
l-m-h3-b0c49-18.s.s1.r.d: E tụrụ ohere 1 n’ime 100,000 (1/10⁵) n’ụzọ na-ezighi ezi dịka 1 n’ime 10,000 (1/10⁴).
l-m-h3-b0c49-18.s.s1.explain: 5000×10⁴×(1/(10×10⁴))=5×10⁷÷10⁵=500. Ọbụna ma ohere pere mpe, ọnụ ọgụgụ ahụ na-ebuwanye mgbe ọtụtụ mmadụ metụtara.
l-m-h3-b0c49-18.s.s2.model.0: 5000×10⁴÷(10×10⁴)=500, ya mere ihe dị ka mmadụ 500 ga-emetụta.
l-m-h3-b0c49-18.s.s2.model.1: Ọbụna ma ohere pere mpe nke ukwuu, mmadụ 5000×10⁴ (nde 50) metụtara, ya mere ọtụtụ narị mmadụ nwere ike imetụta.

l-m-h3-b0c50-04.s.s1.prompt: Nke kacha nso n’ọnụ ọgụgụ ụbọchị iji mechaa nyocha bụ nke dị aṅaa?
l-m-h3-b0c50-04.s.s1.r.a: Na mmadụ 20 kwa ụbọchị, ụbọchị 5 na-enye naanị mmadụ 100.
l-m-h3-b0c50-04.s.s1.r.b: Ntụle a gụrụ naanị mmadụ 10 kwa ụbọchị ma ọ bụ jiri ọnụ ọgụgụ mmadụ mụbaa.
l-m-h3-b0c50-04.s.s1.r.c: Ntụle a chere na mmadụ 100 kwa ụbọchị.
l-m-h3-b0c50-04.s.s1.explain: Na nkeji 3 maka onye ọ bụla, otu onye nyocha na-enyocha mmadụ 10 n’ime nkeji 30. Ndị nyocha 2 na-eme mmadụ 20 kwa ụbọchị, ya mere 200÷20=10 ụbọchị.
l-m-h3-b0c50-04.s.s2.model.0: 1 onye nyocha na-enyocha mmadụ 10 n’ime nkeji 30; mmadụ 2 na-eme 20 kwa ụbọchị, 200÷20=10 ụbọchị.
l-m-h3-b0c50-04.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụ mmadụ 20 kwa ụbọchị; ya mere mmadụ 200 na-ewe ụbọchị 10. Ụbọchị 2 ma ọ bụ 5 ezighị ezi n’ihi na ha chere na a ga-enyocha ọtụtụ mmadụ kwa ụbọchị karịa eziokwu.

l-m-h3-b0c50-11.title: Ụbọchị ebu kpuchiri efere
l-m-h3-b0c50-11.goal: Tụọ ụbọchị ebu ga-ebu ụzọ kpuchie efere, họrọ nha ma ọ bụ nso dabara ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c50-11.material: Ebu ahụ bụ 1cm² n’ụbọchị mbụ, ọ na-abawanye okpukpu 2 kwa ụbọchị. Mpaghara efere bụ ihe dị ka 80cm². Were ya na uto ya ga-aga n’ihu otu a.
l-m-h3-b0c50-11.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ụbọchị ka mpaghara ebu ga-ebu ụzọ karịrị mpaghara efere?
l-m-h3-b0c50-11.s.s1.r.b: Atụmatụ a chere na ọ na-eto 1cm² kwa ụbọchị.
l-m-h3-b0c50-11.s.s1.r.c: Atụmatụ a chere na ọ na-eto 2cm² kwa ụbọchị.
l-m-h3-b0c50-11.s.s1.r.d: Atụmatụ a gbakwụnyere 2 kwa ụbọchị kama ịmụba na 2.
l-m-h3-b0c50-11.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụ 2 n’ụbọchị 2, 4 n’ụbọchị 3, …, 64cm² n’ụbọchị 7, 128cm² n’ụbọchị 8. Ụbọchị mbụ ọ karịrị 80 bụ ụbọchị 8.
l-m-h3-b0c50-11.s.s2.model.0: N’ụbọchị 7, 2⁶=64 dị obere karịa 80; n’ụbọchị 8, 2⁷=128 karịrị ya. Ya mere ụbọchị mbụ karịrị 80 bụ ụbọchị 8.
l-m-h3-b0c50-11.s.s2.model.1: Ọ na-abawanye okpukpu 2 kwa ụbọchị; mgbe ụbọchị 6 gachara ọ bụ 64, ụbọchị 7 gachara 128, gafee 80, ya mere atụmatụ bụ ụbọchị 8.

l-m-h3-b0c50-15.title: Ihe 58 isi pụtara na ntụgharị mkpụrụ ego
l-m-h3-b0c50-15.goal: Tụọ ma isi 58 na ntụgharị mkpụrụ ego sitere n’ohere, họrọ nha ma ọ bụ nso dabara ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c50-15.material: A tụgharịrị mkpụrụ ego ugboro 100, isi pụta 58. Maka mkpụrụ ego ziri ezi, isi na-apụta 50 na nkezi, mgbasa sitere n’ohere dị ihe dị ka ±5 (ndapụ ọkọlọtọ).
l-m-h3-b0c50-15.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ụzọ kacha dabara iji kpebie nsonaazụ a?
l-m-h3-b0c50-15.s.s1.o.a: 58>50, ya mere mkpụrụ ego na-adaba n’isi mfe
l-m-h3-b0c50-15.s.s1.r.a: Ịkarị 50 naanị ya adịghị iche n’ihe nwere ike ime n’ohere.
l-m-h3-b0c50-15.s.s1.o.b: Ọdịiche 8 buru ibu, kwubie na o zighị ezi
l-m-h3-b0c50-15.s.s1.r.b: 8 bụ naanị ihe dị ka ugboro 1.6 nke mgbasa, ya mere ọ na-emekarị n’ihi ohere.
l-m-h3-b0c50-15.s.s1.o.c: Ọ bụrụ na a tụgharịa ya ugboro 100, isi 50 ga-apụta n’ezie
l-m-h3-b0c50-15.s.s1.r.c: Ọbụna ma mkpụrụ ego ahụ ziri ezi, nsonaazụ na-agbanwe agbanwe mgbe e tụbara ya ugboro otu ahụ.
l-m-h3-b0c50-15.s.s1.o.d: Ọ dị n'ime oke ihe nwere ike ime n'ihi ohere; ya mere were ya dịka nke ziri ezi ma ghara ikpebi ngwa ngwa.
l-m-h3-b0c50-15.s.s1.explain: N'ime 50±10 (mgbasa ±2), ihe na-apụta n'ihi ohere na-adịkarị. 58 dị n'ime ya, ya mere o siri ike ikwu na ọ bụghị nke ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c50-15.s.s2.model.0: ±5 bụ ihe a na-ahụkarị, ya mere 58, nke dị n'ime 50±10, nwere ike ịpụta ngwa ngwa n'ihi ohere; enweghị ike ikwubi na ọ bụghị nke ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c50-15.s.s2.model.1: 58-50=8 bụ naanị ugboro 1.6 nke mgbasa 5, ya mere o nwere ike ịbụ ohere; ọ ka mma ịtụgharị ya ọzọ ma kpebie ọzọ.

l-m-h3-b0c50-29.title: Nghọgbu eserese axis e bepụrụ
l-m-h3-b0c50-29.goal: Tụọ nha bara uru maka eserese ogwe axis kwụ ọtọ ya malitere na 90, họrọ nha ma ọ bụ nso dabara ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c50-29.material: Axis kwụ ọtọ nke eserese ogwe malitere na 90, ọ bụghị 0. Ogwe A na-egosi 95, B egosi 100, ma B yiri ka ọ dị 2 ugboro ogologo A.
l-m-h3-b0c50-29.s.s1.prompt: Kedu oke B÷A kacha nso n’eziokwu?
l-m-h3-b0c50-29.s.s1.r.a: Atụmatụ a tụgharịrị, were na B pere mpe karịa A.
l-m-h3-b0c50-29.s.s1.r.c: Atụmatụ a gbanwere ọdịiche 5 ka ọ bụrụ oke.
l-m-h3-b0c50-29.s.s1.r.d: Nke ahụ bụ naanị oke ịdị elu a na-ahụ n’onyonyo.
l-m-h3-b0c50-29.s.s1.explain: Uru n’ezie bụ 100÷95≈1.05 ugboro. Ebe axis malitere na 90, ọdịiche ịdị elu 10 na 5 yiri ka ọ bụ ugboro 2.
l-m-h3-b0c50-29.s.s2.model.0: 100÷95 dị ihe dị ka 1.05; n’ezie ha fọrọ nke nta ka ha hà, ma axis e bepụrụ mere ka ịdị elu yie ugboro 2.
l-m-h3-b0c50-29.s.s2.model.1: Ịdị elu yiri oke ugboro 2 n’ihi 100−90=10 na 95−90=5, ma uru ndị ahụ bụ naanị 1.05 ugboro; eserese ahụ mere ka ọdịiche yie nnukwu.

l-m-h3-b0d07-04.title: Ịtụ uru fraction mgbe n buru ibu
l-m-h3-b0d07-04.goal: Tụọ uru (3n²+5n)/(2n²−7) mgbe n=1000; họrọ oke ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0d07-04.material: aₙ=(3n²+5n)/(2n²−7). Tụọ ihe dịka etu aₙ hà mgbe n=1000.
l-m-h3-b0d07-04.s.s1.prompt: Uru kacha dabara maka aₙ mgbe n=1000 bụ nke dị aṅaa?
l-m-h3-b0d07-04.s.s1.r.a: E tụgharịrị numerator na denominator n’ime atụmatụ ahụ.
l-m-h3-b0d07-04.s.s1.r.c: E wepụrụ coefficient 2 dị na denominator, mee atụmatụ dịka 3n²/n².
l-m-h3-b0d07-04.s.s1.r.d: 5n dọtara uche. Ọ dị obere nke ukwuu karịa n² term.
l-m-h3-b0d07-04.s.s1.explain: Mgbe n buru ibu, term degree kacha elu na-ekpebi; ya mere ọ dị nso 3n²/2n²=3/2. Maka n=1000 ọ bụ ihe dịka 1.5025.
l-m-h3-b0d07-04.s.s2.model.0: Mgbe n=1000, 5n na 7 dị obere nke ukwuu ma e jiri ha tụnyere n² terms; uru ahụ dị nso 3n²/2n²=1.5, ya bụ ihe dịka 1.5.
l-m-h3-b0d07-04.s.s2.model.1: Ratio nke terms degree kachasị elu bụ 3/2, ya mere uru dị nso 1.5; n’ezie 3005000/1999993≈1.5025, ya mere ọ dabara.

l-m-h3-b0d07-17.title: Ịtụ uru (eʰ−1)/h
l-m-h3-b0d07-17.goal: Tụọ uru (eʰ−1)/h mgbe h=0.01, kpebie ọnụọgụ ma ọ bụ oke dabara adaba, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0d07-17.material: Uru (eʰ−1)/h na-abịaru gịnị nso mgbe h dị nso na 0? e^0.01≈1.01. Tụọ ya site n'itinye h=0.01.
l-m-h3-b0d07-17.s.s1.r.a: E gwakọtara ya na e n'onwe ya. Ngosipụta ahụ bụ (eʰ−1)/h.
l-m-h3-b0d07-17.s.s1.r.c: E lere naanị numerator anya. Echefuru ikewa na h.
l-m-h3-b0d07-17.s.s1.r.d: E chegharịrị ya dịka 1/h. Numerator bụ ihe dị ka 0.01.
l-m-h3-b0d07-17.s.s1.explain: e^0.01−1≈0.01005; ikewa ya na 0.01 na-enye ihe dị ka 1.005. Ọ dị nso na uru ókè 1.
l-m-h3-b0d07-17.s.s2.model.0: e^0.01≈1.01, ya mere numerator bụ ihe dị ka 0.01; ikewa nke a na h=0.01 na-enye ihe dị nso na 1, ya mere ihe dị ka 1.
l-m-h3-b0d07-17.s.s2.model.1: (eʰ−1)/h hà nhata mkpọda y=eˣ na x=0, uru ahụ bụ 1, ya mere ihe dị ka 1.

l-m-h3-b0d07-31.material: Tụọ uru definite integral ∫₀¹e^(x²)dx n’enweghị antiderivative. Maka 0≤x≤1, 1+x²≤e^(x²)≤1+(e−1)x², e≈2.72.

l-m-h3-b0d07-31.s.s1.r.a: Integrand dịkarịa ala 1 mgbe niile, ya mere mpaghara dịkarịa ala 1.
l-m-h3-b0d07-31.s.s1.r.c: Rectangle dị elu e, 2.72, bụ oke elu; uru n’ezie dị obere.
l-m-h3-b0d07-31.s.s1.r.d: Ịdị elu bụ e kacha, ogologo nso bụ 1; ya mere ọ gaghị agafe 2.72.
l-m-h3-b0d07-31.s.s1.explain: Integral nke 1+x² bụ 4/3, nke 1+(e−1)x² dị ihe dị ka 1.57. Ya mere ọ dịkarịa ala 1.33 ma karịa 1.57.
l-m-h3-b0d07-31.s.s2.model.0: Ebe e^(x²)≥1+x², mpaghara dịkarịa ala 4/3≈1.33; oke elu bụ integral nke 1+(e−1)x², 1+(e−1)/3≈1.57. Nke a dabara.
l-m-h3-b0d07-31.s.s2.model.1: Akara ahụ na-arị elu site n’ịdị elu 1 ruo e, ya mere uru karịrị 1 ma pekarịa e. Iji oke elu na nke ala, ọ dị n’etiti 1.33 na 1.57.

l-m-h3-b0d08-30.title: Ịtụ mpaghara n'okpuru e^(−x²) site na trapezoid
l-m-h3-b0d08-30.goal: Tụọ oke uru ∫₀²e^(−x²)dx dị n'ime ya, kpebie oke dabara adaba, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0d08-30.material: Anyị na-atụ mpaghara dị n'etiti usoro y=e^(−x²), axis x, x=0 na x=2. Na x=0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2 ịdị elu bụ ihe dị ka 1, 0.78, 0.37, 0.11, 0.02.
l-m-h3-b0d08-30.s.s1.prompt: Oke mpaghara a dị n'ime ya bụ nke?
l-m-h3-b0d08-30.s.s1.r.a: Ọbụna etiti 0 ruo 0.5 naanị nwere mpaghara karịrị 0.4.
l-m-h3-b0d08-30.s.s1.r.c: Ịdị elu anaghị akarị 1, ọ na-ebelatakwa ngwa ngwa.
l-m-h3-b0d08-30.s.s1.r.d: Nke a bụ atụmatụ karịrị nke bụ nso rectangle ịdị elu 1, 2×1=2.
l-m-h3-b0d08-30.s.s1.explain: Ịdị elu na-ebelata site na 1 ruo 0.02. Iji trapezoid obosara 0.5 tụọ ya na-enye ihe dị ka 0.88.
l-m-h3-b0d08-30.s.s2.model.0: Ịgbakwunye mpaghara trapezoid obosara 0.5 na-enye 0.5×{(1+0.02)/2+0.78+0.37+0.11}≈0.88; ya mere ọ dịkarịa ala 0.8 ma kacha 1.
l-m-h3-b0d08-30.s.s2.model.1: Ịdị elu na-amalite na 1 wee belata ngwa ngwa; akụkụ ruo 0.5 bụ ihe dị ka 0.45, nke fọdụrụ bụ ihe dị ka 0.43. Ngụkọta bụ ihe dị ka 0.88, nke dị n'ime oke ahụ.

l-m-h3-b0d08-37.goal: Tụọ nso S=1+1/2+…+1/100 dị n’ime ya, họrọ nso dabara ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0d08-37.material: Tụọ S=1+1/2+…+1/100. Ebe 1/x na-ebelata, S karịrị ∫₁¹⁰¹dx/x ma dị obere karịa 1+∫₁¹⁰⁰dx/x (ln 10≈2.3).
l-m-h3-b0d08-37.s.s1.prompt: Nso dị aṅaa ka S dị n’ime ya?
l-m-h3-b0d08-37.s.s1.r.a: Nchikọta okwu abụọ mbụ bụ 1.5, e nwekwara okwu 100; ya mere ọ ka ukwuu.
l-m-h3-b0d08-37.s.s1.r.b: Nke a dị obere karịa ln 101≈4.6.
l-m-h3-b0d08-37.s.s1.r.d: Oke elu bụ 1+ln 100≈5.6, ya mere ọ naghị eru 6.
l-m-h3-b0d08-37.s.s1.explain: ln 101≈4.6<S<1+ln 100≈5.6. N’ime nhọrọ, nso 4.6 ruo 5.7 na-ekpuchi ya.
l-m-h3-b0d08-37.s.s2.model.1: ln 100=2·ln 10≈4.6, ya mere S karịrị 4.6 ma pekarịa 5.6; 4.6 ruo 5.7 dabara.

l-m-h3-b0d09-04.title: Kedu nso ka perimeter ellipse dị n’ime ya?
l-m-h3-b0d09-04.goal: Tụọ perimeter ellipse x²/25+y²/9=1, họrọ nha ma ọ bụ nso dabara, kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0d09-04.material: Ellipse x²/25 + y²/9 = 1 nwere okirikiri radius 3 n'ime ya ma dịkwa n'ime okirikiri radius 5. Jiri nke a tụọ ogologo gburugburu ellipse ahụ.
l-m-h3-b0d09-04.s.s1.prompt: Oke dabara adaba maka ogologo gburugburu bụ nke? (π≈3.14)
l-m-h3-b0d09-04.s.s1.r.a: Ọ dị mkpụmkpụ karịa ogologo gburugburu nke okirikiri ime, 18.8, ya mere nke a agaghị ekwe omume.
l-m-h3-b0d09-04.s.s1.r.b: Ọ pụghị ịdị mkpụmkpụ karịa ogologo gburugburu okirikiri radius 3 (ihe dị ka 18.8).
l-m-h3-b0d09-04.s.s1.r.d: Ọ pụghị ịdị ogologo karịa gburugburu okirikiri radius 5 (ihe dị ka 31.4).
l-m-h3-b0d09-04.s.s1.explain: Gburugburù okirikiri ime bụ 2π·3≈18.8, nke mpụta bụ 2π·5≈31.4; ya mere gburugburu ellipse dị n'etiti ha.
l-m-h3-b0d09-04.s.s2.model.0: Ellipse ahụ nwere okirikiri radius 3, ya mere gburugburu ya karịrị 18.8; ọ dịkwa n'ime okirikiri radius 5, ya mere ọ dị mkpụmkpụ karịa 31.4.
l-m-h3-b0d09-04.s.s2.model.1: Mgbe usoro gbagọrọ agbagọ convex gbara usoro convex ọzọ gburugburu, ọ na-adị ogologo; ya mere gburugburu dị n'etiti 18.8 na 31.4, oke nke mbụ ziri ezi.

l-m-h3-b0d09-11.title: Oghere ruo asymptote na-adị warara ruo ole?
l-m-h3-b0d09-11.goal: Tụọ ọdịiche y n'etiti hyperbola na asymptote ya mgbe x buru ibu, kpebie ọnụọgụ ma ọ bụ oke dabara adaba, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0d09-11.material: N'akụkụ aka nri hyperbola x²−y²=1, y≈9.95 mgbe x=10. Ọdịiche y na asymptote y=x bụ ihe dị ka 0.05. Tụọ ọdịiche mgbe x=100.
l-m-h3-b0d09-11.s.s1.prompt: Atụmatụ dabara adaba nke ọdịiche mgbe x=100 bụ nke?
l-m-h3-b0d09-11.s.s1.r.a: Ọ pụtara na ọdịiche ahụ buru ibu, nke na-ekwekọghị n'ihe asymptote pụtara.
l-m-h3-b0d09-11.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụ otu na mgbe x=10, ya mere ọ naghị egosi ọchịchọ ịbịaru nso.
l-m-h3-b0d09-11.s.s1.r.d: Uru a na-eme ka usoro ahụ gaa n'ihu n'ebe asymptote dị.
l-m-h3-b0d09-11.s.s1.explain: Ọdịiche bụ x−√(x²−1)=1/(x+√(x²−1))≈1/(2x). Mgbe x=100 ọ bụ ihe dị ka 0.005, ọ na-ebelata n'oke megidere x.
l-m-h3-b0d09-11.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụ 0.05 mgbe x=10; mgbe x ghọrọ okpukpu 10, ọdịiche na-ebelata ruo 1/10, ya mere ihe dị ka 0.005.
l-m-h3-b0d09-11.s.s2.model.1: x−y=1/(x+y), x+y≈200, ya mere ọdịiche bụ ihe dị ka 1/200=0.005.

l-m-h3-b0d09-20.goal: Tụọ oke ebe nha vector ngụkọta dị, kpebie ọnụọgụ ma ọ bụ oke dabara adaba, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0d09-20.material: Ike nwere nha 3 na ike nwere nha 5 na-eme n'otu ihe. Amaghị akụkụ dị n'etiti ike abụọ ahụ. Tụọ iji chọta uru na-enweghị ike ịbụ nha ike nsonaazụ.
l-m-h3-b0d09-20.s.s1.prompt: Uru nke na-enweghị ike ịbụ nha ike nsonaazụ bụ nke?
l-m-h3-b0d09-20.s.s1.r.b: Site n'akụkụ kwesịrị ekwesị, 6 nke dị n'etiti 2 na 8 nwere ike ime.
l-m-h3-b0d09-20.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụrụ na ha na-atụ n'akụkụ megidere, ọ bụ 5−3=2.
l-m-h3-b0d09-20.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụrụ na ha na-atụ n'otu ntụziaka, ọ bụ 3+5=8.
l-m-h3-b0d09-20.s.s1.explain: Nha ike nsonaazụ dịkarịa ala |5−3|=2, kacha bụ 3+5=8. 1 dị n'èzí oke ahụ, ya mere ọ gaghị ekwe omume.
l-m-h3-b0d09-20.s.s2.model.0: Ike nsonaazụ kacha nta, 2, mgbe ike na-atụ n'akụkụ megidere; kacha ukwuu, 8, mgbe ha na-atụ n'otu ntụziaka. Ya mere 1 agaghị ekwe omume.
l-m-h3-b0d09-20.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na i mepụta triangle site n'ike abụọ ahụ, akụkụ fọdụrụ enweghị ike ịdị mkpụmkpụ karịa 5−3=2; ya mere ike nsonaazụ enweghị ike ịbụ 1.

l-m-h3-b0d09-35.goal: Tụọ mpaghara ntule kwụ ọtọ nke ọdịdị n’ụgbọelu, họrọ nha ma ọ bụ nso dabara ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0d09-35.material: Ọdịdị dị larịị nwere mpaghara 20 na-eme akụkụ 30° na ala. Ìhè si n’elu kwụ ọtọ na-enwu n’ala; tụọ mpaghara onyinyo (ntule kwụ ọtọ). cos30°≈0.87.
l-m-h3-b0d09-35.s.s1.prompt: Kedu atụmatụ dabara adaba maka mpaghara onyinyo?
l-m-h3-b0d09-35.s.s1.r.a: Nke ahụ bụ uru maka 60°. Na 30° ọ ka ukwuu.
l-m-h3-b0d09-35.s.s1.r.c: Mpaghara onyinyo agaghị akarị mpaghara mbụ.
l-m-h3-b0d09-35.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ 20 naanị mgbe ọdịdị ahụ yitere ala (0°). Mgbe o yigharịrị, ọ na-ebelata.
l-m-h3-b0d09-35.s.s1.explain: Mpaghara ntule kwụ ọtọ bụ mpaghara mbụ × cosθ. 20×0.87≈17, nke pere mpe karịa 20.
l-m-h3-b0d09-35.s.s2.model.0: Ebe mpaghara ntule = mpaghara×cosθ, 20×0.87≈17. Ka ọdịdị na-ehulata, onyinyo na-adị nta, ya mere ọ erughị 20.
l-m-h3-b0d09-35.s.s2.model.1: 30° dị ntakịrị karịa 0° n’ịtụgharị, ya mere onyinyo na-ebelata ntakịrị. Ihe dị ka 17, ntakịrị n’okpuru 20, dabara.

l-m-h3-b0d10-07.material: Tụọ y-coordinate positive nke isi nwere x=3 n’alaka aka nri hyperbola x²−y²/16=1. Jiri square numbers, n’enweghị calculator.
l-m-h3-b0d10-07.s.s1.prompt: Atụmatụ dabara maka y bụ nke dị aṅaa?
l-m-h3-b0d10-07.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụrụ y=16, y²=256, nke karịrị 128 nke ukwuu.
l-m-h3-b0d10-07.s.s1.r.b: y² bụ 128. E wepụtaghị square root.
l-m-h3-b0d10-07.s.s1.r.c: Site na y²/16=8, y²=128, y abụghị 8.
l-m-h3-b0d10-07.s.s1.explain: Mgbe x=3, y²/16=9−1=8, ya mere y²=128. Ebe 11²=121<128<144=12², y dị n’etiti 11 na 12.
l-m-h3-b0d10-07.s.s2.model.0: y²=128 dị n’etiti 11²=121 na 12²=144; y dị ntakịrị karịa 11, ihe dịka 11.
l-m-h3-b0d10-07.s.s2.model.1: Asymptote y=4x bụ 12 mgbe x=3; curve dị ntakịrị n’okpuru ya, ya mere y dị ihe dịka 11, nso 12.

l-m-h3-b0d10-19.goal: Tụọ uru ngwaahịa dot nwere ike ịbụ ka i họrọ nha ma ọ bụ nso dabara, kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0d10-19.material: Vector a nwere ogologo 5, b nwere ogologo 2. Amaghị akụkụ dị n’etiti ha. Jiri atụmatụ wepụ uru a·b na-agaghị enwe ike ịbụ.
l-m-h3-b0d10-19.s.s1.r.a: N’ụzọ ndị na-emegiderịta onwe ha, ọ bụ 5×2×cos180°=−10.
l-m-h3-b0d10-19.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụrụ ha kwụ n’akụkụ, cos90°=0, ya mere ngwaahịa dot bụ 0.
l-m-h3-b0d10-19.s.s1.r.c: E nwere akụkụ cosθ=0.9, ya mere 5×2×0.9=9.
l-m-h3-b0d10-19.s.s1.explain: a·b=10cosθ na −1≤cosθ≤1, ya mere ọ dị n’etiti −10 na 10. 11 dị n’èzí nso a.
l-m-h3-b0d10-19.s.s2.model.0: a·b=5·2·cosθ=10cosθ; cosθ agaghị akarị 1, ya mere ngwaahịa dot kacha bụ 10, ọ gaghị abụ 11.
l-m-h3-b0d10-19.s.s2.model.1: N’otu ntụziaka, ngwaahịa dot kacha bụ 10, ya mere 11 agaghị apụta; uru niile −10 ruo 10 nwere ike ime.

l-m-h3-b0d10-20.title: Ọ bụrụ ngwaahịa dot bụ 0.8, akụkụ dị n’etiti ha dị ihe dị ka ogo ole?
l-m-h3-b0d10-20.goal: Tụọ akụkụ dị n’etiti vector ndị unit, họrọ nha ma ọ bụ nso dabara ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0d10-20.material: Ngwaahịa dot nke unit vector u=(1, 0) na unit vector v bụ 0.8. Jiri cos30°≈0.87, cos45°≈0.71, cos60°=0.5 tụọ akụkụ ha.
l-m-h3-b0d10-20.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụrụ akụkụ karịrị 45°, cos dị obere karịa 0.71.
l-m-h3-b0d10-20.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụrụ akụkụ erughị 30°, cos karịrị 0.87.
l-m-h3-b0d10-20.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụrụ akụkụ karịrị 60°, cos dị obere karịa 0.5.
l-m-h3-b0d10-20.s.s1.explain: cosθ na-ebelata ka θ na-abawanye. cos30°≈0.87>0.8>cos45°≈0.71, ya mere θ dị n’etiti 30° na 45°.
l-m-h3-b0d10-20.s.s2.model.0: 0.8 dị obere karịa cos30°≈0.87 ma karịrị cos45°≈0.71, ya mere akụkụ ahụ dị n’etiti 30° na 45°.
l-m-h3-b0d10-20.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ ngwaahịa dot bụ 0.8, cosθ=0.8; ka akụkụ na-abawanye, cos na-ebelata, ya mere akụkụ ahụ dị n’etiti ntụaka 30° na 45°.

l-m-h3-b0d10-36.goal: Tụọ anya n'etiti ebe etiti ebe elu sphere abụọ zutere iji kpebie oke dabara adaba, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0d10-36.material: Sphere A nwere radius 5, ebe etiti ya bụ mmalite; sphere B nwere radius 2, ebe etiti ya bụ (d,0,0). Tụọ oke d nke na-eme ka elu sphere abụọ zutere (ya bụ usoro njikọ apụta). (0, 0)
l-m-h3-b0d10-36.s.s1.prompt: Uru d nke na-eme ka elu zutere bụ nke?
l-m-h3-b0d10-36.s.s1.r.a: B dabara kpamkpam n'ime A, ya mere elu ha anaghị ezute.
l-m-h3-b0d10-36.s.s1.r.c: Anya ebe etiti 8 karịrị ngụkọta radius, 7, ya mere ha kewapụrụ.
l-m-h3-b0d10-36.s.s1.r.d: Ha dị anya nke ukwuu, sphere abụọ ahụ anaghị emetụ ibe ha.
l-m-h3-b0d10-36.s.s1.explain: Ka elu ha wee zutere, achọrọ |5−2|=3≤d≤5+2=7. N'ime nhọrọ, naanị 5 dị n'ime oke a.
l-m-h3-b0d10-36.s.s2.model.0: Ka elu ha wee zutere, anya ebe etiti ga-abụ opekata mpe ọdịiche radius, 3, ma ọ gaghị akarị ngụkọta 7; ya mere 5 dabara.
l-m-h3-b0d10-36.s.s2.model.1: d=2 na-etinye B n'ime A, d=8 na 10 kewapụrụ, ya mere naanị 5 ka ha zutere.

l-m-h3-b0c33-17.title: N’ngwọta mbelata ọnụahịa, ahịrị nke mbụ na-ezighị ezi bụ nke dị aṅaa?
l-m-h3-b0c33-17.goal: Soro ngwọta uru na mfu (ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta) gbasara ọnụ ahịa, ọnụahịa e depụtara na ọnụahịa e belatara, chọta ebe mbụ o mejọrọ ma dozie ya.
l-m-h3-b0c33-17.material: A gbakwụnyere 20% n’ọnụ ahịa 5,000 won iji tọọ ọnụahịa e depụtara, wee wepụ 10% n’ọnụahịa ahụ maka ire. Ọrụ nwa akwụkwọ: ① ọnụahịa e depụtara 5,000×1.2=6,000 ② ọnụahịa ire 5,000×0.9=4,500 ③ mfu 500 won n’ihe ọ bụla
l-m-h3-b0c33-17.s.s1.o.a: ① Ahịrị chọtara ọnụahịa e depụtara
l-m-h3-b0c33-17.s.s1.r.a: 6,000 won bụ okpukpu 1.2 nke ọnụ ahịa, ya mere ọ ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c33-17.s.s1.o.c: ③ Ahịrị kwuru uru ma ọ bụ mfu
l-m-h3-b0c33-17.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ naanị nsonaazụ uru na-ezighị ezi n’ahịrị gara aga, ọ bụghị ebe mbụ mmejọ mere.
l-m-h3-b0c33-17.s.s1.r.d: E chefuru ọnọdụ na a na-ewepụ 10% n’ọnụahịa e depụtara.
l-m-h3-b0c33-17.s.s1.explain: A na-ewepụ mbelata ahụ n’ọnụahịa e depụtara 6,000 won. 6,000×0.9=5,400 won; ya mere ire ya na-enye uru 400 won.
l-m-h3-b0c33-17.s.s2.model.0: Na ②, e mere mbelata n’ọnụ ahịa 5,000 won kama ọnụahịa e depụtara 6,000 won; nke a ezighị ezi. Idozi ya ka ọ bụrụ 6,000×0.9=5,400 won na-enye uru 400 won.
l-m-h3-b0c33-17.s.s2.model.1: Ebe a na-ewepụ 10% nke ọnụahịa e depụtara, ọnụahịa ire bụ 5,400 won; nkwubi okwu mfu na ③ na-agbanwekwa bụrụ uru 400 won.

l-m-h3-b0c33-18.title: Ịchọta ahịrị na-ezighị ezi n’ngụkọta ọmụrụ nwa jikọtara ọnụ
l-m-h3-b0c33-18.goal: Soro ngwọta ọmụrụ nwa maka nkwụnye ego afọ 2 na ọmụrụ nwa jikọtara ọnụ, chọta ebe mbụ o mejọrọ ma dozie ya.
l-m-h3-b0c33-18.material: Ị tinyere 1,000×10,000 won ruo afọ 2 na ọmụrụ nwa jikọtara ọnụ 4% kwa afọ. Ọrụ nwa akwụkwọ: ① ọmụrụ nwa afọ mbụ 1,000×0.04=40×10,000 won ② ọmụrụ nwa afọ nke abụọ 1,000×0.04=40×10,000 won ③ mgbe afọ 2 gachara 1,000+40+40=1,080×10,000 won
l-m-h3-b0c33-18.s.s1.o.a: ① Ahịrị chọtara ọmụrụ nwa afọ mbụ
l-m-h3-b0c33-18.s.s1.r.a: N’afọ mbụ, isi ego bụ ntọala; ya mere ọ ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c33-18.s.s1.r.b: Mgbakwunye ahụ ziri ezi. Uru dị n’ahịrị gara aga ezighị ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c33-18.s.s1.r.c: N’ọmụrụ nwa jikọtara ọnụ, ntọala ọmụrụ nwa afọ nke abụọ na-agbanwe.
l-m-h3-b0c33-18.s.s1.o.d: ② Ahịrị chọtara ọmụrụ nwa afọ nke abụọ
l-m-h3-b0c33-18.s.s1.explain: N’ọmụrụ nwa jikọtara ọnụ, ntọala afọ nke abụọ bụ 1,040×10,000 won; ya mere ọmụrụ nwa bụ 41.6×10,000 won, ngụkọta bụ 1,081.6×10,000 won.
l-m-h3-b0c33-18.s.s2.model.0: N’ọmụrụ nwa jikọtara ọnụ, a na-agbakọ ọmụrụ nwa afọ nke abụọ na 1,040×10,000 won kwa, ya mere ② kwesịrị ịbụ 1,040×0.04=41.6×10,000 won.
l-m-h3-b0c33-18.s.s2.model.1: Ọmụrụ nwa e tinyere n’afọ mbụ na-enwetakwa ọmụrụ nwa dịka isi ego; ya mere ọmụrụ nwa afọ nke abụọ karịrị 40×10,000 won, ngụkọta bụ 1,081.6×10,000 won.

l-m-h3-b0c33-19.title: Ebee ka njehie dị n’ngwọta breakeven?
l-m-h3-b0c33-19.goal: Soro ngwọta (ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta) maka ọnụọgụ ere ga-ekpuchi ọnụ ahịa kwụụrụ onwe ya, chọta ebe mbụ o mejọrọ ma dozie ya.
l-m-h3-b0c33-19.material: Ọnụahịa ire otu ihe bụ 5,000 won, ụgwọ mgbanwe otu ihe bụ 3,000 won, ụgwọ kwụụrụ onwe ya bụ 200×10,000 won. Nwa akwụkwọ: ① ego fọdụrụ n’ihe ọ bụla 5,000−3,000=2,000 won ② ụgwọ kwụụrụ onwe ya 2,000,000 won ③ ire breakeven 2,000,000÷5,000=400 ihe
l-m-h3-b0c33-19.s.s1.o.b: ① Ahịrị chọtara ego fọdụrụ n’ihe ọ bụla
l-m-h3-b0c33-19.s.s1.r.b: Iwepụ ụgwọ mgbanwe na ọnụahịa ire ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c33-19.s.s1.o.c: ② Ahịrị ji ụgwọ kwụụrụ onwe ya
l-m-h3-b0c33-19.s.s1.r.c: E ji ụgwọ kwụụrụ onwe ya e nyere mee ihe kpọmkwem.
l-m-h3-b0c33-19.s.s1.r.d: Onye nkewa ga-abụ ego fọdụrụ n’ihe ọ bụla.
l-m-h3-b0c33-19.s.s1.explain: A na-ekpuchi ụgwọ kwụụrụ onwe ya site na 2,000 won fọdụrụ n’ihe ọ bụla. 2,000,000÷2,000=1,000 ihe bụ ọnụọgụ ere breakeven.
l-m-h3-b0c33-19.s.s2.model.0: Na ③, e kewara na ọnụahịa ire 5,000 won, ya mere ezighị ezi; ikewa na 2,000 won fọdụrụ n’ihe ọ bụla na-enye ihe 1,000.
l-m-h3-b0c33-19.s.s2.model.1: A na-ekpuchi ụgwọ kwụụrụ onwe ya site na 2,000 won fọdụrụ n’ihe ọ bụla e rere, nke na-agbakọta; ya mere a ga-edozi ya ka ọ bụrụ 2,000,000÷2,000=1,000 ihe.

l-m-h3-b0c33-20.title: Pasent ịrị elu na ịda: kedu ebe mmejọ ahụ mere?
l-m-h3-b0c33-20.goal: Soro ngwọta (ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta) gbasara ntọala ọnụego mmụba na mbelata, chọta mmejọ mbụ ma dozie ya.
l-m-h3-b0c33-20.material: Ire si na 100×10,000 won rịa ruo 150×10,000 won, wee daa azụ ruo 100×10,000 won. Nwa akwụkwọ: ① ọnụego mmụba 50÷100=50% ② ọnụego mbelata kwa 50÷100=50% ③ ya mere ọnụego ịrị elu na ịda bụ otu.
l-m-h3-b0c33-20.s.s1.r.a: Uru tupu mmụba, 100×10,000 won, bụ ntọala; ya mere ọ ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c33-20.s.s1.r.b: Nkwubi okwu ahụ sitere na uru na-ezighị ezi dị n’ahịrị gara aga.
l-m-h3-b0c33-20.s.s1.r.d: Uru ntọala maka mbelata dị iche.
l-m-h3-b0c33-20.s.s1.explain: Ntọala ọnụego mbelata bụ uru tupu ọdịda, 150×10,000 won; ya mere ọ bụ 50÷150, ihe dịka 33.3%. Ọ dị iche na ọnụego mmụba.
l-m-h3-b0c33-20.s.s2.model.0: Na ②, e kewara na 100×10,000 won kama uru tupu ọdịda bụ 150×10,000 won; ya mere ezighị ezi. 50÷150 bụ ihe dịka 33.3%.
l-m-h3-b0c33-20.s.s2.model.1: Ntọala ọnụego mbelata bụ uru tupu ọdịda; ya mere ọ bụghị 50% dịka ọnụego mmụba, ọ bụ ihe dịka 33.3%.

l-m-h3-b0c34-17.material: Nke a bụ ngwọta ịchọta ọnụ ahịa nhatanha mgbe ọchịchọ bụ q=100−p, ọkọnọ bụ q=−10+1.5p: ①100−p=−10+1.5p ②110=0.5p ③p=220.
l-m-h3-b0c34-17.s.s1.o.a: ① Ahịrị na-eme ka nha abụọ hà
l-m-h3-b0c34-17.s.s1.r.a: Ọnụọgụ a na-achọ ga-adị ka nke a na-enye, ya mere nke a ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c34-17.s.s1.o.b: ② Ahịrị haziri nhatanha ahụ ọzọ
l-m-h3-b0c34-17.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ nsonaazụ si na nhatanha na-ezighi ezi dị n'ahịrị gara aga.
l-m-h3-b0c34-17.s.s1.r.d: Mgbe a chịkọtara okwu p, ọnụọgụ dị n'ihu ya abụghị 0.5.
l-m-h3-b0c34-17.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na i chịkọtara p n'otu akụkụ, 100+10=1.5p+p; ya mere 110=2.5p, p=44.
l-m-h3-b0c34-17.s.s2.model.0: Na ②, a gbakọrọ ọnụọgụ p dịka 0.5, ya mere ezighị ezi; dozie ya ka 110=2.5p, mgbe ahụ p=44.
l-m-h3-b0c34-17.s.s2.model.1: Mgbe e bugara −p n'akụkụ aka nri, a ga-agbakwunye ya na 1.5p ka ọ bụrụ 2.5p; ya mere dozie ya: p=110÷2.5=44.

l-m-h3-b0c34-18.title: Ahịrị nke mbụ nwere njehie na ngwọta uru atụ anya?
l-m-h3-b0c34-18.goal: Soro ngwọta uru atụ anya egwuregwu ebe ị nweta ego ma i merie, tụfuo ma ị daa; chọta njehie mbụ ma dozie ya.
l-m-h3-b0c34-18.material: N'egwuregwu, ohere 20% na-enye mmeri 500 won, ohere 80% na-atụfu 100 won. Nwa akwụkwọ dere: ①0.2×500=100 ②0.8×(−100)=−80 ③uru atụ anya bụ 100+80=180 won.
l-m-h3-b0c34-18.s.s1.r.a: Akụkụ 500 won n'ohere 20% bụ 100 won, ya mere ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c34-18.s.s1.r.b: Akụkụ furu efu bụ −80 won, akara ya ziri ezi kwa.
l-m-h3-b0c34-18.s.s1.r.c: Mgbe ị na-agbakwunye −80, ị ga-edebe akara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c34-18.s.s1.o.d: ③ Ahịrị chịkọtara uru atụ anya
l-m-h3-b0c34-18.s.s1.explain: −80 bụ uru a ga-ewepụ; ya mere 100+(−80)=20 won. E gbakwụnyere akụkụ furu efu dịka mma, ya mere 180 pụtara.
l-m-h3-b0c34-18.s.s2.model.0: Na ③, a gbakwụnyere −80 dịka +80, ya mere ezighị ezi; uru atụ anya bụ 100+(−80)=20 won.
l-m-h3-b0c34-18.s.s2.model.1: Akụkụ furu efu adịghị mma, ya mere wepụ 80 na mmeri; uru atụ anya bụ 20 won.

l-m-h3-b0c34-19.title: Ahịrị nke mbụ nwere njehie na ngwọta uru kacha elu?
l-m-h3-b0c34-19.topic: Soro ngwọta na-eji vertex nke quadratic chọta uru kacha elu; chọta njehie mbụ ma dozie ya.
l-m-h3-b0c34-19.goal: Nke a bụ ngwọta uru kacha elu nke P(q)=−q²+40q−100: ①P=−(q−20)²+300 ②vertex eserese bụ (300, 20) ③ya mere uru kacha elu bụ 20 mgbe q=300.
l-m-h3-b0c34-19.material: Ngwọta P(q)=−q²+40q−100: ①P=−(q−20)²+300 ②vertex (300, 20) ③uru kacha elu bụ 20 mgbe q=300. (20,300)
l-m-h3-b0c34-19.s.s1.o.b: −(q−20)²+300, mgbe e gbasapụrụ, bụ otu ngosipụta mbụ; ya mere ọ ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c34-19.s.s1.r.b: −(q−20)²+300, mgbe e gbasapụrụ, bụ otu ngosipụta mbụ; ya mere ọ ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c34-19.s.s1.r.c: A ga-agụ vertex n'usoro (uru q, uru profit).
l-m-h3-b0c34-19.s.s1.r.d: Vertex bụ (20, 300), ya mere uru kacha elu bụ 300 mgbe q=20.
l-m-h3-b0c34-19.s.s1.explain: Na ②, a gụrụ nhazi vertex azụ; ya mere ezighị ezi. Vertex nke −(q−20)²+300 bụ (20, 300).
l-m-h3-b0c34-19.s.s2.model.0: Na ②, a gụrụ vertex azụ; nke ziri ezi bụ (20, 300), ya bụ q=20 na uru kacha elu 300. Nọmba: 20 300.
l-m-h3-b0c34-19.s.s2.model.1: Uru kacha elu mgbe q−20=0; dozie ya: uru kacha elu bụ 300 mgbe q=20.

l-m-h3-b0c35-05.title: Uru ọ bụ 1,000 won mgbe mbelata gasịrị?
l-m-h3-b0c35-05.topic: Ọnụahịa zụta, ọnụahịa e depụtara, mbelata
l-m-h3-b0c35-05.goal: Soro ngwọta, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta, maka ịchọta uru site n’ọnụahịa zụta, ọnụahịa e depụtara na ọnụahịa e wedatara, chọta ebe njehie mbụ dị ma dozie ya.
l-m-h3-b0c35-05.material: E debere ọnụahịa e depụtara site n’ịgbakwunye uru 25% na ọnụahịa zụta 20,000 won, e rerekwa ihe ahụ na mbelata 20% n’ọnụahịa e depụtara. Nzọụkwụ: 1) ọnụahịa e depụtara=20,000×1.25=25,000 2) mbelata=20,000×0.2=4,000 3) ọnụahịa ire=25,000−4,000=21,000 4) uru=21,000−20,000=1,000 won
l-m-h3-b0c35-05.s.s1.r.c: E jiri uru si na nzọụkwụ gara aga gbakọọ 25,000−4,000 nke ọma.
l-m-h3-b0c35-05.s.s1.explain: A na-agbakọ mbelata site n’ọnụahịa e depụtara, ya mere ọ bụ 25,000×0.2=5,000 won. Ọnụahịa ire bụ 20,000 won, uru bụkwa 0 won.
l-m-h3-b0c35-05.s.s2.model.0: A ga-amụba ọnụego mbelata na ọnụahịa e depụtara, ma a mụbara ya na ọnụahịa zụta; ya mere nzọụkwụ 2 ezighị ezi. Ọ bụrụ na 25,000×0.2=5,000, ọnụahịa ire bụ 20,000 won.
l-m-h3-b0c35-05.s.s2.model.1: A họọrọ ntọala na-ezighị ezi na nzọụkwụ 2. 20% nke ọnụahịa e depụtara 25,000 won bụ 5,000 won, ya mere ọnụahịa ire bụ 20,000 won, uru bụkwa 0 won.

l-m-h3-b0c35-13.title: Ọ bụrụ na mmepụta abawanye, nkezi ọnụ ahịa ọ ga-abụ 0 won?
l-m-h3-b0c35-13.topic: Ọrụ ọnụ ahịa na nkezi ọnụ ahịa
l-m-h3-b0c35-13.goal: Soro ngwọta nkezi ọnụ ahịa dabere na mmepụta, chọta ebe mbụ ọ na-ezighi ezi ma dozie ya.
l-m-h3-b0c35-13.material: Ọnụ ahịa niile bụ C=5,000+300x won (x bụ mmepụta). Ngwọta: 1) x=50, C=20,000 2) nkezi ọnụ ahịa=20,000÷50=400 won 3) x=100, nkezi=35,000÷100=350 won 4) Ọ bụrụ na mmepụta abawanye, nkezi ọnụ ahịa na-abịaru 0 won nso.
l-m-h3-b0c35-13.s.s1.o.d: Nzọụkwụ 4: nkezi ọnụ ahịa na-abịaru 0 won
l-m-h3-b0c35-13.s.s1.explain: Nkezi ọnụ ahịa bụ 5,000/x+300; ọbụna x buru ibu, ọ naghị ada n'okpuru 300 won, kama ọ na-abịaru 300 nso.
l-m-h3-b0c35-13.s.s2.model.0: Nkezi ọnụ ahịa bụ 5,000÷x gbakwunyere 300; mgbe x buru ibu ọ na-abịaru 300 won, ọ dịghị aghọ 0.
l-m-h3-b0c35-13.s.s2.model.1: Ọnụ ahịa mgbanwe 300 won kwa ihe ka na-adị mgbe niile, n'agbanyeghị mmepụta; ya mere 0 won na nzọụkwụ 4 ezighị ezi, 300 won ziri ezi.

l-m-h3-b0c35-20.title: Ịdozi uru atụ anya egwuregwu dice
l-m-h3-b0c35-20.goal: Soro ngwọta uru atụ anya egwuregwu dice, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta, chọta mmejọ mbụ ma dozie ya.
l-m-h3-b0c35-20.material: Tụgharịa dice otu ugboro. Ọ bụrụ nọmba ahụ bụ ọbụna, ị na-enweta (nọmba ahụ)×100 won; ma ọ bụrụ ọgọ, ị na-akwụ 200 won. Ngwọta: 1) ohere ọbụna na ọgọ bụ 1/2 nke ọ bụla 2) mgbe ọ bụ ọbụna, ị na-enweta 400 won ná nkezi 3) uru atụ anya=400−200=200 won 4) egwuregwu ugboro 100 na-enye ihe dịka 20,000 won.
l-m-h3-b0c35-20.s.s1.o.a: Nzọụkwụ 1: ohere nke ọ bụla bụ 1/2
l-m-h3-b0c35-20.s.s1.r.a: E nwere nọmba ọbụna 3 na ọgọ 3; ya mere ọ ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c35-20.s.s1.o.b: Nzọụkwụ 2: ná nkezi 400 won mgbe ọbụna pụtara
l-m-h3-b0c35-20.s.s1.r.d: Nke a bụ mgbakọ e mere site n’iji uru Nzọụkwụ 3, ya mere ọ bụghị ebe mbụ mmejọ ahụ dị.
l-m-h3-b0c35-20.s.s1.explain: Ị ga-amụba na ohere. 1/2×400−1/2×200=100 won, egwuregwu 100 na-enye ihe dịka 10,000 won.
l-m-h3-b0c35-20.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụ n’ihi na Nzọụkwụ 3 amụbaghị na ohere 1/2 nke ọnọdụ abụọ ahụ; dozie ya ka ọ bụrụ 200−100=100 won.
l-m-h3-b0c35-20.s.s2.model.1: Uru atụ anya bụ ngụkọta uru mụbara na ohere; ya mere 400×1/2−200×1/2=100 won, Nzọụkwụ 4 na-agbanwekwa ka ọ bụrụ 10,000 won.

l-m-h3-b0c35-26.title: Ọmụrụ nwa dị mfe agwakọtara na nke jikọtara ọnụ
l-m-h3-b0c35-26.goal: Soro ngwọta ego tozuru oke mgbe afọ 3 nke ọmụrụ nwa jikọtara ọnụ, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta, chọta mmejọ mbụ ma dozie ya.
l-m-h3-b0c35-26.material: Nke a bụ ngwọta nkwụnye 200 ×10,000 won ruo afọ 3 na ọmụrụ nwa jikọtara ọnụ 3% kwa afọ. 1) Mgbe afọ 1: 200×1.03=206 2) Mgbe afọ 2: 206+200×0.03=212 3) Mgbe afọ 3: 212+200×0.03=218 4) Ego tozuru oke bụ 218 ×10,000 won.
l-m-h3-b0c35-26.s.s1.r.c: E megharịrị otu mmejọ ahụ, ma ebe mbụ ọ dara bụ Nzọụkwụ 2.
l-m-h3-b0c35-26.s.s1.r.d: Nke a na-ebufe uru Nzọụkwụ 3 naanị, ya mere ọ bụghị ebe mbụ mmejọ ahụ dị.
l-m-h3-b0c35-26.s.s1.explain: N’ọmụrụ nwa jikọtara ọnụ, ọmụrụ nwa na-enwetakwa ọmụrụ nwa. Mgbe afọ 2 ọ bụ 206×1.03=212.18; mgbe afọ 3 ọ bụ ihe dịka 218.5 ×10,000 won.
l-m-h3-b0c35-26.s.s2.model.0: Ọ dị njọ n’ihi na na Nzọụkwụ 2 a gbakwụnyere ọmụrụ nwa naanị na 200 mbụ. Tinye 3% na 206, dozie ya ka ọ bụrụ 212.18.
l-m-h3-b0c35-26.s.s2.model.1: Ọmụrụ nwa jikọtara ọnụ na-amụba ego toro na ọnụego; ya mere mgbe afọ 2 ọ bụ 206×1.03=212.18, ego tozuru oke bụ ihe dịka 218.5 ×10,000 won.

l-m-h3-b0c35-33.title: Ịchọta njehie na mgbakọ uto ahịa
l-m-h3-b0c35-33.goal: Soro ngwọta ọnụego uto ahịa mgbe ọnụ ahịa rịrị elu; chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ ọ na-ezighi ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c35-33.material: Mgbe ọnụ ahịa si 1,000 ruo 1,250 won, ahịa dara site na 400 ruo 360. Ngwọta: 1) ahịa tupu=1,000×400=400,000 2) mgbe=1,250×360=450,000 3) kewaa mmụba 50,000 na ahịa mgbe ahụ iji nweta ihe dịka 11% 4) ahịa toro ihe dịka 11%.
l-m-h3-b0c35-33.s.s1.o.c: Nzọụkwụ 3: kewaa uto na ahịa mgbe ahụ
l-m-h3-b0c35-33.s.s1.r.d: Nke a na-ebufe nkwubi okwu Nzọụkwụ 3; ya mere ọ bụghị ebe mbụ ezighi ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c35-33.s.s1.explain: Kewaa mmụba na uru mmalite (400,000 won). 50,000÷400,000=12.5%.
l-m-h3-b0c35-33.s.s2.model.0: Ntọala ọnụego uto bụ uru tupu mmụba; kewaa na 400,000, ọ bụghị ahịa mgbe 450,000. Dozie ya ka ọ bụrụ 12.5%.
l-m-h3-b0c35-33.s.s2.model.1: Ezighị ezi n'ihi na ahọpụtara ihe dị n'okpuru na Nzọụkwụ 3. 50,000÷400,000=0.125; ahịa toro ihe dịka 12.5%.

l-m-h3-b0c36-17.title: Ahịrị na-ezighị ezi n’ngwọta ịmụba matris
l-m-h3-b0c36-17.goal: Soro ngwọta ngwaahịa matriks abụọ, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta, chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ mmejọ mere.
l-m-h3-b0c36-17.material: Maka A=(1 2; 3 4) na B=(0 1; 1 0), nwa akwụkwọ gbakọrọ AB n’otu akụkụ n’otu. Chọta ahịrị mbụ na-ezighị ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c36-17.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ahịrị mbụ e gbakọrọ na-ezighị ezi?
l-m-h3-b0c36-17.s.s1.r.a: E mụbara ahịrị 1 nke A na kọlụm 1 nke B nke ọma. Ọ bụghị mmejọ.
l-m-h3-b0c36-17.s.s1.r.b: E mụbara ahịrị 1 nke A na kọlụm 2 nke B nke ọma. Ọ bụghị mmejọ.
l-m-h3-b0c36-17.s.s1.r.d: Ahịrị a dịkwa njọ, ma e nwere nke gara aga dara mbụ.
l-m-h3-b0c36-17.s.s1.explain: (ahịrị 2, kọlụm 1) ga-amụba ahịrị 2 nke A na kọlụm 1 nke B, (0, 1), na-enye 3×0+4×1=4. A gbanwere kọlụm mgbe a na-amụba.
l-m-h3-b0c36-17.s.s2.model.0: Ahịrị 2, kọlụm 1 na-amụba na kọlụm 1 nke B, (0,1); ya mere ọ bụ 3×0+4×1=4, ma e ji kọlụm 2 mee ihe. Nke a bụ ebe mbụ na-ezighị ezi, a ga-edozi ya ka ọ bụrụ 4.
l-m-h3-b0c36-17.s.s2.model.1: Ahịrị abụọ mbụ ziri ezi; a gbanwere kọlụm n’ahịrị nke atọ, ya mere ọ kwesịrị ịbụ 4, ọ bụghị 3.

l-m-h3-b0c36-18.title: Ịlele ngwọta ohere ọrịa ma ọ bụrụ na nsonaazụ ule dị mma
l-m-h3-b0c36-18.goal: Soro ngwọta na-eji iwu Bayes, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta, chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ mmejọ mere.
l-m-h3-b0c36-18.material: Ọnụọgụ ọrịa bụ 10%; onye ọrịa na-enweta nsonaazụ dị mma na ohere 90%, onye ahụ dị mma na-enwetakwa nke ọma na ohere 5%. Chọta ahịrị mbụ na-ezighị ezi n’ngwọta nwa akwụkwọ maka ohere na onye nwetara ezigbo nsonaazụ ule na-arịa ọrịa.
l-m-h3-b0c36-18.s.s1.o.a: ① Ọrịa na nsonaazụ dị mma: 0.1×0.9=0.09
l-m-h3-b0c36-18.s.s1.r.a: E mere ịmụba ahụ nke ọma. Ọ bụghị mmejọ.
l-m-h3-b0c36-18.s.s1.o.b: ② Ahụike na nsonaazụ dị mma: 0.05
l-m-h3-b0c36-18.s.s1.r.c: Ahịrị a dịkwa njọ, ma ② gara aga dara mbụ.
l-m-h3-b0c36-18.s.s1.r.d: Nkewa ziri ezi, ma njehie ahịrị gara aga gafere.
l-m-h3-b0c36-18.s.s1.explain: Ohere onye dị mma ma nweta nsonaazụ ọma bụ 0.9×0.05=0.045. E mụbaghị oke ndị dị mma, 0.9.
l-m-h3-b0c36-18.s.s2.model.0: Ndị dị mma bụ 90% nke mmadụ niile; ya mere a ga-edozi ohere onye dị mma ma nweta nsonaazụ ọma ka ọ bụrụ 0.9×0.05=0.045. ② bụ ahịrị mbụ na-ezighị ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c36-18.s.s2.model.1: Na ② e mụbaghị oke ndị ahụike, ya mere e jiri 0.05; uru ziri ezi bụ 0.045, azịza ya bụ 0.09÷0.135≈0.67.

l-m-h3-b0c36-19.title: Ịlele otu nzọụkwụ gradient descent
l-m-h3-b0c36-19.goal: Soro mgbakọ otu nzọụkwụ gradient descent, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta, chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ mmejọ mere.
l-m-h3-b0c36-19.material: Jiri gradient descent chọta nke kacha nta nke f(x)=x²−6x. Chọta ahịrị mbụ na-ezighị ezi n’ngwọta na-eme otu nzọụkwụ site n’ebe mmalite x=0, learning rate 0.25.
l-m-h3-b0c36-19.s.s1.r.a: A chọtara derivative ahụ nke ọma. Ọ bụghị mmejọ.
l-m-h3-b0c36-19.s.s1.r.b: E tinyere uru ahụ nke ọma. Ọ bụghị mmejọ.
l-m-h3-b0c36-19.s.s1.o.d: ④ x si n’ebe kacha nta 3 pụọkwuo
l-m-h3-b0c36-19.s.s1.r.d: Nsonaazụ a sitere na mmejọ ③. E nwere ahịrị gara aga na-ezighị ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c36-19.s.s1.explain: x ọhụrụ=x−learning rate×mkpọda=0−0.25×(−6)=1.5. A gbakwụnyere mkpọda kama iwepụ ya, ya mere ọ gara n’akụkụ na-ezighị ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c36-19.s.s2.model.0: Gradient descent ga-ewepụ mkpọda, ma na ③ a gbakwụnyere ya, x ghọrọ −1.5. Dozie ya ka ọ bụrụ 0−0.25×(−6)=1.5.
l-m-h3-b0c36-19.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ mkpọda bụ −6, ị ga-aga n’aka nri; x ga-abawanye. Ya mere a ga-edozi ③ ka ọ bụrụ 1.5.

l-m-h3-b0c36-20.title: Ịlele ihe e nwetara site na matriks mgbagwoju anya
l-m-h3-b0c36-20.goal: Soro ngwọta na-achọta ihe ngosi site na matriks mgbagwoju anya, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta, chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ mmejọ mere.
l-m-h3-b0c36-20.material: Nsonaazụ ule 200: ndị ọrịa 40 a chọpụtara nke ọma dị ka ndị nwere ọrịa, ndị ọrịa 10 a hapụrụ, ndị ahụike 20 e kpebiri na ha na-arịa ọrịa n’amaghị ama, ndị ahụike 130 a chọpụtara nke ọma. Chọta ahịrị mbụ na-ezighị ezi n’ngwọta nwa akwụkwọ.
l-m-h3-b0c36-20.s.s1.r.b: A chọtara ngụkọta ahụ nke ọma. Ọ bụghị mmejọ.
l-m-h3-b0c36-20.s.s1.r.c: A gbakọrọ ya nke ọma. Ọ bụghị mmejọ.
l-m-h3-b0c36-20.s.s1.o.d: ④ Recall dị ala, ya mere e chefuru ọtụtụ ndị ọrịa
l-m-h3-b0c36-20.s.s1.r.d: Nkwubi okwu a sitere n’uru na-ezighị ezi na ③. E nwere ahịrị gara aga na-ezighị ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c36-20.s.s1.explain: Onye nkewa nke recall bụ ọnụọgụ ndị ọrịa n’ezie, 40+10=50. 40/50=80%; 40+20 bụ ọnụọgụ e buru amụma na ha nwere ọrịa, nke a na-eji maka precision.
l-m-h3-b0c36-20.s.s2.model.0: Recall bụ oke ndị achọpụtara n’etiti ndị ọrịa n’ezie; ya mere onye nkewa ga-abụ 40+10=50. Ma e tinyere 20, nke ahụ ezighị ezi; uru ziri ezi bụ 80%.
l-m-h3-b0c36-20.s.s2.model.1: 40+20 e ji na ③ bụ ọnụọgụ e buru amụma na ha nwere ọrịa, ya mere ọ bụ onye nkewa maka precision. Dozie recall ka ọ bụrụ 40/50=80%.

l-m-h3-b0c37-17.title: Na-enyocha ngwọta cosine similarity
l-m-h3-b0c37-17.goal: Soro usoro ngwọta na-agbakọ cosine n’etiti vector abụọ, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta, chọta ebe mbụ o mehiere ma dozie ya.
l-m-h3-b0c37-17.material: Nke a bụ ngwọta nwa akwụkwọ nke na-achọta cosθ=(a·b)/(|a||b|) maka a=(3,4) na b=(4,−3). Chọta ahịrị mbụ na-ezighị ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c37-17.s.s1.r.a: A gbakọrọ dot product nke ọma. Ọ bụghị njehie.
l-m-h3-b0c37-17.s.s1.r.b: A gbakọrọ magnitude nke ọma. Ọ bụghị njehie.
l-m-h3-b0c37-17.s.s1.r.d: Denominator ezighị ezi, ma dot product bụ 0, ya mere uru ahụ bụ otu. E nwere ahịrị gara aga ezighị ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c37-17.s.s1.explain: |b|=√(4²+(−3)²)=√25=5. Square na-adị positive n’agbanyeghị akara, ya mere a ga-agbakwunye.
l-m-h3-b0c37-17.s.s2.model.0: Ebe (−3)²=9, |b| bụ √(16+9)=5, ma na ③ e wepụrụ 9 wee ghọọ √7; ya mere ③ bụ njehie mbụ.
l-m-h3-b0c37-17.s.s2.model.1: Iwere square nke akụkụ na-eme ka ha niile bụrụ positive, ya mere a ga-agbakwunye; ma e wepụrụ ya, dozie ③ ka ọ bụrụ 5.

l-m-h3-b0c37-18.title: Na-enyocha confidence interval maka mean
l-m-h3-b0c37-18.goal: Soro usoro ngwọta nke na-achọta confidence interval maka population mean, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta, chọta ebe mbụ o mehiere ma dozie ya.
l-m-h3-b0c37-18.material: Chọta ahịrị mbụ na-ezighị ezi n’ngwọta na-achọta confidence interval 95% maka population mean (sample mean ± 2×standard error) mgbe population standard deviation bụ 16, sample size bụ 64, sample mean bụ 50.
l-m-h3-b0c37-18.s.s1.r.a: E debere etiti ahụ nke ọma. Ọ bụghị njehie.
l-m-h3-b0c37-18.s.s1.r.c: O jiri uru si na ②, ya mere ezighị ezi. E nwere ahịrị gara aga ezighị ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c37-18.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ nsonaazụ sochiri uru dị na ②. E nwere ahịrị gara aga ezighị ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c37-18.s.s1.explain: Standard error=16÷√64=16÷8=2. A ga-ekewa na √n. Oke ahụ bụ 50±4, ya bụ 46 ruo 54.
l-m-h3-b0c37-18.s.s2.model.0: Standard error bụ population standard deviation e kewara ọ bụghị na 64 kama na √64=8, nke na-enye 2; ya mere ② bụ njehie mbụ, a na-edozikwa oke ahụ ka 46 ruo 54.
l-m-h3-b0c37-18.s.s2.model.1: Na ②, o kewara site na sample size n’onwe ya, ya mere ọ ghọrọ 0.25; ahịrị ndị sochiri ezighị ezi n’ihi na ha jiri uru ahụ.

l-m-h3-b0c37-19.title: Na-enyocha ngwọta slope nke ahịrị
l-m-h3-b0c37-19.goal: Soro usoro ngwọta nke na-differentiate ngụkọta njehie square iji chọta slope, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta, chọta ebe mbụ o mehiere ma dozie ya.
l-m-h3-b0c37-19.material: Anyị dabara ahịrị y=wx na isi (1,2), (2,3), (3,7). Chọta ahịrị mbụ na-ezighị ezi n’ngwọta nke na-differentiate ngụkọta njehie square J(w)=(w−2)²+(2w−3)²+(3w−7)² iji chọta w na-enye minimum.
l-m-h3-b0c37-19.s.s1.r.a: E guzobere ngụkọta njehie square nke ọma. Ọ bụghị njehie.
l-m-h3-b0c37-19.s.s1.r.c: Ọ na-eme ka okwu dị na ② dị mfe, ya mere e nwere ahịrị gara aga ezighị ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c37-19.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ nsonaazụ sochiri ③. E nwere ahịrị gara aga ezighị ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c37-19.s.s1.explain: Na ②, echefuru inner derivatives 2 na 3 nke (2w−3)² na (3w−7)². Okwu ziri ezi bụ J'(w)=28w−58.
l-m-h3-b0c37-19.s.s2.model.0: Mgbe a na-differentiate composite function, a na-amụba ya na coefficients 2 na 3 nke okwu dị n’ime, ma e chefuru ha na ②; ya mere nke ahụ bụ njehie mbụ.
l-m-h3-b0c37-19.s.s2.model.1: J'(w) ziri ezi bụ 2(w−2)+4(2w−3)+6(3w−7)=28w−58; ya mere ②, nke chefuru ịmụba na coefficients, bụ ebe njehie dị.

l-m-h3-b0c37-20.goal: Soro usoro nkọwa na-agụ metrics site na confusion matrix, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta, chọta ebe mbụ o mehiere ma dozie ya.
l-m-h3-b0c37-20.material: N’ule 200, a chọtara onye ọrịa 15, echefuru onye ọrịa 25, a kpọrọ ọnọdụ nkịtị 5 onye ọrịa, ma achọpụtara ọnọdụ nkịtị 155 nke ọma. Chọta ahịrị mbụ na-ezighị ezi na nkọwa nwa akwụkwọ.
l-m-h3-b0c37-20.s.s1.o.a: ④ Accuracy bụ 85%, ya mere a chọtara ọtụtụ ndị ọrịa
l-m-h3-b0c37-20.s.s1.explain: Accuracy 85% nwere akụkụ buru ibu nke ọnọdụ nkịtị 155 a chọpụtara nke ọma. N’ime ndị ọrịa 40, a chọtara naanị 15 (recall ihe dịka 38%), ya mere echefuru ọtụtụ.
l-m-h3-b0c37-20.s.s2.model.0: N’ime ndị ọrịa 40, a chọtara naanị 15, ya mere recall bụ 38%. Ọbụna na accuracy dị elu, echefuru ọtụtụ ndị ọrịa; ya mere ④ ezighị ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c37-20.s.s2.model.1: E nwere ọtụtụ ọnọdụ nkịtị, ya mere ọnụọgụ ọnọdụ nkịtị a chọpụtara nke ọma mere ka accuracy bilie naanị; accuracy 85% agaghị agwa gị otú e si chọta ndị ọrịa.

l-m-h3-b0c38-05.s.s1.r.a: A mụbara ahịrị 1 na kọlụm 1 nke ọma.
l-m-h3-b0c38-05.s.s1.r.b: A mụbara ahịrị 1 na kọlụm 2 nke ọma.
l-m-h3-b0c38-05.s.s1.r.d: Ahịrị 4 dịkwa njọ, ma mmejọ ahụ malitere na ahịrị 3.
l-m-h3-b0c38-05.s.s1.explain: Ihe (2,1) bụ 3·0+4·1=4, site n’ịmụba ahịrị 2 nke A na kọlụm 1 nke B. Ahịrị 3 jiri kọlụm 2 nke B.
l-m-h3-b0c38-05.s.s2.model.0: Ihe (2,1) ga-abụ ahịrị 2 nke A mụbara na kọlụm 1 nke B, ma ahịrị 3 jiri kọlụm 2; ya mere ọ dị njọ. Mgbe e doziri, ọ bụ 4.

l-m-h3-b0c38-11.title: Ahịrị mbụ na-ezighị ezi n’ngwọta ohere spam
l-m-h3-b0c38-11.goal: Soro usoro ngwọta ohere email nwere ‘free’ bụ spam, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta, chọta ma dozie mmejọ mbụ.
l-m-h3-b0c38-11.material: 20% ozi bụ spam. ‘Free’ pụtara na 60% nke spam na 5% ozi nkịtị. Ahịrị 1: P(spam∩free)=0.2×0.6=0.12. Ahịrị 2: P(free)=0.6+0.05=0.65. Ahịrị 3: P(spam|free)=0.12÷0.65. Ahịrị 4: ihe dịka 0.18.
l-m-h3-b0c38-11.s.s1.r.a: E mụbara ọnụego spam na ọnụego okwu pụtara nke ọma.
l-m-h3-b0c38-11.s.s1.r.c: Usoro nkewa ziri ezi, ma onye nkewa dị n’ahịrị gara aga ezighị ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c38-11.s.s1.r.d: Nkwubi okwu bụ naanị nsonaazụ njehie ahịrị gara aga.
l-m-h3-b0c38-11.s.s1.explain: A ga-achọta ohere niile ‘free’ pụtara site n’ịmụba oke otu ọ bụla wee chịkọta: P(free)=0.2×0.6+0.8×0.05=0.16. Ya mere azịza bụ 0.12÷0.16=0.75.
l-m-h3-b0c38-11.s.s2.model.0: A ga-achọta ohere niile ‘free’ pụtara site n’ịmụba oke nke otu ndị ahụ, wee gbakwunye; ya mere ahịrị 2 ezighị ezi. Ọ bụ 0.12+0.04=0.16.
l-m-h3-b0c38-11.s.s2.model.1: 0.6 na 0.05 bụ oke n’ime otu dị iche iche; ya mere agbakwụnyela ha kpọmkwem. Mụbaa na spam 20% na nkịtị 80%, wee gbakwunye.

l-m-h3-b0c38-19.goal: Soro ngwọta na-emelite w otu ugboro site na gradient descent, chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ ihe na-ezighi ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c38-19.material: Loss f(w)=(w−3)², mmalite w=0, learning rate 0.1. Ahịrị 1: f′(w)=2(w−3). Ahịrị 2: f′(0)=−6. Ahịrị 3: w ọhụrụ=0+0.1×(−6)=−0.6. Ahịrị 4: f(−0.6)=12.96, nke karịrị f(0)=9.
l-m-h3-b0c38-19.s.s1.r.d: Mgbakọ ahịrị 4 ziri ezi. Loss toro n'ihi ahịrị 3.
l-m-h3-b0c38-19.s.s1.explain: Gradient descent na-ewepụ learning rate×mkpọda na w. 0−0.1×(−6)=0.6, f(0.6)=5.76, nke na-ebelata.
l-m-h3-b0c38-19.s.s2.model.0: Iji belata loss, gaa n'akụkụ nke ọzọ nke mkpọda; ma ahịrị 3 gbakwụnyere, wee nweta −0.6. Wepụ ya kama: 0.6.
l-m-h3-b0c38-19.s.s2.model.1: Ahịrị 3 nwere akara na-ezighi ezi, ya mere loss toro site na 9 ruo 12.96; ahịrị 3 bụ njehie mbụ.

l-m-h3-b0c38-30.title: Ahịrị mbụ na-ezighị ezi n’ngụkọta recall
l-m-h3-b0c38-30.goal: Soro usoro ngwọta na-achọta recall, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta, chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ o mehiere.
l-m-h3-b0c38-30.material: N’ime ngwaahịa 1000, 50 nwere ntụpọ n’ezie. N’ime 40 ụdị ahụ kpebiri na ha nwere ntụpọ, 30 nwere ntụpọ n’ezie. Ahịrị 1: ntụpọ a chọtara=30. Ahịrị 2: ntụpọ n’ezie=50. Ahịrị 3: recall=30÷40=0.75. Ahịrị 4: a chọtara 75% nke ntụpọ.
l-m-h3-b0c38-30.s.s1.r.a: N’ime 40 a kpebiri, 30 nwere ntụpọ n’ezie, nke ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c38-30.s.s1.r.b: Ntụpọ n’ezie 50 bụ uru e nyere.
l-m-h3-b0c38-30.s.s1.r.d: Nkwubi okwu ahụ sitere n’uru na-ezighị ezi dị n’ahịrị 3.
l-m-h3-b0c38-30.s.s1.explain: Recall bụ 30÷50=0.6. 40 bụ ọnụọgụ e kpebiri na ha nwere ntụpọ, ya mere ọ bụ denominator nke precision.
l-m-h3-b0c38-30.s.s2.model.0: Ahịrị 3 ezighị ezi n’ihi na denominator jiri ọnụọgụ e kpebiri, 40. Recall bụ 30÷50=0.6.
l-m-h3-b0c38-30.s.s2.model.1: 30÷40 bụ precision, ya mere agbanwere metric na ahịrị 3. Ọ bụ eziokwu na a chọtara 60% nke ntụpọ.

l-m-h3-b0c40-19.material: Data: n'ọnwa ọkọchị, ahịa ice cream na ihe mberede egwuregwu mmiri abụọ mụbara. Ngwọta: Ahịrị 1: uru abụọ ahụ mụbara ọnụ. Ahịrị 2: ya mere ahịa toro, ihe mberede tokwa. Ahịrị 3: ọ bụrụ na e belata ahịa, ihe mberede ga-ebelata.

l-m-h3-b0c40-21.s.s1.r.c: Ajụjụ chọrọ pasent uru n'elu ọnụ ahịa, ma e kewara na ọnụ ahịa ire.

l-m-h3-b0c40-21.s.s1.explain: Uru pasent n'elu ọnụ ahịa na-ekewa uru na ọnụ ahịa. 200÷800=0.25, ya bụ 25%.
l-m-h3-b0c40-21.s.s2.model.0: Ajụjụ chọrọ dabere n'ọnụ ahịa, ma e kewara na ọnụ ahịa ire 1,000; ya mere ahịrị 2 ezighị ezi. 200÷800=0.25.
l-m-h3-b0c40-21.s.s2.model.1: Ntọala bụ ọnụ ahịa, ya mere kewaa na 800. Mgbe e doziri ya, uru pasent bụ 25%.

l-m-h3-b0c41-18.goal: Soro ngwọta gbanwere oge ọrụ ka ọ bụrụ decimal, chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ mmejọ mere.
l-m-h3-b0c41-18.material: Nke a bụ ngwọta oge niile maka ọrụ 8 nke nke ọ bụla na-ewe awa 1 na nkeji 45. Nzọụkwụ 1: awa 1 na nkeji 45=awa 1.45. Nzọụkwụ 2: 1.45×8=awa 11.6. Nzọụkwụ 3: awa 0.6=nkeji 36; ya mere awa 11 na nkeji 36.
l-m-h3-b0c41-18.s.s1.r.a: 0.6×60=36; ya mere ntụgharị ahụ ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c41-18.s.s1.r.b: Ịmụba n’onwe ya ziri ezi. Nọmba sitere na nzọụkwụ gara aga ezighị ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c41-18.s.s1.r.d: Maka ọrụ 8 ọ ga-abụ awa 14; ya mere awa 11 na nkeji 36 pere mpe.
l-m-h3-b0c41-18.s.s1.explain: Nkeji 45 abụghị awa 0.45, kama 45÷60=awa 0.75. Ya mere 1.75×8=awa 14 ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c41-18.s.s2.model.0: Nkeji 45 bụ awa 0.75, ma e dere ya dịka 0.45; ya mere Nzọụkwụ 1 bụ mmejọ mbụ.
l-m-h3-b0c41-18.s.s2.model.1: A ga-agbakọ na awa 1.75, ma mmalite bụ 1.45, ya mere ihe niile sochiri adabaghị. Ebe mbụ mejọrọ bụ Nzọụkwụ 1.

l-m-h3-b0c41-19.goal: Soro ngwọta na-achọta ọnụahịa e depụtara na nke e belatara, chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ mmejọ mere.
l-m-h3-b0c41-19.material: E debere ọnụahịa site n’ịgbakwunye 25% na ọnụ ahịa 8,000 won, wee nye mbelata 20%. Nzọụkwụ 1: ọnụahịa depụtara=8,000×1.25=10,000 won. Nzọụkwụ 2: 25%−20%=uru 5%. Nzọụkwụ 3: ọnụahịa ire=8,000×1.05=8,400 won.
l-m-h3-b0c41-19.s.s1.r.b: Mbelata 20% sitere n’ọnụahịa e depụtara 10,000 won; ya mere ọnụahịa ire dị iche.
l-m-h3-b0c41-19.s.s1.r.d: Mgbakọ ziri ezi, ma ọnụego uru sitere na nzọụkwụ gara aga ezighị ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c41-19.s.s1.explain: Mbelata 20% bụ 20% nke ọnụahịa e depụtara 10,000 won, ya bụ 2,000 won. Ọnụahịa ire bụ 8,000 won, ya mere uru bụ 0 won.
l-m-h3-b0c41-19.s.s2.model.0: Ọnụego mbelata 20% sitere n’ọnụahịa e depụtara 10,000 won, ọ bụghị ọnụ ahịa; ya mere ewepụla 25%−20%.
l-m-h3-b0c41-19.s.s2.model.1: Iwepụ 2,000 won n’ọnụahịa e depụtara na-enye 8,000 won, uru adịghị; ya mere Nzọụkwụ 2 ezighị ezi.

l-m-h3-b0c41-20.material: Ịtụ ihe ọkọlọtọ 100g ugboro 4 nyere 100.5g, 99.5g, 100.5g, 99.5g. Nzọụkwụ 1: njehie bụ +0.5, −0.5, +0.5, −0.5g. Nzọụkwụ 2: ngụkọta njehie bụ 0. Nzọụkwụ 3: ya mere njehie adịghị.

l-m-h3-b0c41-20.s.s1.r.d: Ha bụ uru a tụrụ ewepụ 100; ya mere ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c41-20.s.s1.explain: Ngụkọta njehie 0 pụtara naanị na + na − kagburu onwe ha. Ọ dị iche 0.5g oge ọ bụla, ya mere njehie dị.
l-m-h3-b0c41-20.s.s2.model.0: Njehie ndị gbakwunyere na ndị ewepụrụ kagburu onwe ha, ya mere ngụkọta ghọrọ 0; nkwubi okwu Nzọụkwụ 3 ezighị ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c41-20.s.s2.model.1: Ọ dị iche na 100g site na 0.5g oge ọ bụla; ya mere ikwu na njehie adịghị ezighị ezi.

l-m-h3-b0c42-15.title: Kọfị na insomnia: ebee ka echiche ahụ wụfere nzọụkwụ?
l-m-h3-b0c42-15.goal: Soro ngwọta site na correlation kọfị na insomnia ruo nkwubi okwu, chọta ebe mbụ o mehiere ma dozie ya.
l-m-h3-b0c42-15.material: Nke a bụ ngwọta maka nsonaazụ nyocha. ① Ka ndị mmadụ na-aṅụ kọfị karịa, otú ahụ ka oke ndị nwere insomnia dị elu. ② Ụkpụrụ abụọ ahụ nwere positive correlation. ③ Kọfị na-akpata insomnia. ④ Ọ bụrụ na ndị mmadụ akwụsị kọfị, insomnia ga-ebelata.
l-m-h3-b0c42-15.s.s1.o.a: ①: Oke ahụ dị elu na nyocha
l-m-h3-b0c42-15.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ eziokwu e gụrụ na data, ya mere o mehiereghị.
l-m-h3-b0c42-15.s.s1.o.b: ②: Ụkpụrụ abụọ ahụ nwere positive correlation
l-m-h3-b0c42-15.s.s1.r.b: Ọ na-akọwa ọchịchọ ịgbanwe ọnụ, ya mere ọ ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c42-15.s.s1.o.d: ④: Ịkwụsị na-eme ka insomnia belata
l-m-h3-b0c42-15.s.s1.r.d: A tụkwasịrị ③ obi ma wuo nkwubi okwu na ya, ya mere ọ bụghị ebe mbụ ihe mehiere.
l-m-h3-b0c42-15.s.s1.explain: Correlation naanị ya agaghị agwa anyị ma kọfị bụ ihe kpatara ya. Ndị mmadụ nwere ike ịṅụ kọfị n’ihi insomnia, ma ọ bụ ihe ọzọ nwere ike ịdị.
l-m-h3-b0c42-15.s.s2.model.0: Ọ mehiere na ③ n’ihi na e mere correlation ozugbo ka ọ bụrụ ihe kpatara ya. Ọ nwekwara ike ịbụ ntụziaka ọzọ: ndị nwere insomnia na-aṅụ kọfị.
l-m-h3-b0c42-15.s.s2.model.1: Data nwere ike igosi ruo ②, na ụkpụrụ abụọ ahụ na-agbanwe ọnụ; a ga-achịkwa ihe ndị ọzọ iji mara ihe kpatara ya, ya mere ③ bụ njehie mbụ.

l-m-h3-b0c42-21.title: Ebee ka ngụkọta uru a tụrụ anya nke lọtrị hiere ụzọ?
l-m-h3-b0c42-21.topic: Uru a tụrụ anya na mkpebi
l-m-h3-b0c42-21.goal: Soro usoro ngụkọta uru a tụrụ anya nke otu tiketi lọtrị na ntụnyere ya na ọnụ ahịa, chọta ebe mbụ o hiere ụzọ ma mezie ya.
l-m-h3-b0c42-21.material: Tiketi 1 nke lọtrị na-efu 300 won: 10,000 won nwere ohere 0.01; 1000 won nwere ohere 0.1; enweghị mmeri nwere 0.89. ① Ohere ndị ahụ gbakọtara bụ 1. ② Uru a tụrụ anya bụ 100+100=200 won. ③ 200 won<300 won, ya mere uru nkezi bụ 100 won n’tiketi ọ bụla. ④ Ka ị zụta ọtụtụ, uru na-abawanye.
l-m-h3-b0c42-21.s.s1.o.a: ①: Ohere ndị ahụ gbakọtara bụ 1
l-m-h3-b0c42-21.s.s1.o.b: ②: Uru a tụrụ anya bụ 200 won
l-m-h3-b0c42-21.s.s1.o.c: ③: Nkọwa na e nwere uru nkezi 100 won
l-m-h3-b0c42-21.s.s1.o.d: ④: Ka ị zụta ọtụtụ, uru na-abawanye
l-m-h3-b0c42-21.s.s1.r.d: Nke a na-esite na nkọwa ③, ya mere ọ bụghị ebe mbụ o hiere ụzọ.
l-m-h3-b0c42-21.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na 300 won a kwụrụ karịrị 200 won a na-enweta na nkezi, mfu nkezi bụ 100 won n’tiketi. Na ③, e gbanwere uru na mfu.
l-m-h3-b0c42-21.s.s2.model.0: A na-enweta 200 won na nkezi ma kwụọ 300 won, ya mere mfu nkezi bụ 100 won; ③ kpọrọ ya uru, ebe ahụ ka o hiere ụzọ.
l-m-h3-b0c42-21.s.s2.model.1: ② ziri ezi, ma na ③ a kpọrọ ịkwụ karịa ego a na-enweta na nkezi uru, nke na-ezighi ezi; ④ sikwa na ya pụta.

l-m-h3-b0c42-27.goal: Soro usoro site na nsonaazụ ntụgharị mkpụrụ ego ruo ná nkwubi okwu na ọ dịghị mma, chọta ebe mbụ o hiere ụzọ ma mezie ya.
l-m-h3-b0c42-27.material: A tụgharịrị mkpụrụ ego ugboro 20, isi pụta ugboro 12. ① Ọ bụrụ na ọ ziri ezi, isi na-apụta ugboro 10 na nkezi. ② 12 dị iche na 10. ③ Ya mere mkpụrụ ego a adịghị ziri ezi. ④ Mkpụrụ ego a na-eme ka isi pụta mfe karị.

l-m-h3-b0c43-05.goal: Soro usoro ngwọta (ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta) site na azịza nyocha ozi-e e weghachiri ruo na nkwubi okwu, chọta ebe mbụ o mehiere ma dozie ya.
l-m-h3-b0c43-05.material: Nke a bụ ngwọta nyocha ozi-e. ① E zigara ndị bi 1000 ajụjụ. ② E weghachiri 200 (response rate 20%). ③ 80% nke nyocha e weghachiri kwadoro. ④ Ya mere 80% nke ndị bi niile kwadoro.

l-m-h3-b0c43-05.s.s1.r.a: Ọ na-akọwa usoro nyocha, ya mere ezighị ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c43-05.s.s1.r.b: Ọ na-ekwu ọnụọgụ e weghachiri, ya mere ọ ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c43-05.s.s1.o.c: ③: 80% nke nyocha e weghachiri kwadoro
l-m-h3-b0c43-05.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụ oke n’etiti naanị nyocha e weghachiri, ya mere ọ ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c43-05.s.s1.o.d: ④: 80% nke ndị bi niile kwadoro

l-m-h3-b0c43-10.title: Ebee ka ngwọta gbasara median mehiere?
l-m-h3-b0c43-10.goal: Soro usoro ngwọta (ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ) maka median nke data 5, chọta ebe mbụ o mehiere ma dozie ya.
l-m-h3-b0c43-10.material: Nke a bụ ngwọta maka data 9, 3, 12, 5, 8. ① E nwere ụkpụrụ data 5. ② Uru etiti, nke 3, bụ 12. ③ Median bụ 12. ④ Mean bụ 7.4, ya mere median karịrị mean.
l-m-h3-b0c43-10.s.s1.r.a: Ịgụta na-enye 5, ya mere ọ ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c43-10.s.s1.o.b: ②: Ebe ahọpụtara uru nke 3 dịka 12
l-m-h3-b0c43-10.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụ nsonaazụ iji 12 nke dị na ② dịka ọ dị, ya mere ọ bụghị ebe njehie mbụ mere.
l-m-h3-b0c43-10.s.s1.r.d: 37÷5=7.4, ya mere a gbakọrọ mean nke ọma.
l-m-h3-b0c43-10.s.s1.explain: Hazie nọmba site na nke kacha nta ruo nke kacha ukwuu: 3, 5, 8, 9, 12. Nke dị n’etiti bụ 8, ya mere median bụ 8.
l-m-h3-b0c43-10.s.s2.model.0: ② ezighị ezi n’ihi na a họọrọ uru nke 3 n’usoro e nyere dịka etiti n’enweghị ịhazi. Mgbe e haziri, ọ bụ 3, 5, 8, 9, 12, nke etiti bụ 8.
l-m-h3-b0c43-10.s.s2.model.1: Median bụ uru etiti mgbe e haziri nọmba n’usoro nha, ya mere njehie mere na ②, ebe a hazighị ha.

l-m-h3-b0c43-14.title: Nchịkọta regression line: ebee ka o mehiere?
l-m-h3-b0c43-14.goal: Soro usoro nkọwa regression line nke mmefu mgbasa ozi na ire, chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ o mehiere.
l-m-h3-b0c43-14.material: Nke a bụ nkọwa regression line y=50+3x (x bụ mmefu mgbasa ozi, y bụ ire, na iri puku won). ① Mgbe x rịrị 1, y e buru amụma na-arị 3. ② Amụma y maka x=40 bụ 170. ③ Ọ bụrụ na mmefu mgbasa ozi bụ 40, ire bụ kpọmkwem 170. ④ Ọ bụrụ na mmefu mgbasa ozi abawanye, ire na-arị mgbe niile.
l-m-h3-b0c43-14.s.s1.o.a: ①: Mgbe ọ rịrị 1, y e buru amụma na-arị 3
l-m-h3-b0c43-14.s.s1.r.a: Nke ahụ bụ ihe slope 3 pụtara, ya mere ọ ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c43-14.s.s1.o.d: ④: Ọ bụrụ na ọ bawanye, ire na-arị mgbe niile

l-m-h3-b0c43-30.title: Kedu obodo n'ime ha abụọ ka dị ize ndụ karịa?
l-m-h3-b0c43-30.goal: Soro ihe ngwọta (ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ) nke na-atụnyere obodo abụọ site n'ọnụọgụ mpụ, site n'otu nzọụkwụ gaa n'ọzọ, wee chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ njehie mere.
l-m-h3-b0c43-30.material: Nke a bụ ngwọta na-atụnyere mpụ n'obodo abụọ. ① Obodo A nwere ikpe 300, Obodo B nwekwara ikpe 120. ② Ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị bi bụ mmadụ 100×10,000 n'Obodo A na mmadụ 20×10,000 n'Obodo B. ③ Obodo A nwere ikpe karịa, ya mere ọ dị ize ndụ karịa Obodo B. ④ Ya mere, a ga-agbakwunye ndị uwe ojii n'Obodo A.
l-m-h3-b0c43-30.s.s1.o.a: ①: Akụkụ jiri ọnụ ọgụgụ mpụ mee ihe
l-m-h3-b0c43-30.s.s1.r.a: E si na data gụọ ọnụ ọgụgụ ikpe ahụ, ya mere ọ ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c43-30.s.s1.o.b: ②: Akụkụ jiri ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị bi mee ihe
l-m-h3-b0c43-30.s.s1.r.b: E sikwa na data gụọ ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị bi, ya mere ọ ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c43-30.s.s1.o.c: ③: Ikpe karịrị, ya mere ọ dị ize ndụ karịa
l-m-h3-b0c43-30.s.s1.o.d: ④: A ga-agbakwunye ndị uwe ojii
l-m-h3-b0c43-30.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ naanị ịga n'ihu na nkwubi okwu ③, ya mere ọ bụghị ebe njehie mbụ mere.
l-m-h3-b0c43-30.s.s1.explain: Mgbe ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị bi dị iche, ị kwesịrị iji ọnụ ọgụgụ ikpe kwa otu 1 nke mmadụ 10000 tụnyere, ọ bụghị ngụkọta ikpe. Ọ bụ ikpe 3 maka Obodo A na ikpe 6 maka Obodo B.
l-m-h3-b0c43-30.s.s2.model.0: ③ ezighị ezi n'ihi na ọ tụnyere naanị ọnụ ọgụgụ ikpe n'agbanyeghị na ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị bi dị iche ugboro 5. Ọnụ ọgụgụ ikpe kwa otu 1 nke mmadụ 10000 bụ 3 maka Obodo A na 6 maka Obodo B.

l-m-h3-b0c44-18.title: Ịkọwa confidence interval: ebee ka o mehiere?
l-m-h3-b0c44-18.goal: Soro ngwọta na-akọwa confidence interval, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, chọta ebe mbụ o mehiere ma dozie ya.
l-m-h3-b0c44-18.material: ① Mean ụra nke ụmụ akwụkwọ 36 bụ awa 7.0. ② Confidence interval 95% maka population mean bụ awa 6.6 ruo 7.4. ③ Ya mere anyị nwere ike ịsị na 95% nke ụmụ akwụkwọ niile n’ụlọ akwụkwọ na-ehi ụra awa 6.6 ruo 7.4. ④ Ya mere ụmụ akwụkwọ na-ehi ụra awa 7.5 dị ụkọ.
l-m-h3-b0c44-18.s.s1.o.a: ① Chọtara sample mean ka ọ bụrụ awa 7.0
l-m-h3-b0c44-18.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụ mean sitere na sample, ya mere nsogbu adịghị.
l-m-h3-b0c44-18.s.s1.o.b: ② Chọtara confidence interval ka ọ bụrụ 6.6 ruo 7.4
l-m-h3-b0c44-18.s.s1.r.b: Interval ahụ dabara dịka atụmatụ population mean.
l-m-h3-b0c44-18.s.s1.o.c: ③ Kọwara ya dịka 95% nke ụmụ akwụkwọ dị n’ime interval ahụ
l-m-h3-b0c44-18.s.s1.o.d: ④ Kwuru na ụmụ akwụkwọ na-ehi ụra awa 7.5 dị ụkọ
l-m-h3-b0c44-18.s.s1.r.d: ④ bụ nkwubi okwu sochiri ③, ya mere ọ bụghị ebe mbụ njehie mere.
l-m-h3-b0c44-18.s.s1.explain: Confidence interval bụ interval maka population mean. Ọ bụghị oke oge nwa akwụkwọ ọ bụla ji ehi ụra.
l-m-h3-b0c44-18.s.s2.model.0: Confidence interval bụ oke na-eme atụmatụ population mean; ya mere ③, nke kwuru na 95% ụmụ akwụkwọ dị n’ime ya, bụ njehie mbụ.
l-m-h3-b0c44-18.s.s2.model.1: ③ ezighị ezi n’ihi na o mere ka oke maka population mean bụrụ oke maka nwa akwụkwọ ọ bụla. E kwesịrị idozi ya ka ọ sị na a na-eme atụmatụ na population mean dị n’ime interval a.

l-m-h3-b0c44-19.title: Kedu ahịrị nke ngwọta p-value mehiere?
l-m-h3-b0c44-19.goal: Soro ngwọta na-akọwa p-value, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, chọta ebe mbụ o mehiere ma dozie ya.
l-m-h3-b0c44-19.material: ① Were ya na fatịlaịza ọhụrụ enweghị mmetụta. ② N’okpuru echiche a, probability nke inweta nsonaazụ dịka nke ugbu a (p-value) bụ 0.03. ③ Ya mere probability na fatịlaịza enweghị mmetụta bụ 3%. ④ Ya mere probability na ọ nwere mmetụta bụ 97%.
l-m-h3-b0c44-19.s.s1.o.a: ① Ewere ya na mmetụta adịghị
l-m-h3-b0c44-19.s.s1.r.a: Ọ ziri ezi na ule na-amalite site n’echiche na mmetụta adịghị.
l-m-h3-b0c44-19.s.s1.o.b: ② Chọtara probability nke nsonaazụ n’okpuru echiche a
l-m-h3-b0c44-19.s.s1.r.b: Nzọụkwụ a kọwara ihe p-value pụtara nke ọma.
l-m-h3-b0c44-19.s.s1.o.c: ③ Kwuru na probability nke enweghị mmetụta bụ 3%
l-m-h3-b0c44-19.s.s1.o.d: ④ Kwuru na probability nke mmetụta bụ 97%
l-m-h3-b0c44-19.s.s1.explain: p-value bụ probability nke inweta ụdị nsonaazụ a mgbe echiche ahụ ziri ezi. Ọ bụghị probability na echiche ahụ ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c44-19.s.s2.model.0: p-value bụ probability nke inweta nsonaazụ ahụ n’okpuru echiche na mmetụta adịghị; ya mere ③, nke kpọrọ ya probability na echiche ahụ ziri ezi, bụ njehie mbụ.

l-m-h3-b0c44-20.title: Na-enyocha ngwọta standard deviation nke akara e chepụtara
l-m-h3-b0c44-20.goal: Soro ngwọta gbasara ọnụọgụ amụma ziri ezi, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, chọta ebe mbụ o mehiere ma dozie ya.
l-m-h3-b0c44-20.material: Chepụta azịza maka ajụjụ 10, nke ọ bụla nwere nhọrọ 5. ① Probability nke azịza ziri ezi n’ajụjụ otu bụ 1/5. ② Ọnụọgụ azịza ziri ezi X na-agbaso B(10, 1/5). ③ Mean bụ 10×1/5=ajụjụ 2. ④ Standard deviation bụ 10×1/5×4/5=ajụjụ 1.6.
l-m-h3-b0c44-20.s.s1.o.a: ① Probability nke azịza ziri ezi bụ 1/5
l-m-h3-b0c44-20.s.s1.r.a: N’ajụjụ nwere nhọrọ 5, naanị otu ziri ezi, ya mere 1/5 dabara.
l-m-h3-b0c44-20.s.s1.r.b: Ndị a bụ nnwale nọọrọ onwe ha 10, ya mere binomial distribution dabara.
l-m-h3-b0c44-20.s.s2.model.0: 1.6 bụ uru variance npq, ya mere standard deviation bụ square root ya, ihe dịka 1.26; nke a mere ④ ezighị ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c44-20.s.s2.model.1: ④ kpọrọ npq standard deviation, ma npq bụ variance; a ga-edozi ya ka ọ bụrụ √1.6≈1.26.

l-m-h3-b0c44-21.material: Ụmụ akwụkwọ 20 nke Klas A nwere mean 70, ụmụ akwụkwọ 30 nke Klas B nwere mean 80. ① Mean klas abụọ bụ 70 na 80. ② Overall mean bụ mean nke mean abụọ ahụ. ③ (70+80)÷2=75. ④ Overall mean bụ 75.

l-m-h3-b0c46-18.title: N’ọrụ ịtụgharị 13 gaa binary, ebee ka o mehiere?
l-m-h3-b0c46-18.goal: Soro nzọụkwụ ọrụ na-ede 13 na binary, chọta ebe mbụ o mehiere ma dozie ya.
l-m-h3-b0c46-18.material: Tụgharịa 13 gaa binary. ①13÷2=6 remainder 1 ②6÷2=3 remainder 0 ③3÷2=1 remainder 1 ④1÷2=0 remainder 1 ⑤Gụọ remainder site n’elu dee 1011₂.
l-m-h3-b0c46-18.s.s1.r.a: 13=2×6+1, ya mere ngụkọta a ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c46-18.s.s1.r.b: 6=2×3+0 na 3=2×1+1, ya mere ngụkọta ndị a ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c46-18.s.s1.r.c: 1=2×0+1, ya mere ngụkọta a ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c46-18.s.s1.explain: A na-agụ remainder site n’ala ruo n’elu. 1101₂=8+4+1=13, 1011₂ bụkwa 8+2+1=11.
l-m-h3-b0c46-18.s.s2.model.0: Remainder ikpeazụ bụ ebe uru kacha elu, ya mere site n’ala ruo n’elu ọ ga-abụ 1101₂.
l-m-h3-b0c46-18.s.s2.model.1: 1011₂ a gụrụ site n’elu bụ 8+2+1=11, ọ bụghị 13; 1101₂ bụ 8+4+1=13, ya mere ⑤ ezighị ezi.

l-m-h3-b0c46-19.title: Ihe akaebe na 1=2: ebee ka o mehiere?
l-m-h3-b0c46-19.goal: Were a=b. Soro usoro na-amalite na a=b ma na-egosi 2=1, chọta ebe mbụ o mehiere ma dozie ya.
l-m-h3-b0c46-19.material: Were a=b. ①a²=ab ②a²−b²=ab−b² ③(a+b)(a−b)=b(a−b) ④Kewaa akụkụ abụọ na (a−b) iji nweta a+b=b ⑤Ebe a=b, 2b=b, ya mere 2=1.
l-m-h3-b0c46-19.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ equation ziri ezi e nwetara site n’ịmụba akụkụ abụọ na a.
l-m-h3-b0c46-19.s.s1.r.b: Nke a bụ equation ziri ezi e nwetara site n’iwepụ otu b² n’akụkụ abụọ.
l-m-h3-b0c46-19.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ equation ziri ezi e nwetara site n’ịwepụ common factor n’akụkụ abụọ.
l-m-h3-b0c46-19.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na a=b, mgbe ahụ a−b=0, ya mere ④ na-ekewa site na 0. A kọwaghị ikewa site na 0.
l-m-h3-b0c46-19.s.s2.model.0: Ebe a=b, a−b=0; ma na ④ e kewara akụkụ abụọ na 0, ya mere ọ dị njọ.
l-m-h3-b0c46-19.s.s2.model.1: Ịkewa site na 0 na-enye nsonaazụ a na-apụghị ikpebi, ya mere a+b=b mgbe ④ gasịrị enweghị ntọala, 2=1 adịghịkwa eziokwu.

l-m-h3-b0c46-20.goal: Soro usoro na-achọta nọmba nke fọdụrụ 2 mgbe e kewara na 3, 3 mgbe e kewara na 5, 2 mgbe e kewara na 7, chọta ebe mbụ o mehiere ma dozie ya.
l-m-h3-b0c46-20.material: Soro ọrụ sitere na Sunzi Suanjing. ①Obere nọmba nke fọdụrụ 2 mgbe e kewara na 3, 3 mgbe e kewara na 5 bụ 8 ②Nọmba ndị dị otu a na-abawanye 3+5=8 oge ọ bụla: 8, 16, 24… ③N’etiti ha, nọmba fọdụrụ 2 mgbe e kewara na 7 bụ 16 ④Azịza bụ 16.
l-m-h3-b0c46-20.s.s1.r.a: 8÷3 na-ahapụ remainder 2, 8÷5 na-ahapụ remainder 3, ya mere ọ ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c46-20.s.s1.o.c: ③ Nọmba fọdụrụ 2 mgbe e kewara na 7 bụ 16
l-m-h3-b0c46-20.s.s1.r.c: Remainder 2 nke 16÷7 ziri ezi, ma 16 sitere na listi na-ezighị ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c46-20.s.s1.r.d: Remainder nke 16÷3 bụ 1. Ihe kpatara ya bụ ②.
l-m-h3-b0c46-20.s.s1.explain: Oghere n’etiti common multiples nke 3 na 5 bụ least common multiple, 15. N’etiti 8, 23, 38, …, nọmba fọdụrụ 2 mgbe e kewara na 7 bụ 23.
l-m-h3-b0c46-20.s.s2.model.0: Oghere ebe remainder nke ikewa na 3 na 5 na-emegharị bụ least common multiple 15; ya mere ọ ga-abawanye 15, ọ bụghị 8.
l-m-h3-b0c46-20.s.s2.model.1: N’etiti 8, 23, 38…, nọmba mbụ fọdụrụ 2 mgbe e kewara na 7 bụ 23; ya mere azịza bụ 23, ọ bụghị 16.

l-m-h3-b0c46-21.title: Ngụkọta compound interest: ebee ka o mehiere?
l-m-h3-b0c46-21.goal: Soro usoro ngụkọta maka itinye 1,000,000 won (100 ×10,000 won) afọ 2 na compound interest 10% kwa afọ, chọta ebe mbụ o mehiere ma dozie ya.
l-m-h3-b0c46-21.material: Ị tinyere 1,000,000 won (100 n’otu 10,000 won) na compound interest 10% kwa afọ ruo afọ 2. ①Mgbe afọ 1: 100×1.1=110 (×10,000 won) ②Mmasị afọ 2 bụ 10% nke 100, ya bụ 10 (×10,000 won) ③Mgbe afọ 2: 110+10=120 (×10,000 won).
l-m-h3-b0c46-21.s.s1.o.b: ② Ịchọta mmasị afọ 2 dịka 10 (×10,000 won)
l-m-h3-b0c46-21.s.s1.r.c: Ịgbakwunye ziri ezi, ma a chọtara mmasị ahụ n’ụzọ na-ezighị ezi na mbụ.
l-m-h3-b0c46-21.s.s1.o.d: ①~③ ziri ezi niile, naanị nsonaazụ ezighị ezi
l-m-h3-b0c46-21.s.s1.r.d: Mgbe e nyochara nzọụkwụ ọ bụla, ọ dịlarị njọ na ②.
l-m-h3-b0c46-21.s.s1.explain: Na compound interest, a na-enwetakwa mmasị n’elu mmasị. Mmasị afọ 2 bụ 10% nke 110 (×10,000 won), ya bụ 11 (×10,000 won), ngụkọta bụkwa 121 (×10,000 won).
l-m-h3-b0c46-21.s.s2.model.0: Na compound interest, a na-agbakwunye mmasị na isi ego tinyere mmasị mgbe afọ 1, 110 (×10,000 won); ya mere mmasị na ② kwesịrị ịbụ 11 (×10,000 won).
l-m-h3-b0c46-21.s.s2.model.1: Ịgbakọ mmasị naanị na 100 (×10,000 won) bụ simple interest; compound interest bụ 110×1.1=121 (×10,000 won).

l-m-h3-b0c46-22.goal: Soro usoro ịchọta ezigbo anya maka 4cm n’elu map scale 1:50,000, chọta ebe mbụ o mehiere ma dozie ya.
l-m-h3-b0c46-22.material: Na map scale 1:50,000, ebe abụọ dị 4cm n’otu n’otu. ①4×50,000=200,000cm ②Ebe 1m=100cm, 200,000÷100=2,000m ③Ebe 1km=100m, 2,000÷100=20km.
l-m-h3-b0c46-22.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ ngụkọta ziri ezi nke na-amụba site na denominator nke scale.
l-m-h3-b0c46-22.s.s1.r.b: Nke a bụ ngụkọta ziri ezi na-atụgharị cm gaa m.
l-m-h3-b0c46-22.s.s1.r.d: Azịza ezighị ezi n’ihi ntụgharị nkeji na ③.
l-m-h3-b0c46-22.s.s1.explain: 1km=1,000m. 2,000m bụ 2km, ya mere ezigbo anya bụ 2km.
l-m-h3-b0c46-22.s.s2.model.0: 1km bụ 1,000m, ọ bụghị 100m; ya mere a ga-edozi ya ka 2,000÷1,000=2km.
l-m-h3-b0c46-22.s.s2.model.1: Ntụgharị nkeji na ③ ezighị ezi; 2,000m bụ 2km, ya mere 20km toro oke.

l-m-h3-b0c47-18.goal: Soro ihe ngwọta nke na-achọta nkewa ọnụ kacha ukwuu nke 252 na 105 site na usoro Euclid, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu; chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ mehiere.
l-m-h3-b0c47-18.material: Nke a bụ ihe ngwọta na-achọta nkewa ọnụ kacha ukwuu nke 252 na 105. ① 252 = 105×2 + 42 ② 105 = 42×3 + 21 ③ 42 = 21×2 + 0 ④ Nkewa 21, nke dị tupu ihe fọdụrụ aghọọ 0, bụ nkewa ọnụ kacha ukwuu.
l-m-h3-b0c47-18.s.s1.o.d: ④ Nkewa ọnụ kacha ukwuu bụ 21
l-m-h3-b0c47-18.s.s1.r.d: Nkwubi okwu ahụ ziri ezi. 252 na 105 bụ ọtụtụ nke 21.
l-m-h3-b0c47-18.s.s1.explain: 42×3+21=147, nke na-abụghị 105. 105 = 42×2 + 21 ziri ezi. Azịza ikpeazụ, 21, ka bụ eziokwu.
l-m-h3-b0c47-18.s.s2.model.0: 42×3+21=147 enyeghị 105, ya mere ② bụ ebe mbụ mehiere. A ga-edozi ya ka ọ bụrụ 105 = 42×2 + 21.
l-m-h3-b0c47-18.s.s2.model.1: Ịmụba 42 na 3 na-enye 126, ya mere ihe fọdụrụ na 105 agaghị abụ 21. 84, nke bụ 42 a mụbara na 2, gbakwunyere 21 na-eme 105, ya mere a ga-edozi ②.
