l-m-h3-b0c47-19.title: Iji eriri nwere akpụ mee akụkụ ziri ezi: ebee ka ihe ngwọta ahụ mehiere?
l-m-h3-b0c47-19.topic: Echiche Pythagoras na ime akụkụ ziri ezi
l-m-h3-b0c47-19.goal: Soro ihe ngwọta nke na-eji eriri nwere akpụ eme triangle akụkụ ziri ezi, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu; chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ mehiere.
l-m-h3-b0c47-19.material: E nwere ụzọ isi jiri eriri e kewara n'akụkụ 12 site na akpụ mee akụkụ ziri ezi. ① Mee akụkụ atọ nwere ogologo 3, 4, na 5 ② 3+4+5=12, ya mere e ji eriri niile ③ 3²+4²=25=5², ya mere ọ bụ triangle akụkụ ziri ezi ④ Akụkụ ziri ezi dị n'etiti akụkụ ogologo 3 na 5.
l-m-h3-b0c47-19.s.s1.o.a: ① Akụkụ atọ nke ngalaba 3, 4, na 5
l-m-h3-b0c47-19.s.s1.r.a: Enwere ike ikewa eriri ngalaba 12 ka ọ bụrụ 3, 4, na 5.
l-m-h3-b0c47-19.s.s1.r.b: 3+4+5=12, ya mere ọ na-eme kpọmkwem otu eriri gburugburu.
l-m-h3-b0c47-19.s.s1.o.d: ④ Akụkụ ziri ezi dị n'etiti akụkụ 3 na 5
l-m-h3-b0c47-19.s.s1.explain: Akụkụ ziri ezi dị n'ihu akụkụ kachasị ogologo, 5. Ya bụ, ọ dị n'etiti akụkụ ogologo 3 na akụkụ ogologo 4.
l-m-h3-b0c47-19.s.s2.model.0: Site na 5²=3²+4², akụkụ ziri ezi dị n'ihu akụkụ kachasị ogologo, 5; ya mere akụkụ ziri ezi ga-adị n'etiti akụkụ 3 na 4.
l-m-h3-b0c47-19.s.s2.model.1: Akụkụ ziri ezi dị n'etiti akụkụ abụọ dị mkpụmkpụ, ya mere a ga-edozi ④ ka ọ bụrụ n'etiti 3 na 4.

l-m-h3-b0c47-20.title: Ịchọta oke ọla edo: kedu ahịrị bụ njehie mbụ?
l-m-h3-b0c47-20.topic: Nhazi quadratic maka oke ọla edo
l-m-h3-b0c47-20.goal: Soro ihe ngwọta na-achọta oke ọla edo, ebe akụkụ ogologo ji okpukpu 1.618, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu; chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ mehiere.
l-m-h3-b0c47-20.material: Ọ bụrụ na akụkụ anọ nwere akụkụ ogologo x na akụkụ dị mkpụmkpụ 1 nwere oke ọla edo, mgbe ahụ x:1=(x+1):x. ① x² = x+1 ② x²−x−1=0 ③ x=(1±√5)/2 ④ Ebe ogologo dị mma, x=(1−√5)/2.
l-m-h3-b0c47-20.s.s1.r.a: N'ime oke, ngwaahịa okwu dị n'ime hà nhata ngwaahịa okwu dị n'èzí, ya mere ọ ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c47-20.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụ nhata x²=x+1 mgbe ebugara ihe niile n'otu akụkụ, ya mere ọ ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c47-20.s.s1.r.c: Itinye a=1, b=−1, c=−1 n'ime usoro quadratic ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c47-20.s.s1.explain: (1−√5)/2 bụ ihe dị ka −0.618, ọnụọgụ na-adịghị mma. Ogologo ahụ bụ nke dị mma, (1+√5)/2≈1.618.
l-m-h3-b0c47-20.s.s2.model.0: √5≈2.236, ya mere (1−√5)/2 bụ ihe dị ka −0.618, ọnụọgụ na-adịghị mma, ọ pụghịkwa ịbụ ogologo. Dozie ya ka ọ bụrụ (1+√5)/2.
l-m-h3-b0c47-20.s.s2.model.1: Ogologo dị mma, ya mere ị ga-ahọrọ mgbọrọgwụ ka ukwuu n'ime abụọ ahụ, (1+√5)/2≈1.618; mana ④ họọrọ nke nta.

l-m-h3-b0c47-21.title: Ohere osisi Yut: kedu ahịrị mehiere?
l-m-h3-b0c47-21.goal: Soro ihe ngwọta nke na-achọta ohere na kpọmkwem osisi Yut 1 gosiri akụkụ dị larịị, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu; chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ mehiere.
l-m-h3-b0c47-21.material: Mgbe a tụbara osisi Yut 4, a na-ekwu na ohere osisi ọ bụla igosi akụkụ dị larịị ma ọ bụ gbaa gburugburu hà nhata. ① Osisi ọ bụla nwere nsonaazụ 2, ya mere ngụkọta bụ 2⁴=16 ② Ọnọdụ nwere akụkụ dị larịị 2 dị 6 ③ Ọnọdụ nwere akụkụ dị larịị 1 dị 1 ④ Ohere bụ 1/16.
l-m-h3-b0c47-21.s.s1.r.a: Osisi 4 nke ọ bụla nwere nsonaazụ 2, ya mere 2⁴=16 ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c47-21.s.s1.r.b: E nwere ụzọ 6 isi họrọ 2 n'ime 4, ya mere ọ ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c47-21.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ nsonaazụ ikewa uru 1 dị na ③ na 16. Njehie ahụ malitere tupu nke ahụ.
l-m-h3-b0c47-21.s.s1.explain: E nwere ụzọ 4 ịhọrọ osisi ga-adị larịị, ya mere ọnọdụ nwere akụkụ dị larịị 1 nwere ụzọ 4, ohere ya bụ 4/16=1/4.
l-m-h3-b0c47-21.s.s2.model.0: Ọ dabere n'ime osisi 4 nke gosiri akụkụ dị larịị; ya mere ụzọ 4 dị, a ga-edozikwa ③ ka ọ bụrụ ụzọ 4.
l-m-h3-b0c47-21.s.s2.model.1: Ịgụ naanị ụzọ 1 na ③ bụ njehie mbụ, nke na-eme ka ohere ahụ bụrụ 4/16=1/4; ④ soro nsonaazụ ahụ naanị.

l-m-h3-b0c48-18.title: Ụfụfụ ka ukwuu ọ̀ pụtara ike ihicha ka mma?
l-m-h3-b0c48-18.goal: Soro ọrụ ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ n'ime nkwubi okwu nyocha ụfụfụ na ike ihicha, chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ o mehiere.
l-m-h3-b0c48-18.material: A tụrụ ịdị elu ụfụfụ na ọnụego iwepụ ntụpọ nke ụdị ncha 5; ka ụfụfụ na-arị elu, ọnụego iwepụkwa na-arị elu (ọnụọgụ njikọ 0.9). Nwa akwụkwọ kwubiri, “Ụfụfụ na-ewepụ unyi.”
l-m-h3-b0c48-18.s.s1.prompt: Ebee ka ọrụ ahụ buru ụzọ mebie?
l-m-h3-b0c48-18.s.s1.o.a: A tụrụ ịdị elu ụfụfụ nke ụdị ncha 5
l-m-h3-b0c48-18.s.s1.r.a: Ịtụ ihe n'onwe ya adịghị njọ.
l-m-h3-b0c48-18.s.s1.o.b: A gụrụ na ịdị elu ụfụfụ na ọnụego iwepụ na-abawanye ọnụ
l-m-h3-b0c48-18.s.s1.r.b: A gụrụ usoro dị na data dịka ọ dị, ya mere ọ dịghị ihe mehiere.
l-m-h3-b0c48-18.s.s1.o.c: E kwubiri na ụfụfụ bụ ihe na-akpata iwepụ unyi
l-m-h3-b0c48-18.s.s1.o.d: A tụrụ aro ka e jiri ncha ndị ọzọ nyochaa kwa
l-m-h3-b0c48-18.s.s1.r.d: Nnyocha ọzọ bụ omume ziri ezi nke na-emeghị mmehie.
l-m-h3-b0c48-18.s.s1.explain: Ịbawanye ọnụ abụghị ihe akaebe na otu bụ ihe kpatara nke ọzọ. Ngwakọta ncha nwere ike ibuli ha abụọ.
l-m-h3-b0c48-18.s.s2.model.0: Njikọ naanị ya enweghị ike ịgwa ihe kpatara ya, mana e kwuru na ụfụfụ bụ ihe kpatara ya; ya mere ahịrị a bụ ebe mmejọ dị.
l-m-h3-b0c48-18.s.s2.model.1: Ngwakọta ncha nwere ike ịbawanye ụfụfụ na ọnụego iwepụ abụọ ahụ, ya mere nkwubi okwu ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ ahụ dị ngwa ngwa.

l-m-h3-b0c48-19.title: Kedu ntụpọ dị n'ihe ngwọta na-enweta 2=1 site na a=b?
l-m-h3-b0c48-19.goal: Soro nzọụkwụ nke ihe ngwọta na-egosi 2=1, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ; chọta ebe mbụ o mehiere ma dozie ya.
l-m-h3-b0c48-19.material: Ka a=b ma mụbaa akụkụ abụọ na a iji nweta a²=ab. Wepụ b² n'akụkụ abụọ iji nweta a²−b²=ab−b². Ime factor na-enye (a+b)(a−b)=b(a−b). Ikewa akụkụ abụọ na (a−b) na-enye a+b=b, ya bụ 2b=b, ya mere 2=1.
l-m-h3-b0c48-19.s.s1.o.a: Mụbaa akụkụ abụọ na a iji nweta a²=ab
l-m-h3-b0c48-19.s.s1.r.a: Ịmụba akụkụ abụọ na otu ọnụọgụ ahụ dị mma.
l-m-h3-b0c48-19.s.s1.o.b: Wepụ b² n'akụkụ abụọ iji nweta a²−b²=ab−b²
l-m-h3-b0c48-19.s.s1.r.b: Iwepụ otu ọnụọgụ n'akụkụ abụọ dị mma.
l-m-h3-b0c48-19.s.s1.o.c: Kewaa akụkụ abụọ na (a−b) iji nweta a+b=b
l-m-h3-b0c48-19.s.s1.o.d: Dochie a=b n'ime a+b=b iji nweta 2b=b
l-m-h3-b0c48-19.s.s1.r.d: Ngụkọta e dochiri a=b ziri ezi. Nsogbu dị n'ahịrị gara aga.
l-m-h3-b0c48-19.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na a=b, mgbe ahụ a−b=0, ya mere nke a na-ekewa na 0. A naghị ekwe ka e kee na 0.
l-m-h3-b0c48-19.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na a=b, a−b=0, ya mere ikewa akụkụ abụọ na (a−b) pụtara ikewa na 0, nke ezighị ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c48-19.s.s2.model.1: Ikewa na 0 agaghị ekwe omume, ya mere ihe ngwọta ahụ buru ụzọ mehie n'ikewa a, 2=1 sochiri ya bụ nsonaazụ njehie ahụ.

l-m-h3-b0c48-20.title: Ruo ókè ole ka anyị nwere ike ịtụkwasị ụdị spring obi?
l-m-h3-b0c48-20.goal: Soro nzọụkwụ ihe ngwọta na-atụ ogologo spring, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ; chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ o mehiere.
l-m-h3-b0c48-20.material: A kwụnyere ibu 0, 100, 200, 300g n'otu spring, ogologo ya bụ 10, 14, 18, 22cm. Ngwọta: ọ na-agbatị 4cm maka 100g ọ bụla, ya mere y=0.04x+10. Maka 250g ọ bụ 20cm. Maka 2000g ọ bụ 90cm.
l-m-h3-b0c48-20.s.s1.o.a: A gụrụ na ọ na-agbatị 4cm kwa 100g
l-m-h3-b0c48-20.s.s1.r.a: Ị gụrụ mmụba kwụ ọtọ dị na data nke ọma.
l-m-h3-b0c48-20.s.s1.r.b: Nhata ahụ dabara na nha anọ niile.
l-m-h3-b0c48-20.s.s1.r.c: Nke a dị n'ime oke a tụrụ, ya mere enwere ike ịtụkwasị amụma ahụ obi.
l-m-h3-b0c48-20.s.s1.o.d: E buru amụma 90cm maka 2000g n'ihi na ọ bụkwa ahịrị kwụ ọtọ
l-m-h3-b0c48-20.s.s1.explain: Ị leleghị ma nhata ahụ ka na-arụ ọrụ n'èzí 0~300g a tụrụ. Spring na-agbanwe ọdịdị mgbe ọ gafere oke ya.
l-m-h3-b0c48-20.s.s2.model.0: Oke a tụrụ bụ naanị 0~300g, mana e chere na otu nhata ahụ ga-aga n'ihu ruo 2000g, ya mere ọ mehiere.
l-m-h3-b0c48-20.s.s2.model.1: Spring buru ibu ibu nwere ike ịgbatị n'ụzọ dị iche, ya mere a ga-enyocha amụma n'èzí oke a tụrụ.

l-m-h3-b0c48-21.title: Ọ bụrụ na ọnụahịa arịgo 20% wee daa 20%, ọ laghachiri ebe ọ malitere?
l-m-h3-b0c48-21.goal: Soro nzọụkwụ ngwọta na-ejikọta mgbanwe ọnụahịa, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ; chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ o mehiere.
l-m-h3-b0c48-21.material: Ngwọta: Ka ọnụahịa mbụ bụrụ 100 won. Ọ rịgooro 20% ruo 120 won. Ugbu a ọ daa 20%, ya mere ọ dara 20 won. 120−20=100 won, nke hà nhata ọnụahịa mbụ.
l-m-h3-b0c48-21.s.s1.r.a: 20% nke 100 bụ 20, ya mere 120 won ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c48-21.s.s1.r.b: Mwepụ ahụ ziri ezi, mana 20 won dị n'ahịrị gara aga ezighị ezi ugbua.
l-m-h3-b0c48-21.s.s1.o.c: Debe ọnụahịa mbụ ka ọ bụrụ 100 won
l-m-h3-b0c48-21.s.s1.r.c: Iji 100 dịka ntọala n'ajụjụ oke dị mma.
l-m-h3-b0c48-21.s.s1.explain: 20% maka ọdịda bụ 20% nke 120 won, nke bụ 24 won. 120−24=96 won, ya mere ọ dị ọnụ ala karịa na mmalite.
l-m-h3-b0c48-21.s.s2.model.0: Maka ọdịda, ntọala bụ ọnụahịa ebuliri elu nke 120 won, ya mere 20% bụ 24 won, nsonaazụ bụ 96 won.
l-m-h3-b0c48-21.s.s2.model.1: Nsogbu bụ na e jiri 20 won, 20% nke 100 won, mee ihe dịka ọ dị. Ntọala na-agbanwe, ya mere otu 20% ahụ na-enye ego dị iche.

l-m-h3-b0c48-22.title: Iwu ahụ rụrụ ọrụ ruo isi 5. Ọ ga-arụkwa ọrụ maka 6?
l-m-h3-b0c48-22.goal: Soro nzọụkwụ ngwọta gbasara ọnụ ọgụgụ mpaghara e mepụtara site n'isi dị n'okirikiri, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ; chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ o mehiere.
l-m-h3-b0c48-22.material: Debe isi n n'okirikiri, jikọọkwa ụzọ isi abụọ ọ bụla site n'ahịrị. Ọnụọgụ mpaghara maka n=1~5 bụ 1, 2, 4, 8, 16. Nwa akwụkwọ mere iwu “a na-amụba ya na 2 oge ọ bụla” wee kwuo na n=6 na-enye 32.
l-m-h3-b0c48-22.s.s1.o.a: O kwuru na n=6 na-enye 32 n'enweghị nyocha
l-m-h3-b0c48-22.s.s1.r.b: Ịchịkọta ihe atụ site n'ịgụ ha ozugbo bụ mmalite dị mma.
l-m-h3-b0c48-22.s.s1.r.c: Ọnụọgụ mpaghara maka n=5, 16, gụrụ ya nke ọma.
l-m-h3-b0c48-22.s.s1.o.d: Ọ chepụtara na a na-amụba ya na 2 oge ọ bụla
l-m-h3-b0c48-22.s.s1.r.d: Ime amụma abụghị nsogbu. Naanị ihe bụ na a ga-enyocha ya.
l-m-h3-b0c48-22.s.s1.explain: Amụma sitere n’ọnọdụ 5 nwere ike ịgha ụgha na nke 6. Ọ bụrụ na ị gụọ n=6 ozugbo, ọ bụ 31.
l-m-h3-b0c48-22.s.s2.model.0: O kwuru site naanị n’ọnọdụ 5 na iwu ahụ dabara maka n niile; n’ezie n=6 na-enye 31, ya mere o mehiere.
l-m-h3-b0c48-22.s.s2.model.1: Iwu bụ amụma, ya mere a ga-enyocha ya na ọnọdụ ọhụrụ. Nsogbu bụ ikwu 32 n’enweghị nyocha.

l-m-h3-b0c49-19.title: Kedu usoro ngụkọta chefuru otu azịza na x(x−2)=3x?
l-m-h3-b0c49-19.goal: Soro usoro ngụkọta x(x−2)=3x, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara nsonaazụ, chọta ebe mbụ o hiere ụzọ ma mezie ya.
l-m-h3-b0c49-19.material: Ngụkọta: x(x−2)=3x. Kee akụkụ abụọ ahụ na x iji nweta x−2=3, ya mere x=5. Ma itinye x=0 na-emekwa ka akụkụ abụọ ahụ bụrụ 0.
l-m-h3-b0c49-19.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ahịrị mere ka e chefuo otu azịza?
l-m-h3-b0c49-19.s.s1.r.a: Nha nhata mmalite bụ kpọmkwem ọnọdụ nsogbu ahụ.
l-m-h3-b0c49-19.s.s1.o.b: Kewaa akụkụ abụọ ahụ na x iji nweta x−2=3.
l-m-h3-b0c49-19.s.s1.r.d: Ide azịza na-esochi nsonaazụ ahịrị gara aga.
l-m-h3-b0c49-19.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na ị kee nha nhata na x ebe x nwere ike ịbụ 0, azịza x=0 ga-apụ. Bugharịa okwu n’otu akụkụ dozie x(x−5)=0, nweta 0 ma ọ bụ 5.
l-m-h3-b0c49-19.s.s2.model.0: x=0 bụkwa azịza; ikewa akụkụ abụọ na x wepụrụ ikpe x=0, ya mere ahịrị a hiere ụzọ.
l-m-h3-b0c49-19.s.s2.model.1: Ikewa ihe nwere ike ịbụ 0 na-eme ka azịza pụọ; bugharịa okwu n’otu akụkụ dozie x(x−5)=0.

l-m-h3-b0c49-20.title: Gịnị ga-esote mgbe isi pụtara ugboro 5 n’usoro?
l-m-h3-b0c49-20.goal: Soro usoro ngwọta ma ọ bụ ihe kpatara ya gbasara nsonaazụ mkpụrụ ego na nke na-esote, chọta ebe mbụ o hiere ụzọ ma mezie ya.
l-m-h3-b0c49-20.material: Ngwọta: Mkpụrụ ego ziri ezi, ya mere ohere isi bụ 1/2. Isi apụtala ugboro 5 n’usoro. Iji mee ka ihe guzozie, ọdụ ga-apụta karịa. Ya mere ohere ọdụ na-esote karịrị 1/2.
l-m-h3-b0c49-20.s.s1.o.a: Nchịkọta na isi pụtara ugboro 5 n’usoro
l-m-h3-b0c49-20.s.s1.r.a: O dekọrọ naanị eziokwu a hụrụ, ya mere mmejọ adịghị ebe a.
l-m-h3-b0c49-20.s.s1.o.b: Tọọ ohere isi ka ọ bụrụ 1/2
l-m-h3-b0c49-20.s.s1.r.b: Ịtọ ya 1/2 n’ihi na mkpụrụ ego ziri ezi bụ eziokwu.
l-m-h3-b0c49-20.s.s1.r.c: Nkwubi okwu a sitere na mmejọ ahịrị gara aga; ọ bụghị ebe mmejọ malitere.
l-m-h3-b0c49-20.s.s1.o.d: Sịrị na ọdụ ga-apụta karịa iji mee ka ihe guzozie
l-m-h3-b0c49-20.s.s1.explain: Ntughari nke ọ bụla anaghị emetụta nke ọzọ. Nsonaazụ gara aga anaghị agbanwe ohere nke ọzọ.
l-m-h3-b0c49-20.s.s2.model.0: Mkpụrụ ego anaghị echeta nsonaazụ gara aga; ohere nke na-esote ka bụ 1/2, ya mere echiche imezi ihe bụ ụgha.
l-m-h3-b0c49-20.s.s2.model.1: Ntughari ọ bụla nwere onwe ya; ọ bụrụgodị na isi apụta ọtụtụ, ọdụ agaghị apụta karịa.

l-m-h3-b0c49-21.goal: Soro usoro ngwọta ma ọ bụ ihe kpatara ya gbasara olu sphere mgbe dayameta ghọrọ okpukpu 2, chọta ebe mbụ o hiere ụzọ ma mezie ya.
l-m-h3-b0c49-21.material: Ngwọta: Ọ bụrụ na dayameta aghọọ okpukpu 2, radius aghọkwara okpukpu 2. Olu bụ V=(4/3)πr³, tinye 2r n’ọnọdụ r. (2r)³=2r³. Ya mere a chọrọ ikuku okpukpu 2.
l-m-h3-b0c49-21.s.s1.r.b: Iji radius ọhụrụ tinye n’usoro olu bụ ụzọ ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c49-21.s.s1.o.c: Ọ bụrụ na dayameta aghọọ okpukpu 2, radius aghọkwara okpukpu 2.
l-m-h3-b0c49-21.s.s1.r.c: Dayameta na radius na-agbanwe n’otu oke, ya mere nke a ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c49-21.s.s1.o.d: Kwubiri na a chọrọ ikuku okpukpu 2
l-m-h3-b0c49-21.s.s1.r.d: Nke a na-esochi naanị ngụkọta ahịrị gara aga.
l-m-h3-b0c49-21.s.s1.explain: (2r)³=8r³. Ọ bụrụ na ogologo aghọọ okpukpu 2, olu aghọọ 2³=8 ugboro, ya mere a chọrọ ikuku okpukpu 8.
l-m-h3-b0c49-21.s.s2.model.0: (2r)³=2³·r³=8r³, ya mere olu bụ okpukpu 8, a chọkwara ikuku okpukpu 8.
l-m-h3-b0c49-21.s.s2.model.1: Ike atọ metụtakwara 2; mmejọ bụ ide naanị r³ ma hapụ 2 ka ọ dị.

l-m-h3-b0c49-22.goal: Soro usoro ngwọta ma ọ bụ ihe kpatara ya na akụkọ gbasara mmetụta ịgụ abalị, chọta ebe mbụ o hiere ụzọ ma mezie ya.
l-m-h3-b0c49-22.material: Ngwọta: Echiche bụ “ịgụ abalị na-ebuli akara.” Anyị nyochara mmadụ 10, akara mmadụ 7 rịrị elu. Nkezi nke naanị mmadụ 7 ahụ bụ +8. Ya mere ịgụ abalị na-ebuli akara site na nkezi 8.
l-m-h3-b0c49-22.s.s1.o.a: Tọọ echiche a pụrụ ịnwale: “ịgụ abalị na-ebuli akara.”
l-m-h3-b0c49-22.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụ echiche a pụrụ ịnwale, ya mere mmejọ adịghị.
l-m-h3-b0c49-22.s.s1.o.b: Gụpụtara na mmadụ 7 n’ime mmadụ 10 a nyochara rịrị elu
l-m-h3-b0c49-22.s.s1.r.b: Ọ gụpụtara nsonaazụ nyocha dịka ha dị, ya mere mmejọ adịghị.
l-m-h3-b0c49-22.s.s1.o.c: Họrọ naanị mmadụ 7 akara ha rịrị elu wee gbakọọ nkezi ha
l-m-h3-b0c49-22.s.s1.o.d: Kwubiri na ịgụ abalị na-ebuli akara site na nkezi 8
l-m-h3-b0c49-22.s.s1.r.d: Nkwubi okwu a sitere na nhọrọ na-ezighi ezi dị n’ahịrị gara aga.
l-m-h3-b0c49-22.s.s1.explain: Ịhapụ mmadụ 3 ndị na-arịghị elu na-ebuli nkezi ahụ. A ga-etinye mgbanwe nke mmadụ 10 niile.
l-m-h3-b0c49-22.s.s2.model.0: Ịhapụ mmadụ 3 ndị akara ha dara ma ọ bụ kwụsịrị, gbakọọ naanị ndị rịrị elu, mere ka mmetụta ahụ yie nnukwu.
l-m-h3-b0c49-22.s.s2.model.1: A ga-ewere nkezi mgbanwe mmadụ 10 niile, ma a họọrọ naanị ụfọdụ; ahịrị a hiere ụzọ.

l-m-h3-b0c50-03.title: Njehie na nyocha afọ ojuju nri ehihie ụlọ akwụkwọ
l-m-h3-b0c50-03.goal: Soro usoro nyocha afọ ojuju nri ehihie, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, n’usoro; chọta ebe mbụ o mehiere ma dozie ya.
l-m-h3-b0c50-03.material: Ị chọrọ ịmata afọ ojuju nri ehihie nke ụmụ akwụkwọ niile. 1) Ebumnuche bụ afọ ojuju ụmụ akwụkwọ niile. 2) Nyochaa naanị mmadụ 20 nọ n’ihu ahịrị nri ehihie. 3) Mmadụ 15 nwere afọ ojuju, ya bụ 75%. 4) “75% nke ụmụ akwụkwọ niile nwere afọ ojuju.”
l-m-h3-b0c50-03.s.s1.o.a: Nyocha naanị mmadụ 20 nọ n’ihu ahịrị
l-m-h3-b0c50-03.s.s1.o.b: Ime ka ebumnuche bụrụ ịmata afọ ojuju ụmụ akwụkwọ niile
l-m-h3-b0c50-03.s.s1.r.b: Enweghị nsogbu n’ebumnuche ịmata maka ụmụ akwụkwọ niile.
l-m-h3-b0c50-03.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ nsonaazụ sitere na nsogbu sample e mere na mbụ.
l-m-h3-b0c50-03.s.s1.r.d: 15÷20=0.75, ya mere mgbakọ ahụ ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c50-03.s.s1.explain: Mmadụ 20 mbụ n’ahịrị nri ehihie anaghị anọchite ụmụ akwụkwọ niile. Njehie mbụ bụ nhọrọ sample a.
l-m-h3-b0c50-03.s.s2.model.0: Ụmụ akwụkwọ nọ n’ihu na-enweta nri ngwa ngwa bụ otu ìgwè pụrụ iche; ha anaghị anọchite mmadụ niile, ebe a ka njehie mbụ mere.
l-m-h3-b0c50-03.s.s2.model.1: Mgbakọ 15÷20=75% ziri ezi, ma sample nwere bias; ya mere nkwubi okwu na 75% ụmụ akwụkwọ niile nwere afọ ojuju esoghị na ya.

l-m-h3-b0c50-12.title: Mmejọ n’ịchọta oge mmiri ga-esi
l-m-h3-b0c50-12.topic: Iji ụdị okwu kwụ ọtọ dozie ya
l-m-h3-b0c50-12.goal: Soro usoro ịchọta oge mmiri ga-eru ogo 100, chọta ebe mbụ o hiere ụzọ ma mezie ya.
l-m-h3-b0c50-12.material: Okpomọkụ mmiri na-arị elu ogo 4 kwa nkeji 1 site na ogo 20. Usoro bụ T=20+4t. 100=20+4t. Iwepụ 20 n’akụkụ abụọ na-enye 4t=120. Ya mere t=30 nkeji.
l-m-h3-b0c50-12.s.s1.r.c: Ọ malite na ogo 20, na-ebili ogo 4 kwa nkeji, ya mere usoro ahụ ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c50-12.s.s1.r.d: Ịtinye 100, okpomọkụ esi mmiri, ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c50-12.s.s1.explain: 100-20=80, ya mere 4t=80. 120 bụ uru na-ezighi ezi; mgbe e doziri ya nke ọma, t=20 nkeji.
l-m-h3-b0c50-12.s.s2.model.0: Iwepụ 20 na 100 na-enye 80, ya mere 4t=120 ezighị ezi; nke ziri ezi bụ 4t=80, t=20 nkeji.
l-m-h3-b0c50-12.s.s2.model.1: 120÷4=30 ziri ezi, ma 120 dị n’ihu ya ezighị ezi; mmejọ mbụ bụ iwepụ 20.

l-m-h3-b0c50-16.title: Ọnyà n'ịlele mmetụta usoro ọmụmụ
l-m-h3-b0c50-16.goal: Soro usoro ịlele mmetụta usoro ọmụmụ ọhụrụ nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu, chọta ebe mbụ o mehiere ma dozie ya.
l-m-h3-b0c50-16.material: Ị chọrọ ịlele mmetụta usoro ọmụmụ ọhụrụ. 1) Mmadụ 5 chọrọ iji ya ji usoro ahụ. 2) E jiri ha tụnyere mmadụ 5 ndị ọzọ. 3) Akara nkezi bụ 82 na 76. 4) “Ọ dị elu isi 6, ya mere usoro ọmụmụ ahụ na-arụ ọrụ.”
l-m-h3-b0c50-16.s.s1.r.a: Inweta ọnụọgụ nsonaazụ abụghị nsogbu n'onwe ya.
l-m-h3-b0c50-16.s.s1.o.b: Inwe naanị mmadụ 5 chọrọ iji usoro ọmụmụ ahụ
l-m-h3-b0c50-16.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ nsonaazụ nsogbu nhazi dị na nzọụkwụ gara aga.
l-m-h3-b0c50-16.s.s1.o.d: Ikwu na ọdịiche nkezi abụọ ahụ bụ isi 6
l-m-h3-b0c50-16.s.s1.explain: Ndị wepụtara onwe ha nwere ike inwe mkpali karịa site na mbụ. Ìgwè abụọ ahụ esiteghị n'otu ọnọdụ, ya mere ntụnyere ahụ na-amalite imejọ.
l-m-h3-b0c50-16.s.s2.model.0: Ụmụ akwụkwọ wepụtara onwe ha nwere ike inwe mkpali karịa na mbụ, ya mere ìgwè ndị ahụ dị iche site na mmalite, ebe a ka ntụnyere ahụ mehiere.
l-m-h3-b0c50-16.s.s2.model.1: Ị gaghị ama ma ọdịiche isi 6 sitere na usoro ọmụmụ ka ọ bụ ọdịiche dị n'etiti ụmụ akwụkwọ; ya mere nzọụkwụ ikewa ìgwè bụ nsogbu.

l-m-h3-b0c50-24.title: Ebe ngwọta mgbọrọgwụ square mehiere
l-m-h3-b0c50-24.topic: Mgbọrọgwụ square na uru zuru oke
l-m-h3-b0c50-24.goal: Soro ihe ngwọta, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, nke na-ekwu √(x²)=x; chọta ebe mbụ o mehiere ma dozie ya.
l-m-h3-b0c50-24.material: Ngwọta: Ọ bụrụ na x=-3, x²=9. √(x²)=√9=3. Mana ebe √(x²)=x, √(x²)=-3. Ya mere 3=-3. Ihe mgbagwoju anya dị otu a apụtala.
l-m-h3-b0c50-24.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ nsonaazụ njehie ahụ mere na mbụ.
l-m-h3-b0c50-24.s.s1.r.d: √9 bụ ọnụọgụ dị mma 3, ya mere ọ ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c50-24.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na x adịghị mma, √(x²)=-x. Usoro ziri ezi mgbe niile bụ √(x²)=|x|, maka x=-3 ọ bụ 3.
l-m-h3-b0c50-24.s.s2.model.0: Mgbe x adịghị mma, √(x²) dị mma, ya mere ọ bụghị otu na x; enweghị ike iji √(x²)=x maka x niile.

l-m-h3-b0c50-30.title: Ịgbakọ nkezi ngụkọta nkezi klas abụọ
l-m-h3-b0c50-30.topic: Ụzọ ziri ezi isi gosipụta nkezi
l-m-h3-b0c50-30.goal: Soro ngwọta ịgbakọ nkezi ụmụ klas abụọ n’ozuzu, chọta ebe mbụ o hiere ụzọ ma mezie ya.
l-m-h3-b0c50-30.material: Ụmụ akwụkwọ 20 na Klas A nwere nkezi akara 70, ụmụ akwụkwọ 30 na Klas B nwere nkezi 80. Ngwọta: 1) Nkezi bụ 70 na 80. 2) Tinye nkezi abụọ, kee ya na 2. 3) (70+80)÷2=75. 4) Nkezi n’ozuzu bụ akara 75.
l-m-h3-b0c50-30.s.s1.o.a: Ikwu na nkezi n’ozuzu bụ akara 75
l-m-h3-b0c50-30.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ nsonaazụ si n’usoro ahịrị gara aga pụta.
l-m-h3-b0c50-30.s.s1.o.b: Naanị ịgbakwunye nkezi abụọ, kee na 2
l-m-h3-b0c50-30.s.s1.r.c: 150÷2=75, ya mere ngụkọta ahụ ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c50-30.s.s1.o.d: Ịgụ nkezi klas nke ọ bụla dịka 70 na 80
l-m-h3-b0c50-30.s.s1.r.d: Ọ gụrụ nkezi e nyere n’ọnọdụ ahụ dịka ọ dị, ya mere ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c50-30.s.s1.explain: Ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ dị iche: kewaa ngụkọta akara 20×70+30×80=3800 na ụmụ akwụkwọ 50, nke na-enye 76, nke bụ nkezi n’ozuzu ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c50-30.s.s2.model.0: Ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ bụ 20 na 30, ya mere e kwesịghị ịgbakọ nkezi abụọ ahụ otu nha. 76 bụ azịza ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c50-30.s.s2.model.1: A ga-ekewa ngụkọta akara 3800 na ụmụ akwụkwọ 50 niile; ya mere mmejọ mbụ bụ ịgbakọ nkezi abụọ ahụ naanị.

l-m-h3-b0d07-02.title: Oke √(n²+3n)−n: ahịrị nke hiere ụzọ bụ nke?
l-m-h3-b0d07-02.goal: Soro ngwọta ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ iji chọta limit nke √(n²+3n)−n; chọta ebe mbụ o mehiere ma dozie ya.
l-m-h3-b0d07-02.material: Nzọpụta lim(√(n²+3n)−n): (1) Mee rationalize: 3n/(√(n²+3n)+n) (2) Kewaa na n: 3/(√(1+3/n)+1) (3) Ebe 3/n→3, 3/(√4+1)=1 (4) Limit bụ 1
l-m-h3-b0d07-02.s.s1.r.a: Nọmba dị n’elu ghọrọ (n²+3n)−n²=3n; ya mere rationalization ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0d07-02.s.s1.o.b: Ahịrị (2): ebe e kewara ya na n
l-m-h3-b0d07-02.s.s1.r.b: Okwu ahụ ka e kewara denominator na numerator na n ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0d07-02.s.s1.o.d: Ahịrị (4): ebe e dere nkwubi okwu
l-m-h3-b0d07-02.s.s1.r.d: (4) na-ewepụ naanị uru sitere na (3); ya mere ọ bụghị ebe mbụ njehie dị.
l-m-h3-b0d07-02.s.s1.explain: Ka n→∞, 3/n→0. Ya mere 3/(1+1)=3/2 bụ limit ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0d07-02.s.s2.model.0: Ka n na-abawanye, 3/n na-eru 0, ọ bụghị 3; ya mere ahịrị (3) ezighị ezi. N’ezie ọ bụ 3/(1+1)=3/2.
l-m-h3-b0d07-02.s.s2.model.1: Denominator nke 3/n na-abawanye n’enweghị oke, ya mere ọ na-abụ 0, √(1+0)=1. Limit bụ 3/2.

l-m-h3-b0d07-16.title: Derivative nke ln(x²+1): ahịrị nke na-ezighị ezi bụ nke?
l-m-h3-b0d07-16.topic: Ụzọ dị iche iche nke ịchọta derivative
l-m-h3-b0d07-16.goal: Soro ihe ngwọta maka ịchọta derivative y=ln(x²+1), ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ n'usoro; chọta ebe mbụ o mehiere ma dozie ya.
l-m-h3-b0d07-16.material: Ịchọta derivative y=ln(x²+1): (1) Ka u=x²+1, ya mere y=ln u (2) dy/du=1/u (3) du/dx=2x (4) y'=1/u+2x
l-m-h3-b0d07-16.s.s1.r.b: Derivative nke ln u, 1/u, ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0d07-16.s.s2.model.0: Ịwepụta ọrụ jikọtara ọnụ na-amụba dy/du na du/dx, ọ bụghị ịgbakwunye ha; ya mere (4) ezighị ezi. y'=2x/(x²+1).
l-m-h3-b0d07-16.s.s2.model.1: Iwu chain bụ (1/u)×2x, ekwesịghị ịgbakwunye ha; ịmụba na-enye 2x/(x²+1).

l-m-h3-b0d07-23.title: Mkpọda tangent nke ọrụ implicit: ahịrị nke na-ezighị ezi bụ nke?
l-m-h3-b0d07-23.goal: Soro ihe ngwọta, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, iji chọta mkpọda tangent n'isi (1,1) na x²+xy+y²=3; chọta ebe mbụ o mehiere ma dozie ya.
l-m-h3-b0d07-23.material: Ngwọta maka mkpọda tangent n'isi (1,1) na x²+xy+y²=3: (1) Were derivative n'akụkụ abụọ: 2x+y+xy'+2yy'=0 (2) Kpọkọta y' ka ọ bụrụ y'(x+2y)=2x+y (3) y'=(2x+y)/(x+2y) (4) Na (1,1), y'=3/3=1
l-m-h3-b0d07-23.s.s1.o.a: Ahịrị (1): ebe e wepụtara derivative n'akụkụ abụọ
l-m-h3-b0d07-23.s.s1.r.a: Ọ ziri ezi, gụnyere derivative nke xy, y+xy'.
l-m-h3-b0d07-23.s.s1.o.b: Ahịrị (2): ebe e chịkọtara y' ma bugharịa ya
l-m-h3-b0d07-23.s.s1.o.c: Ahịrị (3): ebe e dere y' site n'ikewa
l-m-h3-b0d07-23.s.s1.r.c: (3) sitere n'ikewa (2), ya mere ọ bụghị ebe mbụ mehiere.
l-m-h3-b0d07-23.s.s1.o.d: Ahịrị (4): ebe e tinyere isi ahụ
l-m-h3-b0d07-23.s.s1.r.d: Itinye (1,1) na ịgbakọ ziri ezi dabere n'ahịrị gara aga.
l-m-h3-b0d07-23.s.s1.explain: Ịbugharị (2x+y) gaa n'akụkụ aka nri na-agbanwe akara, ya mere y'=−(2x+y)/(x+2y). Mkpọda bụ −1.
l-m-h3-b0d07-23.s.s2.model.0: Ịbugharị 2x+y gaa n'aka nri na (1) na-eme akara −, ya mere (2) ezighị ezi, mkpọda ziri ezi bụ −3/3=−1.
l-m-h3-b0d07-23.s.s2.model.1: Mgbe e debere naanị okwu y' n'aka ekpe ma bugharịa ndị ọzọ, akara na-agbanwe; ya mere (2) ezighị ezi. Mkpọda bụ −1, ọ bụghị 1.

l-m-h3-b0d07-29.topic: Ịgbakọ integral site na mgbanwe mgbanwe
l-m-h3-b0d07-29.goal: Soro n’usoro ngwọta ịchọta ∫x/(x²+1)dx site na mgbanwe mgbanwe, chọta ebe mbụ o hiere ụzọ ma mezie ya.
l-m-h3-b0d07-29.material: Ngwọta ∫x/(x²+1)dx: (1) u=x²+1, du=2x dx (2) x dx=du (3) ∫(1/u)du=ln|u|+C (4) Azịza: ln(x²+1)+C
l-m-h3-b0d07-29.s.s1.o.a: Ahịrị (1): ebe e setịpụrụ u na du
l-m-h3-b0d07-29.s.s1.r.a: Mgbe u=x²+1, du=2x dx ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0d07-29.s.s1.o.b: Ahịrị (2): ebe e jiri ihe dochie x dx

l-m-h3-b0d08-14.title: Quotient rule nke derivatives: ahịrị nke dị aṅaa ezighị ezi?
l-m-h3-b0d08-14.goal: Soro ngwọta ịchọta derivative y=x/(x²+1), usoro kpatara na nsonaazụ ya; chọta ebe mbụ njehie dị ma dozie ya.
l-m-h3-b0d08-14.material: Ịkọwa y=x/(x²+1): (1) f=x, g=x²+1, ya mere f'=1, g'=2x (2) y'=(f'g−fg')/g² (3) numerator 1·(x²+1)−x·2x=x²+1−2x (4) y'=(x²−2x+1)/(x²+1)²
l-m-h3-b0d08-14.s.s1.o.a: Ahịrị (1): ebe a chọtara f' na g'
l-m-h3-b0d08-14.s.s1.r.b: E dere quotient rule nke ọma.
l-m-h3-b0d08-14.s.s1.o.d: Ahịrị (4): ebe e mere expression mfe
l-m-h3-b0d08-14.s.s1.r.d: Ahịrị (4) depụtara nsonaazụ ahịrị (3); ya mere ọ bụghị ebe mbụ njehie dị.
l-m-h3-b0d08-14.s.s1.explain: x·2x=2x²; ya mere numerator bụ x²+1−2x²=1−x². Ya mere y'=(1−x²)/(x²+1)².
l-m-h3-b0d08-14.s.s2.model.0: x·2x bụ 2x², ọ bụghị 2x; ahịrị (3) ezighị ezi. Numerator ziri ezi bụ 1−x², y'=(1−x²)/(x²+1)².
l-m-h3-b0d08-14.s.s2.model.1: f·g'=x·2x=2x²; numerator bụ x²+1−2x²=1−x², derivative bụ (1−x²)/(x²+1)².

l-m-h3-b0d08-22.material: Tangent nke y=ln x gafere mmalite: (1) isi metụtara (a, ln a), mkpọda 1/a (2) tangent y−ln a=(1/a)(x−a) (3) tinye mmalite: −ln a=(1/a)(−a)=−a (4) ln a=a, ya mere ngwọta adịghị
l-m-h3-b0d08-22.s.s1.o.a: Ahịrị (1): ebe e dere isi metụtara na mkpọda
l-m-h3-b0d08-22.s.s1.r.a: Iji derivative 1/x nke y=ln x na isi metụtara ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0d08-22.s.s1.r.b: Tangent e dere n'ụdị isi-na-mkpọda ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0d08-22.s.s1.o.d: Ahịrị (4): ebe e mere nkwubi okwu
l-m-h3-b0d08-22.s.s1.r.d: Ahịrị (4) soro nsonaazụ ahịrị (3). Ọ bụghị ebe mbụ mehiere.
l-m-h3-b0d08-22.s.s1.explain: (1/a)(−a)=−1. Site na −ln a=−1, a=e, tangent bụ y=x/e.
l-m-h3-b0d08-22.s.s2.model.0: (1/a)(−a) bụ −1, ọ bụghị −a; ya mere ahịrị (3) ezighị ezi. Site na −ln a=−1, a=e.

l-m-h3-b0d08-28.goal: Soro ihe ngwọta ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ maka ∫(x+cos x)dx n'elu etiti nhata, nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu; chọta ebe mbụ o mehiere ma dozie ya.
l-m-h3-b0d08-28.material: Ngwọta ∫₋π/2^π/2 (x+cos x)dx: (1) x bụ ọrụ odd, ya mere ∫x dx=0 (2) cos x bụ ọrụ even, ya mere ∫cos x dx=∫₀^π/2 cos x dx (3) =[sin x]₀^π/2=1 (4) Ngụkọta bụ 0+1=1

l-m-h3-b0d08-28.s.s1.o.c: Ahịrị (3): ebe e gbakọrọ integral a kapịrị ọnụ

l-m-h3-b0d09-12.title: Ịlele anya n'etiti isi parabola na focus
l-m-h3-b0d09-12.goal: Soro ihe ngwọta ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ ịchọta anya site n'isi parabola ruo focus, nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu; chọta ebe mbụ o mehiere ma dozie ya.
l-m-h3-b0d09-12.material: Ntọala x nke isi P dị na parabola y²=12x bụ 5. Nke a bụ ngwọta ịchọta anya ruo focus. ① 4p=12, p=3 ② Directrix bụ x=−3 ③ Anya P ruo directrix bụ 5−3=2 ④ Ya mere PF=2
l-m-h3-b0d09-12.s.s1.r.a: p=3 ziri ezi. E nweghị nsogbu n'ahịrị a.
l-m-h3-b0d09-12.s.s1.o.c: Ide anya P ruo directrix dịka 5−3=2
l-m-h3-b0d09-12.s.s1.o.d: Ikwu PF hà nhata anya ruo directrix
l-m-h3-b0d09-12.s.s1.r.d: Nke a bụ nkọwa parabola, ya mere echiche ahụ ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0d09-12.s.s1.explain: Directrix bụ x=−3, ya mere anya n'isi P (x=5) bụ 5−(−3)=8. Ya mere PF=8.
l-m-h3-b0d09-12.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ directrix bụ x=−3, anya n'etiti 5 na −3 bụ 5+3=8. ③ e gbakọrọ dịka 5−3 ezighị ezi, PF=8, a ga-edozikwa ya.
l-m-h3-b0d09-12.s.s2.model.1: Ọbụna ịtụ anya n'etiti P na F ozugbo na-enye √(4+60)=8; ya mere PF=2 ezighị ezi, a ga-edozikwa anya ruo directrix ka ọ bụrụ 8.

l-m-h3-b0d09-21.title: Ebee ka ngwọta uru cosine mehiere?
l-m-h3-b0d09-21.goal: Soro ngwọta ịchọta cosine akụkụ dị n'etiti vectors, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu. Chọta ebe mbụ o mehiere ma dozie ya.
l-m-h3-b0d09-21.material: Nke a bụ ngwọta maka akụkụ θ dị n'etiti a=(2, 1) na b=(1, −3). ① a·b = 2−3 = −1 ② |a|=√5, |b|=√10 ③ cosθ = −1/(√5+√10) ④ Ya mere θ sara mbara
l-m-h3-b0d09-21.s.s1.o.a: Ịgbakwunye nha na denominator kama ịmụba
l-m-h3-b0d09-21.s.s1.o.d: Ikwu akụkụ ahụ sara mbara n'ihi cosθ adịghị mma
l-m-h3-b0d09-21.s.s1.r.d: Nkwubi na akụkụ sara mbara mgbe cosθ<0 ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0d09-21.s.s1.explain: A ga-amụba denominator: |a||b|=√5·√10=5√2. Ebe cosθ=−1/(5√2)<0, nkwubi okwu ahụ bụ otu mana ngosipụta ezighị ezi.
l-m-h3-b0d09-21.s.s2.model.0: Ebe cosθ=a·b/(|a||b|), denominator bụ ngwaahịa nha, √50=5√2. Nzọụkwụ ③ dere ngụkọta, nke ezighị ezi; uru edoziri bụ −1/(5√2).
l-m-h3-b0d09-21.s.s2.model.1: Usoro ahụ na-ekewa a·b na ngwaahịa |a| na |b|, ya mere ekwesịghị ịgbakwunye ha. A ga-edozi ya ka ọ bụrụ ngwaahịa ka uru ahụ zie ezi.

l-m-h3-b0d09-22.title: Vector ọnọdụ nke isi na-ekewa ngalaba n'ime: ebee ka njehie dị?
l-m-h3-b0d09-22.goal: Soro ihe ngwọta ịchọta vector ọnọdụ nke isi nkewa ime, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu. Chọta ebe mbụ o mehiere ma dozie ya.
l-m-h3-b0d09-22.material: Nke a bụ ngwọta ịchọta isi P na ngalaba AB ebe AP:PB=2:1, A(1,2), B(7,5). ① p=(2a+b)/3 ② Dochie nhazi ③ p=(3,3) (1 2 3 3 5 7)
l-m-h3-b0d09-22.s.s1.r.b: Ikewa na ngụkọta oke 2+1=3 ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0d09-22.s.s1.r.c: Ịgụ oke dịka e nyere n'ajụjụ ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0d09-22.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ AP:PB=2:1, P dị nso na B, ya mere p=(a+2b)/3. Itinye uru na-enye P(5,4). (4 5)
l-m-h3-b0d09-22.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ AP bụ okpukpu 2 nke PB, P dị nso na B, ya mere ọnụọgụ na-amụba b ga-abụ 2. Ya mere p=(a+2b)/3=(5,4).
l-m-h3-b0d09-22.s.s2.model.1: (2a+b)/3 na-enye isi dị nso na A, ya mere ezighị ezi. A ga-edozi ya ka ọ bụrụ (a+2b)/3.

l-m-h3-b0d09-36.title: Anya isi ruo ahịrị: ebe mmejọ dị?
l-m-h3-b0d09-36.goal: Soro ngwọta ịchọta anya n’etiti isi na ahịrị, chọta ebe mbụ o hiere ụzọ ma mezie ya.
l-m-h3-b0d09-36.material: Ụkwụ perpendicular site na P dị n’èzí ụgbọelu α ruo α bụ H; ụkwụ perpendicular site na H ruo ahịrị l dị na α bụ Q. Chọta anya P ruo l mgbe PH=3 na HQ=4. ① PQ⊥l ② ∠PHQ=90° ③ PQ=3+4=7 ④ Anya bụ 7.
l-m-h3-b0d09-36.s.s1.r.a: PQ⊥l ziri ezi site na usoro akụkụ atọ kwụ n’akụkụ.
l-m-h3-b0d09-36.s.s1.r.b: PH kwụ n’akụkụ α, ya mere nke a ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0d09-36.s.s1.o.d: Iwere anya site na P ruo l dịka PQ
l-m-h3-b0d09-36.s.s1.r.d: Ebe PQ ⊥ l, ọ ziri ezi na PQ bụ anya ahụ.
l-m-h3-b0d09-36.s.s1.explain: N'ime triangle akụkụ ziri ezi PHQ, PQ²=3²+4²=25, ya mere PQ=5. Ekwesịghị ịgbakwunye ogologo akụkụ abụọ ahụ.
l-m-h3-b0d09-36.s.s2.model.0: Triangle PHQ nwere akụkụ ziri ezi na H, ya mere site n'usoro Pythagoras PQ²=9+16=25, PQ=5. Nzọụkwụ ③ nke gbakwụnyere 3+4 ezighị ezi.
l-m-h3-b0d09-36.s.s2.model.1: Hypotenuse triangle ziri ezi dị mkpụmkpụ karịa ngụkọta akụkụ abụọ, ya mere 7 ezighị ezi, a ga-edozi ya ka ọ bụrụ 5.

l-m-h3-b0d09-37.goal: Soro ngwọta ịchọta nhata sphere nke isi abụọ e nyere bụ nsọtụ diameter, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ. Chọta ebe mbụ o mehiere ma dozie ya.
l-m-h3-b0d09-37.material: Nke a bụ ngwọta maka nhata sphere nwere A(1, 2, 3) na B(5, 2, 3) dịka nsọtụ diameter abụọ. ① Ebe etiti bụ etiti AB, (3, 2, 3) ② AB=4 ③ Radius bụ r=4 ④ (x−3)²+(y−2)²+(z−3)²=16
l-m-h3-b0d09-37.s.s1.r.b: Midpoint diameter bụ ebe etiti, ya mere nke a ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0d09-37.s.s1.r.c: Ọdịiche nhazi x bụ 4, ya mere AB=4 ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0d09-37.s.s1.o.d: Itinye nhazi ebe etiti n'ime nhata
l-m-h3-b0d09-37.s.s1.r.d: Ụdị (x−3)²+(y−2)²+(z−3)² kwekọrọ na ebe etiti ahụ.
l-m-h3-b0d09-37.s.s1.explain: AB bụ diameter, ya mere radius bụ 2. A ga-edozi nhata ka ọ bụrụ (x−3)²+(y−2)²+(z−3)²=4.
l-m-h3-b0d09-37.s.s2.model.0: AB=4 bụ diameter, radius bụ ọkara ya, 2. Nzọụkwụ ③ dere r=4 ezighị ezi, akụkụ aka nri ga-abụ 4, ọ bụghị 16.
l-m-h3-b0d09-37.s.s2.model.1: Maka sphere nwere diameter 4, anya site n'ebe etiti ruo A bụ 2; itinye (1, 2, 3) na-enye 4, akụkụ aka nri 4 ziri ezi. (1.2)

l-m-h3-b0d10-08.title: Ide equation hyperbola site na foci na transverse axis: ebee ka njehie dị?
l-m-h3-b0d10-08.goal: Soro usoro ngwọta ịchọta equation hyperbola site na foci na ogologo transverse axis; chọta ebe mbụ o mehiere ma dozie ya.
l-m-h3-b0d10-08.material: Nzọpụta hyperbola x²/a²−y²/b²=1 nwere foci (±5,0), transverse axis ogologo 6. ① 2a=6, a=3 ② c=5 ③ b²=a²+c²=9+25=34 ④ x²/9−y²/34=1. Foci ọzọ bụ (±5,0), ya bụ y=0. Ọnụọgụ focus 5 pụtara ọzọ: 5.
l-m-h3-b0d10-08.s.s1.r.a: Ogologo transverse axis bụ 2a, ya mere a=3 ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0d10-08.s.s1.r.b: Site na foci (±5,0), c=5 ziri ezi; foci nwere y-coordinate 0. c=5 pụtara 5.
l-m-h3-b0d10-08.s.s1.r.d: Denominator 9 dị n’okpuru x² ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0d10-08.s.s1.explain: Maka hyperbola c²=a²+b², ya mere b²=c²−a²=25−9=16. Equation bụ x²/9−y²/16=1.
l-m-h3-b0d10-08.s.s2.model.0: Hyperbola nwere c²=a²+b², ya mere b²=c²−a² ga-abụ 16. Ide ya na mgbakwunye na ③ ezighị ezi.
l-m-h3-b0d10-08.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ b²=34, c²=9+34=43, foci agaghị abụ (±5,0). Ya mere 34 ezighị ezi, 16 ziri ezi.

l-m-h3-b0d10-09.title: Nzọpụta ji tangency condition: njehie dị ebee?
l-m-h3-b0d10-09.goal: Soro usoro ịchọta k ka ahịrị metụ parabola n’otu ebe; chọta ebe mbụ njehie dị ma dozie ya.
l-m-h3-b0d10-09.material: Nke a bụ ịchọta k ka ahịrị y=x+k metụ parabola y²=4x. ① (x+k)²=4x ② x²+(2k−4)x+k²=0 ③ Ọ metụrụ ya, ya mere D>0, ya bụ −16k+16>0 ④ Ya mere k<1
l-m-h3-b0d10-09.s.s1.r.b: Itinye iji chọta isi tangency bụ ụzọ ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0d10-09.s.s1.o.c: Ịhazigharị ya dịka quadratic n’ime x
l-m-h3-b0d10-09.s.s1.explain: Mgbe ọ metụrụ, e nwere intersection otu, ya mere D=0. Site na −16k+16=0, k=1.
l-m-h3-b0d10-09.s.s2.model.0: Ịmetụ pụtara intersection otu, ya mere D=0. D>0 bụ mgbe ahịrị zutere curve n’isi abụọ. Dozie ka k=1.
l-m-h3-b0d10-09.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ D>0, ahịrị zutere curve n’isi abụọ dị iche; ya mere ọ bụghị tangency. Mgbe D=0, k=1.

l-m-h3-b0d10-21.goal: Soro usoro ngwọta ịchọta nha nhata ahịrị site na vector normal, chọta ebe mbụ o hiere ụzọ ma mezie ya.
l-m-h3-b0d10-21.material: Nke a bụ ngwọta ịchọta ahịrị gafere A(2, 1), B(5, 5). ① AB=(3, 4) ② vector normal n=(4, 3) (gbanwee ebe akụkụ) ③ 4(x−2)+3(y−1)=0 ④ 4x+3y=11.
l-m-h3-b0d10-21.s.s1.o.c: Ide nha nhata ka ọ gafee isi A
l-m-h3-b0d10-21.s.s1.r.c: Igosipụta ya n’ụdị n·(x−2,y−1)=0 ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0d10-21.s.s1.o.d: Ime ka ọ dị mfe ruo 4x+3y=11
l-m-h3-b0d10-21.s.s1.r.d: Ịgbasa ma mee ka ③ dị mfe ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0d10-21.s.s1.explain: Iji kwụ n’akụkụ (3,4), ngwaahịa dot ga-abụ 0. (4,−3) bụ normal; 4(x−2)−3(y−1)=0, ya bụ 4x−3y=5.
l-m-h3-b0d10-21.s.s2.model.0: n·AB=12+12=24≠0, ya mere (4,3) abụghị normal. Dozie ya ka ọ bụrụ (4,−3); ahịrị bụ 4x−3y=5.
l-m-h3-b0d10-21.s.s2.model.1: Normal ga-enwe ngwaahịa dot 0 na AB; ịgbanwe ebe akụkụ naanị ezughị, a ga-agbanwekwa akara otu akụkụ.

l-m-h3-b0d10-22.title: Ịlele ngwọta tangent gburugburu site na vector
l-m-h3-b0d10-22.goal: Soro usoro ịchọta tangent n’otu isi nke okirikiri, chọta ebe mbụ o hiere ụzọ ma mezie ya.
l-m-h3-b0d10-22.material: Nke a bụ ngwọta tangent na Q(3, 4) n’okirikiri x²+y²=25. ① Tangent kwụ n’akụkụ radius OQ. ② Maka isi P na tangent, OQ·OP=0. ③ 3x+4y=0. ④ Tangent bụ 3x+4y=0.
l-m-h3-b0d10-22.s.s1.o.a: Ikwu na tangent kwụ n’akụkụ OQ
l-m-h3-b0d10-22.s.s1.r.a: Tangent na radius na-agbakọta kwụ n’akụkụ ebe ha metụrụ, ya mere nke a ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0d10-22.s.s1.explain: Tangent ga-agafe Q ebe ha metụrụ, ya mere OQ·QP=0. 3(x−3)+4(y−4)=0, ya bụ 3x+4y=25.
l-m-h3-b0d10-22.s.s2.model.0: Maka P na tangent, vector kwụ n’akụkụ OQ bụ QP; ya mere OQ·QP=0. 3x+4y=0 na-agafe mmalite, ọ pụghị ịbụ tangent.
l-m-h3-b0d10-22.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ OQ·OP=0, ahịrị ahụ na-agafe mmalite, ọ naghị agafe Q(3,4) ebe e metụrụ; ya mere ọ dị njọ.

l-m-h3-b0d10-37.title: Ịlele ngwọta ogologo projection kwụ ọtọ nke akụkụ ahịrị
l-m-h3-b0d10-37.goal: Soro ngwọta, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu iji chọta ebe mbụ o mehiere ma dozie ya. (Ịchọta ogologo projection kwụ ọtọ nke akụkụ ahịrị n'elu ụgbọelu)
l-m-h3-b0d10-37.material: Akụkụ AB ogologo 10 na-eme akụkụ 30° na ụgbọelu α. Nke a bụ ngwọta maka ogologo projection kwụ ọtọ nke AB n'elu α. ① Ogologo projection=10×sin30° ② sin30°=1/2 ③ Ogologo projection bụ 5
l-m-h3-b0d10-37.s.s1.o.c: Ịgụ akụkụ dị n'etiti akụkụ ahịrị na ụgbọelu dịka 30°
l-m-h3-b0d10-37.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụ akụkụ e nyere n'ajụjụ, ya mere a gụrụ ya nke ọma.
l-m-h3-b0d10-37.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ akụkụ dị n'etiti akụkụ ahịrị na ụgbọelu bụ θ, ogologo projection bụ 10cosθ. 10cos30°=5√3≈8.7.
l-m-h3-b0d10-37.s.s2.model.0: Projection bụ akụkụ kwekọrọ n'ụgbọelu, ya mere ọ bụ 10cos30°=5√3. Nzọụkwụ ① jiri sin30° ezighị ezi; 5 bụ akụkụ ịdị elu.
l-m-h3-b0d10-37.s.s2.model.1: Ka akụkụ ahụ na-abịaru 0°, projection kwesịrị ịbịaru ogologo mbụ nso; ya mere a ga-eji cos, azịza bụ 5√3≈8.7.

l-m-h3-b0c33-22.topic: Okwu mgbakọ ọmụrụ nwa jikọtara ọnụ
l-m-h3-b0c33-22.goal: Kwuo ego niile (isi ego tinyere ọmụrụ nwa) mgbe afọ 3 gasịrị na ọmụrụ nwa jikọtara ọnụ 5% kwa afọ n’ụdị ọzọ (okwu mgbakọ, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere ha ji pụta otu ihe.
l-m-h3-b0c33-22.material: A tinyere isi ego P ruo afọ 3 na ọmụrụ nwa jikọtara ọnụ 5% kwa afọ. Chọta okwu nwere otu ihe pụtara dịka ego niile mgbe afọ 3 gasịrị.
l-m-h3-b0c33-22.s.s1.prompt: Kedu okwu nwere otu ihe pụtara dịka ego niile?
l-m-h3-b0c33-22.s.s1.r.a: A mụbara ya na 1.05 otu ugboro wee mụbaa na 3, ya mere ihe ọ pụtara dị iche.
l-m-h3-b0c33-22.s.s1.r.c: Okwu a na-ahapụ naanị ntakịrị akụkụ nke isi ego.
l-m-h3-b0c33-22.s.s1.r.d: Nke a bụ okwu ọmụrụ nwa dị mfe. N’ọmụrụ nwa jikọtara ọnụ, a na-amụba ya na 1.05 ugboro ugboro.
l-m-h3-b0c33-22.s.s1.explain: Kwa afọ ọ na-aghọ okpukpu 1.05; ya mere n’afọ 3 a na-amụba na 1.05 ugboro atọ, na-enye P×1.05³.
l-m-h3-b0c33-22.s.s2.model.0: Kwa afọ ọ na-aghọ okpukpu 1.05 nke afọ gara aga; ya mere mgbe afọ 3 gasịrị ọ bụ P×1.05³, a mụbara na 1.05 ugboro atọ.
l-m-h3-b0c33-22.s.s2.model.1: Ọmụrụ nwa na-enwetakwa ọmụrụ nwa, a na-amụba ya; ya mere a ga-ede ya dịka ike, ọ bụghị okwu mgbakwunye nke ọmụrụ nwa dị mfe.

l-m-h3-b0c33-23.title: Iji okwu ego niile e nwetara degharịa okwu ọnụọgụ ere
l-m-h3-b0c33-23.goal: Kwuo ego niile a na-enweta kwa ụbọchị dịka ọnụahịa n’ụdị ọzọ (okwu mgbakọ, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere ha ji pụta otu ihe.
l-m-h3-b0c33-23.material: Mgbe ọnụahịa bụ p won, ọnụọgụ ere kwa ụbọchị bụ ihe 100−2p (0<p<50). Degharịa ego niile kwa ụbọchị R dịka okwu n’ime p.
l-m-h3-b0c33-23.s.s1.prompt: Kedu okwu nwere otu ihe pụtara dịka ego niile R?
l-m-h3-b0c33-23.s.s1.r.a: E jikọtara 100−2p n’ụzọ na-ezighị ezi ka ọ bụrụ 98p.
l-m-h3-b0c33-23.s.s1.r.b: Ego a na-enweta bụ ngwaahịa, ma e ji nkewa mee ya.
l-m-h3-b0c33-23.s.s1.r.d: A mere square nke p naanị n’ime okwu ọnụọgụ ere. Ị ga-amụba ya na ọnụahịa.
l-m-h3-b0c33-23.s.s1.explain: Ego niile a na-enweta bụ ọnụahịa × ọnụọgụ ere; ya mere p(100−2p)=100p−2p². Ọ na-aghọ okwu quadratic.
l-m-h3-b0c33-23.s.s2.model.0: Ego niile a na-enweta bụ ọnụahịa × ọnụọgụ ere; ịgbasa p(100−2p) na-enye 100p−2p².
l-m-h3-b0c33-23.s.s2.model.1: Ọ na-amụba ọnụọgụ ere 100−2p na ọnụahịa p won otu ihe; ya mere R na-aghọ okwu quadratic 100p−2p² n’ime p.

l-m-h3-b0c33-24.title: Iji okwu mgbakọ degharịa ọnọdụ ego enwetara = ọnụ ahịa
l-m-h3-b0c33-24.goal: Kwuo ọnọdụ ebe ego enwetara na ọnụ ahịa hà nhata n’ụdị ọzọ (okwu mgbakọ, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere ha ji pụta otu ihe.
l-m-h3-b0c33-24.material: Ọnụahịa ire otu ihe bụ 5,000 won, ụgwọ mgbanwe otu ihe bụ 3,000 won, ụgwọ kwụụrụ onwe ya bụ 2,000,000 won. Maka ọnụọgụ ere q, chọta okwu nwere otu ihe pụtara dịka “ego enwetara = ọnụ ahịa.”
l-m-h3-b0c33-24.s.s1.prompt: Kedu okwu nwere otu ihe pụtara dịka “ego enwetara = ọnụ ahịa”?
l-m-h3-b0c33-24.s.s1.r.a: Ọ gbakwụnyere ụgwọ mgbanwe na ego enwetara. Ụgwọ mgbanwe dị n’akụkụ ọnụ ahịa.
l-m-h3-b0c33-24.s.s1.r.b: Ịmụba ọnụahịa na ụgwọ enweghị isi.
l-m-h3-b0c33-24.s.s1.r.d: Akara nke ọnụ ahịa edobere tụgharịrị. A ga-agbakwunye ya na ọnụ ahịa.
l-m-h3-b0c33-24.s.s1.explain: Ego mbata 5,000q = ọnụ ahịa 2,000,000+3,000q; ibuga 3,000q n’akụkụ nke ọzọ na-enye (5,000−3,000)q=2,000,000.
l-m-h3-b0c33-24.s.s2.model.1: Ọ na-ekwu na ego 2,000 won fọdụrụ kwa ihe nke e mụbara na q hà nhata ọnụ ahịa edobere, ya mere ọ bụ otu okwu ahụ.

l-m-h3-b0c34-21.goal: Degharịa “iwepụ ụtụ na ọnụahịa gụnyere VAT iji nweta ọnụahịa tupu ụtụ” n’ụdị ọzọ (usoro, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe.
l-m-h3-b0c34-21.material: Ọnụahịa nwere VAT 10% bụ 11,000 won. Chọta usoro nwere otu ihe pụtara dịka ịchọta ọnụahịa tupu ụtụ (ọnụahịa ọkọnọ).
l-m-h3-b0c34-21.s.s1.r.a: A na-agbakwunye ụtụ ọzọ, ya mere ọnụahịa na-ebuwanye.
l-m-h3-b0c34-21.s.s1.r.c: Ị wepụrụ 10% nke ọnụahịa gụnyere ụtụ. Ụtụ bụ 10% nke ọnụahịa ọkọnọ.
l-m-h3-b0c34-21.s.s1.r.d: Ikewa na 0.9 na-enye uru karịrị ọnụahịa gụnyere ụtụ; ya mere ọ bụghị ọnụahịa tupu ụtụ.
l-m-h3-b0c34-21.s.s1.explain: Ọnụahịa ọkọnọ × 1.1=11,000; ya mere ọnụahịa ọkọnọ=11,000÷1.1=10,000 won.
l-m-h3-b0c34-21.s.s2.model.0: Ịgbakwunye ụtụ 10% na ọnụahịa ọkọnọ na-eme ka ọ bụrụ okpukpu 1.1, ya bụ 11,000 won; ya mere ọnụahịa ọkọnọ bụ 11,000÷1.1.
l-m-h3-b0c34-21.s.s2.model.1: Ọnụahịa gụnyere ụtụ bụ okpukpu 1.1 nke ọnụahịa ọkọnọ; iji laghachi azụ ị gaghị amụba, kama kewaa na 1.1.

l-m-h3-b0c34-23.title: Iji ego enwetara na ụgwọ gbanwee ka ọ bụrụ usoro uru
l-m-h3-b0c34-23.goal: Degharịa uru, nke bụ ego enwetara ewepụ ụgwọ, n’ụdị ọzọ (usoro, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe.
l-m-h3-b0c34-23.material: Mgbe ego enwetara bụ R(q)=100q won, ụgwọ bụ C(q)=3,000+40q won; mee ka uru P(q)=R(q)−C(q) dị mfe dịka usoro otu ahịrị n’ime q.
l-m-h3-b0c34-23.s.s1.prompt: Kedu usoro nwere otu ihe pụtara dịka uru P(q)?
l-m-h3-b0c34-23.s.s1.r.b: A ga-ewepụ ụgwọ kwụụrụ onwe ya 3,000 kwa.
l-m-h3-b0c34-23.s.s1.r.c: Ị gbakwụnyere ụgwọ 40q. A ga-ewepụ ụgwọ.
l-m-h3-b0c34-23.s.s1.r.d: Ị hapụrụ ụgwọ kwụụrụ onwe ya 3,000.
l-m-h3-b0c34-23.s.s1.explain: P=100q−(3,000+40q)=60q−3,000. Ị na-edebe 60 won n’ihe ọ bụla, ma buru ụzọ kpuchie ụgwọ kwụụrụ onwe ya 3,000 won.
l-m-h3-b0c34-23.s.s2.model.1: A na-ewepụ ụgwọ niile; ya mere 40q na-apụ na ego enwetara, hapụ 60q, a na-ewepụkwa ụgwọ kwụụrụ onwe ya 3,000.

l-m-h3-b0c34-24.title: Ikwu mbelata 20% n’ụzọ megidere
l-m-h3-b0c34-24.goal: Degharịa “mbelata ma e jiri ya tụnyere ọnwa gara aga, kwuo ya ọzọ site n’iji ọnwa gara aga dịka ntọala” n’ụdị ọzọ (usoro, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe.
l-m-h3-b0c34-24.material: Ire ọnwa a dị ala 20% karịa nke ọnwa gara aga. Gosipụta otu eziokwu ahụ dịka “ire ọnwa gara aga bụ ugboro ole nke ọnwa a.”
l-m-h3-b0c34-24.s.s1.prompt: Kedu okwu nwere otu ihe pụtara?
l-m-h3-b0c34-24.s.s1.o.a: Ire ọnwa a bụ okpukpu 1.2 nke ọnwa gara aga
l-m-h3-b0c34-24.s.s1.r.a: Ọnwa a dara, ya mere ọ ga-erughị 1.
l-m-h3-b0c34-24.s.s1.o.b: Ire ọnwa gara aga bụ okpukpu 1.25 nke ọnwa a
l-m-h3-b0c34-24.s.s1.o.c: Ire ọnwa a bụ okpukpu 0.2 nke ọnwa gara aga
l-m-h3-b0c34-24.s.s1.o.d: Ire ọnwa gara aga bụ okpukpu 1.2 nke ọnwa a
l-m-h3-b0c34-24.s.s1.r.d: Ọnwa a bụ okpukpu 0.8 nke ọnwa gara aga; n’ụzọ megidere, ọ bụ okpukpu 1.25.
l-m-h3-b0c34-24.s.s1.explain: Ọnwa a=ọnwa gara aga×0.8; ya mere ọnwa gara aga=ọnwa a÷0.8=ọnwa a×1.25.
l-m-h3-b0c34-24.s.s2.model.0: Ọnwa a bụ okpukpu 0.8 nke ọnwa gara aga; ya mere ọnwa gara aga bụ 1÷0.8=1.25 ugboro nke ọnwa a.
l-m-h3-b0c34-24.s.s2.model.1: Mbelata 20% pụtara na 80% fọdụrụ; iji laghachi azụ kewaa na 0.8, nke na-enye okpukpu 1.25.

l-m-h3-b0c35-06.title: Iweghachi ọnụahịa dara 20%
l-m-h3-b0c35-06.topic: Ntọala ọnụego mmụba ma ọ bụ mbelata
l-m-h3-b0c35-06.goal: Degharịa “ọnụego mmụba nke na-eweghachi ọnụahịa dara 20%” n’ụdị ọzọ (usoro, tebụl, eserese, okwu) ma kọwaa ihe mere o ji nwee otu ihe ọ pụtara.
l-m-h3-b0c35-06.material: Ọnụahịa ihe dara 20%. Ọnụahịa dara ada bụ okpukpu 0.8 nke ọnụahịa mbụ. Chee echiche n’ihe gbasara ịmụba: pasentị ole nke ọnụahịa dara ka a ga-ebuli ya iji laghachi n’ọnụahịa mbụ?
l-m-h3-b0c35-06.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ọnụego mmụba a chọrọ iji si n’ọnụahịa dara laghachi n’ọnụahịa mbụ?
l-m-h3-b0c35-06.s.s1.r.a: I were mbelata 20% dịka otu nha mmụba a ga-eji laghachi. Ntọala dị iche.
l-m-h3-b0c35-06.s.s1.r.c: Ị gụrụ uru 0.8 ugboro ya onwe ya dịka ọnụego mmụba.
l-m-h3-b0c35-06.s.s1.r.d: Ị gwakọtara ịrị elu ruo okpukpu 1.2 na ịrị elu site na 120%.
l-m-h3-b0c35-06.s.s1.explain: 0.8×(1+r)=1, ya mere 1+r=1.25, ya bụ r=25%. Ntọala aghọwo ọnụahịa dara ada.
l-m-h3-b0c35-06.s.s2.model.0: Ka 0.8 ghọọ 1 mgbe e mụbara ya na nọmba ụfọdụ, ọ ga-abụ okpukpu 1.25, ya mere a ga-ebuli ya 25%.
l-m-h3-b0c35-06.s.s2.model.1: Ọnụọgụ e wedatara bụ otu, ma ntọala ugbu a pere mpe, ọ bụ 0.8 ugboro nke mbụ; ya mere ọnụego mmụba abụghị 20% kama ọ bụ 0.2÷0.8=25%.

l-m-h3-b0c35-14.title: Iji okwu kọwaa ebe enweghị uru ma ọ bụ mfu
l-m-h3-b0c35-14.goal: Dee ebe enweghị uru/mfu nke ngwaahịa nwere ọnụ ahịa kwụ ọtọ 5,000 won n'ụdị ọzọ (usoro, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu.
l-m-h3-b0c35-14.material: Ngwaahịa nwere ọnụ ahịa kwụ ọtọ 5,000 won, ọnụ ahịa ire 800 won kwa ihe, ọnụ ahịa mgbanwe 300 won kwa ihe. Kọwaa ọnụ ọgụgụ ihe (ebe enweghị uru/mfu) ebe ego ire na ọnụ ahịa niile hà.
l-m-h3-b0c35-14.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nkọwa pụtara otu ihe na ebe enweghị uru/mfu?
l-m-h3-b0c35-14.s.s1.o.a: Ọnụọgụ ihe nke, site n'inweta 800 won n'otu, ga-akwụ 5,000 won
l-m-h3-b0c35-14.s.s1.o.b: Ọnụọgụ ihe nke, mgbe 500 won fọdụrụ n'otu, ga-akwụ ọnụ ahịa kwụ ọtọ 5,000 won
l-m-h3-b0c35-14.s.s1.o.c: Ọnụọgụ ihe nke, mgbe 300 won fọdụrụ n'otu, ga-akwụ 5,000 won
l-m-h3-b0c35-14.s.s1.r.c: I weere ọnụ ahịa mgbanwe dịka uru fọdụrụ.
l-m-h3-b0c35-14.s.s1.o.d: Ọnụọgụ ihe ebe ego ire ruru 5,000 won
l-m-h3-b0c35-14.s.s1.r.d: I lere naanị ego ire anya, atụleghị ya na ọnụ ahịa niile.
l-m-h3-b0c35-14.s.s1.explain: Ego fọdụrụ n'otu ihe bụ 800−300=500 won. Mgbe ihe 5,000÷500=10, ego ire na ọnụ ahịa hà na 8,000 won.
l-m-h3-b0c35-14.s.s2.model.0: Ihe ọ bụla e rere na-ahapụ 800−300=500 won; ya mere a chọrọ ihe 10 iji kpuchie 5,000 won.
l-m-h3-b0c35-14.s.s2.model.1: Ego ire niile 800x na ọnụ ahịa niile 5,000+300x ga-hà; ya mere 500x=5,000, x=10.

l-m-h3-b0c35-21.s.s1.r.a: Uru atụ anya bụ nkezi, ọ bụghị nsonaazụ otu nnwale.

l-m-h3-b0c35-21.s.s1.r.c: Nke a gbasara ego nkezi, ọ bụghị ohere mmeri.

l-m-h3-b0c35-27.goal: Gbanwee tebụl ọnụ ahịa dịka ọnụọgụ mmepụta si dị ka ụdị ọzọ (usoro, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe.
l-m-h3-b0c35-27.material: Nke a bụ tebụl mmepụta na ọnụ ahịa niile nke ụlọ ọrụ. Mgbe ihe 0, ọ bụ 8,000 won; ihe 10, 8,600; ihe 20, 9,200; ihe 30, 9,800.
l-m-h3-b0c35-27.s.s1.prompt: Usoro nkee (x bụ ọnụọgụ ihe) pụtara otu ihe na tebụl?
l-m-h3-b0c35-27.s.s1.r.a: I gụrụ mmụba 600 maka ihe 10 dịka mmụba n’otu ihe 1.
l-m-h3-b0c35-27.s.s1.r.b: Ọnụ ahịa mgbe ihe 0 abụghị 0 won. Ọnụ ahịa kwụ ọtọ adịghị.
l-m-h3-b0c35-27.s.s1.r.d: I jiri uru mgbe ihe 10 dị ka ọnụ ahịa kwụ ọtọ.
l-m-h3-b0c35-27.s.s1.explain: Ọ na-abawanye 600 won maka ihe 10, ya bụ 60 won kwa ihe 1; mgbe ihe 0, ọ bụ 8,000. Ya mere C=8,000+60x.
l-m-h3-b0c35-27.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụ 8,000 won mgbe ihe 0, ọ na-abawanye 600 maka ihe 10 (60 kwa ihe); ya mere C=8,000+60x.

l-m-h3-b0c36-21.title: Iji matriks dee usoro nhata
l-m-h3-b0c36-21.goal: Gbanwee usoro nhata 2x+3y=7, x−y=1 ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ (nhata, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere o ji nwee otu ihe pụtara.
l-m-h3-b0c36-21.material: Anyị chọrọ ide usoro 2x+3y=7, x−y=1 dịka ngwaahịa matriks. Dee koefishenti dịka matriks, ihe a na-amaghị na akụkụ aka nri dịka vektọ kọlụm.
l-m-h3-b0c36-21.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ nhata matriks nwere otu ihe pụtara.
l-m-h3-b0c36-21.s.s1.r.a: Akara koefishenti dị na nhata nke abụọ dị iche; ya mere ọ na-aghọ −x+y=1.
l-m-h3-b0c36-21.s.s1.r.b: A gbanwere ahịrị na kọlụm nke matriks koefishenti, ya mere ọ na-aghọ nhata ọzọ.
l-m-h3-b0c36-21.s.s1.r.c: E dere koefishenti −1 nke y dịka 1, ya mere ọ ghọrọ x+y=1.
l-m-h3-b0c36-21.s.s1.explain: Ahịrị nke ọ bụla na-egosi koefishenti nke otu nhata. Ahịrị mbụ (2 3) bụ 2x+3y; nke abụọ (1 −1) bụ x−y.
l-m-h3-b0c36-21.s.s2.model.0: Ahịrị mbụ nke ngwaahịa matriks bụ 2x+3y, nke abụọ bụ x−y; ya mere ha abụọ kwekọrọ n’akụkụ aka nri (7; 1).
l-m-h3-b0c36-21.s.s2.model.1: Ịmụba koefishenti ahịrị nke ọ bụla na vektọ kọlụm (x; y) ma chịkọta na-enye nhata mbụ; ya mere ihe ọ pụtara bụ otu.

l-m-h3-b0c36-22.title: Iji akara gbanwee ohere e kwuru n’okwu
l-m-h3-b0c36-22.goal: Gbanwee “ohere ndị nwetara nsonaazụ dị mma bụ ndị nwere ọrịa n’ezie” ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ (nhata, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere o ji nwee otu ihe pụtara.
l-m-h3-b0c36-22.material: Ihe omume D bụ “n’ezie nwere ọrịa,” ihe omume T bụ “ule dị mma.” Anyị chọrọ ide okwu “ohere na onye e kwuru na ọ dị mma nwere ọrịa n’ezie” n’akara.
l-m-h3-b0c36-22.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ akara nwere otu ihe pụtara dịka ahịrịokwu ahụ.
l-m-h3-b0c36-22.s.s1.r.b: Nke a bụ ohere nsonaazụ dị mma n’etiti ndị ọrịa, ya mere a gbanwere ọnọdụ na nsonaazụ.
l-m-h3-b0c36-22.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ oke zuru oke nke ndị dị mma ma nwee ọrịa, ọ bụghị oke n’etiti ndị dị mma.
l-m-h3-b0c36-22.s.s1.r.d: Nke a bụ ohere nsonaazụ ọma naanị; ọ naghị agụnye ma onye ahụ ọ na-arịa ọrịa.
l-m-h3-b0c36-22.s.s1.explain: “Ụfọdụ ndị nwetara ule dị mma” bụ ọnọdụ T; ihe anyị chọrọ ịma bụ D, ya mere ọ bụ P(D|T).
l-m-h3-b0c36-22.s.s2.model.0: “Ọnọdụ n’etiti ndị nwetara nsonaazụ ọma” bụ ọnọdụ, ihe omume a chọrọ bụ inwe ọrịa; ya mere dee P(D|T), tinye ọnọdụ n’aka nri nke akara kwụ ọtọ.
l-m-h3-b0c36-22.s.s2.model.1: Oke ahụ na-ejedebe naanị n’ebe ndị nwetara ule ọma; T bụ ọnọdụ, oke ndị nwere ọrịa n’ime otu a bụ P(D|T).

l-m-h3-b0c36-23.title: Iji usoro gbanwee gradient descent
l-m-h3-b0c36-23.goal: Gbanwee otu nzọụkwụ gradient descent ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ (nhata, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe.
l-m-h3-b0c36-23.material: N’okwu, otu nzọụkwụ gradient descent bụ “site n’ọnọdụ ugbu a, gaa n’akụkụ megidere mkpọda, ogologo njem bụ mkpọda mụbara na learning rate η.”
l-m-h3-b0c36-23.s.s1.prompt: Kedu usoro nwere otu ihe pụtara dịka nkọwa a?
l-m-h3-b0c36-23.s.s1.r.a: Nke a na-aga n’akụkụ mkpọda, n’ebe uru na-abawanye.
l-m-h3-b0c36-23.s.s1.r.b: E ji ọnọdụ x mee ihe kama mkpọda f'(x).
l-m-h3-b0c36-23.s.s1.r.d: E lebara ọnọdụ ugbu a x anya.
l-m-h3-b0c36-23.s.s1.explain: Ịga megide mkpọda pụtara iwepụ, ogologo njem bụ η·f'(x); ya mere ọ bụ x−η·f'(x).
l-m-h3-b0c36-23.s.s2.model.0: Ị ga-aga megide mkpọda, ya mere wepụ ya; mmegharị ahụ bụ η mụbara na f'(x), ya mere ọ ghọrọ x−η f'(x).
l-m-h3-b0c36-23.s.s2.model.1: Ịmalite n’ọnọdụ x ugbu a ma wepụ η f'(x) na-eme otu mmegharị ahụ dịka nkọwa; ya mere ihe ọ pụtara bụ otu.

l-m-h3-b0c36-24.title: Iji okwu ọzọ kwuo oke ndị ọrịa a hapụrụ
l-m-h3-b0c36-24.goal: Gbanwee “oke a hapụrụ n’etiti ndị nwere ọrịa n’ezie” ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ (nhata, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe.
l-m-h3-b0c36-24.material: N’ime ule 100, a chọpụtara ndị ọrịa 30 nke ọma, echefuru ndị ọrịa 10, a kpọrọ ndị ahụike 5 ndị ọrịa n’amaghị ama, a chọpụtara ndị ahụike 55 nke ọma.
l-m-h3-b0c36-24.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nke bụ “oke a hapụrụ n’etiti ndị nwere ọrịa n’ezie”?
l-m-h3-b0c36-24.s.s1.r.a: I jiri ule 100 niile dịka onye nkewa. Onye nkewa bụ ọnụọgụ ndị ọrịa.
l-m-h3-b0c36-24.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ oke a chọpụtara, ọ bụghị nke a hapụrụ.
l-m-h3-b0c36-24.s.s1.r.d: Ị gbakọrọ ya site n’etiti ndị ahụike e kwuru na ha na-arịa ọrịa.
l-m-h3-b0c36-24.s.s1.explain: E nwere ndị ọrịa 30+10=40 n’ezie, echefuru 10 n’ime ha. 10/40=25%, nke bụ ihe fọdụrụ ma e wepụ recall 75%.
l-m-h3-b0c36-24.s.s2.model.0: Echefuru 10 n’ime ndị ọrịa 40 n’ezie; ya mere ọ bụ 10/40=25%, nke hà nhata 1 ewepụ oke a chọpụtara, 75%.
l-m-h3-b0c36-24.s.s2.model.1: Onye nkewa ga-abụ 40, ọnụọgụ ndị nwere ọrịa n’ezie; dee 10/40=25%, ọ bụghị 10/100.

l-m-h3-b0c37-21.title: Ide tebụl dịka matriks
l-m-h3-b0c37-21.goal: Gbanwee tebụl ngwaahịa fọdụrụ n’ụlọ ahịa dịka ụdị ọzọ (okwu mgbakọ, tebụl, eserese, okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere o ji nwee otu ihe ọ pụtara.
l-m-h3-b0c37-21.material: Ụlọ ahịa A nwere apụl 3 na pears 2, Ụlọ ahịa B nwekwara apụl 1 na pears 4. Dee ya dịka matriks ebe ahịrị bụ ụlọ ahịa (usoro A, B) na kọlụm bụ mkpụrụ osisi (usoro apụl, pear).
l-m-h3-b0c37-21.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ matriks na-egosi otu ozi ahụ.
l-m-h3-b0c37-21.s.s1.r.a: E gwakọtara ọnọdụ ụkpụrụ, ya mere a na-agụ pears nke Ụlọ ahịa A dịka 4.
l-m-h3-b0c37-21.s.s1.r.b: A gbanwere ahịrị na kọlụm, ya mere ahịrị mbụ ghọrọ ngwaahịa apụl.
l-m-h3-b0c37-21.s.s1.r.c: A gbanwere usoro kọlụm, ya mere kọlụm mbụ ghọrọ ngwaahịa pear.
l-m-h3-b0c37-21.s.s1.explain: Ahịrị mbụ bụ Ụlọ ahịa A (apụl 3, pears 2), nke abụọ bụ Ụlọ ahịa B (apụl 1, pears 4), ya mere ọ bụ (3 2; 1 4).
l-m-h3-b0c37-21.s.s2.model.0: N’ahịrị mbụ dee 3 na 2, apụl na pears nke Ụlọ ahịa A n’usoro ahụ; n’ahịrị nke abụọ dee 1 na 4 nke Ụlọ ahịa B, ya mere ọ pụtara otu ihe na tebụl.
l-m-h3-b0c37-21.s.s2.model.1: Ahịrị bụ ụlọ ahịa, kọlụm bụ mkpụrụ osisi, ya mere ụkpụrụ ọ bụla kwekọrọ na otu sel tebụl, nke na-eme ka ọ bụrụ otu ozi ahụ.

l-m-h3-b0c37-22.title: Iji okwu kọwaa ihe expected value pụtara
l-m-h3-b0c37-22.goal: Gbanwee expected value 3.5 nke ịtụ dice ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ (okwu mgbakọ, tebụl, eserese, okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere o ji nwee otu ihe ọ pụtara.
l-m-h3-b0c37-22.material: Expected value nke nọmba na-apụta mgbe ị tụbara otu dice ziri ezi bụ 3.5. Ị chọrọ iji okwu ndụ kwa ụbọchị kọwaa ihe nọmba a pụtara n’ezie.
l-m-h3-b0c37-22.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrịokwu nwere otu ihe na expected value 3.5.
l-m-h3-b0c37-22.s.s1.o.a: Ọ bụrụ na ị tụba ya otu ugboro, 3.5 ga-apụta
l-m-h3-b0c37-22.s.s1.r.a: Dice enweghị ihu 3.5. Ọ bụghị nsonaazụ nke otu igba.
l-m-h3-b0c37-22.s.s1.r.b: 3.5 abụghị ihu, ihu niile nwekwara otu probability.
l-m-h3-b0c37-22.s.s1.o.c: Ma ọ bụ 3 ma ọ bụ 4 na-apụta mgbe niile
l-m-h3-b0c37-22.s.s1.r.c: Ihu ndị ọzọ nwekwara ike ịpụta. Expected value bụ nha nkezi.
l-m-h3-b0c37-22.s.s1.o.d: Ọ bụrụ na ị tụba ya ọtụtụ ugboro were nkezi, ọ na-abịaru nso 3.5
l-m-h3-b0c37-22.s.s1.explain: Expected value abụghị nsonaazụ nke otu igba; ọ bụ uru nkezi na-abịaru nso mgbe a na-emegharị igba ọtụtụ ugboro.
l-m-h3-b0c37-22.s.s2.model.0: Nkezi ihu bụ (1+2+…+6)/6=3.5; ka igba na-adị ọtụtụ, nkezi na-abịaru nso uru a, ya mere o pụtara otu ihe ahụ.
l-m-h3-b0c37-22.s.s2.model.1: Expected value bụ ihe dịka nkezi igba ugboro ugboro, ọ bụghị otu ihu, ya mere ahịrịokwu na-ekwu na nkezi na-abịaru nso 3.5 bụ nke ziri ezi.

l-m-h3-b0c37-23.title: Ịgụ error function n’okwu
l-m-h3-b0c37-23.goal: Gbanwee error function J(w)=2(w−1)²+5 ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ (okwu mgbakọ, tebụl, eserese, okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe.
l-m-h3-b0c37-23.material: Function na-egosi njehie ụdị bụ J(w)=2(w−1)²+5. w bụ uru ị na-agbanwe, J bụ njehie. Lelee okwu mgbakọ ma kọwaa ya n’okwu gbasara uru minimum.
l-m-h3-b0c37-23.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrịokwu nwere otu ihe na okwu mgbakọ ahụ.
l-m-h3-b0c37-23.s.s1.o.a: Njehie kacha nta na w=−1, ọ bụkwa 5
l-m-h3-b0c37-23.s.s1.r.a: Uru na-eme ka w−1 hà nhata 0 bụ 1, ọ bụghị −1.
l-m-h3-b0c37-23.s.s1.o.b: Njehie kacha nta na w=1, ọ bụkwa 5
l-m-h3-b0c37-23.s.s1.o.c: Njehie kacha nta na w=1, ọ bụkwa 2
l-m-h3-b0c37-23.s.s1.r.c: Ị were coefficient 2 dịka uru minimum.
l-m-h3-b0c37-23.s.s1.o.d: Njehie kacha nta na w=5, ọ bụkwa 1
l-m-h3-b0c37-23.s.s1.r.d: Ị were constant 5 dịka uru w.
l-m-h3-b0c37-23.s.s1.explain: 2(w−1)² kacha nta na w=1 ebe ọ bụ 0. Mgbe ahụ J=5, ya mere uru minimum bụ 5.
l-m-h3-b0c37-23.s.s2.model.0: (w−1)² kacha nta na w=1 ebe ọ bụ 0, J aghọkwa 5; ya mere ọ bụ otu ihe na ịsị njehie kacha nta mgbe w=1.
l-m-h3-b0c37-23.s.s2.model.1: Okwu square na-adị 0 ma ọ bụ karịa, ya mere ọ bụrụ na w=1 na-eme ka ọ bụrụ 0, 5 fọdụrụ bụ uru minimum, nke pụtara otu ihe ahụ.

l-m-h3-b0c37-24.title: Iji ahịrịokwu kọwaa precision
l-m-h3-b0c37-24.goal: Gbanwee “precision 80%” ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ (okwu mgbakọ, tebụl, eserese, okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe.
l-m-h3-b0c37-24.material: N’ime ọnọdụ 50 ụdị kpọrọ positive, 40 bụ positive n’ezie. A na-akpọ nsonaazụ a precision 80%. Ị chọrọ iji okwu kọwaa ihe ọ pụtara.
l-m-h3-b0c37-24.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrịokwu nwere otu ihe na precision 80%.
l-m-h3-b0c37-24.s.s1.r.a: Nke ahụ bụ recall. Denominator ya bụ positive n’ezie.
l-m-h3-b0c37-24.s.s1.o.b: O kpebiri 80% nke ọnọdụ niile nke ọma
l-m-h3-b0c37-24.s.s1.r.b: Nke ahụ bụ accuracy. Ọ gụnyekwara ọnọdụ nkịtị a chọpụtara nke ọma.
l-m-h3-b0c37-24.s.s1.o.c: 80% nke ọnọdụ ọ kpọrọ positive bụ positive n’ezie
l-m-h3-b0c37-24.s.s1.r.d: Oke positive dị iche na precision.
l-m-h3-b0c37-24.s.s1.explain: Precision bụ oke true positive n’etiti ihe ụdị kpọrọ positive. Ọ bụ 40 n’ime 50, ya bụ 80%.
l-m-h3-b0c37-24.s.s2.model.0: Denominator bụ ọnọdụ 50 ụdị kpọrọ positive, numerator bụ positive n’ezie 40 n’ime ha; ya mere ọ pụtara na oku positive 80% ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c37-24.s.s2.model.1: Precision na-egosi ntụkwasị obi oku positive, ya mere ọ pụtara otu ihe na ịsị 80% nke ihe akpọrọ positive bụ eziokwu.

l-m-h3-b0c38-06.title: Iji nhata matriks degharịa usoro nhata
l-m-h3-b0c38-06.goal: Degharịa ụdị ngwaahịa matriks nke usoro nhata ka ọ bụrụ ihe nnọchiteanya ọzọ (nhata, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe.
l-m-h3-b0c38-06.material: Anyị chọrọ ide usoro nhata 2x+y=5, x−y=1 dịka nhata matriks ụdị (matriks koefishenti)(x; y)=(akụkụ aka nri). Semicolon (;) na-egosi ahịrị ọhụrụ n’ime matriks.
l-m-h3-b0c38-06.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nhata matriks nwere otu ihe pụtara dịka usoro nhata mbụ?
l-m-h3-b0c38-06.s.s1.r.a: Koefishenti y n’ahịrị nke abụọ bụ -1, ma e dere ya dịka +1.
l-m-h3-b0c38-06.s.s1.r.b: A gbanwere usoro 5 na 1 n’akụkụ aka nri.
l-m-h3-b0c38-06.s.s1.explain: Dee koefishenti nke nhata ọ bụla n’otu ahịrị, dee akụkụ aka nri n’otu kọlụm n’otu usoro. x=2, y=1 na-emezu nhata abụọ ahụ.

l-m-h3-b0c38-15.material: Akara ajụjụ X nwere ike ịbụ 1 na ohere 0.2, akara 2 na 0.5, akara 3 na 0.3. Uru atụ anya bụ E(X)=1×0.2+2×0.5+3×0.3=2.1. Họrọ okwu ọzọ nwere otu ihe pụtara.
l-m-h3-b0c38-15.s.s1.prompt: Kedu okwu nwere otu ihe pụtara dịka E(X)?

l-m-h3-b0c38-15.s.s1.r.a: Ị pụghị ịchọta uru etiti site n’ogo ohere.
l-m-h3-b0c38-15.s.s1.r.b: Nke ahụ bụ mode. Uru atụ anya bụ nkezi nwere arọ.
l-m-h3-b0c38-15.s.s1.o.c: Nkezi dị mfe nke isi 1, 2, 3 bụ isi 2.
l-m-h3-b0c38-15.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ nkezi dị mfe, anaghị etinye ohere n'ịtụ arọ.
l-m-h3-b0c38-15.s.s1.o.d: Nkezi mgbe mmadụ 2, 5, 3 n'ime mmadụ 10 nwetara isi 1, 2, 3.
l-m-h3-b0c38-15.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ n'ime mmadụ 10, mmadụ 2 nweta isi 1, mmadụ 5 nweta 2, mmadụ 3 nweta 3, nkezi bụ (2+10+9)÷10=2.1, otu ihe ahụ.
l-m-h3-b0c38-15.s.s2.model.0: Mgbanwe ohere ka ọ bụrụ oke mmadụ na-enye (1×2+2×5+3×3)÷10=2.1; ya mere ọ pụtara otu ihe na uru atụ anya.
l-m-h3-b0c38-15.s.s2.model.1: Uru atụ anya bụ nkezi a tụrụ arọ site n'ihe gbasara ohere; ya mere ọ na-enye otu uru ahụ dịka nkezi mmadụ 10 n'otu oke ahụ.

l-m-h3-b0c38-23.material: Mean squared error (MSE) bụ (1/n)Σ(predicted−actual)². Maka amụma [2,5,4] na ezigbo [3,5,2], ọ bụ (1+0+4)÷3=5/3. Ka anyị jiri okwu kọwaa usoro a.

l-m-h3-b0c38-31.title: Iji okwu kọwaa ọdịiche n’etiti training error na validation error
l-m-h3-b0c38-31.goal: Degharịa ọnọdụ training error 2% na validation error 18% n’ụdị ọzọ (usoro, tebụl, eserese, okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe.
l-m-h3-b0c38-31.material: Njehie ụdị bụ 2% na data ọzụzụ, 18% na data validation e debere iche. Anyị chọrọ iji okwu kọwaa nọmba ndị a.
l-m-h3-b0c38-31.s.s1.prompt: Nkọwa nke nwere otu ihe bụ nke aṅaa?
l-m-h3-b0c38-31.s.s1.o.a: Ka data na-adị ọtụtụ, njehie na-abawanye
l-m-h3-b0c38-31.s.s1.r.a: Site na nọmba naanị, ị gaghị ama mmekọrịta n’etiti ọnụọgụ data na njehie.
l-m-h3-b0c38-31.s.s1.o.b: Ọ mụtabeghị nke ọma n’ihi na ọ pụghị ọbụna ịdaba na data ọzụzụ
l-m-h3-b0c38-31.s.s1.r.b: Training error dị ala na 2%, ya mere ọ bụghị under-learning.
l-m-h3-b0c38-31.s.s1.o.c: Ọ dabara data ọzụzụ nke ọma ma adịghị ike na data ọhụrụ
l-m-h3-b0c38-31.s.s1.o.d: Data validation dị mfe karịa data ọzụzụ
l-m-h3-b0c38-31.s.s1.r.d: Validation error ka ukwuu, ya mere n’ezie akụkụ ahụ ka sie ike.
l-m-h3-b0c38-31.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na training error dị ala ma validation error dị elu, ọ bụ overfitting: e mere ka ọ dabara data ọzụzụ nke ukwuu.
l-m-h3-b0c38-31.s.s2.model.0: Training error dị ala na 2% ma validation error dị elu na 18%, ya mere ọ dabara naanị data ọzụzụ nke ọma, adịghịkwa ike na data ọhụrụ.
l-m-h3-b0c38-31.s.s2.model.1: Njehie dị ukwuu karịa na data validation, nke bụ data ọhụrụ; ya mere ị nwere ike ịsị na ọ nọ n’ọnọdụ overfitting, ọ fọrọ nke nta ka ọ cheta data ahụ.

l-m-h3-b0c40-22.material: Mmiri na-asọpụta na ọkpọkọ na ọnụego 3.6 m³ kwa awa. 1 m³ bụ 1,000 L. Ị chọrọ igosipụta otu ọnụego ahụ dịka L kwa sekọnd.

l-m-h3-b0c40-22.s.s2.model.0: 3.6 m³ bụ 3,600 L, awa 1 bụ sekọnd 3,600; ya mere 3,600÷3,600=1, ya bụ 1 L kwa sekọnd.
l-m-h3-b0c40-22.s.s2.model.1: Mgbe a gbanwere ha abụọ ka L na sekọnd, numerator na denominator hà, 3,600; ya mere 1 L kwa sekọnd.

l-m-h3-b0c41-22.s.s1.r.c: Nke a gbanwere oge naanị, n’enweghị ịgbanwe km ka ọ bụrụ m.
l-m-h3-b0c41-22.s.s1.r.d: Awa 1 abụghị sekọnd 60; ọ bụ sekọnd 3600.
l-m-h3-b0c41-22.s.s1.explain: 36km=36000m, awa 1=sekọnd 3600. 36000÷3600=10; ya mere ọ bụ 10 m/s.

l-m-h3-b0c42-28.title: Ebee ka nkezi nlele na-agbakọta?
l-m-h3-b0c42-28.goal: Kwuo n’ụzọ ọzọ (usoro, tebụl, eserese, okwu) eziokwu na nnukwu ìgwè nwere nkezi 50 na ndapụ ọkọlọtọ 10; kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe.
l-m-h3-b0c42-28.material: Akara ule nwere nkezi 50 na ndapụ ọkọlọtọ 10. Nkezi nke nlele ụmụ akwụkwọ 25 a họọrọ n’enweghị mmasị nwere nkesa nkezi 50 na ndapụ ọkọlọtọ 2. Kwuo eziokwu a n’okwu.
l-m-h3-b0c42-28.s.s1.o.a: Ihe dị ka 95% nke akara ụmụ akwụkwọ dị n’etiti 46 na 54
l-m-h3-b0c42-28.s.s1.r.a: E gụrụ nso nkezi nlele dịka nso akara ụmụ akwụkwọ n’otu n’otu.
l-m-h3-b0c42-28.s.s1.o.b: Ọ bụrụ na ị họrọ ụmụ akwụkwọ 25 oge ọ bụla, nkezi ahụ na-abụ 50 kpọmkwem mgbe niile
l-m-h3-b0c42-28.s.s1.r.b: Nkezi nlele na-agbanwe ntakịrị oge ọ bụla ị họọrọ.
l-m-h3-b0c42-28.s.s1.o.c: Ọtụtụ nkezi nlele nke ụmụ akwụkwọ 25 dị n'etiti isi 46 na 54.
l-m-h3-b0c42-28.s.s1.o.d: Nkezi nlele na-adị obere isi 2 mgbe niile karịa nkezi ọnụ ọgụgụ mmadụ niile.
l-m-h3-b0c42-28.s.s1.r.d: 2 bụ mgbasa ọkọlọtọ nke nkezi nlele, ọ bụghị ọdịiche dị n'etiti ya na nkezi ọnụ ọgụgụ mmadụ niile.
l-m-h3-b0c42-28.s.s1.explain: Mgbasa ọkọlọtọ nke nkezi nlele bụ 2, ya mere ihe dị ka 95% dị na 50±4, ya bụ isi 46 ruo 54. Akara onye ọ bụla gbasasịrị karịa nke ukwuu.
l-m-h3-b0c42-28.s.s2.model.0: Mgbasa ọkọlọtọ nke nkezi nlele bụ 2, ya mere ọtụtụ n'ime ha na-adị n'ime ±4 site na nkezi 50, ya bụ n'etiti isi 46 na 54.
l-m-h3-b0c42-28.s.s2.model.1: Nke a abụghị maka akara onye ọ bụla, kama ọ bụ nkesa nkezi ụmụ akwụkwọ 25, ya mere mgbasa ahụ na-adị ntakịrị ma ha na-adị n'etiti isi 46 na 54.

l-m-h3-b0c42-31.title: Kedu ka ị ga-esi dee akụkọ “ihe ize ndụ ji okpukpu 2”?
l-m-h3-b0c42-31.topic: Ihe ize ndụ dị n'ogo ibe ya na ọnụ ọgụgụ zuru oke
l-m-h3-b0c42-31.goal: Degharịa isi akụkọ “ihe ize ndụ mmetụta ọjọọ ji okpukpu 2” n'ụdị ọzọ (usoro mgbakọ, tebụl, eserese, ma ọ bụ okwu) ma kọwaa ihe mere o ji nwee otu ihe ahụ.
l-m-h3-b0c42-31.material: Isi akụkọ: “Ịṅụ ọgwụ a pụtara ihe ize ndụ mmetụta ọjọọ ji okpukpu 2!” Akụkụ isi akụkọ ahụ sịrị, “Ọnụọgụ ndị nwere mmetụta ọjọọ si na 3 ruo 6 n'ime ìgwè mmadụ 1 nke 10,000 ọ bụla.”
l-m-h3-b0c42-31.s.s1.prompt: Ahịrịokwu nke na-ezipụta otu eziokwu ahụ dị ka isi akụkọ ahụ nke ọma bụ nke?
l-m-h3-b0c42-31.s.s1.o.a: 6% nke ndị na-aṅụ ya na-enwe mmetụta ọjọọ
l-m-h3-b0c42-31.s.s1.o.b: N'ime ìgwè mmadụ 1 nke 10,000, mmadụ 6 ọzọ malitere inwe mmetụta ọjọọ
l-m-h3-b0c42-31.s.s1.r.b: Mmadụ 6 bụ ngụkọta ndị nwere ya, mmụba ahụ bụ mmadụ 3.
l-m-h3-b0c42-31.s.s1.o.c: 1 n'ime mmadụ 2 ndị na-aṅụ ya na-enwe mmetụta ọjọọ
l-m-h3-b0c42-31.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụ 6÷10000, ọ bụghị 1 n'ime mmadụ 2.
l-m-h3-b0c42-31.s.s1.o.d: Mmetụta ọjọọ si na mmadụ 3 ruo 6 n'ime ìgwè mmadụ 1 nke 10,000 ọ bụla, mmụba ya bụ mmadụ 3
l-m-h3-b0c42-31.s.s1.explain: “Okpukpu 2” bụ oke nke mmadụ 3 ghọrọ mmadụ 6. N'ọnụọgụ zuru oke, ọ bụ mmụba mmadụ 3 n'ime ìgwè mmadụ 1 nke 10,000 ọ bụla.
l-m-h3-b0c42-31.s.s2.model.0: Ọ si na 3 ruo 6, ya bụ okpukpu 2, mana ọ bụ naanị mmadụ 3 ọzọ n'ime ìgwè mmadụ 1 nke 10,000 ka metụtara, ya mere ekwesịghị ịghọta ya dị ka nnukwu mmụba n'ihe ize ndụ.
l-m-h3-b0c42-31.s.s2.model.1: Enwere ike idegharị okwu ikwu “okpukpu 2” ka ọ bụrụ na mmadụ 3 ghọrọ mmadụ 6 n'ime ìgwè mmadụ 1 nke 10,000, mmụba ya bụkwa mmadụ 3, ya mere ahịrịokwu a ziri ezi.

l-m-h3-b0c43-15.material: Ahịrị regression maka oge ije x nkeji na calorie ọkụ y kcal bụ y=30+8x.

l-m-h3-b0c43-26.title: Gịnị ka “ịjụ echiche ahụ” pụtara n'okwu nkịtị?
l-m-h3-b0c43-26.goal: Gbanwee nsonaazụ ịjụ echiche na ọkwa mkpa 5% ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ (usoro mgbakọ, tebụl, eserese, ma ọ bụ okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere ha ji pụta otu ihe.
l-m-h3-b0c43-26.material: N'ime ule, a jụrụ “echiche na mmetụta adịghị” n'ọkwa mkpa 5%. Tinye nsonaazụ a n'okwu nkịtị.
l-m-h3-b0c43-26.s.s1.o.a: Ohere na echiche nke enweghị mmetụta ziri ezi bụ 5%
l-m-h3-b0c43-26.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụghị ohere na echiche ahụ ziri ezi; ọ bụ otú nsonaazụ ahụ si dị ụkọ.
l-m-h3-b0c43-26.s.s1.o.b: Naanị 5% nke ndị sonyere nwere mmetụta
l-m-h3-b0c43-26.s.s1.r.b: 5% abụghị òkè ndị sonyere hụrụ mmetụta.
l-m-h3-b0c43-26.s.s1.o.c: Ọ bụrụ na enweghị mmetụta, nsonaazụ dị otu a dị ụkọ, ohere ya erughị 5%
l-m-h3-b0c43-26.s.s1.r.d: 5% abụghị ogo mmetụta; ọ bụ ụkpụrụ ikpe.
l-m-h3-b0c43-26.s.s1.explain: Ọ pụtara na ọ bụrụ na anyị ewere na mmetụta adịghị, ohere ịnweta nsonaazụ dị otu a erughị 5%, ya mere o siri ike iche na ọ bụ naanị ohere kpatara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c43-26.s.s2.model.0: Ọ pụtara na mgbe anyị chere na mmetụta adịghị, ohere ịnweta nsonaazụ dị otu a erughị 5%, ya mere o siri ike iwere ya dị ka ihe mberede.
l-m-h3-b0c43-26.s.s2.model.1: 5% abụghị ohere na echiche ahụ ziri ezi; ọ bụ ụkpụrụ maka otú nsonaazụ si dị ụkọ n'okpuru echiche ahụ, ya mere ahịrịokwu a pụtara otu ihe ahụ.

l-m-h3-b0c43-31.title: Ọ bụrụ na ọ daa 20% wee rịa 20%, ọ̀ ga-adị ka mmalite?
l-m-h3-b0c43-31.goal: Gbanwee nsonaazụ ahịa dara 20% wee rịa 20% ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ (usoro mgbakọ, tebụl, eserese, ma ọ bụ okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere ha ji pụta otu ihe.
l-m-h3-b0c43-31.material: Ahịa ụlọ ahịa dara 20% n'ọnwa a, wee rịa 20% n'ọnwa na-abịa. Were ahịa mbụ dị ka 100 ma kwuo otu nsonaazụ ahụ n'okwu ọzọ.
l-m-h3-b0c43-31.s.s1.prompt: Ahịrịokwu nke kwuru otu nsonaazụ ahụ nke ọma bụ nke?
l-m-h3-b0c43-31.s.s1.o.b: Ọ bụ otu ihe na mmalite
l-m-h3-b0c43-31.s.s1.r.b: Ịgbakwunye 20% na 80, nke bụ ihe fọdụrụ mgbe e wepụrụ 20%, na-enye 96, ọ bụghị 100.
l-m-h3-b0c43-31.s.s1.r.c: Ọ rịgooro site na 80 mgbe ọ daa, ya mere ọ gaghị akarị mmalite.
l-m-h3-b0c43-31.s.s1.explain: Mbelata 20% nke 100 bụ 80, mmụba 20% nke 80 bụ 96. Nke ahụ bụ 96% nke mmalite, ya mere ọ dị ala 4%.
l-m-h3-b0c43-31.s.s2.model.0: 100 dara 20% wee ghọọ 80; mgbe ahụ, agbakwunyere 16, nke bụ 20% nke 80, wee mee 96. Nke ahụ bụ 96% nke mmalite, ya mere ọ dị ala 4%.
l-m-h3-b0c43-31.s.s2.model.1: A gbakọrọ mmụba 20% ahụ site na 80 fọdụrụ mgbe ọ dara, ya mere ọ laghachighị na mmalite ma ghọọ 96.

l-m-h3-b0c44-23.title: Iji okwu ọzọ kwuo margin of error
l-m-h3-b0c44-23.goal: Degharịa support rate 52% na margin of error ±3 percentage points ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ, ma kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu.
l-m-h3-b0c44-23.material: Poll kwupụtara, “support rate 52%, confidence level 95%, margin of error ±3%p”. Jiri okwu ọzọ kwuo ọkwa a pụtara otu ihe.
l-m-h3-b0c44-23.s.s1.o.a: A na-eme atụmatụ na support rate n’ezie bụ ihe dịka 49% ruo 55%
l-m-h3-b0c44-23.s.s1.o.b: 49% ruo 55% nke ndị zara ajụjụ kwadoro ya
l-m-h3-b0c44-23.s.s1.r.b: Support rate ndị zara pụtara 52%. Interval ahụ gbasara population.
l-m-h3-b0c44-23.s.s1.o.c: Support rate n’ezie dị n’etiti 49% na 55% n’ezie
l-m-h3-b0c44-23.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụ confidence 95%, ya mere ị gaghị ekwu “n’ezie”.
l-m-h3-b0c44-23.s.s1.o.d: Support rate rịrị ma ọ bụ daa 3% site na 52%
l-m-h3-b0c44-23.s.s1.r.d: ±3 percentage points bụ njehie nyocha, ọ bụghị ego mgbanwe.
l-m-h3-b0c44-23.s.s1.explain: 52% ±3 percentage points bụ 49% ruo 55%, nke a bụ interval e mere atụmatụ maka support rate population.
l-m-h3-b0c44-23.s.s2.model.0: 52% ±3 percentage points bụ 49% ruo 55%; ebe nke a bụ interval e mere atụmatụ maka population proportion, ọ pụtara otu ihe na nkwupụta mbụ.
l-m-h3-b0c44-23.s.s2.model.1: Iwepụ ma tinye margin of error na sample proportion na-enye interval ahụ; ya mere ọ pụtara otu ihe na ịsị na a na-eme atụmatụ support rate n’ezie dịka 49% ruo 55%.

l-m-h3-b0c44-24.title: Iji standard deviation kọwaa akara 85
l-m-h3-b0c44-24.goal: Degharịa akara 85 mgbe mean bụ 70, standard deviation bụ 10 ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ, ma kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu.
l-m-h3-b0c44-24.material: N’ule mean ya bụ 70 na standard deviation 10, akara nwa akwụkwọ bụ 85. Jiri mean na standard deviation kwuo akara a n’ụzọ ọzọ.
l-m-h3-b0c44-24.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ okwu mgbakọ nwere otu ihe na akara 85.
l-m-h3-b0c44-24.s.s1.r.b: Ọ dị elu site na isi 15, ya bụ ugboro 1.5 n’ihe nkeji standard deviation.
l-m-h3-b0c44-24.s.s1.r.c: Nke a gwakọtara ọdịiche akara 15 na pasentị (%).
l-m-h3-b0c44-24.s.s1.r.d: Ọ dị elu site na isi 15. Dịka oke, ọ dị elu ihe dịka 21%.
l-m-h3-b0c44-24.s.s1.explain: 85−70=15 na 15÷10=1.5, ya mere ọ bụ standard deviations 1.5 n’elu mean.
l-m-h3-b0c44-24.s.s2.model.0: 85−70=15 na 15÷10=1.5, ya mere ọ pụtara standard deviations 1.5 n’elu mean.
l-m-h3-b0c44-24.s.s2.model.1: Standard deviation bụ isi 10, ya mere ọdịiche isi 15 bụ nzọụkwụ 1.5, a pụkwara ide ya dịka standardized value 1.5.

l-m-h3-b0c44-26.material: Anyị haziri akara ụmụ akwụkwọ 100, chọpụta na quartile nke 1 bụ 40, median bụ 55, quartile nke 3 bụ 70. Jiri ahịrịokwu kwuo nchịkọta a ọzọ.
l-m-h3-b0c44-26.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrịokwu nwere otu ihe na nchịkọta ahụ.

l-m-h3-b0c44-26.s.s1.r.b: 55 bụ median, ya mere ihe dịka 50% nwetara 55 ma ọ bụ karịa.
l-m-h3-b0c44-26.s.s1.r.c: Ọbụna ma median bụ 55, enweghị nkwa na mean bụkwa 55.

l-m-h3-b0c44-26.s.s1.r.d: 40 bụ quartile nke 1, ya mere ihe dịka 25% nwetara 40 ma ọ bụ obere.
l-m-h3-b0c44-26.s.s1.explain: 25% dị n’okpuru quartile nke 1, 25% dịkwa n’elu quartile nke 3; ya mere 50% etiti dị n’etiti 40 na 70.
l-m-h3-b0c44-26.s.s2.model.0: 50% etiti dị n’etiti quartile nke 1 na nke 3, ya bụ ọkara ụmụ akwụkwọ dị n’etiti 40 na 70.

l-m-h3-b0c45-25.title: Gịnị bụ oke ugboro nke eriri ogologo ha dị n'oke 2:3?
l-m-h3-b0c45-25.goal: Degharịa oke ogologo eriri abụọ ka ọ bụrụ oke ugboro n'ụdị ọzọ (nhata, tebụl, eserese, ma ọ bụ okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu.
l-m-h3-b0c45-25.material: Maka eriri abụọ nwere otu ihe na otu esemokwu, eriri dị mkpụmkpụ na-enwe ugboro ka ukwuu, ugboro ahụ na-adabere n'ụzọ megidere ogologo. Oke ogologo eriri dị mkpụmkpụ na ogologo bụ 2:3.
l-m-h3-b0c45-25.s.s1.prompt: Oke ugboro (eriri dị mkpụmkpụ : eriri dị ogologo) bụ ole?
l-m-h3-b0c45-25.s.s1.r.a: I mere square ya. Ndabere megidere anaghị apụta ime square.
l-m-h3-b0c45-25.s.s1.r.b: I jiri oke ogologo ahụ dịka ọ dị. Ebe ọ na-adabere n'ụzọ megidere, ị ga-atụgharị ya.
l-m-h3-b0c45-25.s.s1.r.d: Ogologo ha dị iche, ya mere ugboro ha dị iche.
l-m-h3-b0c45-25.s.s1.explain: Ugboro na-adabere n'ụzọ megidere ogologo, ya mere tụgharịa oke ahụ. Eriri dị mkpụmkpụ na-ada elu, ya mere oke ya bụ 3:2.
l-m-h3-b0c45-25.s.s2.model.0: Ndabere megidere pụtara na ngwaahịa ahụ na-adị otu; ya mere oke ogologo 2:3 na-aghọ oke ugboro 3:2.
l-m-h3-b0c45-25.s.s2.model.1: Eriri dị mkpụmkpụ na-eme ụda elu, ya mere akụkụ nwere ugboro ka ukwuu bụ eriri dị mkpụmkpụ; oke ya bụ 3:2.

l-m-h3-b0c45-26.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nhata na-egosi na ha na-ezukọta n'enweghị oghere?

l-m-h3-b0c45-26.s.s1.r.b: Ị gbanwere ọnụ ọgụgụ ụdị. Ngụkọta ahụ karịrị 360°.
l-m-h3-b0c45-26.s.s1.r.d: Ị gbakwụnyere naanị ọnụ ọgụgụ ụdị, ọ bụghị nha akụkụ ha.

l-m-h3-b0c45-26.s.s2.model.0: Akụkụ gbara gburugburu otu isi ga-abụ 360°; dee ma 60°×3 tinyere 90°×2 na-eme 360°.
l-m-h3-b0c45-26.s.s2.model.1: Ọ na-aghọ 180°+180°=360°; ya mere nhata na-amụba akụkụ ọ bụla na ọnụ ọgụgụ ụdị ya wee gbakwunye ha na-egosi na ha na-ezukọta n'enweghị oghere.

l-m-h3-b0c46-23.title: Note octave abụọ dị elu bụ ugboro ole frequency?
l-m-h3-b0c46-23.goal: Degharịa frequency note dị octave abụọ elu ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ, ma kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu.
l-m-h3-b0c46-23.material: Ịrị otu octave na-amụba frequency na 2. E nwere note octave abụọ elu karịa note 110Hz.
l-m-h3-b0c46-23.s.s1.prompt: Kedu okwu mgbakọ na-egosi frequency note a nke ọma?
l-m-h3-b0c46-23.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ uru ịrị naanị otu octave (220Hz).
l-m-h3-b0c46-23.s.s1.r.b: Nke a were octave ọ bụla dịka okpukpu 4. Ọ bụ okpukpu 2 ugboro abụọ.
l-m-h3-b0c46-23.s.s1.r.d: Ọ na-arị site n’ịmụba, ọ bụghị site n’ịgbakwunye.
l-m-h3-b0c46-23.s.s1.explain: Octave ọ bụla bụ okpukpu 2, ya mere octave abụọ bụ okpukpu 2×2=4, 110×4=440Hz.
l-m-h3-b0c46-23.s.s2.model.0: Octave ọ bụla na-amụba na 2, ya mere octave abụọ nwere ike ide dịka okpukpu 4, nke bụ 2 e mụbara ugboro abụọ.
l-m-h3-b0c46-23.s.s2.model.1: Ọ na-aga site na 110Hz ruo 220Hz, site na 220Hz ruo 440Hz; ya mere ọ bụ otu ihe na 110×2×2=440.

l-m-h3-b0c46-24.material: Ị tụbara yut sticks 4. Were ya na maka stick nke ọ bụla, akụkụ dị larịị na nke gbara okirikiri nwere ohere hà nhata, sticks anaghị emetụta ibe ha. Dee probability na kpọmkwem akụkụ dị larịị 2 ga-apụta dịka okwu mgbakọ.

l-m-h3-b0c46-25.title: Olee otu ị ga-esi dee isi ihe nke pattern symmetry aka ekpe-aka nri na coordinates?
l-m-h3-b0c46-25.goal: Degharịa isi ihe na pattern symmetric gbasara y-axis ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ, kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu.
l-m-h3-b0c46-25.material: E nwere pattern ọdịnala symmetric aka ekpe-aka nri gbasara y-axis (ahịrị etiti kwụ ọtọ). Dee na coordinates isi ihe dị n’aka ekpe nke kwekọrọ na (4, −1) dị n’akụkụ ala aka nri.
l-m-h3-b0c46-25.s.s1.prompt: Kedu coordinates nke isi ihe kwekọrọ?
l-m-h3-b0c46-25.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ isi ihe ebe a gbanwere x na y.
l-m-h3-b0c46-25.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ isi ihe tụgharịrị gburugburu origin.
l-m-h3-b0c46-25.s.s1.r.d: Nke a bụ isi ihe a tụgharịrị gbasara x-axis.
l-m-h3-b0c46-25.s.s1.explain: Maka symmetry gbasara y-axis, naanị akara x-coordinate na-agbanwe, y-coordinate na-anọ otu. Isi ihe kwekọrọ na (4, −1) bụ (−4, −1).
l-m-h3-b0c46-25.s.s2.model.0: Symmetry aka ekpe-aka nri bụ mpịaji n’akụkụ y-axis, ya mere elu na-anọ otu, naanị akara x na-agbanwe, nke na-enye (−4, −1).
l-m-h3-b0c46-25.s.s2.model.1: Mgbe a tụgharịrị ya, ha ga-ejikọta, ya mere y-coordinate −1 na-anọ otu, x-coordinate 4 aghọ −4, nke pụtara otu ihe.

l-m-h3-b0c46-26.title: Ịtụgharị triangle ka ọ bụrụ rectangle nwere otu mpaghara
l-m-h3-b0c46-26.goal: Degharịa triangle nwere base 8 na height 5 ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ, kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu.
l-m-h3-b0c46-26.material: Mgbakọ na mwepụ East oge ochie chọtara mpaghara site n’ịkpụ shapes ma kwaga iberibe (out-in complementary principle). Ị chọrọ ịkpụ triangle base 8, height 5, ma jikọta ya ọzọ dịka rectangle obosara 8.
l-m-h3-b0c46-26.s.s1.prompt: Kedu height rectangle nwere otu mpaghara ahụ?
l-m-h3-b0c46-26.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụrụ na height anọ otu, mpaghara na-aghọ okpukpu abụọ.
l-m-h3-b0c46-26.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụrụ na height agbaa okpukpu abụọ, mpaghara na-aghọ okpukpu anọ.
l-m-h3-b0c46-26.s.s1.r.d: Nke a dere mpaghara triangle 20 dịka height.
l-m-h3-b0c46-26.s.s1.explain: Mpaghara triangle bụ 8×5÷2=20. Height rectangle obosara 8 bụ 20÷8=2.5, nke bụ ọkara height.
l-m-h3-b0c46-26.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na e bepụ akụkụ elu triangle ma kpalie ya, ọ na-abụ rectangle nke ịdị elu ya bụ ọkara; ya mere ọkara nke 5 bụ 2.5.
l-m-h3-b0c46-26.s.s2.model.1: Ikewa mpaghara 20 site na obosara 8 na-enye 2.5, ya mere ọ na-abụ rectangle nwere otu mpaghara.

l-m-h3-b0c47-23.title: Kedu ka ị ga-esi degharịa nhata oke ọla edo n'ụdị ọzọ?
l-m-h3-b0c47-23.goal: Degharịa nhata oke ọla edo φ n'ụdị ọzọ (nhata, tebụl, eserese, ma ọ bụ okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu.
l-m-h3-b0c47-23.material: Oke ọla edo φ (ihe dị ka 1.618) na-emezu φ = 1 + 1/φ. Chọta nhata ọzọ nke pụtara otu ihe ahụ.
l-m-h3-b0c47-23.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ nhata nke pụtara otu ihe ahụ dị ka nke mbụ.
l-m-h3-b0c47-23.s.s1.r.a: Ọ dị iche, n'ihi na φ²≈2.618 na φ−1≈0.618.
l-m-h3-b0c47-23.s.s1.r.b: Ọ na-arụ ọrụ naanị mgbe φ=2. Mana φ bụ ihe dị ka 1.618.
l-m-h3-b0c47-23.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụrụ na i kagbuo φ n'akụkụ abụọ, ị ga-enweta 0=1, nke bụ ụgha.
l-m-h3-b0c47-23.s.s1.explain: Ịmụba akụkụ abụọ na φ na-enye φ² = φ + 1. Ọ bụrụ na φ≈1.618, akụkụ abụọ ahụ bụ ihe dị ka 2.618.
l-m-h3-b0c47-23.s.s2.model.0: Ịmụba akụkụ abụọ na φ na-enye φ²=φ+1, ya mere ọ pụtara otu ihe ahụ na nhata mbụ.
l-m-h3-b0c47-23.s.s2.model.1: Itinye φ=1.618 na-enye φ²≈2.618 na φ+1=2.618, ya mere nhata abụọ ahụ na-enye otu uru.

l-m-h3-b0c47-24.title: Kedu ka ị ga-esi gbanwee ọnụ ọgụgụ ụzọ bekee ka ọ bụrụ iwu otu ahịrị?
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.goal: Degharịa ka ọnụ ọgụgụ ụzọ bekee si eto dịka iwu otu ahịrị n'ụdị ọzọ (nhata, tebụl, eserese, ma ọ bụ okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu.
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.material: A mụrụ otu ụzọ bekee, mgbe ọnwa abụọ gachara ọ na-amụ ụzọ ọhụrụ kwa ọnwa. Ụzọ bekee anaghị anwụ. Ọnụ ọgụgụ ụzọ kwa ọnwa na-eto dịka 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, ….
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.s.s1.prompt: Nke na-agbanwe uto a ka ọ bụrụ iwu otu ahịrị nke ọma bụ nke?
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.s.s1.o.a: Ọnụ ọgụgụ ụzọ ọnwa a = ọnụ ọgụgụ ọnwa gara aga × ọnụ ọgụgụ ọnwa gara aga
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.s.s1.r.a: Ịmụba na-enye 1, 1, 1, …. Nke a dị iche na ọnụọgụ ndị e nyere.
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.s.s1.o.b: Ọnụ ọgụgụ ọnwa a = ọnụọgụ ọnwa gara aga + nke ọnwa abụọ gara aga
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.s.s1.o.c: Ọnụ ọgụgụ ọnwa a = ọnụ ọgụgụ ọnwa gara aga × 2
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.s.s1.r.c: Ọ na-eto dịka 1, 2, 4, 8. Nke a dị iche na 1, 1, 2, 3 ndị e nyere.
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.s.s1.r.d: Ọ na-eto dịka 1, 2, 3, 4. Nke a dị iche na nọmba e nyere.
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.s.s1.explain: Ọnụọgụ ụzọ ụmụ ọhụrụ hà nhata ọnụọgụ ụzọ dị ọnwa abụọ gara aga. Ya mere 1+1=2, 1+2=3, 2+3=5.
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.s.s2.model.0: Ụzọ ọnwa a bụ ụzọ ọnwa gara aga tinyere ụzọ ụmụ ọhụrụ, ọnụọgụ ụzọ ọhụrụ ahụ hà nhata nke dị ọnwa abụọ gara aga; ya mere iwu ahụ na-arụ ọrụ.
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.s.s2.model.1: Ịgbakọta nọmba abụọ gara aga na-enye nke na-esote, dịka 2+3=5 na 3+5=8; ya mere iwu abụọ ahụ pụtara otu ihe.

l-m-h3-b0c47-25.title: Kedu ka e si dee ntụgharị 180° gburugburu mmalite dị ka equation?
l-m-h3-b0c47-25.goal: Degharịa mmegharị ịtụgharị 180° gburugburu mmalite n’ụdị ọzọ (equation, tebụl, eserese, ma ọ bụ okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe.
l-m-h3-b0c47-25.material: Debe ụkpụrụ n’elu coordinate plane ma tụgharịa ya 180° gburugburu mmalite. Isi (3, 2) na-aga (−3, −2). Tụgharịa mmegharị a ka ọ bụrụ equation maka isi (x, y).
l-m-h3-b0c47-25.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ symmetry gbasara y-axis. (3, 2) na-aga (−3, 2).
l-m-h3-b0c47-25.s.s1.r.b: Nke a bụ symmetry gbasara x-axis. (3, 2) na-aga (3, −2).
l-m-h3-b0c47-25.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ symmetry gbasara ahịrị y=x. (3, 2) na-aga (2, 3).
l-m-h3-b0c47-25.s.s1.explain: Ntughari 180° na-agbanwe akara x na y abụọ. Nke a dabara na (3, 2) ịga (−3, −2).
l-m-h3-b0c47-25.s.s2.model.0: Ebe (3, 2) na-aga (−3, −2), (−x, −y), nke na-agbanwe akara x na y abụọ, bụ otu mmegharị ahụ.
l-m-h3-b0c47-25.s.s2.model.1: Symmetry gbasara y-axis ma ọ bụ x-axis na-agbanwe naanị otu akara, ya mere (3, 2) agaghị aghọ (−3, −2); ha adabaghị.

l-m-h3-b0c48-23.title: Ikwu “mbelata ihe ize ndụ 50%” n’ụzọ ọzọ
l-m-h3-b0c48-23.goal: Tụgharịa isi akụkọ na-ekwu na ihe ize ndụ dara 50% ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ (equation, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe kpatara ya ji pụta otu ihe.
l-m-h3-b0c48-23.material: N’ime mmadụ 1000 ṅụrụ ọgwụ ọhụrụ, 1 onye nwere mgbaàmà; n’ime mmadụ 1000 na-aṅụghị ya, 2 nwere mgbaàmà. Isi akụkọ kwuru “mbelata ihe ize ndụ 50%.” Gosi otu eziokwu ahụ n’ụzọ ọzọ.
l-m-h3-b0c48-23.s.s1.prompt: Okwu nke na-egosi otu eziokwu dị na isi akụkọ bụ nke dị aṅaa?
l-m-h3-b0c48-23.s.s1.r.a: Ọdịiche ọnụego bụ 0.1 percentage points. 50% bụ ọnụego relative, mbelata sitere na 2 ruo 1.
l-m-h3-b0c48-23.s.s1.o.b: N’ime mmadụ 10 na-aṅụghị ya, mmadụ 2 nwere mgbaàmà
l-m-h3-b0c48-23.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụ 2 n’ime 1000, ọ bụghị 2 n’ime 10.
l-m-h3-b0c48-23.s.s1.o.c: Ọnụego mgbaàmà dara site na 0.2% ruo 0.1%
l-m-h3-b0c48-23.s.s1.o.d: 50% nke ndị ṅụrụ ya nwere mgbaàmà
l-m-h3-b0c48-23.s.s1.explain: O si mmadụ 2 ruo 1 belata ọkara, nke bụ “mbelata 50%”; n’ihe gbasara ọnụego, ọ dara 0.1 percentage points.
l-m-h3-b0c48-23.s.s2.model.0: 2 n’ime 1000 (0.2%) ghọrọ 1 (0.1%); n’ụzọ relative o belatara ọkara, n’ụzọ absolute ọ dara 0.1 percentage points.
l-m-h3-b0c48-23.s.s2.model.1: 50% bụ nke e jiri ihe ize ndụ mbụ tụnyere; ya mere ọ dị iche na absolute difference 0.1 percentage points. Ọ bụ ya mere e ji nye ha abụọ ọnụ.
