l-m-h3-b0c48-24.title: Iji ego a gbakọtara elu mee equation
l-m-h3-b0c48-24.goal: Gosipụta iwu ego dịka equation n’ụdị ọzọ (equation, tebụl, eserese, okwu) ma kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe.
l-m-h3-b0c48-24.material: Ego ebe ụgbọala: won 4000 maka awa 3 mbụ, mgbe ahụ tinye won 800 maka awa 1 ọ bụla gafere. Oge na-erughị awa 1 ọ bụla a na-agụ dịka awa 1. Chọta usoro ego maka x>3 awa. (⌈a⌉ bụ integer kacha nta hà ma ọ bụ karịa a)
l-m-h3-b0c48-24.s.s1.prompt: Equation nke pụtara otu ihe na iwu a bụ nke dị aṅaa?
l-m-h3-b0c48-24.s.s1.r.a: Maka awa 3.2, ọ na-enye won 3200, nke dị iche na iwu ịgbakọta elu.
l-m-h3-b0c48-24.s.s1.r.b: Maka awa 3.2, ọ na-enye won 4160, nke dị iche na iwu ịgbakọta elu.
l-m-h3-b0c48-24.s.s1.r.c: Maka awa 3.2, ọ na-enye won 4000, nke dị iche na iwu ịgbakọta elu.
l-m-h3-b0c48-24.s.s1.explain: A na-agbakwunye won 800 maka awa x−3 nke e gbakọtara elu. Maka awa 3.2, ⌈0.2⌉=1, ya mere ọ bụ won 4800.
l-m-h3-b0c48-24.s.s2.model.0: Ịtinye x=3.2 na-enye ⌈0.2⌉=1 na won 4800; ya mere ọ na-agbaso iwu ahụ kpọmkwem.
l-m-h3-b0c48-24.s.s2.model.1: Ọbụna obere oge gafere a na-agụ dịka otu awa, ya mere a ga-amụba ya na ⌈x−3⌉ e gbakọtara elu.

l-m-h3-b0c48-25.title: Iji ọnụ ọgụgụ gosipụta probability spam
l-m-h3-b0c48-25.goal: Tụgharịa ahịrịokwu conditional probability ka ọ bụrụ ọnụ ọgụgụ n’ụdị ọzọ (equation, tebụl, eserese, okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe.
l-m-h3-b0c48-25.material: 10% nke email bụ spam. Okwu “free” pụtara na 80% nke spam na 5% nke email nkịtị. Were ya na email 1000 dị, tụlee oke spam n’etiti email ndị nwere “free.”
l-m-h3-b0c48-25.s.s1.prompt: Nkọwa ziri ezi nke ji ọnụ ọgụgụ bụ nke dị aṅaa?
l-m-h3-b0c48-25.s.s1.o.a: 80 n’ime email 85 nwere “free,” ya bụ ihe dịka 94%
l-m-h3-b0c48-25.s.s1.r.a: 5% nke email nkịtị bụ 5% nke 900, nke bụ email 45.
l-m-h3-b0c48-25.s.s1.r.b: Ajuju a na-ekwu maka email niile nwere “free,” ọ bụghị naanị spam.
l-m-h3-b0c48-25.s.s1.o.c: 80 n’ime email 125 nwere “free” bụ spam, ya bụ 64%
l-m-h3-b0c48-25.s.s1.o.d: Spam bụ 10%; ọbụna email nwere “free” bụ 10%
l-m-h3-b0c48-25.s.s1.r.d: Mgbe e tinyere ozi “free,” probability na-agbanwe.
l-m-h3-b0c48-25.s.s1.explain: “Free” pụtara na email spam 80 n’ime 100 na email nkịtị 45 n’ime 900. 80÷(80+45)=64%.
l-m-h3-b0c48-25.s.s2.model.0: Email ndị nwere “free” bụ 80+45=125, n’ime ha 80 bụ spam; ya bụ 64%.
l-m-h3-b0c48-25.s.s2.model.1: 5% nke email nkịtị 900 bụ 45; ya mere spam n’etiti email “free” bụ 80/125.

l-m-h3-b0c48-26.goal: Tụgharịa ọdịiche magnitude ka ọ bụrụ energy ratio n’ụdị ọzọ (equation, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe.
l-m-h3-b0c48-26.material: Ejikọtara ike ala ọma jijiji E na magnitude M site na log E=4.8+1.5M. Degharịa equation iji tụlee ugboro ole ike ala ọma jijiji magnitude 7 karịrị nke magnitude 5.
l-m-h3-b0c48-26.s.s1.prompt: Nkọwa ziri ezi nke ji energy ratio bụ nke dị aṅaa?
l-m-h3-b0c48-26.s.s1.r.a: A ga-amụba ya na 1.5. Ọdịiche magnitude 1 abụghị ugboro 10.
l-m-h3-b0c48-26.s.s1.r.b: Ọdịiche 3 na uru log abụghị ugboro 3 kama ọ bụ ugboro 10³.
l-m-h3-b0c48-26.s.s1.r.c: Enweghị ike iji ọdịiche magnitude ozugbo dịka ọtụtụ ike.
l-m-h3-b0c48-26.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na ọdịiche log E bụ 1.5×2=3, ratio E bụ 10³=1000 ugboro.
l-m-h3-b0c48-26.s.s2.model.0: Ọdịiche log E bụ 3, ya mere energy ratio bụ 10³=1000 ugboro.
l-m-h3-b0c48-26.s.s2.model.1: N’ime logarithm, 1 karịa pụtara ike ugboro 10; ya mere ọdịiche 3 bụ ịmụba 10 ugboro atọ, ya bụ 1000.

l-m-h3-b0c49-23.title: Ịkọwa okwu quadratic dịka mmegharị bọọlụ
l-m-h3-b0c49-23.goal: Gbanwee usoro ịdị elu ka ọ bụrụ nkọwa mmegharị bọọlụ: kwuo ya n’ụzọ ọzọ (usoro, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe.
l-m-h3-b0c49-23.material: Mgbe a tụbara bọọlụ, ịdị elu ya na sekọnd t bụ h=−2(t−3)²+18 (m). Kọwaa mmegharị bọọlụ ahụ n’okwu.
l-m-h3-b0c49-23.s.s1.o.a: Ọ na-eru ebe kacha ala, 18m, mgbe sekọnd 3, daa n’ala mgbe sekọnd 6
l-m-h3-b0c49-23.s.s1.r.a: −2 dị n’ihu na-egosi na ọ na-emeghe ala, ya mere nke a bụ ebe kacha elu.
l-m-h3-b0c49-23.s.s1.o.b: Ọ na-eru ebe kacha elu, 18m, mgbe sekọnd 3, daa n’ala mgbe sekọnd 6
l-m-h3-b0c49-23.s.s1.o.c: Ọ na-eru ebe kacha elu, 3m, mgbe sekọnd 18
l-m-h3-b0c49-23.s.s1.r.c: Isi ntụgharị bụ (3, 18), ya mere oge bụ 3, ịdị elu bụ 18.
l-m-h3-b0c49-23.s.s1.o.d: Ịdị elu mmalite bụ 18m, ọ na-agakwa ala
l-m-h3-b0c49-23.s.s1.r.d: Mgbe t=0, ịdị elu bụ 0, ya mere ọ malitere n’ala.
l-m-h3-b0c49-23.s.s1.explain: Isi ntụgharị bụ (3, 18), ọ na-emeghe ala, ya mere kacha elu bụ 18m na sekọnd 3. h=0 mgbe t=0 na 6.
l-m-h3-b0c49-23.s.s2.model.0: −2(t−3)² bụ 0 ma ọ bụ obere, ya mere h kacha ukwuu mgbe t=3, ọ bụ 18; h=0 mgbe t=0 na 6, ya mere ọ metụrụ ala.
l-m-h3-b0c49-23.s.s2.model.1: Isi ntụgharị bụ (3, 18), ya mere ịdị elu kacha elu bụ 18m mgbe sekọnd 3, site na symmetry ọ laghachiri n’ala mgbe sekọnd 6.

l-m-h3-b0c49-24.title: Ịkọwa inequality dịka ọnọdụ eserese
l-m-h3-b0c49-24.goal: Kọwaa x²−4x−5<0 site n’ọnọdụ eserese: dee ya n’ụzọ ọzọ (usoro, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe.
l-m-h3-b0c49-24.material: Kwuo inequality quadratic x²−4x−5<0 site n’ọnọdụ eserese ọrụ quadratic y=x²−4x−5. (x²−4x−5=(x+1)(x−5))
l-m-h3-b0c49-24.s.s1.o.a: Nso x ebe eserese dị n’okpuru axis x
l-m-h3-b0c49-24.s.s1.o.b: Ụkpụrụ x ebe eserese metụrụ axis x
l-m-h3-b0c49-24.s.s1.r.b: Ebe o metụrụ bụ x=−1, 5; ha na-edozi “=”, ọ bụghị “<”.
l-m-h3-b0c49-24.s.s1.o.c: Nso x ebe eserese dị n’elu axis x
l-m-h3-b0c49-24.s.s1.r.c: N’elu pụtara y>0, ya bụ x²−4x−5>0.
l-m-h3-b0c49-24.s.s1.r.d: Isi ntụgharị bụ naanị otu isi, mana inequality na-ekwu maka nso.
l-m-h3-b0c49-24.s.s1.explain: Akụkụ y<0 dị n’okpuru axis x. Nso ahụ bụ −1<x<5.
l-m-h3-b0c49-24.s.s2.model.0: x²−4x−5<0 pụtara y<0, ya mere ọ bụ nso −1<x<5 ebe eserese dị n’okpuru axis x.
l-m-h3-b0c49-24.s.s2.model.1: Ebe o kwuru <0, azịza bụ ebe uru na-adịghị mma, ya bụ ebe eserese dị n’okpuru axis x.

l-m-h3-b0c49-26.title: Iche nkezi dịka ngụkọta
l-m-h3-b0c49-26.goal: Gbanwee ọnọdụ nkezi ka ọ bụrụ ọnọdụ ngụkọta: dee ya n’ụzọ ọzọ (usoro, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe.
l-m-h3-b0c49-26.material: N’ime ụbọchị 7, ị gagharịrị nzọụkwụ 6000 kwa ụbọchị na nkezi. Were nkezi dịka ngụkọta, chọta nzọụkwụ ole ị ga-aga n’ụbọchị 8 ka nkezi ruo ụbọchị 8 bụrụ 6500.
l-m-h3-b0c49-26.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nkọwa dabere na ngụkọta ziri ezi?
l-m-h3-b0c49-26.s.s1.o.a: Nzọụkwụ ụbọchị 8 bụ ugboro 2 nke 6500, ya bụ 13000
l-m-h3-b0c49-26.s.s1.r.a: Ngụkọta ụbọchị 8 bụ nzọụkwụ 52000, ya mere 13000 karịrị mkpa.
l-m-h3-b0c49-26.s.s1.o.b: Nkezi kwa ụbọchị ga-arị elu 500, ya mere nzọụkwụ 6500
l-m-h3-b0c49-26.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụrụ na naanị ụbọchị 8 bụ nzọụkwụ 6500, nkezi ga-abụ ihe dị ka 6060.
l-m-h3-b0c49-26.s.s1.o.c: Ngụkọta ụbọchị 7 bụ nzọụkwụ 42000, nke ụbọchị 8 bụ 52000, ya mere 10000
l-m-h3-b0c49-26.s.s1.r.d: Ịgbakọ nkezi nkezi anaghị egosi nzọụkwụ ụbọchị 8.
l-m-h3-b0c49-26.s.s1.explain: Nkezi×ụbọchị bụ ngụkọta. Iwepụ ngụkọta ụbọchị 7 nke 42000 na nke ụbọchị 8 nke 52000 na-enye nzọụkwụ 10000.
l-m-h3-b0c49-26.s.s2.model.0: Ngụkọta ụbọchị 8 bụ 8×6500=52000, nke ụbọchị 7 bụ 42000; ya mere ị ga-aga nzọụkwụ 10000 n’ụbọchị 8.
l-m-h3-b0c49-26.s.s2.model.1: Nkezi bụ ngụkọta e kewara n’ọnụọgụ ụbọchị; ịgbanwe ya ka ọ bụrụ ngụkọta na-enyere aka gbakwunye ihe fọdụrụ ozugbo.

l-m-h3-b0c49-27.title: Ịgbanwe olu igbe apịaji ka ọ bụrụ usoro
l-m-h3-b0c49-27.goal: Kwuo olu igbe akwụkwọ dịka x: dee ya n’ụzọ ọzọ (usoro, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe.
l-m-h3-b0c49-27.material: Site n’akụkụ anọ nke mpempe akwụkwọ square nwere akụkụ x cm, bepụ square akụkụ 2cm, tụgharịa mee igbe mepere emepe n’elu (x>4). Kwuo olu dịka usoro x.
l-m-h3-b0c49-27.s.s1.prompt: Kedu usoro na-egosi olu n’ụzọ ziri ezi?
l-m-h3-b0c49-27.s.s1.r.a: Ntọala na-adị nta n’ihi akụkụ ndị e bepụrụ.
l-m-h3-b0c49-27.s.s1.r.b: Akụkụ ntọala na-ebelata 2cm n’akụkụ abụọ, ya mere ọ bụ x−4.
l-m-h3-b0c49-27.s.s1.explain: Ntọala bụ square akụkụ x−4cm, ịdị elu bụ 2cm, ya mere olu bụ 2(x−4)².
l-m-h3-b0c49-27.s.s2.model.0: Ịkpụ 2cm n’akụkụ abụọ na-eme ka akụkụ ntọala bụrụ x−4, ya mere olu bụ 2(x−4)².
l-m-h3-b0c49-27.s.s2.model.1: Ịdị elu igbe apịaji bụ 2cm, mpaghara ntọala bụ (x−4)²; ngwaahịa 2(x−4)² bụ olu.

l-m-h3-b0c50-02.title: Ime ka “ọ bụrụ na ị gụọ akwụkwọ ogologo oge” doo anya
l-m-h3-b0c50-02.topic: Ime ka ajụjụ na-edoghị anya doo anya
l-m-h3-b0c50-02.goal: Tụgharịa “Ọ bụrụ na ị gụọ akwụkwọ ogologo oge, akara gị ọ ga-arị elu?” ka ọ bụrụ ahịrịokwu a pụrụ ịtụ: gosipụta ya n’ụdị ọzọ (formula, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe.
l-m-h3-b0c50-02.material: “Ọ bụrụ na ị gụọ akwụkwọ ogologo oge, akara gị ọ ga-arị elu?” edoghị anya, enweghịkwa ike ịnwale ya ozugbo. Ị chọrọ ịgbanwe ya ka ọ bụrụ ahịrịokwu a pụrụ ịtụ na iji tụnyere.
l-m-h3-b0c50-02.s.s1.prompt: Ahịrịokwu nke na-edobe otu ihe ma dị mfe ịnwale bụ nke dị aṅaa?
l-m-h3-b0c50-02.s.s1.o.a: Lelee naanị ma ụmụ akwụkwọ akara ha rịrị elu gụrụ akwụkwọ ogologo oge
l-m-h3-b0c50-02.s.s1.r.a: Ịhapụ ụmụ akwụkwọ akara ha arịgaghị elu pụtara na ị gaghị enyocha mmekọrịta ahụ.
l-m-h3-b0c50-02.s.s1.o.b: Jụọ ma ụmụ akwụkwọ na-agụ ọtụtụ awa bụ ndị na-arụsi ọrụ ike
l-m-h3-b0c50-02.s.s1.r.b: Ịrụsi ọrụ ike na-ajụ ihe dị iche na akara.
l-m-h3-b0c50-02.s.s1.o.c: Jụọ ma ọ dị ka ihe ọma ịgụ akwụkwọ ogologo oge
l-m-h3-b0c50-02.s.s1.r.c: Ọ na-ajụ mmetụta mmadụ, ya mere enweghị ike iji uru nyochaa ya.
l-m-h3-b0c50-02.s.s1.o.d: Lelee mmekọrịta dị n’etiti awa ọmụmụ kwa izu na akara ule
l-m-h3-b0c50-02.s.s1.explain: Ịtụ oge ọmụmụ na akara dịka nọmba ma lelee mmekọrịta ha na-edobe otu ihe ajụjụ mbụ, a pụkwara ịnwale ya.
l-m-h3-b0c50-02.s.s2.model.0: Enwere ike ịtụ oge ọmụmụ na akara dịka nọmba; ya mere ọ na-edobe ihe ajụjụ mbụ ma nwee ike ịnwale ya.
l-m-h3-b0c50-02.s.s2.model.1: Agbanweela “ogologo oge” na “akara” ka ha bụrụ oge na akara ule; ya mere ọ bụ otu ajụjụ, a na-enyochakwa ya site n’uru, ọ bụghị mmetụta.

l-m-h3-b0c50-09.title: Ịgbanwe tebụl ụgwọ ka ọ bụrụ usoro
l-m-h3-b0c50-09.goal: Jiri mkpụrụedemede gbanwee tebụl ụgwọ ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ (usoro, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere ha ji pụta otu ihe.
l-m-h3-b0c50-09.material: Nke a bụ tebụl ụgwọ ekwentị. Data 0GB na-efu 9000 won, 2GB bụ 10000 won, 4GB bụ 11000 won. Ka ụgwọ data xGB bụrụ y won.
l-m-h3-b0c50-09.s.s1.prompt: Kedu usoro pụtara otu ihe na tebụl?
l-m-h3-b0c50-09.s.s1.r.a: Na 2GB ọ ga-abụ 19000 won, nke dị iche na tebụl.
l-m-h3-b0c50-09.s.s1.r.d: E gbanwere ọnọdụ ụgwọ ntọala na ụgwọ kwa GB.
l-m-h3-b0c50-09.s.s1.explain: Ụgwọ na-abawanye 1000 won kwa 2GB, ya bụ 500 won kwa GB; ebe 0GB bụ 9000 won, usoro bụ y=500x+9000.
l-m-h3-b0c50-09.s.s2.model.0: Itinye x=0, 2, 4 na-enye 9000, 10000, 11000, ya mere y=500x+9000 pụtara otu ihe na tebụl.
l-m-h3-b0c50-09.s.s2.model.1: Ụgwọ na-abawanye 1000 won kwa 2GB, malitekwa na 9000 won; ya bụ 500 won kwa GB tinyere ụgwọ ntọala 9000 won.

l-m-h3-b0c50-19.title: Ide echiche dị ka ahaghị nhata
l-m-h3-b0c50-19.goal: Gbanwee echiche banyere mmetụta fatịlaịza ọhụrụ ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ (usoro, tebụl, eserese, okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu.
l-m-h3-b0c50-19.material: Ị chọrọ ịgbanwe “Nkezi ịdị elu ite ndị e nyere fatịlaịza ọhụrụ karịrị ite ndị a na-enyeghị ya opekata mpe 5cm” ka ọ bụrụ usoro. Ka a bụrụ nkezi ite ndị e nyere ya, b bụrụ nkezi nke ndị a na-enyeghị.
l-m-h3-b0c50-19.s.s1.prompt: Kedu usoro pụtara otu ihe ahụ?
l-m-h3-b0c50-19.s.s1.r.a: Ọ na-akọwa nha a n'onwe ya, ọ bụghị ọdịiche ya na b.
l-m-h3-b0c50-19.s.s1.r.b: Ọ na-akọwa ugboro ole, ọ bụghị ọdịiche.
l-m-h3-b0c50-19.s.s1.r.c: E tụgharịrị akụkụ nke ka ukwuu.
l-m-h3-b0c50-19.s.s1.explain: “Karịrị ịdị elu na 5cm ma ọ bụ karịa” pụtara na ọdịiche nkezi abụọ ahụ, a-b, bụ 5 ma ọ bụ karịa. Ma ọdịiche ma ntụziaka ga-abụrịrị eziokwu.
l-m-h3-b0c50-19.s.s2.model.0: Ikwu na nke e nyere fatịlaịza dị elu karịa na 5 ma ọ bụ karịa pụtara na nke ukwu wepụ nke nta bụ 5 ma ọ bụ karịa, ya mere a-b≥5.
l-m-h3-b0c50-19.s.s2.model.1: a-b na-anọchite anya ọdịiche nkezi abụọ ahụ, ya mere ọ pụtara otu ihe dị ka “karịrị ịdị elu na 5cm ma ọ bụ karịa.”

l-m-h3-b0c50-26.goal: Gbanwee okwu na nchikọta nọmba atọ na-esochi bụ ọtụtụ nke 3 ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ (usoro, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere ha ji pụta otu ihe.

l-m-h3-b0c50-26.s.s1.r.b: Okwu maka nọmba atọ na-esochi ezighị ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c50-26.s.s1.r.c: Ngụkọta nchikọta ezighị ezi, ya mere ọ bụghị ọtụtụ nke 3.
l-m-h3-b0c50-26.s.s1.explain: Nọmba zuru ezu atọ na-esochi bụ n, n+1, n+2; nchikọta bụ 3n+3=3(n+1), ya mere ọ bụ ọtụtụ nke 3 maka n ọ bụla.
l-m-h3-b0c50-26.s.s2.model.0: Nchikọta bụ 3(n+1), ya mere ọ bụ ọtụtụ nke 3 maka nọmba zuru ezu n ọ bụla; ọ na-adị eziokwu n’ọnọdụ niile.

l-m-h3-b0d07-05.title: Iji partial sum n/(n+1) nweta general term
l-m-h3-b0d07-05.goal: Gosipụta general term aₙ nke partial sum Sₙ=n/(n+1) n’ụdị ọzọ (equation, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere ha ji pụta otu.
l-m-h3-b0d07-05.material: Ngụkọta series Σaₙ site na term mbụ ruo nke n bụ Sₙ=n/(n+1). Gosipụta otu series ahụ site na general term aₙ.
l-m-h3-b0d07-05.s.s1.prompt: Ụzọ ziri ezi igosipụta aₙ bụ nke dị aṅaa?
l-m-h3-b0d07-05.s.s1.r.a: S₂−S₁=1/6, ma okwu a na-enye a₂=2/3; ya mere ọ dị iche.
l-m-h3-b0d07-05.s.s1.r.c: Mgbe n=1 ọ na-enye 1/4, ma a₁=S₁=1/2.
l-m-h3-b0d07-05.s.s1.explain: aₙ=Sₙ−Sₙ₋₁. n/(n+1)−(n−1)/n=1/{n(n+1)}; ọ na-arụkwa ọrụ maka n=1, na-enye 1/2.
l-m-h3-b0d07-05.s.s2.model.0: General term bụ ọdịiche partial sums agbata obi, Sₙ−Sₙ₋₁; ya mere itinye n/(n+1)−(n−1)/n n’otu denominator na-enye 1/{n(n+1)}.
l-m-h3-b0d07-05.s.s2.model.1: S₁=1/2 na S₂−S₁=1/6; itinye uru n’ime 1/{n(n+1)} na-enye 1/2 na 1/6; ya mere ha bụ otu series.

l-m-h3-b0d07-18.title: Ide f'(2)=3 dịka ngosipụta ókè
l-m-h3-b0d07-18.goal: Gosipụta f'(2)=3 n'ụdị ọzọ (nhata, tebụl, eserese, okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu.
l-m-h3-b0d07-18.material: Ọrụ f nwere derivative na x=2, uru derivative bụ f'(2)=3. Gosipụta otu eziokwu ahụ dịka ngosipụta ókè.
l-m-h3-b0d07-18.s.s1.prompt: Ngosipụta nke pụtara otu ihe ahụ na f'(2)=3 bụ nke?
l-m-h3-b0d07-18.s.s1.r.a: Ókè a na-aghọ 3f'(2)=9. E kewaghị ya na 3h.
l-m-h3-b0d07-18.s.s1.r.b: Isi ntụnyere ahụ abụghị x=2, ya mere ọ bụghị mkpọda ahụ.
l-m-h3-b0d07-18.s.s1.r.d: Denominator ga-abụ mgbanwe h. Ọ bụghị 2+h.
l-m-h3-b0d07-18.s.s1.explain: Uru derivative bụ ókè nke oke mgbanwe, {f(2+h)−f(2)}/h. Denominator bụ mgbanwe x, h.
l-m-h3-b0d07-18.s.s2.model.0: Uru derivative bụ ókè nke oke mgbanwe y na mgbanwe x h, ya bụ ókè {f(2+h)−f(2)}/h.
l-m-h3-b0d07-18.s.s2.model.1: Numerator bụ f(2+h)−f(2), denominator ga-abụ otu mgbanwe h iji nye ọnụego mgbanwe nkezi; ya mere ngosipụta a pụtara otu f'(2).

l-m-h3-b0d07-25.title: Ịgbanwe nso na-arị elu ka ọ bụrụ inequality
l-m-h3-b0d07-25.goal: Dee nso ebe f(x)=x·e^(−x) na-arị elu n’ụdị ọzọ (nhata, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere ha ji pụta otu ihe.
l-m-h3-b0d07-25.material: Iji chọta nso ebe f(x)=x·e^(−x) na-arị elu, gbanwee f'(x)>0 ka ọ bụrụ inequality dị mfe.
l-m-h3-b0d07-25.s.s1.prompt: Kedu inequality pụtara otu ihe na f'(x)>0?
l-m-h3-b0d07-25.s.s1.r.c: Ọbụna ma e^(−x) dị mma, leleekwa akara 1−x.
l-m-h3-b0d07-25.s.s1.r.d: Akara ahụ tụgharịrị, ya mere e gbanwere nso ịrị elu na ọdịda.
l-m-h3-b0d07-25.s.s1.explain: f'(x)=e^(−x)−xe^(−x)=(1−x)e^(−x), e^(−x)>0; ya mere f'>0 pụtara 1−x>0, ya bụ x<1.
l-m-h3-b0d07-25.s.s2.model.0: Site n’iwu ngwaahịa f'(x)=(1−x)e^(−x), e^(−x) na-adị mma mgbe niile; ya mere f'>0 bụ 1−x>0, ya bụ x<1.
l-m-h3-b0d07-25.s.s2.model.1: Ebe e^(−x)>0, akara ya dabere na 1−x. Ya mere f'(x)>0 pụtara x<1.

l-m-h3-b0d07-32.goal: Dee lim Σ(2/n)f(1+2k/n) n’ụdị ọzọ (nhata, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere ha ji pụta otu ihe.
l-m-h3-b0d07-32.material: f na-aga n’ihu. Dee lim(n→∞) Σ(k=1~n) (2/n)·f(1+2k/n) dịka definite integral.
l-m-h3-b0d07-32.s.s1.prompt: Kedu definite integral hà nhata oke a?
l-m-h3-b0d07-32.s.s1.r.a: 2/n bụ obosara nso; ị gaghị amụba ya na 2 ọzọ.
l-m-h3-b0d07-32.s.s1.r.b: Uru dị n’ime f bụ 1+2k/n, ya mere x si 1 ruo 3.
l-m-h3-b0d07-32.s.s1.r.c: Ogologo nso bụ (2/n)×n=2 ma malite na 1, ya mere ọ gwụchara na 3.
l-m-h3-b0d07-32.s.s1.explain: 2/n bụ obosara, x=1+2k/n si 1 ruo 3; ya mere ọ bụ ∫₁³f(x)dx.
l-m-h3-b0d07-32.s.s2.model.0: Ịchịkọta akụkụ obosara 2/n n na-enye ogologo 2, x=1+2k/n si 1 ruo 3; ya bụ ∫₁³f(x)dx.
l-m-h3-b0d07-32.s.s2.model.1: Mgbe k=1, x dị ntakịrị karịa 1; mgbe k=n, x=3, ya mere nso bụ [1,3], nke bụ integral a.

l-m-h3-b0d08-25.material: Anyị chọrọ ịchọta ọnụ ọgụgụ mgbọrọgwụ ezigbo dị iche nke eˣ=kx (k>0). Gbanwee nsogbu a ka ọ bụrụ mmekọrịta eserese.
l-m-h3-b0d08-25.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nke bụ otu nsogbu ahụ?
l-m-h3-b0d08-25.s.s1.o.a: Ọnụọgụ ebe eserese y=eˣ na y=k na-ezukọta
l-m-h3-b0d08-25.s.s1.r.a: x dị n'ime kx adịghị. I kwesịrị iji ahịrị y=kx tụnyere ya.
l-m-h3-b0d08-25.s.s1.o.b: Ọnụọgụ ebe eserese y=eˣ−x na y=k na-ezukọta
l-m-h3-b0d08-25.s.s1.r.b: Ọ na-aghọ eˣ−x=k, ọ bụghị eˣ−kx=0.

l-m-h3-b0d08-25.s.s1.o.d: Ọnụọgụ ebe eserese y=x/eˣ na y=k na-ezukọta
l-m-h3-b0d08-25.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ eˣ/x=k, ọ bụghị x/eˣ=k.
l-m-h3-b0d08-25.s.s1.explain: x=0 abụghị mgbọrọgwụ, ya mere ikewa akụkụ abụọ na x na-enye eˣ/x=k. Ọnụọgụ ebe ha na-ezukọta bụ ọnụ ọgụgụ mgbọrọgwụ.
l-m-h3-b0d08-25.s.s2.model.0: Ebe x=0 abụghị mgbọrọgwụ, ikewa akụkụ abụọ na x na-enye eˣ/x=k; ya mere ebe y=eˣ/x na y=k na-ezukọta bụ ọnụ ọgụgụ mgbọrọgwụ.
l-m-h3-b0d08-25.s.s2.model.1: Ebe k bụ mkpọda ahịrị ahụ, ịchịkọta k n'otu akụkụ na-enye eˣ/x=k; ya mere gbanwee ya ka ọ bụrụ ebe y=eˣ/x na ahịrị kwụ ọtọ y=k na-ezukọta.

l-m-h3-b0d08-31.title: Iji integration by parts degharịa ∫x f'(x)dx
l-m-h3-b0d08-31.goal: Tinyeghachi ∫₀¹ x f'(x)dx n'ụdị ọzọ (ngosipụta, tebụl, eserese, okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu.
l-m-h3-b0d08-31.material: f nwere derivative na [0,1], f' na-aga n'ihu. Jiri integration by parts degharịa ∫₀¹ x f'(x)dx ka ọ bụrụ ngosipụta eji f eme ihe.
l-m-h3-b0d08-31.s.s1.r.a: Ịji akụkụ abụọ bụ uv−∫u'v, ya bụ mwepụ.
l-m-h3-b0d08-31.s.s1.r.b: Ebe x na-abawanye, ọ naghị aghọ ∫f'=f(1)−f(0) ozugbo.
l-m-h3-b0d08-31.s.s1.r.c: Akara ahụ dị iche. [xf(x)]₀¹=f(1) na-abịa mbụ.
l-m-h3-b0d08-31.s.s1.explain: Tọọ u=x, v'=f'; iji akụkụ abụọ na-enye [xf(x)]₀¹−∫₀¹f(x)dx=f(1)−∫₀¹f(x)dx.

l-m-h3-b0d09-06.title: Ịgbanwe “anya ha hà nhata” ka ọ bụrụ nhata
l-m-h3-b0d09-06.goal: Tinyeghachi ọnọdụ na anya ruo focus na directrix hà nhata n'ụdị ọzọ (ngosipụta, tebụl, eserese, okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu.
l-m-h3-b0d09-06.material: Nchịkọta isi P(x, y) nke anya ha na focus F(0, 2) na directrix y = −2 hà nhata bụ parabola. Gbanwee ọnọdụ a ka ọ bụrụ otu nhata.
l-m-h3-b0d09-06.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nhata na-egosipụta otu ihe ahụ?
l-m-h3-b0d09-06.s.s1.r.a: Na 4py, p=2, ya mere ọ bụ 8y, ọ bụghị 4y.
l-m-h3-b0d09-06.s.s1.r.b: Parabola ahụ nwere axis y, ya mere agbanwere x na y.
l-m-h3-b0d09-06.s.s1.r.c: Focus dị n'elu, ya mere ọ na-emeghe elu. Akara ahụ dị iche.
l-m-h3-b0d09-06.s.s1.explain: Ime square n'akụkụ abụọ nke √(x²+(y−2)²)=|y+2| na-enye x²+y²−4y+4=y²+4y+4, ya bụ x²=8y.
l-m-h3-b0d09-06.s.s2.model.0: Ide “anya hà nhata” dịka nhata na-enye x²+(y−2)²=(y+2)², ime ka ọ dị mfe na-enye x²=8y; ya mere ha pụtara otu.
l-m-h3-b0d09-06.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ vertex bụ mmalite, focus bụ (0,2), p=2; ya mere x²=4py=8y, ebe ọ na-emeghe elu akara ahụ ziri ezi.

l-m-h3-b0d09-13.title: Ịgbanwe ellipse e jiri eriri see ka ọ bụrụ nhata
l-m-h3-b0d09-13.goal: Tinyeghachi ellipse e sere site n'eriri n'ụdị ọzọ (ngosipụta, tebụl, eserese, okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu.
l-m-h3-b0d09-13.material: A kekọtara nsọtụ abụọ nke eriri 10 cm na ntu abụọ F(3,0) na F′(−3,0), nke dị 6 cm n'ebe ibe ha nọ; pensụl dọtara eriri ahụ sie ike ma gbaa otu gburugburu. Gbanwee usoro a ka ọ bụrụ nhata.
l-m-h3-b0d09-13.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nhata nke usoro e sere bụ?
l-m-h3-b0d09-13.s.s1.r.b: 9 bụ c². Ị kwesịrị iji b²=a²−c²=16.
l-m-h3-b0d09-13.s.s1.r.c: Axis ukwu dị na axis x, ya mere denominator 25 ga-esoro x².
l-m-h3-b0d09-13.s.s1.r.d: 10 na 6 bụ ogologo eriri na oghere ntu. Ha abụghị a² ma ọ bụ b².
l-m-h3-b0d09-13.s.s1.explain: PF+PF′=10, ya mere a=5; oghere ntu bụ 6, ya mere c=3; b²=25−9=16.
l-m-h3-b0d09-13.s.s2.model.0: Ogologo eriri PF+PF′=10, ya mere 2a=10, a=5, c=3, b²=16, nke na-enye x²/25+y²/16=1.
l-m-h3-b0d09-13.s.s2.model.1: Isi ihe ndị e sere na-agafe (±5,0) n'axis x na (0,±4) n'axis y; ya mere ọ bụ otu ellipse, nhata ya bụ x²/25+y²/16=1.

l-m-h3-b0d09-23.goal: Gbanwee ahịrị e nyere vector ntụziaka ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ (nhata, tebụl, eserese, okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu.
l-m-h3-b0d09-23.material: Ahịrị na-agafe isi A(1,2), vector ntụziaka ya bụ (2,3). Degharịa nkwupụta na isi P(x,y) dị n'ahịrị a dịka ngosipụta ahịrị n'ime x na y. (1 2 2 3)

l-m-h3-b0d09-23.s.s1.r.c: Ọ na-agafe (1,2), mana ntụziaka ya bụ (3,2), ya mere ọ bụ ahịrị dị iche.

l-m-h3-b0d09-24.topic: Ngwaahịa ntụpọ na ịdị n'akụkụ ziri ezi
l-m-h3-b0d09-24.goal: Gbanwee akụkụ ziri ezi n'otu vertex triangle ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ (nhata, tebụl, eserese, okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu.
l-m-h3-b0d09-24.material: Degharịa nkwupụta na akụkụ dị na vertex A nke triangle ABC bụ akụkụ ziri ezi dịka nhata vectors. Dee vectors maka akụkụ AB na AC.
l-m-h3-b0d09-24.s.s1.r.a: Nhata a pụtara na akụkụ dị na vertex B bụ akụkụ ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0d09-24.s.s1.r.b: Ọ pụtara na akụkụ abụọ ahụ nwere otu ogologo. O nweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na akụkụ ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0d09-24.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụrụ ngụkọta bụ vector efu, vectors abụọ ahụ na-atụ n'akụkụ megidere.
l-m-h3-b0d09-24.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ akụkụ abụọ dị na A kwụ n'akụkụ ibe ha, AB·AC=0. Ọ bụrụ ngwaahịa ntụpọ bụ 0, vectors abụọ na-abụghị efu na-adị n'akụkụ ziri ezi.
l-m-h3-b0d09-24.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ akụkụ dị na A bụ akụkụ ziri ezi, AB na AC kwụ n'akụkụ ibe ha; ya mere ngwaahịa ntụpọ bụ AB·AC=|AB||AC|cos90°=0.
l-m-h3-b0d09-24.s.s2.model.1: A na-eji AB·BC=0 mgbe akụkụ dị na B bụ ziri ezi; ya mere maka akụkụ dị na A, jiri akụkụ abụọ AB na AC na-apụta na A, nweta AB·AC=0.

l-m-h3-b0d09-38.title: Igosipụta ebe etiti na radius na nhata sphere
l-m-h3-b0d09-38.goal: Gbanwee nhata sphere e gbasawanyere ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ (nhata, tebụl, eserese, okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu.
l-m-h3-b0d09-38.material: E gbasawanyere nhata sphere ka ọ bụrụ x² + y² + z² − 2x + 4y − 6z + 5 = 0. Degharịa ya ka a hụ ebe etiti na radius ozugbo.
l-m-h3-b0d09-38.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nhata na-anọchite anya otu sphere ahụ?
l-m-h3-b0d09-38.s.s1.r.a: E tụgharịrị akara nhazi ebe etiti.
l-m-h3-b0d09-38.s.s1.r.b: Akụkụ aka nri bụ square radius, ya mere ọ bụ 9, ọ bụghị 3.
l-m-h3-b0d09-38.s.s1.r.c: E mere akụkụ aka nri n'ụzọ na-ezighị ezi site n'ịgbakwunye okwu na-adịgide adịgide 5.
l-m-h3-b0d09-38.s.s1.explain: Ime square zuru ezu na-enye (x−1)²+(y+2)²+(z−3)²=1+4+9−5=9. Ebe etiti bụ (1, −2, 3), radius bụ 3.
l-m-h3-b0d09-38.s.s2.model.0: Ime square zuru ezu maka x, y, z na-agbakwunye 1+4+9, bugharịa 5; akụkụ aka nri na-aghọ 9, otu nhata ahụ.
l-m-h3-b0d09-38.s.s2.model.1: Ịbugharị 9 n'akụkụ aka ekpe ma gbasaa na-enye −2x+4y−6z na okwu na-adịgide adịgide 1+4+9−9=5; ya mere otu na nhata mbụ.

l-m-h3-b0d10-39.material: Tụgharịa set isi P(x,y,z) hà nhata anya site na A(2, 0, 0) na B(−2, 0, 0); coordinates ọzọ bụ 2, 0, 0.
l-m-h3-b0d10-39.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụ xz-plane. Ụfọdụ isi anaghị anọ n’otu anya site na A na B.

l-m-h3-b0d10-39.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ PA²=PB², (x−2)²+y²+z²=(x+2)²+y²+z²; ime ka ọ dị mfe na-enye x=0. Ọ bụ yz-plane.
l-m-h3-b0d10-39.s.s2.model.0: Ịgbasa PA²=PB² na-enye −4x=4x, ya bụ x=0, yz-plane, perpendicular bisector plane nke AB.

l-m-h3-b0c33-27.topic: Tụnyere ụkpụrụ a tụrụ anya ya
l-m-h3-b0c33-27.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ gbasara nhọrọ abụọ site n’ụkpụrụ a tụrụ anya ya, họrọ nke ka mma ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c33-27.material: Nhọrọ A na-enye gị ego doro anya 8,000 won. Nhọrọ B bụ ịtụ isi mkpụrụ ego: isi na-enye 20,000 won, ọdụ na-enye 0 won. Tụnyere ha naanị site n’ụkpụrụ a tụrụ anya ya.
l-m-h3-b0c33-27.s.s1.prompt: Mkpebi nke ka mma dabere n’ụkpụrụ a tụrụ anya ya bụ nke aṅaa?
l-m-h3-b0c33-27.s.s1.o.a: B: ihe kacha mma ga-esi na ya pụta bụ 20,000 won
l-m-h3-b0c33-27.s.s1.r.a: Nke ahụ na-ele naanị ihe ọma ga-esi na ya pụta. A ghaghị itinyekwa 0 won nke ọdụ n’ime nkezi.
l-m-h3-b0c33-27.s.s1.o.b: B: ụkpụrụ a tụrụ anya ya 10,000 won > 8,000 won
l-m-h3-b0c33-27.s.s1.o.c: Ha hà nhata: nkezi bụ 8,000 won
l-m-h3-b0c33-27.s.s1.o.d: A: ego doro anya 8,000 won ka mma
l-m-h3-b0c33-27.s.s1.r.d: Ijide n’aka metụtara mmasị mmadụ n’ihe ize ndụ. B nwere ụkpụrụ a tụrụ anya ya ka ukwuu.
l-m-h3-b0c33-27.s.s1.explain: Ụkpụrụ a tụrụ anya ya nke B bụ 0.5×20,000+0.5×0=10,000 won, nke karịrị 8,000 won nke A.
l-m-h3-b0c33-27.s.s2.model.0: Ụkpụrụ a tụrụ anya ya nke B bụ 0.5×20,000+0.5×0=10,000 won, ya mere ọ karịrị A nke 8,000 won.
l-m-h3-b0c33-27.s.s2.model.1: Ụkpụrụ a tụrụ anya ya bụ ngụkọta ihe ga-esi na ya pụta nke ọ bụla amụbara na probability ya, ya mere ọbụna mgbe etinyere 0 won nke ọdụ, B ka ji 2,000 won karịa.

l-m-h3-b0c33-28.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ gbasara ịtụnyere ọsọ uto nke ụlọ ahịa abụọ, họrọ nke ka mma ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c33-28.material: Ire ụlọ ahịa A si na 100 × 10,000 won gaa na 200 × 10,000 won, nke ụlọ ahịa B si na 1,000 × 10,000 won gaa na 1,500 × 10,000 won. Anyị chọrọ ịtụnyere ọsọ uto ụlọ ahịa abụọ ahụ.
l-m-h3-b0c33-28.s.s1.prompt: Echiche nke ka mma iji tụnyere uto bụ nke aṅaa?
l-m-h3-b0c33-28.s.s1.o.a: Tụnyere ire afọ a: B ka ukwuu
l-m-h3-b0c33-28.s.s1.r.a: Uru afọ a naanị ya agaghị agwa anyị ole uto dị.
l-m-h3-b0c33-28.s.s1.o.b: Tụnyere ire mmalite: B ka ukwuu
l-m-h3-b0c33-28.s.s1.o.c: Tụnyere ego mmụba: B 500 × 10,000 won > A 100 × 10,000 won
l-m-h3-b0c33-28.s.s1.r.c: Nha ụlọ ahịa dị iche, ya mere ego mmụba naanị ya agaghị agwa anyị onye toro ngwa ngwa.
l-m-h3-b0c33-28.s.s1.explain: Ọnụego uto bụ mmụba e jiri uru mmalite tụnyere, ya mere enwere ike iji ya tụnyere ụlọ ahịa nha dị iche. A bụ 100%, B bụ 50%.
l-m-h3-b0c33-28.s.s2.model.0: Ọnụego uto bụ oke e jiri uru mmalite tụnyere: A bụ 100%, B bụ 50%, ya mere A toro ngwa ngwa.
l-m-h3-b0c33-28.s.s2.model.1: Nha ụlọ ahịa abụọ ahụ dị iche, ya mere ọ ka mma ma zie ezi karịa ịtụnyere oke uto na uru mmalite karịa ego mmụba.

l-m-h3-b0c34-25.title: Ọnụego ọmụrụ nwa 3.5% (a na-atụ ụtụ) vs 3.0% (enweghị ụtụ)
l-m-h3-b0c34-25.goal: Tụlee ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ gbasara ọmụrụ nwa fọdụrụ mgbe ụtụ gasịrị, họrọ nke dabara adaba ma kọwaa ihe akaebe.
l-m-h3-b0c34-25.material: E nwere nkwụnye ego afọ 1 abụọ. Akaụntụ A na-enye 3.5% kwa afọ, a na-atụ ụtụ 15.4% n’ọmụrụ nwa. Akaụntụ B na-enye 3.0% kwa afọ na-enweghị ụtụ. Ọ bụrụ na ego isi ha bụ otu, họrọ nke na-ahapụ ọmụrụ nwa ka ukwuu.
l-m-h3-b0c34-25.s.s1.o.a: A: ọnụego ọmụrụ nwa 3.5% ka elu
l-m-h3-b0c34-25.s.s1.r.a: Mgbe ụtụ gasịrị, ọnụego A na-ada ihe dịka 2.96%.
l-m-h3-b0c34-25.s.s1.o.b: Enweghị ike ịma: a maghị isi ego
l-m-h3-b0c34-25.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụrụ isi ego hà nhata, naanị ịtụnyere ọnụego ezuru; ọ dịghị mkpa ịma isi ego.
l-m-h3-b0c34-25.s.s1.o.c: Ha bụ otu: ụtụ anaghị emetụta ọmụrụ nwa
l-m-h3-b0c34-25.s.s1.r.c: A na-ewere ụtụ n’ọmụrụ nwa; ya mere ọmụrụ nwa i na-edebe na-ebelata.
l-m-h3-b0c34-25.s.s1.o.d: B: mgbe ụtụ gasịrị 3.0% > nke A ihe dịka 2.96%
l-m-h3-b0c34-25.s.s1.explain: A na-edobe 3.5%×(1−0.154)≈2.96%, nke dị ala karịa B 3.0%. Ọ bụrụ isi ego hà nhata, B na-enye karịa.
l-m-h3-b0c34-25.s.s2.model.0: Ọnụego A mgbe ụtụ gasịrị bụ 3.5%×0.846, ihe dịka 2.96%; ya mere ọ na-ahapụ ọmụrụ nwa pere mpe karịa B 3.0%.
l-m-h3-b0c34-25.s.s2.model.1: A ga-atụnyere ọnụego mgbe ụtụ gasịrị; ya mere ọbụna na ọnụego dị ala, B na-enweghị ụtụ na-ahapụ karịa.

l-m-h3-b0c34-26.material: Mmemme na-efu 20,000 won kwa ọnwa dịka ndenye aha, ma ọ bụ 360,000 won ịzụta otu oge. Ị na-eme atụmatụ iji ya afọ 2 (ọnwa 24). Họrọ nke ka mma site n’ọnụ ahịa niile.

l-m-h3-b0c34-27.goal: Tụlee ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ gbasara ọnụego mmụba ụgwọ ọnwa na nke ọnụahịa, họrọ nke dabara adaba ma kọwaa ihe akaebe.
l-m-h3-b0c34-27.material: Ụgwọ ọnwa rịrị 4%, ọnụahịa rịkwara 6% n’otu oge. A kwuru “Ụgwọ ọnwa rịrị, ya mere ndụ ka mma.” B kwuru “Ọnụahịa rịrị karịa, ya mere ihe anyị nwere ike ịzụta belatara.”
l-m-h3-b0c34-27.s.s1.o.a: B: n’ihi na ọnụahịa rịrị karịa ụgwọ ọnwa
l-m-h3-b0c34-27.s.s1.o.b: A: n’ihi na ụgwọ ọnwa adaghị
l-m-h3-b0c34-27.s.s1.r.b: Ọbụna ma ego ahụ mụbara, ọ bụrụ na ọnụahịa rịgoro karịa, ihe ị nwere ike ịzụta na-ebelata.
l-m-h3-b0c34-27.s.s1.o.c: A: n’ihi na mmụba ụgwọ 4% buru ibu nke ukwuu
l-m-h3-b0c34-27.s.s1.r.c: Ọbụna ma mmụba ahụ dị ukwuu, ọ dị ala karịa mmụba ọnụahịa 6%.
l-m-h3-b0c34-27.s.s1.o.d: Enweghị ike ịtụnyere: nkeji ha dị iche
l-m-h3-b0c34-27.s.s1.r.d: Ha abụọ bụ ọnụego mmụba (%), ya mere enwere ike ịtụnyere ha ozugbo.
l-m-h3-b0c34-27.s.s1.explain: Ụgwọ ọnwa rịrị 4%, ọnụahịa rịrị 6%. 1.04÷1.06≈0.98; ya mere ihe ị nwere ike ịzụta dara ihe dịka 2%.
l-m-h3-b0c34-27.s.s2.model.0: Ọnụahịa rịrị karịa ụgwọ ọnwa; ya mere otu ụgwọ ọnwa nwere ike ịzụta ihe pere mpe n’ezie.
l-m-h3-b0c34-27.s.s2.model.1: Ọnụego mmụba ụgwọ ọnwa 4% dị ala karịa ọnụego mmụba ọnụahịa 6%; ya mere enwere ike ikwu na ikike ịzụta n’ezie dara ihe dịka 2%.

l-m-h3-b0c34-28.title: Mgbanwe ego abụọ: kedu nke dị ọnụ ala ma tinye ụgwọ?
l-m-h3-b0c34-28.goal: Tụlee ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ gbasara ọnụ ahịa mgbanwe ego, na-atụle ma ọnụego mgbanwe na ụgwọ; họrọ nke dabara adaba ma kọwaa ihe akaebe.
l-m-h3-b0c34-28.material: Ị na-agbanwe dollar 100. Bank A na-ana 1,390 won maka dollar 1 n’enweghị ụgwọ. Bank B na-ana 1,380 won maka dollar 1, ma agbakwunyere ụgwọ 1% n’elu won ị na-akwụ.
l-m-h3-b0c34-28.s.s1.r.b: 1% nke 138,000 won bụ 1,380 won, nke karịrị ọdịiche ọnụego mgbanwe 1,000 won.
l-m-h3-b0c34-28.s.s1.o.c: Ha bụ otu: ụgwọ na ọnụego mgbanwe kagburu onwe ha
l-m-h3-b0c34-28.s.s1.r.c: A bụ 139,000 won, B bụ 139,380 won; ha dị iche.
l-m-h3-b0c34-28.s.s1.r.d: Ịgbakwunye ụgwọ 1% na-eme ka B dị ọnụ karịa, 139,380 won.
l-m-h3-b0c34-28.s.s1.explain: A bụ 139,000 won. B bụ 138,000×1.01=139,380 won; ya mere A dị ọnụ ala na 380 won.
l-m-h3-b0c34-28.s.s2.model.0: A bụ 100×1,390=139,000 won, B bụ 138,000 won tinyere 1%, ya bụ 139,380 won; ya mere A na-akwụ obere.
l-m-h3-b0c34-28.s.s2.model.1: B nwere ọnụego mgbanwe dị ala, ma ụgwọ 1,380 won ya karịrị ọdịiche ọnụego mgbanwe 1,000 won; ya mere ngụkọta ya dị elu.

l-m-h3-b0c34-29.goal: Tụlee ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ gbasara ụgwọ ịbanye na ọnụ ahịa mmezi atụ anya, họrọ nke dabara adaba ma kọwaa ihe akaebe.
l-m-h3-b0c34-29.material: Ọ bụrụ na ị kwụọ 3 × 10,000 won maka mkpuchi agbatị ngwa ụlọ, a ga-ewepụ ụgwọ mmezi 20 × 10,000 won ma ọ daa. Ohere ọ ga-adaba n’ime afọ 1 bụ 10%. Kpebie ma ị ga-abanye, dabere naanị n’ọnụ ahịa mmezi atụ anya.
l-m-h3-b0c34-29.s.s1.o.a: Banye: n’ihi na 20 × 10,000 won bụ nnukwu ego ma ọ daa
l-m-h3-b0c34-29.s.s1.r.a: Ị lere nha ego naanị, ịmụbaghị ya na ohere ọdịda 10%.
l-m-h3-b0c34-29.s.s1.o.b: Banye: n’ihi na ohere 10% adịghị ala
l-m-h3-b0c34-29.s.s1.r.b: A ga-amụba ohere na ọnụ ahịa mmezi, tụnyere ha dịka uru atụ anya.
l-m-h3-b0c34-29.s.s1.o.c: Ọ dịghị mkpa: uru atụ anya hà nhata 3 × 10,000 won
l-m-h3-b0c34-29.s.s1.r.c: Ọnụ ahịa mmezi atụ anya bụ 20 × 10,000 won × 0.1=2 × 10,000 won.
l-m-h3-b0c34-29.s.s1.o.d: Abanyela: ọnụ ahịa mmezi atụ anya 2 × 10,000 won < ụgwọ ịbanye 3 × 10,000 won
l-m-h3-b0c34-29.s.s1.explain: Ọnụ ahịa mmezi atụ anya bụ 20 × 10,000 won × 0.1=2 × 10,000 won, nke dị ala karịa ụgwọ ịbanye 3 × 10,000 won. N’ile uru atụ anya naanị, ị gaghị abanye.
l-m-h3-b0c34-29.s.s2.model.0: Ọnụ ahịa mmezi atụ anya bụ 20 × 10,000 won × 0.1=2 × 10,000 won, ụgwọ ịbanye 3 × 10,000 won ka ukwuu; ya mere dịka uru atụ anya si dị, ọ ka mma ịghara ịbanye.
l-m-h3-b0c34-29.s.s2.model.1: Ọbụna ma ọ daa, ná nkezi ị na-echekwa naanị 2 × 10,000 won; ịkwụ 3 × 10,000 won bụ mfu dịka uru atụ anya si dị.

l-m-h3-b0c35-22.title: Ịtụnyere uru atụ anya na ihe ize ndụ ọnụ
l-m-h3-b0c35-22.goal: Tụlee ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ gbasara uru atụ anya na ihe ize ndụ nke ngwaahịa abụọ, họrọ nke dabara adaba ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c35-22.material: A nwere ohere ọkara nke ịlaghachi +10% ma ọ bụ −2%, B nwekwara ohere ọkara nke +30% ma ọ bụ −20%. Tụlee oke mgbanwe kwa, ọ bụghị uru atụ anya naanị.
l-m-h3-b0c35-22.s.s1.o.a: A nwere uru atụ anya ka elu, ya mere ọ ka mma n’ụzọ niile
l-m-h3-b0c35-22.s.s1.r.a: A bụ 4%, B bụ 5%; ya mere uru atụ anya B ka elu.
l-m-h3-b0c35-22.s.s1.o.b: A dị ize ndụ karịa n’ihi na ohere mfu ya dị iche
l-m-h3-b0c35-22.s.s1.r.b: Ngwaahịa abụọ ahụ nwere otu ohere 50% nke mfu.
l-m-h3-b0c35-22.s.s1.o.c: B nwere uru atụ anya ka elu ma ihe ize ndụ dị ala
l-m-h3-b0c35-22.s.s1.r.c: B na-agbada ruo −20%, ya mere ihe ize ndụ ya ka ukwuu n’ezie.
l-m-h3-b0c35-22.s.s1.o.d: B nwere uru atụ anya dị elu site na 1%p na oke mgbanwe sara mbara
l-m-h3-b0c35-22.s.s1.explain: Uru atụ anya bụ 4% maka A na 5% maka B; oke nloghachi bụ −2 ruo 10% maka A, −20 ruo 30% maka B; ya mere B na-agbanwe karịa.
l-m-h3-b0c35-22.s.s2.model.0: A bụ 0.5×10−0.5×2=4%, B bụ 0.5×30−0.5×20=5%; B nwere uru atụ anya ka elu ma ọ nwere ike ịda ruo −20%.
l-m-h3-b0c35-22.s.s2.model.1: Ha abụọ nwere otu ohere 50% nke mfu; ọdịiche bụ nha mfu ahụ, B dị ize ndụ karịa n’agbanyeghị na nkezi ya dị elu.

l-m-h3-b0c35-30.material: I tinyere 1,000×10,000 won maka afọ 1. A na-enye 3.0% kwa afọ na-enweghị ụtụ ọmụrụ nwa. B na-enye 3.4%, ma a na-ewere 15.4% nke ọmụrụ nwa dịka ụtụ.
l-m-h3-b0c35-30.s.s1.prompt: Nke a na-enye ọmụrụ nwa fọdụrụ n'aka gị karịa?

l-m-h3-b0c35-30.s.s1.o.b: B, 34×10,000 ma e jiri ya tụnyere 30×10,000
l-m-h3-b0c35-30.s.s1.r.b: I wepughi ụtụ n'ọmụrụ nwa B.
l-m-h3-b0c35-30.s.s1.o.c: B, ihe dịka 31×10,000 ọbụna mgbe ụtụ gasịrị
l-m-h3-b0c35-30.s.s1.r.c: I tụrụ ụtụ ahụ ka ọ dị obere karịa eziokwu.
l-m-h3-b0c35-30.s.s1.r.d: I gbakọtaghị ọmụrụ nwa mgbe ụtụ gasịrị ozugbo.
l-m-h3-b0c35-30.s.s1.explain: Ụtụ B bụ 34×0.154≈5.2 (×10,000 won); ọmụrụ nwa fọdụrụ bụ ihe dịka 28.8×10,000, nke dị ala karịa 30×10,000 nke A.
l-m-h3-b0c35-30.s.s2.model.0: B nwere 34×10,000 won; a na-ewepụ 5.2×10,000 won, nke bụ 15.4% nke 34×10,000; ihe dịka 28.8×10,000 fọdụrụ, ya mere 30×10,000 nke A ka ukwuu.

l-m-h3-b0c36-25.title: Vektọ abụọ ahụ na-atụ aka n’otu ụzọ?
l-m-h3-b0c36-25.goal: Tụlee ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ gbasara ntụziaka vektọ (1,2) na (2,4), họrọ nke dabara adaba ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0c36-25.material: E nwere nkwupụta abụọ banyere ntụziaka u=(1,2) na v=(2,4). Nkwupụta A: ihe ndị mejupụtara dị iche, ya mere ntụziaka dị iche. Nkwupụta B: v bụ ugboro 2 nke u, ya mere ntụziaka otu.
l-m-h3-b0c36-25.s.s1.o.a: A: ihe ndị mejupụtara dị iche, ya mere ntụziaka dị iche
l-m-h3-b0c36-25.s.s1.r.a: I chefuru na vektọ nwere ike ịdị nha dị iche ma ka na-atụ aka n’otu ụzọ.
l-m-h3-b0c36-25.s.s1.o.b: B: ọ bụ mmekọrịta ugboro 2, ya mere ntụziaka otu
l-m-h3-b0c36-25.s.s1.o.c: Ha abụọ ziri ezi: ntụziaka ọ bụla ga-ekwe omume
l-m-h3-b0c36-25.s.s1.r.c: A na-ekpebi ntụziaka dịka otu naanị. Nkwupụta abụọ na-emegiderịta enweghị ike ịbụ eziokwu abụọ.
l-m-h3-b0c36-25.s.s1.o.d: Nha ha ga-abụrịrị otu ka ntụziaka ha bụrụ otu
l-m-h3-b0c36-25.s.s1.r.d: Ị gwakọtara nha na ntụziaka. A na-ekpebi ntụziaka iche na nha.
l-m-h3-b0c36-25.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ v=2u, v bụ u agbatị n’otu ntụziaka. Nha naanị dị iche, ntụziaka bụ otu.
l-m-h3-b0c36-25.s.s2.model.0: v=(2,4)=2×(1,2); ya mere ọ bụ u agbatị ka ọ bụrụ ogologo okpukpu abụọ n’otu ntụziaka. Ihe ndị mejupụtara dị iche n’ihi na nha dị iche.
l-m-h3-b0c36-25.s.s2.model.1: Vektọ nwere otu ntụziaka bụ ibe ha mụbara na ọnụọgụ dị mma; ya mere B nke nwere mmekọrịta ugboro 2 ziri ezi, A weere ọdịiche nha dịka ọdịiche ntụziaka.

l-m-h3-b0c36-26.title: Nsonaazụ nyocha nke a ka anyị tụkwasị obi?
l-m-h3-b0c36-26.goal: Tụlee ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ gbasara nsonaazụ nyocha abụọ nwere nha ihe atụ dị iche, họrọ nke dabara adaba ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0c36-26.material: Maka otu iwu, na Nnyocha A mmadụ 30 n’ime 50 (60%) kwadoro, na Nnyocha B mmadụ 280 n’ime 500 (56%) kwadoro. A họọrọ mmadụ abụọ ahụ n’otu ụzọ.
l-m-h3-b0c36-26.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nke a tụkwasịrị obi karịa iji maa ọnụego nkwado niile?
l-m-h3-b0c36-26.s.s1.o.a: Otu: oke abụọ ahụ yiri ibe ha
l-m-h3-b0c36-26.s.s1.r.a: Ọbụna ma oke yiri ibe ha, ogo ntụkwasị obi dabere na nha ihe atụ.
l-m-h3-b0c36-26.s.s1.o.b: A: ọnụego nkwado pụtara elu karịa
l-m-h3-b0c36-26.s.s1.r.b: Uru dị elu apụtaghị na a pụrụ ịtụkwasị ya obi karịa.
l-m-h3-b0c36-26.s.s1.o.c: A: ọ ziri ezi n’ihi na ọnụọgụ ndị zara pere mpe
l-m-h3-b0c36-26.s.s1.r.c: Ka ihe atụ na-adị ntakịrị, mmetụta ohere na-adị ukwuu.
l-m-h3-b0c36-26.s.s1.o.d: B: ihe atụ buru ibu, ya mere oke njehie pere mpe
l-m-h3-b0c36-26.s.s1.explain: Ka ihe atụ na-ebuwanye, oke ihe atụ na-abịaru nso na oke igwe mmadụ, oke njehie na-ebelata. Ya mere Nnyocha B ka a tụkwasịrị obi karịa.
l-m-h3-b0c36-26.s.s2.model.0: Ihe atụ 10 ugboro buru ibu nwere njehie ọkọlọtọ pere mpe, ya mere 56% nke Nnyocha B nwere ike ịdị nso karịa na ọnụego nkwado niile.
l-m-h3-b0c36-26.s.s2.model.1: N’ime mmadụ 50, oke ahụ na-agbanwe nke ukwuu ma mmadụ ole na ole dị iche; ya mere enwere ike ịtụkwasị nsonaazụ mmadụ 500 obi karịa.

l-m-h3-b0c36-27.title: Ịtụnyere learning rate 1.0 na 0.1
l-m-h3-b0c36-27.goal: Tụlee ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ gbasara gradient descent nwere learning rate dị iche, họrọ nke dabara adaba ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0c36-27.material: Mee gradient descent na f(x)=x² site n’ọnọdụ mmalite x=4. Na learning rate 1.0, x na-aga 4→−4→4→…; na 0.1 ọ gbanwere 4→3.2→2.56→… .
l-m-h3-b0c36-27.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nke dabara adaba ịchọta nke kacha nta na x=0?
l-m-h3-b0c36-27.s.s1.o.a: Learning rate 1.0: ọ na-agagharị nke ukwuu otu mgbe
l-m-h3-b0c36-27.s.s1.r.a: Ọ na-agagharị nke ukwuu, ma ọ gafere ebe kacha nta wee na-aga azụ na n’ihu n’otu ebe.
l-m-h3-b0c36-27.s.s1.o.b: Learning rate 0.1: ọ na-abịaru 0 nso nke nta nke nta
l-m-h3-b0c36-27.s.s1.o.c: Ha bụ otu: ha na-eji otu usoro
l-m-h3-b0c36-27.s.s1.r.c: Ọbụna na otu usoro, nsonaazụ na-adị iche dabere na learning rate.
l-m-h3-b0c36-27.s.s1.o.d: Learning rate 1.0: ọ gafere 0 ma na-abịaru nso karịa
l-m-h3-b0c36-27.s.s1.r.d: Mgbe ọ gafere 0, ọ na-aga azụ na n’ihu n’etiti 4 na −4. Ọ naghị abịaru nso.
l-m-h3-b0c36-27.s.s1.explain: Learning rate 1.0 na-aga azụ na n’ihu n’etiti −4 na 4, ọ naghị abịaru 0 nso. Na 0.1, uru ahụ na-aghọ 0.8 ugboro oge ọ bụla ma na-abịaru 0 nso.
l-m-h3-b0c36-27.s.s2.model.0: Learning rate 1.0 na-emegharị naanị 4 na −4, ya mere ọ gaghị erute nke kacha nta; na 0.1 uru ahụ na-ebelata ma na-abịaru 0 nso.
l-m-h3-b0c36-27.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na nzọụkwụ buru oke ibu, ọ gafere nke kacha nta wee malite ịla azụ na n’ihu; ya mere learning rate nta 0.1 dabara adaba.

l-m-h3-b0c36-28.title: Ànyị kwesịrị ịtụkwasị ihe nlereanya nwere akara ọzụzụ dị elu obi?
l-m-h3-b0c36-28.goal: Tụlee ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ gbasara ihe nlereanya abụọ nwere akara ọzụzụ na nnwale dị iche, họrọ nke dabara adaba ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0c36-28.material: Ihe nlereanya P nwere izi ezi 99% na data ọzụzụ, 80% na data nnwale ọ na-ahụbeghị. Ihe nlereanya Q nwere 88% n’ọzụzụ, 86% na nnwale. A tụrụ ha abụọ n’otu ụzọ.
l-m-h3-b0c36-28.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ihe nlereanya a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi karịa na data ọhụrụ?
l-m-h3-b0c36-28.s.s1.o.a: P: o nwere izi ezi ọzụzụ kacha elu
l-m-h3-b0c36-28.s.s1.r.a: Ọbụna na akara ọzụzụ dị elu, o dara na data ọ na-ahụbeghị.
l-m-h3-b0c36-28.s.s1.o.b: P: ọ bụ 99% n’ọzụzụ, ya mere 80% bụ ohere
l-m-h3-b0c36-28.s.s1.r.b: Akara nnwale 80% na-agwa anyị karịa banyere arụmọrụ na data ọhụrụ.
l-m-h3-b0c36-28.s.s1.o.c: Ha bụ otu: nkezi akara abụọ ahụ yiri ibe ha
l-m-h3-b0c36-28.s.s1.r.c: Nkezi ahụ anaghị agwa anyị arụmọrụ na data ọhụrụ.
l-m-h3-b0c36-28.s.s1.o.d: Q: ọdịiche akara ọzụzụ na nnwale pere mpe
l-m-h3-b0c36-28.s.s1.explain: P dabere nke ukwuu na data ọzụzụ (overfitting) ma daa nke ukwuu na nnwale. Q, nke nwere akara nnwale dị elu na obere ọdịiche, ka a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi.
l-m-h3-b0c36-28.s.s2.model.0: P nwere ọdịiche pasent 19 n’etiti ọzụzụ na nnwale, ya mere ọ dabere na data ọzụzụ; Q nwere 86% n’ule, ya mere a pụrụ ịtụkwasị ya obi karịa.
l-m-h3-b0c36-28.s.s2.model.1: Akara nnwale na-egosi arụmọrụ data ọhụrụ; ya mere Q nwere 86% ka P nwere 80% mma, ọdịiche ya dịkwa ntakịrị.

l-m-h3-b0c36-29.goal: Tụlee ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ gbasara ohere mgbe nsonaazụ ụfọdụ pụtara n’usoro n’ịtụ mkpụrụ ego, họrọ nke dabara adaba ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0c36-29.material: A tụgharịrị mkpụrụ ego ziri ezi, isi pụta ugboro 5 n’usoro. Nkwupụta A: ohere ọdụ dị elu ugbu a. Nkwupụta B: ohere ọdụ na ntụgharị na-esote ka bụ 1/2.
l-m-h3-b0c36-29.s.s1.o.a: A: Isi pụtara ọtụtụ, ya mere ọ ga-akwụghachi
l-m-h3-b0c36-29.s.s1.r.a: Mkpụrụ ego anaghị echeta nsonaazụ gara aga.
l-m-h3-b0c36-29.s.s1.o.b: B: Ntụgharị ọ bụla enweghị ịdabere na ndị ọzọ
l-m-h3-b0c36-29.s.s1.o.c: A: Ugboro 5 n’usoro bụ ihe a na-adịghị ahụkebe, ya mere ọdụ ga-ebu ụzọ pụta
l-m-h3-b0c36-29.s.s1.r.c: Ugboro 5 n’usoro adịghị ahụkebe, ma ohere otu ntụgharị na-esote anaghị agbanwe.
l-m-h3-b0c36-29.s.s1.o.d: Ha abụọ ezighị ezi: nke na-esote ga-abụrịrị isi
l-m-h3-b0c36-29.s.s1.r.d: Ọbụna mgbe isi pụtara ugboro 5, ị gaghị ama nsonaazụ ọzọ n’ezie.
l-m-h3-b0c36-29.s.s1.explain: Nsonaazụ ntụgharị enweghị ịdabere, ya mere isi 5 gara aga anaghị agbanwe ohere nke ọzọ. Ohere ọdụ ka bụ 1/2.
l-m-h3-b0c36-29.s.s2.model.0: Ntụgharị ọ bụla enweghị ịdabere; isi 5 gara aga anaghị emetụta ohere ọzọ, ọdụ ka bụ 1/2.

l-m-h3-b0c37-25.title: Ndụmọdụ akwụkwọ: dot product na cosine similarity
l-m-h3-b0c37-25.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ abụọ ịhọrọ akwụkwọ dabara na mmasị, họrọ nke kacha dabara ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0c37-25.material: Mmasị bụ s=(1,2), Akwụkwọ X=(1,2), Akwụkwọ Y=(6,0). Usoro A na-ahọrọ akwụkwọ nwere dot product ka ukwuu, Usoro B na-ahọrọ nke nwere cosine similarity ka ukwuu cosθ=(a·b)/(|a||b|). Ebumnuche bụ akwụkwọ nwere otu “ntụziaka” na mmasị ahụ.
l-m-h3-b0c37-25.s.s1.prompt: Kedu usoro dabara nke ọma n’ebumnuche ịchọta akwụkwọ nwere otu ntụziaka?
l-m-h3-b0c37-25.s.s1.o.a: A: Họrọ akwụkwọ nwere dot product kacha ukwuu
l-m-h3-b0c37-25.s.s1.r.a: Dot product na-abawanye ka vector na-ebuwanye ibu, ya mere ọ pụghị iji ntụziaka naanị tụnyere.
l-m-h3-b0c37-25.s.s1.r.b: Usoro A na-ahọrọ Y, Usoro B na-ahọrọ X, ya mere ha dị iche.
l-m-h3-b0c37-25.s.s1.o.c: B: Kewaa site na nha ma tụnyere naanị ntụziaka
l-m-h3-b0c37-25.s.s1.o.d: A: Akwụkwọ buru ibu ka mma mgbe niile
l-m-h3-b0c37-25.s.s1.r.d: Nha enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na otú o si dabara n’ihe ụtọ.
l-m-h3-b0c37-25.s.s1.explain: X nwere otu ntụziaka na s, ya mere cos=1, Y dịkwa ihe dịka 0.45. Dot product na-enye Y, nke buru ibu, ọkwa dị elu; ya mere ọ dabaraghị n’ebumnuche ntụziaka.
l-m-h3-b0c37-25.s.s2.model.0: Cosine similarity na-ekewa site na nha ma tụnyere naanị ntụziaka, ya mere ọ na-ahọrọ X, nke nwere otu ntụziaka na s, dabara n’ebumnuche.
l-m-h3-b0c37-25.s.s2.model.1: Dot product dị elu, 6, n’ihi na Y buru ibu, ma ntụziaka ya dị iche; ọ bụrụ na ntụziaka bụ ebumnuche, B kacha dabara.

l-m-h3-b0c37-26.title: Olee otu anyị ga-esi họrọ ndị anyị ga-ajụ nyocha?
l-m-h3-b0c37-26.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ abụọ sampling iji chọpụta afọ ojuju ụlọ akwụkwọ niile maka nri ehihie, họrọ nke kacha dabara ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0c37-26.material: Ị chọrọ ịma afọ ojuju ụmụ akwụkwọ 600 niile maka nri ehihie ụlọ akwụkwọ. Usoro A na-ahọrọ ụmụ akwụkwọ 60 na listi n’amaghị ama. Usoro B na-ajụ ụmụ akwụkwọ 60 o zutere n’ihu ụlọ nri ehihie.
l-m-h3-b0c37-26.s.s1.prompt: Kedu usoro dabara nke ọma iji mee atụmatụ afọ ojuju ụlọ akwụkwọ niile?
l-m-h3-b0c37-26.s.s1.o.a: B: Ịjụ n’ebe ahụ ziri ezi karịa
l-m-h3-b0c37-26.s.s1.r.a: Ọ na-ezute naanị ụmụ akwụkwọ riri nri ehihie, ya mere ọ nwere ike ịdọrọ n’otu akụkụ.
l-m-h3-b0c37-26.s.s1.o.b: Ha bụ otu: ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ hà nhata, 60
l-m-h3-b0c37-26.s.s1.r.b: Ọbụna mgbe ọnụọgụ mmadụ hà nhata, bias dị iche dabere n’otú e si họrọ ha.
l-m-h3-b0c37-26.s.s1.o.c: A: Nwa akwụkwọ ọ bụla nwere ohere hà nhata ka a họrọ ya
l-m-h3-b0c37-26.s.s1.o.d: B: Ọ na-agwụ ngwa ngwa, ya mere njehie dị obere
l-m-h3-b0c37-26.s.s1.r.d: Ịmecha ngwa ngwa enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na nha njehie.
l-m-h3-b0c37-26.s.s1.explain: Na random sampling, onye ọ bụla nwere ohere hà nhata ka a họrọ ya, ya mere sample yiri ndị niile. N’ihu ụlọ nri ehihie, ọ na-adọrọ n’ebe ụmụ akwụkwọ na-eri nri ehihie.
l-m-h3-b0c37-26.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na i họrọ n’amaghị ama na listi, nwa akwụkwọ ọ bụla nwere ohere hà nhata, ya mere sample na-anọchite anya ụlọ akwụkwọ niile.
l-m-h3-b0c37-26.s.s2.model.1: N’ihu ụlọ nri ehihie, ị na-ezute naanị ụmụ akwụkwọ na-eri nri ehihie, ya mere afọ ojuju na-adọrọ n’otu akụkụ; A kacha dabara.

l-m-h3-b0c37-27.title: MSE na MAE: ịchọta nnukwu njehie
l-m-h3-b0c37-27.goal: Tụlee ụzọ abụọ e si atụ njehie, MAE na MSE, họrọ nke dabara adaba ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0c37-27.material: Njehie Model P bụ (2,2,2,2), nke Model Q bụ (0,0,0,8). Nkezi njehie zuru oke (MAE) nke abụọ ahụ bụ 2. Anyị chọrọ izere nnukwu njehie nke ukwuu.
l-m-h3-b0c37-27.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ọnụọgụ ka dabara adaba iji mata ọdịiche dị n’etiti ihe nlereanya abụọ ahụ?
l-m-h3-b0c37-27.s.s1.o.a: MAE: ihe nlereanya abụọ ahụ bụ otu, nke ahụ ezuru
l-m-h3-b0c37-27.s.s1.r.a: Uru ha hà nhata; ya mere ọ gaghị egosi ihe nlereanya nwere nnukwu njehie.
l-m-h3-b0c37-27.s.s1.o.b: MAE: ọ naghị anabata outlier, ya mere enweghị ike iji ya
l-m-h3-b0c37-27.s.s1.r.b: MAE na-ata nnukwu njehie ahụhụ ntakịrị. Ọ bụghị ihe a na-apụghị iji.
l-m-h3-b0c37-27.s.s1.o.c: MSE: ngụkọta njehie ha bụ otu, ya mere ọ gaghị amata ọdịiche
l-m-h3-b0c37-27.s.s1.r.c: MSE bụ 4 maka P, 16 maka Q; ha dị iche, ya mere enwere ike ịmata ha.
l-m-h3-b0c37-27.s.s1.o.d: MSE: a na-eme square nke nnukwu njehie Q, ya pụta ìhè
l-m-h3-b0c37-27.s.s1.explain: MSE bụ 4 maka P, 16 maka Q. Ọ na-eme square nke nnukwu njehie, na-agụ ya karịa; ya mere ọ na-egosi Q nwere nnukwu njehie.
l-m-h3-b0c37-27.s.s2.model.0: MAE bụ 2 maka ha abụọ, ya mere ọ naghị amata ha; MSE bụ 4 na 16, dị iche, ma na-egosi Q nwere nnukwu njehie 8. Ya mere MSE dabara.
l-m-h3-b0c37-27.s.s2.model.1: Ebumnuche bụ izere nnukwu njehie; MSE na-eme square njehie ma na-ata nnukwu uru ahụhụ karịa, ya mere ọ dabara.

l-m-h3-b0c37-28.title: Gịnị ka ihe nzacha spam kwesịrị ilekwasị anya karịa?
l-m-h3-b0c37-28.goal: Tụlee ụzọ abụọ e si nyochaa ihe nzacha spam, precision na recall, họrọ nke dabara adaba ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0c37-28.material: Ihe nzacha spam na-ekewa ozi dịka spam. Nsogbu kacha njọ bụ mgbe ozi dị mkpa dabara na folda spam, ị hụghị ya. Nkwupụta A: anyị kwesịrị ilekwasị anya na recall. B: anyị kwesịrị ilekwasị anya na precision.
l-m-h3-b0c37-28.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nkwupụta dabara adaba na ebumnuche a?
l-m-h3-b0c37-28.s.s1.o.a: A: ọ gaghị echefu ọbụna otu spam
l-m-h3-b0c37-28.s.s1.r.a: Ịhapụ spam bụ naanị nsogbu. Ị gaghị efunahụ ozi dị mkpa.
l-m-h3-b0c37-28.s.s1.o.b: A: ka recall dị elu, ozi nkịtị na-adị nchebe
l-m-h3-b0c37-28.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụrụ ị kpọọ ọtụtụ ozi spam iji bulie recall, a ga-ejidekwu ozi nkịtị.
l-m-h3-b0c37-28.s.s1.o.c: Ọ dịghị nke a dị mkpa: accuracy ezuru
l-m-h3-b0c37-28.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụrụ spam dị ntakịrị, ọbụna accuracy dị elu agaghị agwa gị ole ozi nkịtị furu efu.
l-m-h3-b0c37-28.s.s1.o.d: B: ihe ọ kpọrọ spam ga-abụrịrị spam n’ezie
l-m-h3-b0c37-28.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na e kenyere ozi nkịtị spam n’amaghị ama, precision na-ebelata. Ichebe ozi dị mkpa chọrọ precision nke ozi a kpọrọ spam.
l-m-h3-b0c37-28.s.s2.model.0: Ozi nkịtị agaghị abụ spam; ya mere lelee precision, oke spam n’ezie n’etiti ihe a kpọrọ spam.
l-m-h3-b0c37-28.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ ịkpọ ọtụtụ ozi spam na-ebuli recall, a ga-ejide ozi dị mkpa; ya mere B nke na-elekwasị anya na precision dabara.

l-m-h3-b0c37-29.title: Kedu n’ime ahịrị abụọ dabara data karịa?
l-m-h3-b0c37-29.goal: Tụlee ụdị ahịrị abụọ e tinyere n’otu isi data, họrọ nke dabara adaba ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0c37-29.material: E tinyere ahịrị abụọ na isi (1,2), (2,4), (3,5). Model A: y=2x. Model B: y=1.5x+0.5. Ka nkezi square ọdịiche amụma na uru n’ezie (MSE) dị nta, ka ọ ka mma.
l-m-h3-b0c37-29.s.s1.prompt: Kedu model nwere MSE pere mpe?
l-m-h3-b0c37-29.s.s1.o.a: A: ọ na-agafe isi abụọ kpọmkwem, ya mere ọ ka mma
l-m-h3-b0c37-29.s.s1.r.a: B na-agafekwa isi abụọ kpọmkwem. A ga-atụnyere njehie n’isi fọdụrụ.
l-m-h3-b0c37-29.s.s1.o.b: A: naanị otu njehie bụ 1, ya mere ọ pere mpe
l-m-h3-b0c37-29.s.s1.r.b: Square njehie 1 bụ 1, nke karịrị 0.25 nke B.
l-m-h3-b0c37-29.s.s1.r.c: Ọbụna na isi 3, enwere ike ịgbakọ ma tụnyere MSE.
l-m-h3-b0c37-29.s.s1.o.d: B: nkezi square njehie pere mpe, ihe dịka 0.08
l-m-h3-b0c37-29.s.s1.explain: Njehie A bụ (0,0,−1), ya mere MSE=1/3; nke B bụ (0,0.5,0), ya mere MSE=0.25/3≈0.08. Nke B pere mpe.
l-m-h3-b0c37-29.s.s2.model.0: A bụ otu njehie 1 e mere square, kewaa na 3, ihe dịka 0.33; B bụ 0.5²=0.25 kewaa na 3, ihe dịka 0.08; ya mere B pere mpe.
l-m-h3-b0c37-29.s.s2.model.1: Model abụọ ahụ metụrụ isi abụọ kpọmkwem; mgbe e jiri njehie isi fọdụrụ tụnyere, 1 na 0.5, B dabara karịa.

l-m-h3-b0c38-07.goal: Tụlee ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ maka ịhọrọ ndị ọrụ nwere ụdị mmasị yiri ibe ha, họrọ nke dabara adaba ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0c38-07.material: Vektọ akara fim atọ: P=(1,2,3), Q=(2,4,6), R=(3,2,1). Q na-enye akara obiọma karịa P, ma usoro ihe ha masịrị bụ otu. Anyị chọrọ iji usoro ahụ tụnyere, ọ bụghị nha akara.
l-m-h3-b0c38-07.s.s1.prompt: Onye nwere ụdị mmasị kacha yie P bụ onye dị aṅaa, gịnịkwa kpatara ya?
l-m-h3-b0c38-07.s.s1.o.a: Q, vektọ abụọ ahụ nwere otu ntụziaka
l-m-h3-b0c38-07.s.s1.o.b: R, ngụkọta akara ha bụ otu na P
l-m-h3-b0c38-07.s.s1.r.b: Ọbụna ma ngụkọta hà nhata, usoro fim ndị masịrị ha megidere.
l-m-h3-b0c38-07.s.s1.o.c: R, anya dị n’etiti ya na P pere mpe
l-m-h3-b0c38-07.s.s1.r.c: Nha akara na-emegharị anya; ọ nwere ike ghara ịhụ ụkpụrụ ahụ.
l-m-h3-b0c38-07.s.s1.o.d: Q, ngụkọta akara ya karịrị nke P
l-m-h3-b0c38-07.s.s1.r.d: Ngụkọta ka ukwuu abụghị ihe kpatara ịdị ka ibe ya.
l-m-h3-b0c38-07.s.s1.explain: Q=2P; ya mere ntụziaka ha bụ otu, cosine similarity bụ 1. Ọ bụ ezie na R dị nso n’anya, usoro mmasị ya megidere.
l-m-h3-b0c38-07.s.s2.model.0: Q bụ ugboro 2 nke P, ntụziaka ha bụ otu, cosine similarity bụ 1; ya mere enwere ike iwere ụdị mmasị ha dịka otu.
l-m-h3-b0c38-07.s.s2.model.1: Nha akara ndị mmadụ na-enye n’obiọma na-emetụta anya; mgbe a na-atụnyere ụkpụrụ, cosine nke na-ele ntụziaka dabara karịa.

l-m-h3-b0c38-32.material: Ụdị X: training accuracy 98%, validation accuracy 80%. Ụdị Y: training 90%, validation 88%. Ejighị data validation n’ọzụzụ. Họrọ ụdị ga-arụ ọrụ nke ọma na data ọhụrụ.
l-m-h3-b0c38-32.s.s1.r.a: Akara training gụnyekwara ole e chetara. Ọ bụghị arụmọrụ na data ọhụrụ.

l-m-h3-b0c38-32.s.s1.r.b: Nkezi ahụ hà nhata 89, ma akara validation bụ nke na-anọchite anya data ọhụrụ.
l-m-h3-b0c38-32.s.s1.o.c: X, akara abụọ ahụ dịkarịa ala 80%
l-m-h3-b0c38-32.s.s1.r.c: Ọbụna ma ha abụọ gafere, nke nwere validation score dị elu ka mma.
l-m-h3-b0c38-32.s.s1.explain: Validation score dị nso na arụmọrụ data ọhụrụ. Y bụ 88%, dị elu karịa 80% nke X, ọdịiche dị n’etiti akara abụọ ya dịkwa ntakịrị.
l-m-h3-b0c38-32.s.s2.model.0: Ejighị data validation n’ọzụzụ, ya mere ọ dị nso na arụmọrụ data ọhụrụ; Y, nke nwere akara dị elu, kacha dabara.

l-m-h3-b0c39-28.title: Kedu ngwakọta fatịlaịza ka siri ike karịa?
l-m-h3-b0c39-28.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ gbasara ike ngwakọta fatịlaịza A na B, họrọ nke kacha dabara ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0c39-28.material: Ngwakọta A gwakọtara akpa fatịlaịza 1 na akpa mmiri 3; B gwakọtara akpa fatịlaịza 2 na akpa mmiri 5. Ị chọrọ iji otu ụkpụrụ tụnyere nke siri ike karịa.
l-m-h3-b0c39-28.s.s1.prompt: Nke siri ike bụ nke aṅaa, gịnịkwa mere?
l-m-h3-b0c39-28.s.s1.o.a: A: n’ihi na mmiri dị ntakịrị
l-m-h3-b0c39-28.s.s1.r.a: Ngụkọta ihe agwakọtara dị iche, ya mere ị gaghị eji naanị mmiri tụnyere ha.
l-m-h3-b0c39-28.s.s1.o.b: B: oke fatịlaịza 2/7 ka ukwuu karịa 1/4 nke A
l-m-h3-b0c39-28.s.s1.o.c: Ha hà nhata: n’ihi na ha abụọ nwere mmiri karịa fatịlaịza
l-m-h3-b0c39-28.s.s1.r.c: A bụ 25% nke ngụkọta, B bụ ihe dịka 28.6%, ya mere ha dị iche.
l-m-h3-b0c39-28.s.s1.o.d: A: n’ihi na ọnụọgụ akpa fatịlaịza pere mpe
l-m-h3-b0c39-28.s.s1.r.d: Ị gaghị amata ike site n’ọnụọgụ akpa naanị. Lelee oke ya n’ime ngụkọta.
l-m-h3-b0c39-28.s.s1.explain: Oke fatịlaịza n’ime ngụkọta bụ 1/4=25% maka A, 2/7, ihe dịka 28.6%, maka B. B siri ike karịa.
l-m-h3-b0c39-28.s.s2.model.0: A nwere akpa fatịlaịza 1 n’ime akpa 4 niile, ya bụ 25%; B nwere 2 n’ime 7, ihe dịka 28.6%, ya mere B siri ike karịa.
l-m-h3-b0c39-28.s.s2.model.1: Ngụkọta ahụ dị iche, ya mere a ga-eji oke n’ime ngụkọta tụnyere, ọ bụghị mmiri. 2/7 karịrị 1/4.

l-m-h3-b0c39-29.material: Ụzọ nnyefe A bufere iwu 98% n’ime 1,000 n’oge, ụzọ B bufere 90% n’ime 200 n’oge. Usoro 1 bụ (98+90)÷2=94%; Usoro 2 na-enweta ya site n’ịjikọta ọnụọgụ iwu.

l-m-h3-b0c39-29.s.s1.r.d: Usoro 1 na-enye 94%, Usoro 2 na-enye ihe dịka 96.7%, ya mere ha dị iche.

l-m-h3-b0c39-29.s.s2.model.0: Oke abụọ nwere ọnụọgụ iwu dị iche na-enweta arọ dị iche dabere n’ọnụọgụ iwu, ya mere e kwesịghị iwepụta nkezi naanị. Usoro 2, 1,160÷1,200, ziri ezi.

l-m-h3-b0c39-31.goal: Tụnyere ngụkọta ọnụ ahịa atụmatụ ọrụ mmadụ abụọ maka otu ọrụ, họrọ nke kacha dabara ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c39-31.material: A na-arụ otu ọrụ site n’aka mmadụ 3 n’ụbọchị 4 ma ọ bụ mmadụ 4 n’ụbọchị 3. Ụgwọ ụbọchị mmadụ 1 bụ 100,000 won (10×10,000), ụgwọ mgbazinye akụrụngwa bụ 30,000 won (3×10,000) kwa ụbọchị.
l-m-h3-b0c39-31.s.s1.prompt: Kedu usoro na-efu obere n’ozuzu, gịnịkwa mere?
l-m-h3-b0c39-31.s.s1.o.a: Mmadụ 3, ụbọchị 4: n’ihi na mmadụ dị ole na ole
l-m-h3-b0c39-31.s.s1.r.a: Person-days ọrụ ha hà nhata, 12 maka ha abụọ, ya mere ụgwọ ọrụ hà nhata.

l-m-h3-b0c39-31.s.s1.r.b: A na-agbazinye akụrụngwa maka ụbọchị dị iche, 4 na 3.
l-m-h3-b0c39-31.s.s1.o.c: Mmadụ 4, ụbọchị 3: otu ụgwọ ọrụ ahụ na ụbọchị mgbazinye ole na ole
l-m-h3-b0c39-31.s.s1.o.d: Mmadụ 3, ụbọchị 4: n’ihi na iji akụrụngwa ogologo oge bụ uru
l-m-h3-b0c39-31.s.s1.r.d: Ụgwọ mgbazinye na-abawanye na ọnụọgụ ụbọchị e ji ya, ya mere ụbọchị 4 na-efu karịa.
l-m-h3-b0c39-31.s.s1.explain: Ụgwọ ọrụ hà nhata: person-days 12 × 100,000 won (10×10,000)=1,200,000 won (120×10,000). Akụrụngwa bụ 90,000 won (9×10,000) maka ụbọchị 3, 120,000 won (12×10,000) maka ụbọchị 4; ya mere mmadụ 4 ụbọchị 3 dị ọnụ ala site na 30,000 won (3×10,000).
l-m-h3-b0c39-31.s.s2.model.0: Atụmatụ abụọ ahụ bụ person-days 12, ya mere ụgwọ ọrụ hà nhata, 1,200,000 won (120×10,000); mana mgbazinye akụrụngwa bụ 90,000 won (9×10,000) ụbọchị 3 na 120,000 won (12×10,000) ụbọchị 4, ya mere mmadụ 4 ụbọchị 3 dị ọnụ ala.
l-m-h3-b0c39-31.s.s2.model.1: Ebe ụgwọ ọrụ hà nhata, ọdịiche sitere na ụbọchị ole e ji akụrụngwa gbazinye. Ụbọchị 3 na-efu 30,000 won (3×10,000) obere karịa ụbọchị 4.

l-m-h3-b0c40-26.s.s1.r.a: Ọ dị mfe, ma oke njehie buru ibu dịka ±1.2 m.

l-m-h3-b0c40-28.goal: Tụlee ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ maka ịgụ tebụl mbupu ngụkọta dịka ụbọchị izu, họrọ nke dabara adaba ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c40-28.material: Mbupu ngụkọta kwa ụbọchị: Mọnde ihe 3, Tuzdee 7, Wenezdee 10, Tọọzdee 12, Fraịdee 13. Nkọwa A: “mbupu na-arịwanye elu ngwa ngwa.” B: “ọ na-aga n’ihu ịbawanye, ma ego mmụba na-ebelata.”
l-m-h3-b0c40-28.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nkọwa dabara tebụl karịa, gịnịkwa kpatara ya?

l-m-h3-b0c40-28.s.s1.r.a: Uru na-abawanye na ego mmụba na-abawanye abụghị otu ihe.
l-m-h3-b0c40-28.s.s1.o.c: Ha abụọ ziri ezi: n’ihi na ọ na-abawanye
l-m-h3-b0c40-28.s.s1.r.c: A kwuru na ego mmụba na-abawanye, nke na-adabaghị na tebụl.
l-m-h3-b0c40-28.s.s1.o.d: A: n’ihi na Fraịdee nwere uru kachasị ukwuu
l-m-h3-b0c40-28.s.s1.r.d: Ilele uru ikpeazụ naanị anaghị agwa gị ọsọ mgbanwe.

l-m-h3-b0c40-29.title: N’etiti dayameta 20 mm na 150 mm, nke ka zie ezie?
l-m-h3-b0c40-29.goal: Tụlee ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ gbasara izi ezi ịtụ dayameta akụkụ abụọ, họrọ nke dabara adaba ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c40-29.material: A tụrụ akụkụ A nke dayameta 20 mm na njehie ±0.2 mm, akụkụ B nke dayameta 150 mm na njehie ±0.9 mm. Anyị chọrọ iji oke tụnyere nke ka zie ezie.
l-m-h3-b0c40-29.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nha ka zie ezi n’oke?
l-m-h3-b0c40-29.s.s1.o.a: A: n’ihi na njehie 0.2 mm dị ntakịrị
l-m-h3-b0c40-29.s.s1.r.a: Nke a na-ele njehie zuru oke naanị. A bụ 1%, B bụ 0.6%.
l-m-h3-b0c40-29.s.s1.o.b: B: njehie ikwu 0.6% pere mpe karịa 1% nke A
l-m-h3-b0c40-29.s.s1.o.c: Ha bụ otu: njehie ha abụọ bụ 1 mm ma ọ bụ obere
l-m-h3-b0c40-29.s.s1.r.c: Ha abụọ erughị 1 mm, ma njehie ikwu dị iche, 1% na 0.6%.
l-m-h3-b0c40-29.s.s1.o.d: Enweghị ike ịma: akụkụ ndị ahụ dị iche
l-m-h3-b0c40-29.s.s1.r.d: Iji njehie ikwu na-enye ohere iji tụnyere ọbụna mgbe ogologo dị iche.
l-m-h3-b0c40-29.s.s1.explain: Njehie ikwu A bụ 0.2÷20=1%, nke B bụ 0.9÷150=0.6%. B ka zie ezi n’oke.
l-m-h3-b0c40-29.s.s2.model.0: A bụ 0.2÷20=1%, B bụ 0.9÷150=0.6%; ya mere B nwere njehie ikwu pere mpe, ọ ka zie ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c40-29.s.s2.model.1: Ebe ogologo dị iche, jiri njehie ikwu tụnyere, ya bụ njehie kewara na ogologo e tụrụ. 0.6% pere mpe karịa 1%; B ka mma.

l-m-h3-b0c40-30.title: Ime ya n’onwe anyị ka ọ bụ nye onye ọzọ?
l-m-h3-b0c40-30.goal: Tụlee ụzọ abụọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta maka ime akụkụ 100, họrọ nke dabara adaba ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c40-30.material: Anyị chọrọ akụkụ 100. Ime ha n’onwe anyị na-efu 30,000 won maka ịtọ akụrụngwa tinyere 500 won n’otu akụkụ; inye onye ọzọ bụ 700 won n’otu akụkụ.
l-m-h3-b0c40-30.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nke dị ọnụ ala maka ịnweta akụkụ 100, gịnịkwa kpatara ya?
l-m-h3-b0c40-30.s.s1.o.a: Ha bụ otu: n’ihi na ọdịiche kwa akụkụ bụ naanị 200 won
l-m-h3-b0c40-30.s.s1.r.a: Maka ọnụọgụ 100, ngụkọta dị iche: 70,000 won na 80,000 won.
l-m-h3-b0c40-30.s.s1.o.b: Ime anyị onwe anyị: n’ihi na ị ga-eji akụrụngwa ugboro ugboro
l-m-h3-b0c40-30.s.s1.r.b: Oge a, ị ga-atụnyere ọnọdụ ime naanị 100.
l-m-h3-b0c40-30.s.s1.o.c: Inye onye ọzọ: ngụkọta 70,000 won, dị ọnụ ala karịa 80,000 won nke ime anyị onwe anyị
l-m-h3-b0c40-30.s.s1.o.d: Ime anyị onwe anyị: n’ihi na 500 won n’otu akụkụ dị ọnụ ala
l-m-h3-b0c40-30.s.s1.r.d: E hapụrụ ụgwọ ịtọ akụrụngwa 30,000 won. Ime anyị onwe anyị na-efu ngụkọta 80,000 won.
l-m-h3-b0c40-30.s.s1.explain: Ime anyị onwe anyị bụ 30,000+500×100=80,000 won; inye onye ọzọ bụ 700×100=70,000 won. Maka akụkụ 100, inye onye ọzọ dị ọnụ ala.
l-m-h3-b0c40-30.s.s2.model.0: Ime anyị onwe anyị na-efu 80,000 won tinyere ụgwọ ịtọ ya, inye onye ọzọ bụ 70,000 won; ya mere maka 100 akụkụ, inye onye ọzọ dị ọnụ ala.
l-m-h3-b0c40-30.s.s2.model.1: Ilele ọnụahịa n’otu akụkụ naanị na-eme ka ime anyị onwe anyị dị ọnụ ala, ma n’ihi ụgwọ ịtọ 30,000 won, inye onye ọzọ dị ọnụ ala na 10,000 won maka akụkụ 100.

l-m-h3-b0c42-04.title: Nyocha nri ehihie ụlọ akwụkwọ: ajụjụ nkee dị mma karịa?
l-m-h3-b0c42-04.goal: Tụlee ụzọ abụọ ma ọ bụ ahịrịokwu ajụjụ abụọ gbasara afọ ojuju nri ehihie; họrọ nke dabara adaba, kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c42-04.material: Ndị a bụ ajụjụ abụọ nyocha afọ ojuju. A: “Kedu ka nri ụlọ akwụkwọ na-adịghị atọ ụtọ si ewute gị?” B: “Afọ ole ka ị nwere maka nri ehihie taa? (Họrọ site n'enweghị afọ ojuju ruo afọ ojuju nke ukwuu)”
l-m-h3-b0c42-04.s.s1.prompt: Ajụjụ nkee ka mma iji chọpụta afọ ojuju?
l-m-h3-b0c42-04.s.s1.o.a: A, n'ihi na ọ na-egosi enweghị afọ ojuju nke ọma
l-m-h3-b0c42-04.s.s1.r.a: Ajụjụ ahụ ewereworị na mmadụ enweghị afọ ojuju, na-edugakwa azịza n'otu akụkụ.
l-m-h3-b0c42-04.s.s1.o.b: A, n'ihi na ahịrịokwu ya dị mkpụmkpụ
l-m-h3-b0c42-04.s.s1.o.c: Ajụjụ abụọ ahụ bụ otu n'ihi na isiokwu bụ otu
l-m-h3-b0c42-04.s.s1.r.c: Ọbụna isiokwu ha hà, ahịrịokwu nwere ike iduzi azịza.
l-m-h3-b0c42-04.s.s1.o.d: B, n'ihi na e dere ya n'enweghị ele mmadụ anya n'ihu, nhọrọ dịkwa n'akụkụ abụọ
l-m-h3-b0c42-04.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ ajụjụ duzie azịza n'otu akụkụ, nsonaazụ ga-agbagọ. Okwu na-enweghị ele mmadụ anya n'ihu na nhọrọ abụọ na-egosi echiche n'ezie.
l-m-h3-b0c42-04.s.s2.model.0: A kpebiri tupu oge na nri anaghị atọ ụtọ, ya mere azịza ga-adabere n'enweghị afọ ojuju; B na-enweghị ele mmadụ anya n'ihu ka mma.
l-m-h3-b0c42-04.s.s2.model.1: B ka mma n'ihi na ndị zara nwere ike ịhọrọ site na enweghị afọ ojuju ruo afọ ojuju nke ukwuu, na-egosi echiche ha n'ezie.

l-m-h3-b0c42-10.title: Variance na standard deviation: nke a ka a ga-ede n’ọkwa?
l-m-h3-b0c42-10.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ, uru abụọ na-egosi mgbasa akara, họrọ nke dabara ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c42-10.material: Otu ule nwere mean isi 60, variance 36 (isi²), standard deviation isi 6. Họrọ uru mgbasa a ga-ede n’akụkụ mean n’ọkwa ezigara ụmụ akwụkwọ.
l-m-h3-b0c42-10.s.s1.prompt: Kedu uru dabara karịa ide n’akụkụ mean?
l-m-h3-b0c42-10.s.s1.o.a: Standard deviation isi 6, n’ihi na nkeji ya bụ otu na akara
l-m-h3-b0c42-10.s.s1.o.b: Nke buru ibu n’ime ha abụọ, n’ihi na mgbasa yiri ka ọ ka ukwuu
l-m-h3-b0c42-10.s.s1.r.b: A họọrọ ya site n’echiche naanị, ọ bụghị ebumnuche.
l-m-h3-b0c42-10.s.s1.o.c: Variance 36, n’ihi na ọ bụ uru a na-eji n’ngụkọta
l-m-h3-b0c42-10.s.s1.r.c: Nkeji ya bụ isi², ya mere o siri ike iji akara tụnyere ozugbo.
l-m-h3-b0c42-10.s.s1.o.d: Variance 36, n’ihi na nọmba ya ziri ezi karịa
l-m-h3-b0c42-10.s.s1.r.d: Variance ezighị ezi karịa; naanị nkeji ya dị iche.
l-m-h3-b0c42-10.s.s1.explain: Standard deviation nwere otu nkeji na akara, ya mere enwere ike ịgụ ya ozugbo, dịka “mean isi 60, mgbasa ihe dịka isi 6”.
l-m-h3-b0c42-10.s.s2.model.0: Standard deviation isi 6 nwere otu nkeji na akara, ya mere enwere ike ịgụ ya n’akụkụ mean isi 60; nke a na-eme ka ọ dabara karịa.
l-m-h3-b0c42-10.s.s2.model.1: Variance nwere nkeji isi², nke na-eme ka o sie ike iji akara tụnyere ozugbo; jiri standard deviation nwere otu nkeji.

l-m-h3-b0c42-32.title: Ọkwa nnabata 20→25%: gịnị ka anyị kwesịrị ide?
l-m-h3-b0c42-32.goal: Tụlee isi akụkọ akwụkwọ akụkọ abụọ gbasara mgbanwe ọkwa nnabata, họrọ nke dabara adaba, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c42-32.material: Ọkwa nnabata si na 20% ruo 25%. Isi akụkọ A: “Ọkwa nnabata rịrị 5%” Isi akụkọ B: “Ọkwa nnabata rịrị 5%p (mmụba 25%)”
l-m-h3-b0c42-32.s.s1.prompt: Kedu isi akụkọ kacha zie ezi?
l-m-h3-b0c42-32.s.s1.o.a: A, ọ rịrị 5, ya mere nsogbu adịghị
l-m-h3-b0c42-32.s.s1.r.a: Enwere ike ịghọta “5%” dị ka 5% nke 20, ya bụ mmụba 1.
l-m-h3-b0c42-32.s.s1.o.b: B, ọ na-ekewa %p na ọnụego mmụba
l-m-h3-b0c42-32.s.s1.o.c: B ezighị ezi, n'ihi na 5%p na 25% dị iche
l-m-h3-b0c42-32.s.s1.r.c: Ha bụ okwu na-atụ ihe dị iche iche, ya mere iji ha ọnụ abụghị ihe na-ezighị ezi.
l-m-h3-b0c42-32.s.s1.r.d: Mmụba 5%p na mmụba 5% pụtara ihe dị iche.
l-m-h3-b0c42-32.s.s1.explain: Site na 20% ruo 25% bụ mmụba 5%p, ma dịka oke ọ bụ mmụba 5÷20=25%. Enwere ike ịghọta “5%” dị ka 5% nke 20 (=1).
l-m-h3-b0c42-32.s.s2.model.0: Isi pasent bụ ọdịiche dị n'etiti ọnụego, ebe mmụba 25% bụ ọnụego mgbanwe ma e jiri 20 tụnyere ya, ya mere B nke kewara ha abụọ ziri ezi karịa.

l-m-h3-b0c42-33.topic: Mgbagọ nke ile naanị ndị lanarịrị/meriri
l-m-h3-b0c42-33.goal: Tụlee nkọwa abụọ gbasara ihe ndị ikpe gara nke ọma nwere otu, họrọ nke dabara adaba, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c42-33.material: A na-ekwu na ndị ọchụnta ego 20 niile gara nke ọma na-eteta n'elekere 5 nke ụtụtụ. A: “Ite aka n'ụtụtụ bụ ihe nzuzo nke ihe ịga nke ọma.” B: “Ọ bụrụ na anyị amaghị mgbe ndị ọchụnta ego dara ada na-eteta, anyị enweghị ike ịkpọ ya ihe nzuzo.”
l-m-h3-b0c42-33.s.s1.prompt: Naanị site na data a, nkwupụta nke dabara adaba bụ nke?
l-m-h3-b0c42-33.s.s1.o.a: A, ha 20 niile bụ otu, ya mere o doro anya
l-m-h3-b0c42-33.s.s1.r.a: O lere naanị ikpe ndị gara nke ọma anya, ọ nyochaghị ndị dara ada.
l-m-h3-b0c42-33.s.s1.o.b: A, ndị na-eteta n'isi ụtụtụ na-arụsi ọrụ ike
l-m-h3-b0c42-33.s.s1.r.b: E gosibeghị na ịrụsi ọrụ ike bụ ihe kpatara ihe ịga nke ọma.
l-m-h3-b0c42-33.s.s1.o.c: B, e gosipụtara na ite aka n'ụtụtụ enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na ihe ịga nke ọma
l-m-h3-b0c42-33.s.s1.r.c: E gosipụtaghị na ha enweghị njikọ; naanị na anyị enweghị ike ịma.
l-m-h3-b0c42-33.s.s1.o.d: B, e nweghị ìgwè ndị dara ada iji tụnyere, ya mere anyị enweghị ike ikpebi
l-m-h3-b0c42-33.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na anyị achịkọta naanị ndị gara nke ọma, anyị agaghị ama ma àgwà ahụ bụkwa ihe a na-ahụkarị n'etiti ndị dara ada. Ya mere anyị enweghị ike ikwubi na ọ bụ ihe nzuzo.
l-m-h3-b0c42-33.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na ndị ọchụnta ego dara ada na-etekwa aka n'ụtụtụ, ọ bụghị ihe nzuzo, ya mere B dabara adaba karịa A nke kwubiri n'enweghị ìgwè ntụnyere.
l-m-h3-b0c42-33.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na ị chịkọta naanị ikpe ndị gara nke ọma, ị gaghị ama ma ihe ha nwere otu nwere njikọ na ihe ịga nke ọma, ya mere B nke na-egosi oke ihe akaebe ahụ dabara adaba karịa.

l-m-h3-b0c43-06.title: Kedu uru kwesịrị ịkọwa mgbasa akara?
l-m-h3-b0c43-06.goal: Tụnyere uru abụọ na-egosi otú data si gbasaa, họrọ nke kacha dabara ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c43-06.material: N’ule mgbakọ na mwepụ, ọtụtụ n’ime akara ụmụ akwụkwọ 20 dị n’etiti isi 70 na 80, otu nwa akwụkwọ nwetara isi 20. Range bụ isi 60, interquartile range bụ isi 8. Họrọ uru ga-akọwa mgbasa nke ọtụtụ ụmụ akwụkwọ.
l-m-h3-b0c43-06.s.s1.prompt: Kedu uru kacha dabara ịkọwa mgbasa nke ọtụtụ ụmụ akwụkwọ?
l-m-h3-b0c43-06.s.s1.o.a: Range isi 60, n’ihi na ọ na-egosi ọdịiche kacha ukwuu
l-m-h3-b0c43-06.s.s1.r.a: Isi 20 nke otu nwa akwụkwọ mere range ka ọ bawanye nke ukwuu.
l-m-h3-b0c43-06.s.s1.o.b: Range isi 60, n’ihi na ọ na-eji data niile
l-m-h3-b0c43-06.s.s1.r.b: Range na-eji naanị ụkpụrụ abụọ, nke kacha elu na nke kacha ala.
l-m-h3-b0c43-06.s.s1.o.c: Ha abụọ bụ otu, n’ihi na ha na-atụ mgbasa
l-m-h3-b0c43-06.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụrụ na e nwere outlier, ụkpụrụ abụọ ahụ na-adị nnọọ iche.
l-m-h3-b0c43-06.s.s1.o.d: Interquartile range isi 8, n’ihi na ọ bụ obosara ọkara etiti
l-m-h3-b0c43-06.s.s1.explain: Otu uru isi 20 na-emetụta range nke ukwuu. Interquartile range bụ obosara ọkara etiti, ya mere ọ na-anọchite anya ọtụtụ ụmụ akwụkwọ nke ọma.
l-m-h3-b0c43-06.s.s2.model.0: N’ihi isi 20 nke otu nwa akwụkwọ, range ghọrọ isi 60; ya mere interquartile range isi 8, obosara ọkara etiti, na-egosi mgbasa nke ọtụtụ ụmụ akwụkwọ nke ọma.
l-m-h3-b0c43-06.s.s2.model.1: Range na-eji naanị ụkpụrụ kacha nta na nke kacha elu, ya mere outlier na-emetụta ya nke ukwuu; interquartile range anaghị emetụta nke ukwuu, ya mere ọ dabara karịa.

l-m-h3-b0c43-27.material: Mmadụ 8 n'ime 10 ndị ṅụrụ ọgwụ ọhụrụ ahụ gbakee. A: “Ọgwụ a nwere mmetụta 80%.” B: “Anyị enweghị ike ikwu maka mmetụta ya ma ọ bụrụ na anyị amaghị ọnụego mgbake nke ìgwè ntụnyere na-aṅụghị ọgwụ ahụ.”
l-m-h3-b0c43-27.s.s1.o.a: B, n'ihi na egosila na ọgwụ ahụ enweghị mmetụta
l-m-h3-b0c43-27.s.s1.r.a: Ọ naghị egosi na mmetụta adịghị; ọ na-ekwu na anyị enweghị ike ịmata.
l-m-h3-b0c43-27.s.s1.o.b: A, n'ihi na mmadụ 10 bụ nnukwu nlele zuru ezu
l-m-h3-b0c43-27.s.s1.r.b: Mmadụ 10 bụ nlele pere mpe nke ohere nwere ike ime ka ọ bụrụ nke na-adịghị nhata.
l-m-h3-b0c43-27.s.s1.o.c: B, anyị enweghị ike ịmata mmetụta ya n'enweghị ìgwè ntụnyere
l-m-h3-b0c43-27.s.s1.o.d: A, n'ihi na mmadụ 8 gbakere, ya mere mmetụta ahụ doro anya
l-m-h3-b0c43-27.s.s1.r.d: O mere nkwupụta siri ike n'amaghị mmadụ ole gaara agbake ọbụna n'enweghị ọgwụ ahụ.
l-m-h3-b0c43-27.s.s1.explain: Ụfọdụ mmadụ na-agbake ọbụna n'ejighị ọgwụ. Naanị site n'ịtụnyere ọnụego mgbake nke ìgwè ntụnyere ka anyị nwere ike ikwu maka mmetụta ọgwụ ahụ.
l-m-h3-b0c43-27.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na ihe dị ka mmadụ 8 nwere ike ịgbake ọbụna n'enweghị ọgwụ ahụ, ọ bụghị mmetụta ọgwụ ahụ; ya mere B dabara adaba karịa A nke kwuru nkwubi okwu siri ike n'enweghị ìgwè ntụnyere.
l-m-h3-b0c43-27.s.s2.model.1: Mmadụ 10 nwere ike ghara ịnọchite anya ndị mmadụ nke ọma n'ihi ohere, e nweghịkwa ụkpụrụ ntụnyere; ya mere B nke kwuru na anyị enweghị ike ịmata mmetụta ahụ dabara adaba karịa.

l-m-h3-b0c43-32.title: Kedu nke na-enwe mgbanwe na-adịghị nhata karịa, nnukwu ụlọ ọgwụ ka ọ bụ obere ụlọ ọgwụ?
l-m-h3-b0c43-32.goal: Tụlee ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ banyere otu ọnụego si agbanwe dabere n'ogo ụlọ ọgwụ, họrọ nke dabara adaba, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c43-32.material: E nwere obere ụlọ ọgwụ ebe a na-amụ ụmụaka 10 kwa ụbọchị ná nkezi, na nnukwu ụlọ ọgwụ ebe a na-amụ 100. N'ime otu afọ, kedu ụlọ ọgwụ ga-enwe ọtụtụ ụbọchị ebe ụmụ nwoke bụ 70% ma ọ bụ karịa n'ime ụmụ amụrụ ụbọchị ahụ? A na-ekwu nnukwu ụlọ ọgwụ, B na-ekwu obere ụlọ ọgwụ.
l-m-h3-b0c43-32.s.s1.prompt: Nkwupụta na ihe kpatara ya nke dabara adaba bụ nke?
l-m-h3-b0c43-32.s.s1.o.a: A, n'ihi na a na-amụ ọtụtụ ụmụaka
l-m-h3-b0c43-32.s.s1.r.a: Ka ụmụaka na-adị ọtụtụ, otú ọnụego ahụ si kwụsie ike na-adịkwa ukwuu.
l-m-h3-b0c43-32.s.s1.o.b: Ha bụ otu, n'ihi na ohere ịmụ nwa nwoke bụ otu
l-m-h3-b0c43-32.s.s1.r.b: Ọbụna ma ohere ahụ hà nhata, ọnụego na-agbanwe karịa mgbe nlele kwa ụbọchị pere mpe.
l-m-h3-b0c43-32.s.s1.o.c: B, n'ihi na a na-amụ ọtụtụ ụmụ nwoke n'obere ụlọ ọgwụ
l-m-h3-b0c43-32.s.s1.r.c: E nweghị ihe akaebe na-egosi na a na-amụ ọtụtụ ụmụ nwoke.
l-m-h3-b0c43-32.s.s1.o.d: B, n'ihi na ka nlele na-adị ntakịrị, otú ọnụego si na-agbanwe na-adị ukwuu
l-m-h3-b0c43-32.s.s1.explain: Ohere na ụmụ nwoke ga-abụ 7 ma ọ bụ karịa n'ime ụmụaka 10 bụ ihe dị ka 17%, mana 70 ma ọ bụ karịa n'ime 100 anaghị eme ihe fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ mgbe niile. Nlele pere mpe na-agbanwe karịa.
l-m-h3-b0c43-32.s.s2.model.0: Maka ụmụaka 10, ohere ụmụ nwoke ga-abụ 7 ma ọ bụ karịa bụ ihe dị ka 17%; maka ụmụaka 100, 70 ma ọ bụ karịa fọrọ nke nta ka ọ ghara ime. Ya mere, obere ụlọ ọgwụ ga-enwe ọtụtụ ụbọchị dị otu a.
l-m-h3-b0c43-32.s.s2.model.1: Ka nlele na-adị ntakịrị, ọnụego na-agbanwe karịa, oke ọnụego dị nnọọ elu apụta ugboro ugboro; ya mere B nke họọrọ obere ụlọ ọgwụ ziri ezi.

l-m-h3-b0c44-27.title: Ego a na-enwetakarị n’obodo: mean ka ọ bụ median?
l-m-h3-b0c44-27.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ gbasara uru nnọchite anya data skewed, họrọ nke dabara ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0c44-27.material: Ego kwa ọnwa (na nde won) nke ezinụlọ 5 n’obodo bụ 3, 3, 4, 4, 50. Iji kọwaa “ego a na-enwetakarị” n’obodo, tụnyere mean, 12.8, na median, 4.
l-m-h3-b0c44-27.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ uru nnọchite anya dabara na ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c44-27.s.s1.o.a: Median 4: uru pụrụ iche 50 anaghị emetụta ya nke ukwuu
l-m-h3-b0c44-27.s.s1.o.b: Mean 12.8: ọ na-eji ụkpụrụ niile, ya mere ọ ziri ezi karịa mgbe niile
l-m-h3-b0c44-27.s.s1.r.b: Otu 50 mere ka mean rịa elu nke ukwuu ma mee ka ọ dị anya n’ihe a na-enwetakarị.
l-m-h3-b0c44-27.s.s1.o.c: Mean 12.8: ọ dị nso na ego ọtụtụ ezinụlọ na-enweta
l-m-h3-b0c44-27.s.s1.r.c: 12.8 ka ukwuu karịa ego ezinụlọ 4 (3 ruo 4) nke ukwuu.
l-m-h3-b0c44-27.s.s1.o.d: Maximum 50: ezinụlọ kasị baa ọgaranya na-anọchite anya obodo
l-m-h3-b0c44-27.s.s1.r.d: Otu ezinụlọ anaghị anọchite anya ihe a na-enwetakarị n’obodo niile.
l-m-h3-b0c44-27.s.s1.explain: Uru pụrụ iche 50 dọtara mean ruo 12.8. Median 4 na-anọchite anya ego ọtụtụ ezinụlọ nke ọma.
l-m-h3-b0c44-27.s.s2.model.0: Otu 50 mere ka mean rịa ruo 12.8 ma mee ka ọ dị anya na ezinụlọ a na-enwetakarị; ya mere median 4 kacha dabara.
l-m-h3-b0c44-27.s.s2.model.1: Median bụ uru etiti, ya mere uru pụrụ iche anaghị eme ka ọ maa jijiji nke ukwuu; nke a na-eme ka ọ dabara ịkọ ego a na-enwetakarị.

l-m-h3-b0c44-28.title: Correlation na ihe kpatara ya: ahịrịokwu dabara bụ nke aṅaa?
l-m-h3-b0c44-28.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ, ahịrịokwu abụọ gbasara correlation na causation; họrọ nke kacha dabara ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0c44-28.material: N’ịtụle data, anyị chọpụtara na ụmụ akwụkwọ na-etinye oge karịa n’egwuregwu na-enwekarị akara dị ala (correlation coefficient −0.5). A: Ụmụ akwụkwọ nwere ogologo oge egwuregwu na-enwekarị akara dị ala. B: Egwuregwu na-eme ka akara daa.
l-m-h3-b0c44-28.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrịokwu dabara data nlele a nke ọma, na ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c44-28.s.s1.o.a: B: Ọ bụrụ na correlation bụ −0.5, akwadoro ihe kpatara ya
l-m-h3-b0c44-28.s.s1.r.a: Correlation coefficient naanị ya enweghị ike igosi ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c44-28.s.s1.o.b: A na B pụtara otu ihe, ya mere nke ọ bụla dabara
l-m-h3-b0c44-28.s.s1.r.b: Ọchịchọ na ihe kpatara ya bụ nkwupụta dị iche.
l-m-h3-b0c44-28.s.s1.o.c: B: Oge egwuregwu na-abịa mbụ, ya mere ọ bụ ihe kpatara ya
l-m-h3-b0c44-28.s.s1.r.c: Usoro oge naanị ya enweghị ike iwepụ ihe kpatara ndị ọzọ, dịka ụra.
l-m-h3-b0c44-28.s.s1.o.d: A: Naanị correlation ka akwadoro, ihe kpatara ya amaghị
l-m-h3-b0c44-28.s.s1.explain: Na data nlele, ị nwere ike ịsị naanị na ihe na-agakọ ọnụ. Iji kwuo na ọ bụ ihe kpatara ya, a ga-achịkwa ihe ndị ọzọ.
l-m-h3-b0c44-28.s.s2.model.0: Data nlele kwadoro naanị ọchịchọ, ya mere A, nke kwuru ọchịchọ, dabara karịa B nke kwuru ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c44-28.s.s2.model.1: Ihe ndị ọzọ dịka oge ụra nwere ike imetụta akara na oge egwuregwu abụọ ahụ, ya mere A dabara karịa.

l-m-h3-b0c44-29.title: Tụnyere ahịrịokwu akụkọ mgbe p-value bụ 0.2
l-m-h3-b0c44-29.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ gbasara ịkọ nsonaazụ ule na-abụghị significant, họrọ nke dabara ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0c44-29.material: Anyị nwalere mmetụta usoro ọmụmụ ọhụrụ, p-value bụ 0.2, nke na-abụghị significant (significance level 0.05). A: E gosipụtara na mmetụta adịghị. B: Anyị enwetaghị ihe akaebe zuru ezu na mmetụta dị.
l-m-h3-b0c44-29.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrịokwu dabara na ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c44-29.s.s1.o.a: B: p-value bụ 0.2, ya mere mmetụta dị
l-m-h3-b0c44-29.s.s1.r.a: p-value buru ibu abụghị ihe akaebe na mmetụta dị.
l-m-h3-b0c44-29.s.s1.o.b: A: 0.2 karịrị 0.05, ya mere mmetụta bụ 0
l-m-h3-b0c44-29.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụrụ na sample pere mpe, ị nwere ike ghara ịhụ ezigbo mmetụta.
l-m-h3-b0c44-29.s.s1.o.c: B: Ihe akaebe ezughị, ma nke ahụ egosighị na mmetụta adịghị
l-m-h3-b0c44-29.s.s1.o.d: A: Ọ bụrụ na p-value buru ibu, a kwụsiela na mmetụta adịghị
l-m-h3-b0c44-29.s.s1.r.d: Ọbụna ma p-value buru ibu, e kpebibeghị na mmetụta adịghị.
l-m-h3-b0c44-29.s.s1.explain: Nsonaazụ na-abụghị significant pụtara na ihe akaebe maka mmetụta ezughị. Ọ pụtaghị na e gosipụtara na mmetụta adịghị.

l-m-h3-b0c45-27.title: Kedu nke dị nso na π, 22/7 ka ọ bụ 3.14?
l-m-h3-b0c45-27.goal: Tụlee ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ, 22/7 na 3.14, dịka atụmatụ π, họrọ nke dabara adaba, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c45-27.material: Archimedes gosiri na π karịrị 3 10/71 ma pere mpe karịa 3 1/7. π bụ ihe dị ka 3.14159. Tụlee atụmatụ 22/7 (= 3 1/7) na 3.14.
l-m-h3-b0c45-27.s.s1.prompt: Kedu uru kacha nso na π?
l-m-h3-b0c45-27.s.s1.o.a: 3.14: ọ bụ ntụpọ, ya mere ọ ziri ezi karịa
l-m-h3-b0c45-27.s.s1.r.a: Ide ya dịka ntụpọ anaghị eme ka ọ ziri ezi karịa.
l-m-h3-b0c45-27.s.s1.o.b: 22/7: njehie ya bụ ihe dị ka 0.0013
l-m-h3-b0c45-27.s.s1.r.c: 22/7 na 3.14 dị iche n'oke njehie ha na π.
l-m-h3-b0c45-27.s.s1.o.d: 22/7: ọ dị ala karịa π, ya mere ọ dị anya karịa
l-m-h3-b0c45-27.s.s1.r.d: 22/7 karịrị π. Tụnyere site n'ogo njehie.
l-m-h3-b0c45-27.s.s1.explain: 22/7≈3.14286, njehie ya bụ ihe dị ka 0.0013, njehie 3.14 bụ ihe dị ka 0.0016; ya mere 22/7 dị ntakịrị nso.
l-m-h3-b0c45-27.s.s2.model.0: Ebe π≈3.14159, ọdịiche na 22/7 bụ ihe dị ka 0.0013, ebe nke 3.14 bụ 0.0016; ya mere 22/7 dị nso.
l-m-h3-b0c45-27.s.s2.model.1: Mgbe i wepụrụ kpọmkwem, akụkụ 22/7 dị obere, ya mere ọ dị nso. Enweghị ike ikwu na ntụpọ ziri ezi karịa naanị n'ihi na ọ bụ ntụpọ.

l-m-h3-b0c45-29.material: Ego kwa afọ (nde won) nke ezinụlọ ise n'otu obodo bụ 20, 20, 21, 22, 200. Nkezi bụ 56.6, etiti bụ 21. Kedu uru ka dabara adaba dịka ego nnọchiteanya obodo a?
l-m-h3-b0c45-29.s.s1.prompt: Kedu uru bụ ego nnọchiteanya dabara adaba karịa?
l-m-h3-b0c45-29.s.s1.o.a: Nkezi 56.6: ọ na-eji uru niile, ya mere ọ ziri ezi
l-m-h3-b0c45-29.s.s1.r.a: Uru buru ibu nke otu ezinụlọ dọtara nkezi elu nke ukwuu.
l-m-h3-b0c45-29.s.s1.o.b: Oke 200: ọ bụ ezinụlọ kasị baa ọgaranya
l-m-h3-b0c45-29.s.s1.r.b: Otu ezinụlọ naanị ya enweghị ike ịnọchite anya obodo niile.
l-m-h3-b0c45-29.s.s1.o.c: Ha bụ otu, ya mere ọ dịghị ihe o mere
l-m-h3-b0c45-29.s.s1.r.c: Ọdịiche dị n'etiti uru abụọ ahụ buru ibu, ya mere echiche ha na-enye dị iche nke ukwuu.

l-m-h3-b0c45-30.title: Gịnị mere egwu okporo ígwè dị na foto ji yie ka ha na-ezukọta n'otu ebe?
l-m-h3-b0c45-30.topic: Echiche anya na ebe ihe na-apụ n'anya
l-m-h3-b0c45-30.goal: Tụlee ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ gbasara egwu okporo ígwè yiri ibe ya n'ihe osise echiche anya, họrọ nke dabara adaba, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c45-30.material: N'ihe osise echiche anya, egwu okporo ígwè yiri ibe ya na-ezukọta n'otu ebe dị anya (ebe ihe na-apụ n'anya). Otu nkwupụta bụ “egwu dị adị na-ezukọta n'ebe dị anya,” nke ọzọ bụ “egwu ahụ yiri ibe ya, ọ bụ naanị na foto ka ha yiri ka ha na-ezukọta.”
l-m-h3-b0c45-30.s.s1.prompt: Kedu n'ime nkwupụta abụọ ahụ nwere ntọala ka mma?
l-m-h3-b0c45-30.s.s1.o.a: Ha na-ezukọta: n'ihi na ahịrị na-ezukọta mgbe i lere ebe dị anya
l-m-h3-b0c45-30.s.s1.r.a: Ihe ị na-ahụ na-ezukọta, mana ha anaghị ezukọ n'ezie.
l-m-h3-b0c45-30.s.s1.o.b: Ha yiri ibe ha: ka ha na-adị anya, akụkụ ị na-ahụ na-adị ntakịrị, ya mere ha yiri ka ha na-ezukọta
l-m-h3-b0c45-30.s.s1.o.c: Ha abụọ ziri ezi: ọ dabere n'otú i si ele ya
l-m-h3-b0c45-30.s.s1.r.c: Oghere dị n'etiti egwu ahụ anaghị agbanwe, ya mere ha anaghị ezukọ.
l-m-h3-b0c45-30.s.s1.o.d: Egwu ahụ gbagọrọ agbagọ, ya mere ha na-ezukọta

l-m-h3-b0c45-31.goal: Tụlee ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ banyere nhazi ndị nwere ike ịdị na bọọdụ Go 19×19, họrọ nke dabara adaba, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h3-b0c45-31.material: Ebe nzute 361 ọ bụla dị na bọọdụ Go 19×19 nwere ike ịbụ oji, ọcha, ma ọ bụ tọgbọ chakoo; ya mere e nwere nhazi kacha ruo 3³⁶¹, ihe dị ka 10¹⁷². A na-atụle na atom dị n'eluigwe na ala dị ihe dị ka 10⁸⁰. Tụlee nkwupụta abụọ ahụ.
l-m-h3-b0c45-31.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nkwupụta nwere ntọala ka mma?
l-m-h3-b0c45-31.s.s1.o.a: Ebe ọ bụ na ndị egwuregwu na-egwu ibe ha n'otu n'otu, ọ fọrọ nke nta ka nhazi ghara ịdị
l-m-h3-b0c45-31.s.s1.r.a: Ọbụna ma ha na-agbanwe ibe ha n'otu n'otu, ọnụ ọgụgụ nhazi ndị nwere ike ịdị buru ibu nke ukwuu.
l-m-h3-b0c45-31.s.s1.o.b: Ọ dị mfe n'ihi na e nwere naanị nhazi 361
l-m-h3-b0c45-31.s.s1.r.b: Ị gwakọtara ọnụ ọgụgụ ebe nzute na ọnụ ọgụgụ nhazi. Ha na-amụba, ya mere ngụkọta ahụ na-ebuwanye ibu.
l-m-h3-b0c45-31.s.s1.o.c: Ọnụọgụ nhazi karịrị ọnụ ọgụgụ atom nke ukwuu, ya mere ọ gaghị ekwe omume
l-m-h3-b0c45-31.s.s1.o.d: Ọ bụrụ na kọmputa dị ngwa, ọ nwere ike ịlele ha niile
l-m-h3-b0c45-31.s.s1.r.d: N'agbanyeghị otú ọ si dị ngwa, nhazi 10¹⁷² karịrị akarị.
l-m-h3-b0c45-31.s.s1.explain: 3³⁶¹≈10¹⁷² ji okpukpu 10⁹² karịa 10⁸⁰. Ịlele ha otu otu agaghị agwụ agwụ.

l-m-h3-b0c46-31.material: A na-ekwu na otu echiche Gris oge ochie kwenyere na enwere ike igosi ogologo ọ bụla dịka oke nọmba zuru ezu abụọ. Diagonal square nwere akụkụ 1 bụ √2. Tụlee okwu abụọ ahụ.

l-m-h3-b0c46-31.s.s1.r.c: A maara ogologo ya dịka √2; ọ bụghị obere irighiri.

l-m-h3-b0c46-31.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na i were √2=p/q, p na q abụọ ga-abụ ọbụna, nke na-emegide ọnọdụ na e belatara oke ahụ; ya mere enweghị ike ide ya dịka oke nọmba zuru ezu.

l-m-h3-b0c47-26.title: N’ime uru pi ochie abụọ ahụ, nke dị nso karịa bụ nke dị aṅaa?
l-m-h3-b0c47-26.goal: Tụnyere ntụru pi ochie abụọ ahụ, họrọ nke dị nso na π ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h3-b0c47-26.material: Pi (π) bụ 3.14159…. Ụzọ ndị Ijipt oge ochie were π dịka 256/81 (ihe dịka 3.1605), ebe ndị Babilọn were ya dịka 25/8 (=3.125).
l-m-h3-b0c47-26.s.s1.o.a: Uru abụọ ahụ dị otu anya site na π
l-m-h3-b0c47-26.s.s1.r.a: Ebe dị iche na π abụghị otu: ihe dịka 0.0189 na 0.0166.
l-m-h3-b0c47-26.s.s1.r.b: Ebe 3.1605 dị na π ka ukwuu, ihe dịka 0.0189.
l-m-h3-b0c47-26.s.s1.o.c: Babịlọn (3.125): ebe ọ dị na π pere mpe
l-m-h3-b0c47-26.s.s1.o.d: Nke ndị Ijipt, nke nwere fraction dị mgbagwoju anya, ziri ezi karịa
l-m-h3-b0c47-26.s.s1.r.d: Ịdị mgbagwoju anya anaghị eme ka ọ bụrụ nke ziri ezi karịa. A ga-atụnyere ebe ha dị iche.
l-m-h3-b0c47-26.s.s1.explain: Ebe dị iche na π=3.14159 bụ ihe dịka 0.0189 maka Ijipt na 0.0166 maka Babịlọn; ya mere uru ndị Babilọn dị ntakịrị nso.
l-m-h3-b0c47-26.s.s2.model.0: 3.1605−3.14159≈0.0189 na 3.14159−3.125≈0.0166; ebe 0.0166 pere mpe, uru ndị Babilọn dị nso karịa.
l-m-h3-b0c47-26.s.s2.model.1: 3.125 dị ala karịa π, 3.1605 dị elu karịa π. Mgbe e tụnyere etu nke ọ bụla si dị anya, nke Babịlọn pere mpe, ya mere ọ dị nso karịa.
